bugzilla.description: log4j-core: Remote code execution in Log4j 2.x when logs contain an attacker-controlled string value

details: Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 (excluding security releases 2.12.2, 2.12.3, and 2.3.1) JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code loaded from LDAP servers when message lookup substitution is enabled. From log4j 2.15.0, this behavior has been disabled by default. From version 2.16.0 (along with 2.12.2, 2.12.3, and 2.3.1), this functionality has been completely removed. Note that this vulnerability is specific to log4j-core and does not affect log4net, log4cxx, or other Apache Logging Services projects.

A flaw was found in the Apache Log4j logging library in versions from 2.0.0 and before 2.15.0. A remote attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters, can execute arbitrary code on the server via JNDI LDAP endpoint.
cve.mitigation:
For Log4j versions >=2.10
set the system property log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups or the environment variable LOG4J_FORMAT_MSG_NO_LOOKUPS to true
For Log4j versions >=2.7 and <=2.14.1
all PatternLayout patterns can be modified to specify the message converter as %m{nolookups} instead of just %m
For Log4j versions >=2.0-beta9 and <=2.10.0
remove the JndiLookup class from the classpath. For example: 
```
zip -q -d log4j-core-*.jar org/apache/logging/log4j/core/lookup/JndiLookup.class
```
On OpenShift 4 and in OpenShift Logging, the above mitigation can be applied by following the steps in this article: https://access.redhat.com/solutions/6578421
On OpenShift 3.11, mitigation to the affected Elasticsearch component can be applied by following the steps in this article: https://access.redhat.com/solutions/6578441

cve.statement:
This issue only affects log4j versions between 2.0  and 2.14.1. In order to exploit this flaw you need:
- A remotely accessible endpoint with any protocol (HTTP, TCP, etc) that allows an attacker to send arbitrary data,
- A log statement in the endpoint that logs the attacker controlled data.
In Red Hat OpenShift Logging the vulnerable log4j library is shipped in the Elasticsearch components. Because Elasticsearch is not susceptible to remote code execution with this vulnerability due to use of the Java Security Manager and because access to these components is limited, the impact by this vulnerability is reduced to Moderate.
As per upstream applications using Log4j 1.x may be impacted by this flaw if their configuration uses JNDI. However, the risk is much lower. This flaw in Log4j 1.x is tracked via https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2021-4104 and has been rated as having Moderate security impact.
CodeReady Studio version 12.21.1 was released containing a fix for this vulnerability.
The following products are NOT affected by this flaw and have been explicitly listed here for the benefit of our customers.
- Red Hat Enterprise Linux
- Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management for Kubernetes 
- Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes
- Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform (Engine and Tower)
- Red Hat Certificate System
- Red Hat Directory Server
- Red Hat Identity Management
- Red Hat CloudForms 
- Red Hat Update Infrastructure
- Red Hat Satellite
- Red Hat Ceph Storage
- Red Hat Gluster Storage
- Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation
- Red Hat OpenStack Platform
- Red Hat Virtualization
- Red Hat Single Sign-On
- Red Hat 3scale API Management

            "base_score": 9.8,

          "cwe": "CWE-20",
          "details": [
            "Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 (excluding security releases 2.12.2, 2.12.3, and 2.3.1) JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code loaded from LDAP servers when message lookup substitution is enabled. From log4j 2.15.0, this behavior has been disabled by default. From version 2.16.0 (along with 2.12.2, 2.12.3, and 2.3.1), this functionality has been completely removed. Note that this vulnerability is specific to log4j-core and does not affect log4net, log4cxx, or other Apache Logging Services projects.",
            "A flaw was found in the Apache Log4j logging library in versions from 2.0.0 and before 2.15.0. A remote attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters, can execute arbitrary code on the server via JNDI LDAP endpoint."
          ],
          "mitigation": "For Log4j versions >=2.10\nset the system property log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups or the environment variable LOG4J_FORMAT_MSG_NO_LOOKUPS to true\nFor Log4j versions >=2.7 and <=2.14.1\nall PatternLayout patterns can be modified to specify the message converter as %m{nolookups} instead of just %m\nFor Log4j versions >=2.0-beta9 and <=2.10.0\nremove the JndiLookup class from the classpath. For example: \n```\nzip -q -d log4j-core-*.jar org/apache/logging/log4j/core/lookup/JndiLookup.class\n```\nOn OpenShift 4 and in OpenShift Logging, the above mitigation can be applied by following the steps in this article: https://access.redhat.com/solutions/6578421\nOn OpenShift 3.11, mitigation to the affected Elasticsearch component can be applied by following the steps in this article: https://access.redhat.com/solutions/6578441",

response.body_text:
Today, we published a revised edition of Directive 068: Security Deposits.
We made the following revisions to the directive:
Added guidance regarding security deposits for new or amended oilfield waste management facility applications (section 3.1.3).
Revised the notice period for nonrenewal and cancellation of letters of credit from 60 days to 90 days (section 4.2).
Added demand forfeiture bonds (DFBs) to the list of acceptable forms of security (section 4.3). We will now accept surety bonds in the form of an AER-approved DFB from licensees of oil, gas, geothermal, and brine-hosted mineral developments.
Revised how interest accrued from a cash security deposit is refunded (section 7).
Removed references to monthly bank statements.
The AER-approved DFB is the only form of surety bond accepted by the AER. The DFB will be available on our liability management forms webpage. We will only accept it without alteration.
We will only accept surety from providers with active operations in Canada and an A rating (or equivalent) from a credit-rating agency acceptable to the AER.
The revised edition of Directive 068 is available on the directive landing page.
Direct any questions regarding security deposits to Directive068@aer.ca. All other questions can be directed to our Customer Contact Centre by phone at 403-297-8311 (1-855-297-8311 toll free) or by email at inquiries@aer.ca.

Replaces the previous edition released on July 4, 2023.
Released with Bulletin 2025-04.
See section 1.3 of the directive for what’s new.
Purpose of this Directive
This directive sets out the requirements for completing and submitting a site-specific liability assessment (SSLA). These directive applies to all liability management programs administered under the Oil and Gas Conservation Rules, Brine-Hosted Mineral Resource Development Rules, and Geothermal Resource Development Rules. It does not apply to sites subject to liability management programs administered under the specified enactments (e.g., the Mine Financial Security Program, which is authorized under the Environmental Protection and Enhancement Act).
The aim of this directive is to improve the consistency and accuracy of liability assessments submitted to the AER. They do not modify requirements on how to provide reasonable care and measures, contamination management (including remediation), suspension, abandonment, and reclamation activities.

food_group_id.description: Restrict to one AFCD food group (see list_food_groups); joins the food catalogue.

page.description: 1-based page of the client-side paginated result (the API returns the whole list).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the food name and inclusions.

sort.description: Row order: value_desc (default), value_asc or name (AFCD alphabetical).

post.description:
After search_foods, list_foods_in_group or foods_by_nutrient returned a pfk, or when the user pastes an AFCD food URL. Answers 'nutrients in Vegemite' (F008785).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

pfk.description: Public Food Key such as F008785 (Vegemite); case-insensitive. Give either pfk or url. Pattern: ^[Ff][0-9]{6}$.

url.description: An AFCD food page URL (https://www.foodstandards.gov.au/science-data/food-nutrient-databases/afcd/search/food/F008785) or legacy link (https://afcd.foodstandards.gov.au/foodDetails.aspx?PFKID=F008785).

response.description: Commercial, thick dark brown, salty concentrated yeast extract spread made by treating yeast with acid. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2 and B3.
response.name: Spread, yeast, vegemite

nutrients.name: Total long chain omega 3 fatty acids (%)
Total long chain omega 3 fatty acids (mg)

references.reference_desc: Australian Government Analytical Laboratory. (1991) Analysis of Breakfast Cereals. Unpublished, commissioned laboratory report to National Food Authority.
Based on the scientific literature and/or product ingredients, the retinol content of these foods is insignificant or zero and has been specified as zero.
Based on the scientific literature, the cholesterol content of these foods is insignificant or zero and has been specified as zero.
National Measurement Institute. (2008) Adult Key Foods Program. Commissioned report to Food Standards Australia New Zealand.
National Measurement Institute. (2010) Australian Health Survey Program. Report commissioned by Food Standards Australia New Zealand.

response.sampling_details: The majority of nutrient data were derived from individual and composite samples of 8 purchases of Kraft Vegemite purchased nationally in each state and territory capital city in 2008. Some proximates, vitamins and minerals were also derived from a composite of 5 samples of Kraft Vegemite purchased from five states across Australia in 2010. Folate and folic acid were determined in the 5 individual samples from the 2010 analysis. Retinol, vitamin D and cholesterol were imputed zero. Note that sample is likely to contain carbohydrates not detected with analytical techniques used and were represented by an estimated starch value in this profile.
response.sub_food_group: Yeast, and yeast vegetable or meat extracts

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

foods.description: Commercial thick, dark brown concentrated yeast extract spread. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2 and B3.
foods.name: Spread, yeast, marmite
foods.sampling_details: The majority of nutrient data were from Sanitarium industry data (2008). Other nutrient data were derived from a composite of 6 samples of Sanitarium Marmite purchased in Adelaide in 1990. Folate and folic acid were borrowed from NZ Food Composition Database, ID P1004 Spread, yeast extract, Marmite, Sanitarium, fortified vitamins B1, B2, B3, B12 & folate, & Fe. Fe was from NZFSA 2005. Note high fibre content which should be used with caution. The analysed nitrogen value was reduced by 10% to account for purine nitrogen. Alpha-tocopherol and I were imputed from vegemite. Fatty acids were borrowed from USDA SR Legacy, FDC ID 175043  - Leavening agents, yeast, baker's, active dry. Vitamins (C, D, retinol), alcohol and caffeine were imputed zero.

post.description:
To find the nutrient code for foods_by_nutrient (e.g. 'iron' -> FE, 'sodium' -> NA, 'energy' -> ENERGY-04) or to read how AFCD defines a nutrient.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category_id.description: Restrict to one category: PRO (Proximates), OA (Organic acids), MNS (Minerals), VIT (Vitamins), FA (Fatty acids), AA (Amino acids) or OTHER.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against nutrient code and name (e.g. 'iron', 'FE', 'vitamin').

categories.description: Proximates are nutrients that contribute energy to a food or beverage.
Group of organic compounds containing the carboxylic group -C(O)OH, formed by the oxidation of aldehydes. Generally analysed by chromotography.

Minerals are inorganic substances needed in the diet in small amounts to help regulate body function. From around the mid 1990's onwards, most mineral levels have been determined using inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) or inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES). Before that time, atomic absorption spectroscopy was used for most mineral determination unless noted otherwise. The more recent techniques are more sensitive and therefore likely to be more reliable for minerals present in low levels.
Vitamins are organic compounds that are needed in the diet in small amounts.

Fatty acids are classified as saturated, polyunsaturated or monounsaturated depending on the presence or absence of double bonds on the carbon molecules. Saturated fatty acids contain no double bond, monounsaturated fatty acids contain one double bond per molecule, and polyunsaturated fatty acids contain more than one double bond per molecule. Polyunsaturated fatty acids can be further subdivided into those that are omega - 6 fatty acids and those that are omega - 3 fatty acids. Although all fatty acid values reported have been generated using chromatographic methods the more recent data are considered more reliable as newer techniques are better able to separate closely related fatty acids, particularly where these occur in very low levels. Fatty acids have been measured as a percentage of all extracted fatty acids and this has been converted to a mass of fatty acids using the measured fat content of the food and a conversion factor (Greenfield and Southgate, 2003: Mooney et al., 2002: Nichols, Virtue et al., 1998: Nichols, Mooney et al., 1998: Nichols et al., 2002)

Dietary amino acids are classified as essential or non-essential. Essential amino acids cannot be manufactured by the body and must be supplied in the diet. The non-essential amino acids are also essential for health, but can be synthesized in the body from the essential amino acids. Tryptophan, an essential amino acid was determined using a separate HPLC procedure or a colorimetric procedure.

nutrients.definition: Determined largely by using inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS).

post.description:
Search affiliate product listings by keyword, identifier, price, brand, merchant or network.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0025 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

keyword.description: Plain-text search such as `JBL speaker`; sent as the string form of `search`.

search.description: Filter objects `{ field, value, operator }`, ANDed together. Fields include any, name, brand, category, barcode, sku, asin, merchant.id, network.id, final_price, currency, availability, on_sale, merchant.countries. Operators: =, !=, LIKE, NOT LIKE, >, <, >=, <=, NOT NULL. `||` in value ORs values.

query.description: Rule builder `{ rules_operator: any|all, rules: [{ conditions_operator, conditions: [{ field, operator, value }] }] }`. Exclusive with keyword and search.

per_page.description: Products per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10 here.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1.

after.description: Deep-pagination cursor from the previous response's meta.after, for results past 10,000 on plans that allow it.

exact_total.description: Count meta.total past 10,000 precisely, at some extra latency.

fields.description: Product fields to return, for example `id`, `name`, `final_price`, `urls`.

duplicate_fields_to_exclude.description: Deduplicate by name, image_url, direct_url, barcode or merchant.id. Comma syntax applies each independently and accepts `[N]` caps (`name,merchant.id[10]`); `a||b` drops a row when either has appeared.

facets.description: Aggregations to include: network, merchant, final_price, or dotted sub-fields such as network.name.

sort_by.description: Sort field: relevance, id, barcode, ean, gtin, upc, isbn, asin, name, currency, regular_price, final_price, sale_discount, stock_quantity, commissionable_status, brand, category, color, gender, size, author, network.id, network.name, merchant.id, merchant.name, added_at, updated_at.

balanced_mix.description: `{ field, max_per_value, interleave?, weights? }` to keep one merchant or brand from dominating. Not combinable with duplicate_fields_to_exclude.

Dear Guest,
Thank you for your wonderful review and for choosing Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection.

We are truly honored to hear that, among the many 5-star hotels you have experienced in Ho Chi Minh City, your stay with us stands out as the best. Your recognition means a great deal to our entire team.

We are especially delighted that our service was the highlight of your visit. Delivering warm, personalized, and memorable hospitality is at the heart of everything we do, and it is rewarding to know that our associates made such a positive impression. We are also pleased that you enjoyed our modern facilities and well-appointed amenities, designed to provide both comfort and convenience throughout your stay.

Thank you once again for your kind words and recommendation. We are thrilled to know that we have earned your trust, and we look forward to welcoming you back to Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection on your next trip to Ho Chi Minh City.

Vinpearl L

reviews.title: Exceptional

response.text:
Dear Guest,
Thank you for choosing Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection once again and for sharing your wonderful feedback.

We are truly honored to know that your second stay with us was both excellent and memorable. Your comment that "everything is perfect" is incredibly rewarding for our entire team and serves as great motivation for us to continue delivering exceptional experiences.

It is always a pleasure to welcome returning guests, and we sincerely appreciate your continued trust and support. We look forward to creating many more memorable moments with you on your next visit.

Warm regards,
Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection

response.text:
Dear Guest,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We are delighted to know that you found Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection to be a very good place to stay. We truly appreciate your recognition of the experience we strive to provide.

At the same time, we understand your concerns regarding the pricing and appreciate your honest comments. We continuously work to deliver exceptional service, facilities, and memorable experiences that reflect the value of staying at one of Ho Chi Minh City's landmark destinations.

Thank you once again for your valuable feedback. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back for an even more enjoyable stay in the future.

Warm regards,
Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection

response.text:
Dear Guest,
Thank you for sharing your feedback and for highlighting our location as the best in Ho Chi Minh City. We are delighted that you enjoyed the convenience and unique setting of Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection.

At the same time, we sincerely regret that our breakfast buffet did not meet your expectations. We appreciate your candid comments regarding the variety and quality of the offerings, especially in comparison with your experience at Vinpearl Phu Quoc. Your observations have been shared with our culinary team for review as we continuously seek ways to enhance our breakfast experience and better cater to our guests' preferences.

Thank you once again for your valuable feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide an even more satisfying dining experience on your next visit.

Warm regards,
Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection

post.description:
Find wholesale products and suppliers in Alibaba's public keyword listing (/premium/<keyword>.html), which is mostly sponsored placements. Returns 40 offers per page with source price strings and MOQ, not normalized price or verified inventory. Pass the returned next_cursor as cursor for the next page; the listing serves about 50 pages (2,000 offers), so has_more is false past page 50 even when source_total is larger. Narrow the query to reach offers beyond that.

post.description:
To see which partners AlphaFold DB predicts a protein binds and how confident each interface is. These are predictions from a selective dataset (AlphaFold DB shows NVIDIA complexes only above its own pDockQ2 and ipSAE cut-offs), so a missing partner is not evidence of no interaction, and partners can come from other species: check each partner's organism.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。

gene.description: Gene symbol (TP53, CD52, HLA-A), resolved to the one reviewed (Swiss-Prot) UniProt entry with that gene name, or that synonym, in organism. A symbol shared by several entries is invalid_input listing them.

id.description: UniProt accession (P04637), isoform (P04637-2), entry name (P53_HUMAN), AlphaFold DB model ID (AF-P04637-F1, AF-0000000000710001) or alphafold.ebi.ac.uk entry URL; case-insensitive. Exactly one of id and gene.

limit.description: Most complexes to return, highest ipTM first.

min_iptm.description: Only complexes with ipTM at least this (0.8 keeps confident interfaces).

organism.description: Organism for gene: NCBI taxonomy ID (9606) or name (human, Mus musculus). Default 9606 (human). Only with gene.

post.description:
To check whether a protein has a reliable predicted 3D structure and which residue ranges are ordered or likely disordered, e.g. before choosing a construct, docking, or judging where a variant sits. For experimentally determined structures use rcsb-org structures/search with uniprot_accession; for function and annotation use uniprot-org proteins/get.

feature.description: Feature filter url_name (e.g. note-taking, privacy-focused, ad-free). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$.

license.description: License filter url_name (e.g. free, opensource, gpl-3.0, mit). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$.

page.description: 1-based page; pass the returned next_cursor to continue.

platform.description: Platform filter url_name from a previous result's platforms[].url_name or filters.platforms (e.g. android, windows, mac, linux, online, self-hosted). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$.

sort.description: Site sort options beyond the default ranking.

alternatives.name: Lemmy
alternatives.short_description: Lemmy is similar to sites like Reddit, Lobste.rs, or Hacker News: you subscribe to forums you're interested in, post links and discussions, then vote, and comment on them. Behind the scenes, it is very different; anyone can easily run a server, and all these servers are...

top_opinions.text:
Has a good, fast and smooth interface.
Also its Opensource and federated.
It's basically Reddit, but federated. Feels quite natural to use.
No ads, no fake comments/posts, and no hate or rage baiting content

alternatives.name: Raddle
alternatives.short_description: Unsatisfied with the few link sharing communities that were available and their proprietary, untransparent and non-secure nature, ziq made the original raddle.me (then known as raddit.me) with Wordpress, but it had a lot of limitations.

top_opinions.text: its pretty good and i must say i really enjoyed it! this website reaaaly deserves more users!

I think raddle is good for link sharing, but reddit is more user friendly. I am neutral.
Raddle:MEWPRODUCTIONS

alternatives.name: Hacker News
alternatives.short_description: Hacker News is a social news website that caters to programmers and entrepreneurs, delivering content related to computer science and entrepreneurship.

top_opinions.text: Similar content and community with more in-depth discussions
This website doesn't really function like reddit at all. The only thing they have in common is that they both use a karma system.
Users cannot create communities, and the website itself has little to nothing in common  with Reddit. It's certainly not an alternative to Reddit.

alternatives.name: Minds
alternatives.short_description: An open-source platform for decentralized social networking. Users can monetize posts through ads or monthly support, engaging in various features such as Blogs, Videos, and secure private chats. Minds supports free speech and facilitates sharing across networks and exploring global trends.

top_opinions.text: It is more Twitter-like than Reddit-like.
Minds is closer to Facebook than Reddit.
It's a social network. It's an alternative for Facebook or Twitter

alternatives.name: Quora
alternatives.short_description: People come to Quora to ask questions about any subject, read high quality knowledge that's personalized and relevant to them, and share their own knowledge with others. Quora is a place to share knowledge and better understand the world.

top_opinions.text: Quora might not have all of Reddit's features and versatility, but many people use Reddit as just a Q&A site. For that purpose, Quora is a good alternative.
Quora is spinach, Reddit is cake, one is just question and answers (like Yahoo answers), the other you go to in order to have fun
Quora's login model is super-annoying, and it's not really a flexible open forum the way reddit can be.

license.long_name: MIT License

alternatives.name: Phuks
alternatives.short_description: An alternative to Reddit and Voat. It has the original Voat culture of open expression. Most users on the site are interested in web development but mostly only chat about that in IRC.

top_opinions.text: The community is very pleasant
Spontaneous, unbiased, and with a strong sense of community. If you're looking for a Reddit alternative, you should start from here.
Civil, non-political, open to all views, friendly users.

license.long_name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

alternatives.name: PieFed
alternatives.short_description: PieFed is a link aggregator, a forum, a hub of social interaction and information, built for the fediverse. the focus is on individual control, safety, and decentralised power.

license.long_name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

alternatives.name: Infinity for Reddit+
alternatives.short_description: A Reddit client on Android written in Java. It does not have any ads and it features a clean UI and smooth browsing experience.

top_opinions.text: Not a reddit alternative, just an app.
From what i am hearing people are calling it just an app, pretty sure they meant a frontend alternative
It's just an app for displaying Reddit, not an alternative.

alternatives.name: Tildes
alternatives.short_description: A non-profit community site driven by its users' interests.

top_opinions.text: The average quality of discussion seems to be higher then reddit. It also has an interesting set of features which makes high quality discussions more likely.
Very heavy handed moderation to the point where it stifles all creativity and freedom of thought.

alternatives.name: Digg
alternatives.short_description: Platform for discovering, following, and engaging in topic-specific communities through content submission, voting, transparent moderation, anti-spam verification, web or mobile access, integrations, favorite pinning, and an optional AI-created podcast featuring trending stories.

top_opinions.text: It doesn't allow users to post content. It allows only commenting on content.
Doesn't let users to post content or leave comments, the main functionalities of Reddit.

response.comment_summary: Lemmy is praised for its decentralized, federated structure, and open-source nature, offering a fast, lightweight interface similar to Reddit. Users appreciate the potential to create communities and enjoy fewer trolls, promoting better privacy. However, concerns exist over its lack of a privacy policy, censorship aspects, and inadequate documentation. While some find it a great Reddit alternative, others criticize its user base and lack of certain Reddit features.
response.creator: Dessalines
response.description:
Lemmy is similar to sites like Reddit, Lobste.rs, or Hacker News: you subscribe to forums you're interested in, post links and discussions, then vote, and comment on them. Behind the scenes, it is very different; anyone can easily run a server, and all these servers are federated (think email), and connected to the same universe, called the Fediverse.

For a link aggregator, this means a user registered on one server can subscribe to forums on any other server, and can have discussions with users registered elsewhere.

The overall goal is to create an easily self-hostable, decentralized alternative to Reddit and other link aggregators, outside of their corporate control and meddling.

Each Lemmy server can set its own moderation policy; appointing site-wide admins, and community moderators to keep out the trolls, and foster a healthy, non-toxic environment where all can feel comfortable contributing.

# Features: 
- Open source, AGPL License.
- Self hostable, easy to deploy.
 - Comes with Docker and Ansible.
- Clean, mobile-friendly interface.
- Only username and password are required to sign up!
- User avatar support.
- Live-updating Comment threads.
- Full vote scores (+/-) like old Reddit.
- Themes, including light, dark, and solarized.
- Emojis with autocomplete support. Start typing :
- User tagging using @, Community tagging using !.
- Integrated image uploading in both posts and comments.
- Flexible posts can consist of a title and a combination of self text, URL, or nothing.
- Notifications, on comment replies and when you're tagged.
 - Notifications can be sent via email.
- Private messaging support.
- i18n / internationalization support.
- RSS / Atom feeds for All, Subscribed, Inbox, User, and Community.
- Cross-posting support.
- Automatic related post search when creating new posts. Great for question / answer communities and reposts.
- Moderation abilities.
 - Public Moderation Logs.
 - Can sticky posts to the top of communities.
 - Both site admins, and community moderators, who can appoint other moderators.
 - Can lock, remove, and restore posts and comments.
 - Can ban and unban users from communities and the site.
 - Can transfer site and communities to others.
Can fully erase your data, replacing all posts and comments.
NSFW post / community support.
- High performance.
 - Server is written in rust.
 - Front end is ~80kB gzipped.
 - Supports arm64 / Raspberry Pi.

reviews.body: Lightweight interface that is fast like lightning as well as open source and federated. What is there not to love?

Beware they still have no privacy policy despite being given plenty of links explaining how to create one & appear to be at least somewhat hostile to "right-wingers" which is precisely why a lot of people have left reddit. An alternative with the same issues as the original serves zero purpose.

_[Edited by nathalto, August 16]_

Yet Another Feddi


Like any other flavor of Feddiverse “allows free speech” is their highest moral crime

Probably the most well developed open source reddit alternative, with features added constantly.

reading posts incrementally is still too hard unlike reddit with reddit enhancement suite (which has a few other nice features that lemmy does not have yet).
Cool application but the user base sucks
Lemmy is just as fun and interactive as Reddit, but with better privacy and less trolls.
Federated alternative to Reddit

post.description:
Get public Amazon.com.br product details by ASIN or URL: title, brand, BRL price and list price, stock text, buy-box seller and shipper ('Vendido por' / 'Enviado por'), rating summary, images, feature bullets, specifications and variations.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

asin.description: Amazon.com.br ASIN, or ISBN-10 for books. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{10}$.

url.description: HTTPS amazon.com.br /dp/ASIN or /gp/product/ASIN URL. Supply this or asin. Pattern: ^https://(?:www\.)?amazon\.com\.br/(?:[^?#]*/)?(?:dp|gp/product)/[A-Za-z0-9]{10}(?:[/?#]|$).

features: SOM VIBRANTE E POTENTE - Experimente um áudio aprimorado — vocais mais nítidos, graves mais potentes — para uma experiência Echo Dot ainda mais imersiva.
SUAS MÚSICAS E CONTEÚDOS FAVORITOS - Reproduza músicas e podcasts do Amazon Music, Apple Music, Spotify, entre outros, ou por Bluetooth em todos os ambientes da sua casa.

SEMPRE DISPONÍVEL PARA AJUDAR - Pergunte a previsão do tempo para Alexa, defina timers com sua voz, obtenha respostas e ouça piadas. Precisa de mais uns minutinhos de sono pela manhã? É só tocar no seu Echo Dot para adiar o alarme.

MAIS CONFORTO EM CASA - Controle dispositivos de casa inteligente compatíveis por voz ou com rotinas ativadas por sensores de temperatura internos. Crie rotinas para ligar o ar condicionado se a temperatura interna estiver mais quente que o ideal.

DESENVOLVIDO PARA PROTEGER A SUA PRIVACIDADE - A Amazon não vende informações pessoais de clientes. O Echo Dot foi construído com várias camadas de controles de privacidade, incluindo o botão de desligar o microfone.
APROVEITE AO MÁXIMO O PAREAMENTO DE DISPOSITIVOS - Escute música na casa toda usando os dispositivos Echo compatíveis em cômodos diferentes ou crie um sistema de home theater com o Fire TV.

specifications.name: Peso
specifications.value: 304 gramas. O tamanho e o peso reais podem variar de acordo com o processo de fabricação.

specifications.name: Conectividade wifi
specifications.value: Wifi de banda dupla suporta redes 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (2,4 e 5 GHz). Incompatível com a conexão a redes wifi ad-hoc (ou ponto a ponto).

specifications.name: Compatibilidade com dispositivos de Casa Inteligente
specifications.value: Wifi, Bluetooth Low Energy e Matter.

specifications.name: Conectividade Bluetooth
specifications.value: Oferece suporte ao Perfil de distribuição de áudio avançada (A2DP) para streaming de áudio do seu dispositivo móvel para o Echo Dot ou do Echo Dot para o seu alto-falante Bluetooth. Perfil de controle remoto de áudio/vídeo (AVRCP) para controle de voz de dispositivos móveis conectados. O controle por voz no modo de mãos livres não é compatível com dispositivos Mac OS X. Os alto-falantes Bluetooth que exigem códigos PIN não são compatíveis.

specifications.name: Requisitos do sistema
specifications.value: O Echo Dot vem pronto para se conectar à rede wifi. O aplicativo Alexa é compatível com dispositivos Fire OS, Android e iOS. A lista de sistemas operacionais compatíveis pode ser encontrada aqui. Determinadas Skills e serviços podem exigir taxas de inscrição ou outros tipos de taxa.

specifications.name: Tecnologia de configuração
specifications.value: A configuração simples de wifi da Amazon permite que clientes conectem dispositivos inteligentes à rede wifi em poucas etapas fáceis. A configuração simples de wifi é outra maneira pela qual Alexa se torna cada vez mais inteligente. Saiba mais.

specifications.name: Garantia
specifications.value: Garantia limitada por 1 ano inclusa. O uso do Echo está sujeito aos termos encontrados aqui.

specifications.name: Recursos de acessibilidade
specifications.value: O aplicativo Alexa e os produtos habilitados para Alexa incluem vários recursos para clientes com necessidades de acessibilidade relacionadas à visão, audição, mobilidade e fala. Saiba mais sobre a acessibilidade de Alexa.

specifications.name: Inclusos na caixa
specifications.value: Echo Dot 5ª geração, adaptador de energia bivolt na cor branca (15W) e Guia de início rápido

specifications.name: Recursos de privacidade
specifications.value: Tecnologia de palavra de ativação, indicadores de streaming, botão de desligamento do microfone, capacidade de visualizar e excluir suas gravações de voz e muito mais. Visite o Portal de privacidade de Alexa para explorar como Alexa e os dispositivos Echo são desenvolvidos para proteger sua privacidade.

specifications.name: Skills e recursos de Alexa
specifications.value: Alexa torna sua vida mais fácil, significativa e divertida ao permitir que a sua voz controle seu mundo. Alexa ajuda você a aproveitar mais ainda as coisas que já ama e descobrir novas possibilidades inimagináveis. Descubra e saiba tudo o que Alexa pode fazer. Você pode encontrar anúncios em dispositivos Echo e Alexa.

specifications.name: Atualizações de segurança de software
specifications.value: Este dispositivo recebe atualizações de segurança de software garantidas até pelo menos quatro anos após o dispositivo estar disponível pela última vez para compra como uma nova unidade em nossos sites. Saiba mais sobre essas atualizações de segurança de software. Se você já possui um Amazon Echo, acesse a página Gerencie seu conteúdo e dispositivos para obter informações específicas do seu dispositivo.

features: MAAK KENNIS MET ALEXA: Echo Dot is een smartspeaker met spraakbesturing die verbonden kan worden met Alexa om muziek af te spelen, timers en wekkers in te stellen, vragen te stellen, je huis slimmer te maken met compatibele apparaten en nog veel meer. Het enige wat je moet doen, is het vragen. Beschikbaar in het Nederlands.
KRACHTIGE SOUND, KLEIN FORMAAT: Onze bestseller Echo met heldere klanken, diepe bas en een vol geluid in elke ruimte.

MUZIEK BEDIENEN MET JE STEM: Vraag Alexa om muziek en podcasts af te spelen vanaf je favoriete aanbieders zoals Amazon Music, Apple Music, Spotify en luister naar radiostations. Koppel je smartphone via bluetooth en stream door je hele ruimte.
ALEXA HELPT JE GRAAG: Vraag Alexa naar het weerbericht, om handsfree timers in te stellen, naar een antwoord op je vragen en zelfs om moppen te vertellen.

MAAK HET JE MAKKELIJK IN HUIS: Bedien compatibele smarthome-apparaten met je stem of met routines die geactiveerd worden door binnentemperatuursensoren. Je kunt routines instellen om slimme ventilatoren automatisch in te schakelen als de binnentemperatuur hoger is dan de door jou ingestelde omgevingstemperatuur.

top_reviews.author: Luc Wijdeveld
top_reviews.text: Kocht het als toevoeging van mijn Eufy video deurbel. Kende het wel, maar had al eerder terug gestuurd omdat ik er niks mee kon. Nu kan ik er wel wat mee, Alexa verteld mij als er iemand aanbelt, als ik de bel niet heb gehoord. 's Morgens roep ik dan: "Alexa, goedemorgen" en je krijgt de noviteit van de dag. top_reviews.title: Gekocht als toevoeging op mijn Eufy video deurbel.

top_reviews.author: Fran
top_reviews.text:
Aaw, ik wilde twee Echo Dots (5e generatie) cadeau geven aan mijn zoons. Omdat ik zelf totaal geen ervaring had met slimme speakers en niet wist of het wel écht leuk zou zijn, heb ik besloten er drie te kopen: twee als cadeau en één voor mijzelf. Dankzij de Black Friday-deals was de prijs bovendien heel aantrekkelijk.
Inmiddels heb ik mijn eigen Echo Dot uitgebreid getest (witte uitvoering) en die staat nu standaard in mijn studio. En eerlijk is eerlijk: ik ben verkocht.
Uiterlijk
De Echo Dot heeft een strak, modern ontwerp met slechts vier knoppen bovenop. De kleur ‘wit’ is eigenlijk een mooie zachtgrijze tint, wat ik persoonlijk juist erg mooi vind. Hij oogt rustig en past perfect in mijn interieur.
Geluid
Wat een verrassing! Het geluid is echt beter dan ik had verwacht. Voor de ruimte waarin ik hem gebruik is het volume meer dan voldoende, en zelfs op laag volume klinkt de muziek vol en warm. De bas is verrassend goed voor zo’n compact apparaat.
Gebruik
Ik gebruik geen slimme apparaten, dus daar kan ik niets over zeggen. Maar wat ik wél gebruik, doe ik inmiddels dagelijks: muziek via Spotify, nieuwsflitsen (NOS), het weerbericht, reminders, boodschappenlijstjes, timers en het opzoeken van feitjes.
Muziek bedienen met je stem werkt fantastisch. Ik vraag Alexa om favoriete nummers of afspeellijsten en regel het volume zonder ook maar iets aan te raken. Het weerbericht gebruik ik meerdere keren per dag: van een uitgebreid overzicht tot even snel checken of het het komende uur gaat regenen – zó handig.
Reminders zijn voor mij een enorme plus. In plaats van notities op mijn telefoon vertel ik alles aan Alexa. Ze herinnert me aan spullen die ik moet meenemen naar afspraken en laat me weten wanneer het tijd is om te vertrekken. Mijn boodschappenlijst vul ik tussendoor gewoon aan met mijn stem.
De timerfunctie gebruik ik niet alleen in de keuken, maar ook voor mijn werk. Bijvoorbeeld bij het bedrukken van T-shirts: 30 seconden persen? Alexa houdt het bij en ik heb mijn handen vrij. Ideaal.
En dan nog dit: ik speel graag woordspelletjes en kom daarbij regelmatig lastige woorden tegen. Waar ik vroeger Google gebruikte, vraag ik het nu gewoon aan Alexa. Ze geeft snel en duidelijk uitleg. Heerlijk gemak.
Conclusie
De cadeaus worden over twee weken gegeven en als mijn zoons hier net zo enthousiast over zijn als ik, dan zit het helemaal goed. Ik kan dit product van harte aanbevelen. De Echo Dot is niet alleen praktisch en handig, maar ook verrassend leuk en gezellig in huis. Een aankoop waar ik echt blij van word!
top_reviews.title: Blij verrast – nu al fan van de Echo Dot (5e generatie)!

top_reviews.author: shayan
top_reviews.text: Produces surprisingly deep bass and clear vocals for its compact size. The updated Alexa response times are noticeably faster than previous generations.
top_reviews.title: Surprising sound and fast responses

❓ Antwoorden: vaak onvolledig, waardoor je extra vragen moet beantwoorden.
top_reviews.title: De kwaliteit van de speaker is goed allichts

top_reviews.author: prime reviewer
top_reviews.text:
If you’ve ever wanted a tiny, round friend who can answer your questions, play your favorite tunes, and occasionally judge your life choices, then the Alexa Dot Echo 2022 is your new best buddy!
First off, let’s talk about the size. This little gadget is so compact that it could easily be mistaken for a fancy coaster. I mean, if you ever need to impress someone with your “high-tech” decor, just place it next to your coffee mug and watch the confusion unfold. “Is that a speaker or a really advanced drink holder?”
Now, onto the voice recognition. Alexa is like that friend who always thinks they know what you’re talking about, even when they don’t. You could ask her to play “Bohemian Rhapsody,” and she might just start reciting the ingredients for a lasagna. But hey, who doesn’t love a surprise cooking lesson while trying to rock out?
And let’s not forget the smart home integration. You can control your lights, thermostat, and even your coffee maker with just your voice. Just be careful not to accidentally summon the vacuum cleaner while you’re still in your pajamas. Nothing says “I’m not ready for adulting” like a Roomba chasing you around the living room.
The sound quality? Well, let’s just say it’s like listening to your favorite band through a tin can. But hey, if you’re not too picky, it’s perfect for drowning out the sound of your neighbor’s questionable taste in music.
In conclusion, the Alexa Dot Echo 2022 is the perfect blend of convenience and comedy. It’s like having a personal assistant who’s also a stand-up comedian—just don’t expect her to get your jokes. If you’re looking for a device that can do it all while keeping you entertained, this little orb is worth every penny. Just remember to keep your questions simple, or you might end up with a lasagna recipe instead of your favorite song!
top_reviews.title: absolutely! especially during prime day deals

top_reviews.author: Suresh Kumar
top_reviews.text:
I recently purchased the Alexa Dot 5th Generation, and I must say, it has exceeded my expectations in every way. Here's a detailed breakdown of my experience:
Design & Build:
The compact and sleek design is perfect for any room. The rounded edges and fabric finish give it a modern, elegant look that blends seamlessly with my decor. It’s lightweight yet feels sturdy.
Sound Quality:
The improvement in audio quality is remarkable compared to earlier models. The sound is clearer, bass is deeper, and it fills the room nicely for such a small device. Whether I'm listening to music, podcasts, or setting alarms, the audio does not disappoint.
Smart Features:
Alexa's capabilities have impressed me time and again. From controlling smart home devices (lights, thermostat, and even my TV) to providing quick answers and weather updates, it has become an indispensable part of my daily routine. The integration with third-party apps like Spotify works seamlessly.
I am enjoying the drop in feature very much.
Enhanced Features:
The addition of motion detection and temperature sensing in the 5th Generation is a game-changer. For example, the motion detection feature turns on my lights automatically when I enter the room, and the temperature sensor helps me adjust my thermostat smartly.
Ease of Use:
Setting it up was a breeze. The Alexa app walks you through the process step by step, making it beginner-friendly. Voice recognition is top-notch—it even distinguishes between different family members!
Room for Improvement:
While it's an excellent device, I noticed that the microphone sensitivity could sometimes be a bit too high, picking up commands from other rooms (im having one in each room). Also, it would be great to have a USB-C charging option instead of the proprietary adapter (If so we can play with longer cable or shorter cable where needed).
Overall Verdict:
The Alexa Dot 5th Generation is a fantastic upgrade with thoughtful features and improvements. It’s versatile, user-friendly, and truly enhances the smart home experience. Whether you're a first-time Alexa user or upgrading from an earlier model, I highly recommend it!
top_reviews.title: A Smart Assistant Packed with Impressive Features!

top_reviews.text:
Deze Echo Dot is de derde dot in huis en is gewoon goed.
Dit in tegenstelling van bezorgdienst Dragonfly, want dat is echt een k.t bezorgdienst. Dit is de tweede keer dat ze het pakket gewoon voor de voordeur zetten en er vandoor gaan. Amazon laat electronica door Dragonfly verzorgen. Electronica bestel ik m.i.v. nu maar bij Amazo.de.
top_reviews.title: Goed product maar met slechte bezorgdienst

post.description:
Start here to find station codes for `get_station`, `search_stations` inputs or route stops; filter by `state` to keep the result small.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

state.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code, e.g. NY, CA, BC. Case-insensitive. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

post.description:
To price one OCI SKU by its part number (from `records_list`, `search` or Oracle's price list page).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the price slice, e.g. `USD`, `EUR`, `JPY` (case-insensitive; default `USD`). Oracle published 50 currencies on 2026-10-17; a code it does not publish fails with `not_found`. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{3}$.

post.description:
Past weather for a date or period at a Canadian station: how cold was it on a day, rainfall last month.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

climate_id.description: ECCC Climate ID of a climate station (7 characters, e.g. 6158355 TORONTO CITY, 6158350 TORONTO, 1108447 VANCOUVER INTL A). Find ids with climate_stations. Pattern: ^[0-9A-Za-z]+$.

lang.description: Language of names and texts: en (English) or fr (French). Numbers are the same in both.

start.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

response.attribution: Data Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada

station.name: TORONTO CITY
station.operator: Environment and Climate Change Canada - Meteorological Service of Canada

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Month-by-month climate history of a station, e.g. July rainfall by year.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

climate_id.description: ECCC Climate ID of a climate station (7 characters, e.g. 6158355 TORONTO CITY, 6158350 TORONTO, 1108447 VANCOUVER INTL A). Find ids with climate_stations. Pattern: ^[0-9A-Za-z]+$.

end.description: Last month, YYYY-MM. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$.

lang.description: Language of names and texts: en (English) or fr (French). Numbers are the same in both.

start.description: First month, YYYY-MM. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$.

response.attribution: Data Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada

station.name: TORONTO CITY
station.operator: Environment and Climate Change Canada - Meteorological Service of Canada

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

post.description:
Typical climate of a place by month: normal January temperature, average annual snowfall, frost-free period.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

climate_id.description: ECCC Climate ID of a climate station (7 characters, e.g. 6158355 TORONTO CITY, 6158350 TORONTO, 1108447 VANCOUVER INTL A). Find ids with climate_stations. Pattern: ^[0-9A-Za-z]+$.

lang.description: Language of names and texts: en (English) or fr (French). Numbers are the same in both.

...The National Weather Service in Fort Worth has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in Texas...

Walnut Creek Near Mansfield affecting Tarrant County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Walnut Creek near Mansfield.

* WHEN...Until late tonight.

* IMPACTS...At 19.0 feet, Minor flooding will occur along the creek
through Mansfield, downstream of Joe Pool Lake. By 19 feet, Retta
Road is flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 11:00 AM CDT Thursday the stage was 18.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river will rise above flood stage to 19.3 feet
this afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage this
afternoon to 11.2 feet tomorrow morning. It will rise to 11.3
feet tomorrow morning. It will then fall again and remain below
flood stage.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 19.0 feet.
alert.headline: Flood Warning issued October 1 at 11:26AM CDT until October 2 at 2:00AM CDT by NWS Fort Worth TX
alert.instruction:
Do not drive cars through flooded areas. Caution is urged when
walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at water.noaa.gov/wfo/fwd.

Which watches, warnings and advisories (red flag, fire weather, flood, heat, severe storms) are in effect right now for this paddock, parcel or point, optionally including those within up to 5 km. For past alerts use alerts_history; for one alert's full text use alert.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

buffer_km.description: Also keep storm-based alerts whose polygon lies within this many kilometres of the geometry, and resolve zones for points this far outside its bounding box.

events.description: Keep only these event names (case-insensitive substring match on the NWS event name, e.g. "Red Flag", "Flood", "Heat").

geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon or MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored. A FeatureCollection is refused (send one place per call), as is a geometry crossing the antimeridian. Invalid input is `invalid_input` with a JSON pointer and a stable code (ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, too_many_vertices, outside_coverage).

severity.description: Keep only alerts with one of these CAP severities.

app_id.description: Numeric App Store app id (the `id` in `apps.apple.com/us/app/<slug>/id493145008`). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

bundle_id.description: iOS bundle identifier (`com.spotify.client`). Resolved to the app id on the same storefront first. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,254}$.

country.description: Two-letter App Store storefront code (lowercase, e.g. `us`, `gb`, `de`). Default `us`. Prices and availability are storefront specific. Pattern: ^[a-zA-Z]{2}$.

locale.description: Display locale for names, descriptions and release notes, e.g. `en-US`, `en-GB`. Default `en-US`. Pattern: ^[a-zA-Z]{2,3}(-[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,8})*$.

url.description: A pasted App Store app URL such as `https://apps.apple.com/us/app/headspace-sleep-meditation/id493145008`; the storefront in the path is used unless `country` is given.

response.description:
Welcome to Headspace, your expert-led guide to mental health, mindfulness, and meditation. Whether you're navigating stress, anxiety, sleep trouble, or life’s ups and downs, Headspace is here to support you. Explore science-backed exercises, courses, and programs that help you build everyday skills to care for your mind. For more support, you have access to licensed therapists, mental health coaches or Ebb, your empathetic AI companion. Headspace is always here, so you can always put your mind first.

DAILY MEDITATIONS
Discover mental wellness and mindfulness with over 500+ guided meditations. From quick 3-minute mental resets to longer sessions, we'll help you make meditation a daily practice. Meditate, practice mindfulness and relax. Headspace is proven to increase happiness and reduce stress in just 10 days.

BETTER SLEEP
Headspace helps improve your sleep with expert-led sleep tools, guided sleep meditations, sleep sounds, sleepcasts, and more. Explore sleep music and meditation for sleeping to reduce stress and anxiety.

ANXIETY & STRESS RELIEF
Headspace is the mental health app here to help you manage your stress through personalized recommendations, guided meditations, and exercises. Learn calming breathwork and breathing techniques to help with panic attacks, anxiety relief and calm. Just 2 weeks of Headspace reduces anxiety.

AFFORDABLE THERAPY 
From finding the right therapist to easy scheduling, Headspace therapy makes it easier to start feeling better. You’ll also get access to mindfulness tools and Ebb, your empathetic AI companion, for support anytime you need it. Plus, with partnerships with major insurance companies, your sessions could cost as little as $0.

COACHING & MENTAL HEALTH SUPPORT
Get matched and text with your own mental health coach and schedule sessions at your convenience. Headspace mental health coaches are trained professionals that provide personalized care to help you set and reach goals, manage everyday anxiety and stress, navigate major life events, and more.

WELLNESS & BALANCE
Increase balance with guided meditation and focus music. Calm and relax with quick breathing exercises, improve focus with binaural beats and calm your mind with relaxing music for studying.

MINDFUL MOVEMENT
Relieve stress, release tension, and strengthen your mind-body connection with mindful movement. Practice CBT techniques and CBT therapy exercises to reduce stress and anxiety.

PROGRESS TRACKING
Self-care tracker to follow your mental health journey. Share insights with your mindfulness coach or therapist so they can keep you on track towards your goals.

Headspace is the everyday mental health app that’s proven to help. Stress less, sleep better, and feel happier with do-anywhere exercises and personalized recommendations from Ebb, Headspace’s AI mental health companion.

Access online therapy and psychiatry through your organization.* (Check coverage with your coach or benefits team.)

Start your free trial and experience the benefits of meditation, mindfulness and expert mental health therapy & coaching. Subscription options: $12.99/month, $69.99/year. These prices are for United States, pricing in other countries may vary. Coaching and therapy pricing varies by subscription.

The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.

Headspace saves your meditation sessions to your Apple Health app.
Read the terms and conditions here: http://www.headspace.com/terms-and-conditions
Read the privacy policy here: https://www.headspace.com/privacy-policy

post.description:
Read what users say about an app, or its latest feedback; page with `offset` from `next_offset`, keeping the same `sort`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

app_id.description: Numeric App Store app id (the `id` in `apps.apple.com/us/app/<slug>/id493145008`). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

country.description: Two-letter App Store storefront code (lowercase, e.g. `us`, `gb`, `de`). Default `us`. Prices and availability are storefront specific. Pattern: ^[a-zA-Z]{2}$.

limit.description: Reviews per page (default and maximum 10, the page size the App Store web client uses).

locale.description: Display locale for names, descriptions and release notes, e.g. `en-US`, `en-GB`. Default `en-US`. Pattern: ^[a-zA-Z]{2,3}(-[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,8})*$.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; pass `next_offset` from the previous page.

sort.description: Review order, the App Store's own sort options. `most_recent` (default): newest first, dates non-increasing within and across pages. `most_helpful`: Apple's 'Most Helpful' ranking, not chronological. `most_favorable` / `most_critical`: positive / critical reviews (observed as 5-star / 1-star), newest first.

post.description:
To find FCC equipment authorization filings by grantee, applicant, date range or technical filters; use lookup_fcc_id for one exact FCC ID.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

applicant_name.description: Applicant / grantee name (the site matches a prefix).

application_purpose.description: I = Change in FCC ID, P = Class II Permissive Change, S = Class III Permissive Change, O = Original Grant.

application_status.description: granted (default: all granted statuses), all (grants, dismissals and denials), GI (grant issued), IP (permissive change issued), IM (modification of FCC ID issued), DM (dismissed), DN (denied).

cursor.description: Continuation from a previous page (meta.page.next_cursor): the site's 1-based FromRec offset of the next page.

equipment_class.description: Numeric equipment class code from the site's search form select (e.g. 103 = DTS Digital Transmission System). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,4}$.

final_action_date_from.description: Earliest final action (grant) date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

final_action_date_to.description: Latest final action (grant) date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

grantee_code.description: Grantee code (3 or 5 characters), e.g. IPH.

modular_type.description: 1 single modular, 2 limited single modular, 3 split modular, 4 limited split modular approval.

page_size.description: Rows per page (the form's show_records; 500 accepted by the site).

product_code.description: Product code (the FCC ID after the grantee code, hyphen included), up to 14 characters; prefix match unless product_exact_match.

product_exact_match.description: Match product_code exactly instead of as a prefix.

rule_parts.description: Up to 3 FCC rule parts as the form lists them (e.g. 15C, 22H, 90).

tcb_code.description: Telecommunication Certification Body code, e.g. US0101.

tcb_scope.description: TCB scope code A1..A4, B1..B4. Pattern: ^[AB][1-4]$.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

response.description:
WhatsApp is a messaging app for personal and group communication through a direct, chat-based interface. It supports text messaging, voice calls, video calls, and media sharing, allowing real-time conversation between individuals or groups. Messages, attachments, and calls are handled within the same interface, without requiring separate tools. 

A chat list organizes ongoing conversations, showing recent activity and keeping frequently used threads accessible. Each chat supports text messages, images, videos, documents, voice notes, and location sharing. The interface presents these elements within a linear timeline that preserves context and makes exchanges easy to follow. Message indicators show when content has been sent, delivered, or viewed, giving users a clear sense of message status as interactions progress. 

Group functionality enables multi-party communication with tools for naming groups, assigning profile images, and managing participants. Administrators can add or remove members, adjust permissions, and determine who may send messages or modify group details. Groups support the same media types as individual chats, allowing coordinated sharing among teams, families, or other communities. Broadcast lists extend this system by sending one-to-many messages that appear as private conversations to recipients who have the sender’s number saved. 

Voice messages offer an alternative when typing is impractical. Users can record short or extended voice notes that appear directly in the chat timeline and can be played at adjustable speeds. The app also includes high-quality voice and video calling that operates through an internet connection. Calls support one-to-one conversations as well as group calls, giving users multiple ways to connect depending on context. 

Contact management draws on the device’s address book, allowing new chats to begin with minimal setup. A search function supports locating past messages, documents, links, and media by keyword, providing efficient retrieval of information from extended histories. Starred messages offer another retrieval method by marking important items for quick access. Together, these tools help maintain continuity in conversations that evolve over long periods. 

Media handling is central to the messaging experience. Photos, videos, and documents sent or received in chats can be viewed in galleries organized by file type, enabling users to revisit shared materials without scrolling through entire message histories. Forwarding options allow redistribution of items to other chats, with forwarding indicators helping recipients understand the origin of the content. Storage management tools assist in reviewing and removing large files or clearing specific chat histories to free device space. 

Privacy features offer granular control over visibility and interaction. Users can choose who may see their profile photo, status updates, and last-seen information. Read receipts can be enabled or disabled depending on communication preferences, and blocked contacts are prevented from calling or messaging. Two-step verification adds an optional security layer by requiring a PIN when registering the number on a new device. 

Status updates allow users to share photos, text, or short videos that remain visible for twenty-four hours to selected contacts. These updates appear in a separate section distinct from chats, keeping ephemeral content organized away from ongoing conversations. Viewership indicators show who has seen each update, while privacy controls define which contacts have access. 

Cross-device features support messaging on linked devices, allowing users to continue conversations from desktops or secondary devices once they authenticate through their phone. Linked devices maintain access even if the primary device temporarily loses connection, depending on service guidelines. This flexibility supports workflows in which typing on a larger screen or accessing shared files from a computer is preferable. 

Security is maintained through end-to-end encryption applied automatically to messages, calls, and media. This ensures that only the sender and recipient can access the contents of their communication. Encryption operates in the background and does not require manual configuration, providing a protected environment for everyday messaging without altering the interaction model familiar to users. 

Compatibility with Android devices allows the app to operate across a broad range of phones and tablets. It integrates with system-level notifications to surface incoming messages, calls, and media previews. Notification settings can be adjusted for individual chats or groups, offering flexibility for managing interruptions during work or personal time. 

Backup options support preserving chat histories, including messages, images, and other attachments. Users can enable automatic backups at chosen intervals or create them manually. Restoration from a backup allows chat data to reappear on a new device after number verification, dependent on backup availability and user settings. 

Additional tools refine the messaging experience. Wallpaper customization lets users set distinct backgrounds for specific chats or apply global themes. Data usage settings control media auto-download behavior, which can help manage bandwidth consumption in limited-data environments. These configurations allow users to tailor the app’s operation to their preferences while maintaining consistent communication capabilities. 

Group invitation controls and link management features offer structured options for admitting participants into group chats. Administrators can generate invitation links, reset them when necessary, or approve or deny join requests when restricted access is enabled. These controls help maintain group integrity and reduce unwanted additions. 

WhatsApp supports everyday communication through messaging, calling, and media sharing within a familiar chat-based environment. Its structure accommodates personal conversations, ongoing group discussions, and coordinated interaction, making it a consistent tool for routine communication across different contexts.

post.description:
Before query_layer: find the right layer id in a service and the exact field names and codes for a where clause (zoning codes, flood zone values), or check a layer's licence and record limits. Pass a url from search_datasets or a pasted ArcGIS REST URL.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

item_id.description: ArcGIS item id of a Feature Service or Map Service (from search_datasets), optionally with a Hub `_<layer>` suffix. Alternative to url. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}(_[0-9]{1,6})?$.

layer.description: Layer id within the service, when the URL names the service only.

url.description: ArcGIS REST service or layer URL, or an ArcGIS Online item page (https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=…). https://<host>/<adaptor>/rest/services/<folder>/<service>/FeatureServer[/<layer>] or …/MapServer[/<layer>], on ArcGIS Online (services*.arcgis.com/<orgId>/arcgis/rest/services/…) or an agency's ArcGIS Server (gis.<agency>.gov/arcgis/rest/services/…). Query strings are ignored; URLs carrying a token or key are refused.

post.description:
Look up the parcel, zoning district, flood zone, permit, address point or boundary at a location or matching an id (e.g. an assessor parcel number), or page through a layer's records. Get field names from describe_layer first.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees.

distance_m.description: Search radius around point, in metres (default 0: features containing the point).

layer.description: Layer id within the service, when the URL names the service only.

limit.description: Rows per page; the layer's maxRecordCount may cap it lower.

offset.description: Rows to skip (next_offset from the previous page).

order_by.description: `FIELD` or `FIELD DESC`. Default: object id ascending, for stable paging.

out_fields.description: Fields to return (case-insensitive, checked against the layer). Default: all fields.

point.description: WGS84 point: features at (or within distance_m of) this location.

spatial_rel.description: Relation between the features and point/bbox.

url.description: ArcGIS REST service or layer URL: https://<host>/<adaptor>/rest/services/<folder>/<service>/FeatureServer[/<layer>] or …/MapServer[/<layer>], on ArcGIS Online (services*.arcgis.com/<orgId>/arcgis/rest/services/…) or an agency's ArcGIS Server (gis.<agency>.gov/arcgis/rest/services/…). Query strings are ignored; URLs carrying a token or key are refused.

where.description: ArcGIS SQL-92 where clause, e.g. `PIN = '123-456-789'`, `ZONE_CODE LIKE 'R-%'`, `FLD_ZONE IN ('AE','VE')`.

To compare where to run a given model: prices and measured speed per provider. Needs a model slug from search_models.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

post.description:
Start here to find a model slug (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`) for get_model or list_model_providers, to rank models by intelligence, price or speed, or with `slug` to fetch one known model/effort row (legacy slugs included) without paging the whole table.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

include_deprecated.description: Include models the site marks deprecated. Since 2026-10-17 the leaderboard page serves only current models, so deprecated rows are usually absent and the result is reported as partial coverage. Implied true when `slug` is given.

query.description: Case-insensitive terms matched against model name, short name, slug and creator; every whitespace-separated term must match (substring: `deepseek-v3` also matches `deepseek-v3-0324`; use `slug` for an exact row). Punctuation is folded on both sides, so `Claude Sonnet 5.5`, `claude-sonnet-5.5` and `claude-sonnet-5-5` find the same rows. One model per call: a list of several names matches nothing.

slug.description: Exact model slug at one reasoning effort (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`, `deepseek-v3`) or a pasted https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/{slug} URL: returns that one row (effort siblings such as `-high`/`-low` are not matched). Implies `include_deprecated: true`; a deprecated slug matches only while the page lists deprecated rows (use get_model for it otherwise). Combines with the other filters. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9./:_-]+$.

To find the fastest or cheapest endpoint for a model, or all models a provider hosts. Use list_model_providers for one model's percentile detail.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

cursor.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

host.description: API provider slug or name, exact and case-insensitive (e.g. `anthropic`, `amazon_bedrock`, `novita`).

response.description_bottom_html:
Don't See a Fitting Open Role? Join our Talent Community!

Questions & Answers

Who else works at Ashby?

We're a team of ~350 people globally, with a majority in the Americas and EMEA time zones. You can meet the team and read about their experience at Ashby here.

How remote-friendly are you?

We are a remote-first company with most team members in countries in the Americas and EMEA time zones. We favor asynchronous communication through written documents and emails. We maintain a small office in the SF Bay Area that can be used by folks who want to work out of an office occasionally. We host an annual company-wide gathering, along with individual team meetups each year.

What is the interview process like?

Across all roles, we favor practical interviews combined with work samples and share clear goals and expectations for each. Many of our interviews simulate what it’s like to work at Ashby: you’ll collaborate with interviewers, talk through decisions, and build artifacts that you would as a full-time employee (albeit in a much shorter period of time). We will share the entire interview process with you in detail during our first conversation.
response.description_top_html:
Where we're coming from

Abhik and I started Ashby for two reasons.

First, we wanted to equip people & talent teams with much more powerful tools - matching the strategic importance these functions have for modern businesses.

Just as importantly, we wanted to build a world-class organization that delivers excellent products and customer experiences and constantly challenges the status quo.

This ambition spans every function: we’re known for our best in class product velocity (powered by an excellent and uniquely organized Engineering team). At the same time our customers view our Customer Success & Sales experience as a huge differentiator. We care deeply about making all touch points with the Ashby brand & people excellent - and we’re investing in the talent to make that possible.


Growth to date & what’s next

Having publicly launched in late 2022, we now serve over 5,000 global customers. We’re delivering top decile metrics across growth rates, retention & efficiency. All of our customer segments are experiencing rapid growth. We’re the default for new startups - and are rapidly growing our Enterprise segment as well. There’s a lot of organic love for what we’ve built.

We’re now entering our next phase of exciting growth by becoming a true multi-product company. As much as we’ve achieved significant scale, we’re still attracting builders and there’s a ton of exciting work ahead of us.

There’s a common belief that companies slow down as they scale. That they stop innovating. Become “political”. As much as Ashby is about solving the most important problems our customers face, it’s also about defying gravity when it comes to building a successful business.

Our operating principles (next section) are a big part of what have allowed us to deliver on both fronts in recent years.

How we work & what we value

We have published our operating principles on our blog - they describe how we work at Ashby. They cover how we aim to run projects, spend time and make decisions.

Beyond that we also look for specific attributes in new hires. Folks at Ashby are generally described as:

  • Humble and Empathetic

  • Curious

  • Driven

  • Reliable

  • Transparent and Honest

  • Don't Take Themselves Too-Seriously

You can read more about the "why" behind these attributes in the same blog post.
