response.description_html:
We're excited to share that we're hiring a Product Support Specialist in the APAC region, specifically in Australia 🎉.

Over the past few years, we’ve built a team of Ashby experts who delight customers through keen attention to detail, deep product knowledge, and fast, thoughtful support. By joining the team, you’ll contribute to delivering that same world-class experience.

In this role, you’ll work closely with customers every day. Ashby is a broad and complex product, so you can expect to handle everything from troubleshooting sophisticated integrations to guiding customers through detailed workflows and best practices.

You’ll also spend time on projects that make the work we do better. Past projects our team has taken on include:

  • Absorbing and synthesizing highly technical work from our Engineering Team to create enablement for technical up-leveling of the broader Support Team.

  • Developing workflow automation allowing for better team cohesion and efficacy.

As a company, we value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication. These and other values, which we’ll explore more deeply during the interview process, guide how we work.

 

You should apply if:

  • You are already comfortable owning complex SaaS troubleshooting from first report through resolution, including isolating configuration issues, reproducing ambiguous behavior, and communicating clearly

  • You can explain technical issues concisely, you think systematically, and operate with strong ownership in asynchronous environments. You can explain the same issue differently depending on the audience, while staying clear and direct.

  • You’re curious—both when addressing customers and when creating solutions that improve our workflows. You seek the answers beyond what’s on the surface.

  • You delight customers. You possess keen attention to detail, ensure your responses are thorough and clear, and are empathetic along the way.

  • You can balance investigation, customer communication, and escalation quality in a fast-moving environment.

  • You've done B2B support across company sizes, from SMB to enterprise.

You should not apply if:

  • Your recent experience is primarily customer success management, account management, or customer onboarding

  • You're more drawn to coordination, enablement, or team leadership than spending your days deep in tickets.

  • You avoid getting in the weeds of solving technical problems; each member of our support team is highly technical and capable of solving deeply complex tickets.

  • You prefer to triage tickets swiftly; if tagging in Engineering early on (without attempting comprehensive solutions) is an exhale moment, this is likely not a great fit.

  • You prefer to support a product you can know the ins and outs of quickly (such as a point solution) rather than a product that is rapidly evolving with quite a bit of surface area.

About Ashby

We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. Learn more on our website: https://www.ashbyhq.com/

We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. Following our Series D in 2025, we’re continuing to grow ARR at more than 100% year over year, serving over 4,000 customers, including industry leaders like Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, Reddit, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!). Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers. We’ll share more details once we meet. In short, it's the perfect time to join! 🚀

 

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

 

Interview Process

biography: The Honourable Danielle Smith was sworn-in as Alberta’s 19th Premier on October 11, 2022. She was re-elected as the Member of the Legislative Assembly for the constituency of Brooks-Medicine Hat on May 29, 2023.

Danielle Smith was first elected as the Member of the Legislative Assembly for Highwood on April 23, 2012. She served as leader of the Wildrose Party of Alberta from October 17, 2009, to December 17, 2014.
She previously served on the Special Standing Committee on Members’ Services and the Standing Committee on Alberta’s Economic Future.

Prior to entering politics, Ms. Smith was the director of provincial affairs for Alberta with the Canadian Federation of Independent Business, CFIB. She worked with all levels of government to represent the interests of CFIB’s 10,000 small-business members in Alberta.

Before joining CFIB, Ms. Smith had extensive experience in the media. She was an editorial writer and columnist at the Calgary Herald for six years. She served as host of Global Sunday, a national current affairs television talk show, and was also the host of two programs on CKMX 1060 AM radio in Calgary, Health Frontiers and Standing Ground. She has made frequent guest appearances as a commentator on TV and radio.

Ms. Smith’s public policy experience began with an internship at the Fraser Institute. She was also elected as a trustee for the Calgary board of education and served as the director of the Alberta Property Rights Initiative and the Canadian Property Rights Research Institute.

Smith received a BA in English and a BA in economics from the University of Calgary. She married her husband, David Moretta in 2006 and is the proud stepmother of David’s son Jonathan. Danielle and David live in High River with their two dogs, Caine and Turk.
She was the 814th Member of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta.

按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

response.filename: 30958_X[]_Decision 30958-D01-2026 - Kneehill Energy Storage Facility Letter of Enquiry_000021.pdf
response.text:
October 9, 2026 Decision 30958-D01-2026

Kneehill Solar GP Inc.
2930, 155 Wellington Street West
Toronto, Ont. M5V 3H1

Attention: Yasser Beshr

Kneehill Energy Storage Facility Letter of Enquiry
Proceeding 30958
Application 30958-A001

Approval of minor amendments

1. Kneehill Solar GP Inc., by Application 30958-A001, registered on July 21, 2026, applied
to the Alberta Utilities Commission for approval to make minor amendments to the 10-megawatt
(MW) energy storage facility within the existing Kneehill Solar Generation Facility boundary, in
the Three Hills area.

2. The proposed work is related to facilities previously approved by the Commission but not
yet constructed in Approval 30539-D02-2026.
1

3. Kneehill Solar requested to update the equipment of the battery energy storage system
from the SolBank system to the HyperBlock system, a type of HyperStrong system.
Kneehill Solar indicated that the number of containers would be reduced from eight to five,
inverters would be reduced from eight to three, and transformers would be reduced from four to
three. Kneehill Solar confirmed that the HyperBlock system uses the same lithium iron
phosphate battery chemistry as the approved configuration and that the proposed changes are not
changing the battery technology or associated characteristics.
2

4. Kneehill Solar confirmed that the project capability remains the same as what was
approved, at 10 MW/20 megawatt-hours.

5. Kneehill Solar stated that the proposed HyperBlock system incorporates safety systems
and design features that are comparable to the approved SolBank system and are intended to
prevent, detect and mitigate thermal events, fire hazards and explosion risks. Kneehill Solar
confirmed that it will continue to meet the safety obligations in the approval, including energy
storage facility-related training, ongoing safety upgrades and annual updates to the site-specific
emergency response plan.

1
 Energy Storage Facility Approval 30539-D02-2026, Proceeding 30539, Application 30539-A001,
January 28, 2026.
2
 Exhibit 30958-X0001, Letter of Enquiry for Minor Amendment, PDF page 2. Alberta Utilities Commission
October 9, 2026  Page 2 of 2

6. Kneehill Solar provided a letter from Stantec Consulting Ltd., which confirmed that the
original dispersion modelling and risk assessment prepared by Calvin Consulting Group Ltd. for
the approved battery system remains valid and that the carbon monoxide release rates observed
during HyperBlock testing are below the carbon monoxide emission rate used in the original
modelling assessment.
3
 Kneehill Solar confirmed that the proposed HyperBlock system would
not be expected to result in materially different hydrogen fluoride emissions or hydrogen
fluoride-related risk outcomes than the system evaluated in the original assessment.
4

7. Kneehill Solar retained Green Cat Renewables Canada Corporation to complete a noise
impact assessment for the proposed equipment which concluded that the project will comply
with Rule 012: Noise Control.
5

8. Kneehill Solar confirmed that the proposed changes are limited to internal equipment
arrangement to be located within the approved project boundary.

9. Kneehill Solar has provided information respecting the need, nature, extent, land
affected, land ownership and the timing of the work. Kneehill Solar also stated that no adverse
environmental impact will be caused by the proposed work.

10. Based upon the information provided, the Commission is satisfied that the proposed
amendment to the energy storage facility is of a minor nature, no person is directly and adversely
affected by the proposal, and no significant adverse environmental impact will be caused by the
proposed work. The Commission approves the amendment to the energy storage facility.

11. Approval 30958-D02-2026 is attached.

12. The Commission may, no later than 60 days from the date of this decision and without
notice, correct typographical, spelling and calculation errors and other similar types of errors and
post the corrected decision on its website.

Alberta Utilities Commission

Rita Chan
Director – Power Plants, Facilities Division
On behalf of the Alberta Utilities Commission

Attachment

3
 Exhibit 30958-X0012, KneehillSolar-Response_to_AUC_Information_Request_Round_1.
4
 Exhibit 30958-X0018, KneehillSolar-Response_to_AUC_Information_Request_Round_2.
5
 Exhibit 30958-X0015, Attachment 3 - Kneehill BESS - LOE NIA Letter.

response.text:
Proceeding 30732 Register
Application 30732-A001
Decision 30732-D01-2026
AUC contact: Victor Choy
403-592-4439 or victor.choy@auc.ab.ca
Synapse Real Estate Corp: Jason Van Gaal
613-797-3311 or jason@synapsedatacenter.com
Overview
Synapse Real Estate Corp applied to construct and operate a combined-cycle natural gas-fired power plant with a nominal capacity of approximately 1,400 megawatts (MW) as well as 1,800 MW of emergency and backup diesel generation (the power plant). The application stated that the power plant will not be connected to the Alberta Interconnection Electric System but will be used to power the on-site data centre load. The application was filed under the Hydro and Electric Energy Act.
On August 17, 2026, the AUC denied the Synapse Data Center Power Plant Project application. The Commission finds that the project is too close to the surrounding community, and Synapse failed to demonstrate any compelling justification for selecting that location. The site is simply not suitable for the proposed development. In making this finding, the Commission is not commenting on the suitability of a data centre in this location. The Commission does not approve or regulate data centres.
Hearing information
To learn more about the review process, or for more information about how you may become involved in this proceeding, please contact us or visit the following webpages:
Review process for facility applications
Have your say about a utility project
Participate in an AUC hearing
The eFiling System​
The eFiling System should be accessed to view the applications and the other documents the AUC will be considering in this proceeding. The system is also used to file submissions and evidence to participate in the proceeding.
To create an account, select “New account” and follow the steps to create a user ID and password. If you have any questions about how to use the eFiling System please contact us at info@auc.ab.ca or 310-4AUC.
Documents being considered in this proceeding can be found in the eFiling​ System (which requires log in). Once you have logged in, enter 30732 in the “go to” section at the top left corner of your screen.

post.description:
Finding auction properties in an area; listing sold (closed) auctions with winning bids; locating a listing_id for get_listing, get_valuation or get_auction_status.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

city.description: City name, for example Atlanta. Combine with state.

county.description: County name without the word County, for example Miami-Dade. Combine with state.

listing_type.description: Listing states to include. closed means sold. Defaults to ["active"].

offset.description: Continuation: pass next_offset from the previous page.

query.description: Free text (address, ZIP, city) sent to the site's search box filter.

sort.description: Site sort keys: auction date (default), newly added, price low-high / high-low, sqft low-high / high-low, recommended.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example GA. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Find equipment lots to bid on or to look up; take `listing_id` into `get_auction_lot`. Use `list_categories` for category ids.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category_id.description: Numeric category id from `list_categories` or a category URL (e.g. 16044).

listing_type.description: `upcoming` = lots open or scheduled for bidding; `results` = closed lots (final bid amounts are login-only and not returned).

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer facet value, e.g. `CATERPILLAR` (case-insensitive on the site).

model.description: Model facet value, e.g. `320`.

page.description: 1-based page; 28 lots per page.

sort.description: sort

state.description: Full US state or Canadian province name as the site spells it, e.g. `Texas`. Two-letter codes return no results.

response.description_html:
A striking piece of American wartime public service history, this USDA Forest Service poster from the mid-1940s captures the urgent national campaign to prevent forest fires during World War II. The bold composition features an oversized hand crushing out a cigarette on a woodland rock, a direct visual instruction that needed no translation. The flame-styled lettering of 'PREVENT FOREST FIRES!' adds visceral urgency to the message.

Produced by the U.S. Government Printing Office for joint distribution by the federal Forest Service and state forestry agencies, this poster predates the now-iconic Smokey Bear by mere months. During the war years, America's forests were considered strategic resources essential for shipbuilding and military construction, while the genuine threat of Japanese incendiary balloon attacks made civilian fire prevention a matter of national security.

A compelling document of the home front effort, this poster bridges wartime anxiety with environmental stewardship in a way that resonates across decades. A standout piece for collectors of WWII Americana, conservation history, or mid-century graphic design.

Size: 20.0" x 14.25"

Artist: Baldridge

Condition: Very Good, Condition: Very Good, Age-appropriate wear, fading and toning. Original fold lines present. Circle drawn on backside of upper right corner, lightly visible on front. Creasing in upper right corner. Light border wear. Please use the photo zoom feature to get a better understanding of overall condition. *Additional photos available upon request.

products.description_html:
Constantin Alajalov captures the electric energy of a Harlem nightclub in this stunning late 1920s illustration. The Russian-American artist, celebrated for his sophisticated magazine work, renders the scene with his characteristic Art Deco elegance: elongated chorus girls in coral-fringed costumes ascend the stage in synchronized movement, while a central couple commands the spotlight in an intimate dance.

The composition brilliantly conveys the theatrical atmosphere of Jazz Age Harlem, where legendary venues drew adventurous audiences seeking the pulse of American nightlife. Alajalov's masterful handling of dramatic lighting, with cool spotlight beams cutting through warm amber tones, creates a sense of glamour and intrigue that defined the era.

A remarkable document of the Harlem Renaissance at its height, this illustration embodies the cultural ferment that made uptown Manhattan the center of American creative life. Signed by the artist in the lower right, this piece represents both exceptional artistic achievement and significant cultural history.

Size: 13.5" x 10"

Artist: Constantin Alajalov

products.description_html:
This George Petty illustration epitomizes the sophisticated glamour that defined American magazine art during the mid-1930s. Signed 'PETTY' in the upper left, the piece showcases his signature airbrush technique: luminous flesh tones, a dramatic orange-red backdrop, and the diaphanous oversized hat that became a recurring Petty motif. The figure, telephone pressed to her ear, embodies the flirtatious wit that made the Petty Girl a cultural phenomenon.

The suggestive caption ('Well, we could go to the opera, Mr. Hammond, if you insist on preliminaries') captures the playful sophistication Esquire cultivated during the Depression era, offering readers escapist fantasy with a knowing wink. collections.description_html: This range tends to be where genuine variety lives. Period works at this price point span formats and eras, from late 19th-century commercial illustration to mid-century travel and entertainment posters to original psychedelic concert work from the 1960s. Condition, rarity, and format all shift the value, so the mix at any moment reflects what the market actually produces. Everything here is a period original, not a modern facsimile.

This price range tends to bring in work with a real track record: pieces old enough to carry genuine historical weight, by artists or from movements that have held collector interest over time. Lithographed advertising posters from the early 20th century sit comfortably here, as do rare printed ephemera from the 19th century. The period originals in this range are the kind of work that rewards closer attention the longer it hangs on a wall.

This range tends to be where genuine variety opens up: travel posters, foreign film releases, concert work, and more, spanning the mid-20th century through the 1980s. Period originals at this level often reflect regional printing traditions that don't survive in large numbers, whether a Japanese studio release or a European travel commission. The works here are period originals, not modern reproductions.

At this level, the market narrows to works with genuine art-historical weight: large-format lithographs from the Belle Époque, interwar commercial masterworks by designers like Cassandre, and rare concert posters from the psychedelic era. These are pieces that defined their genres rather than followed them. Period originals at this price reflect condition, rarity, and the kind of provenance that serious collectors and institutions look for.

This range tends to attract serious work from the mid-20th century golden age of commercial illustration, when travel, cinema, and consumer brands all competed for wall space through hand-drawn imagery. Designers like Edward McKnight Kauffer and Milton Glaser brought genuine artistic ambition to commercial commissions, and their period work sits comfortably here alongside lesser-known but equally skilled hands. All are period originals, not modern reproductions.

products.description_html:
Originally designed in 1969 for The Who's three night engagement at Detroit's legendary Grande Ballroom, this classic Carl Lundgren image was later reissued as a signed and numbered artist edition limited to 200 copies. The composition captures one of Lundgren's most dynamic concert poster designs, centering on a cosmic explosion from which musical instruments, lightning bolts, hands, and abstract forms radiate outward, a fitting visual metaphor for The Who's electrifying live performances at the height of their late 1960s career.

Lundgren's distinctive style bridges underground comix and psychedelic poster art, while the lower panels function as a visual program guide for the weekend's supporting acts: Joe Cocker and the Grease Band on Friday, Mixed Generation on Saturday, and Rush, the Detroit group rather than the later Canadian trio, on Sunday. A vibrant palette of purples, blues, and turquoise gives the composition a graphic intensity that has become synonymous with the Grande Ballroom series.

Printed by The Highway Press, this artist authorized edition preserves one of Lundgren's most celebrated Grande Ballroom designs while commemorating both Detroit's influential rock scene and one of The Who's memorable American performances during the band's formative years.

Size: 29.0" x 18.0"

Condition: Very Good, Age-appropriate wear, fading and toning. Light border wear. Please use the photo zoom feature to get a better understanding of overall condition. *Additional photos available upon request.

products.description_html:
A striking piece of American wartime public service history, this USDA Forest Service poster from the mid-1940s captures the urgent national campaign to prevent forest fires during World War II. The bold composition features an oversized hand crushing out a cigarette on a woodland rock, a direct visual instruction that needed no translation. The flame-styled lettering of 'PREVENT FOREST FIRES!' adds visceral urgency to the message.

Produced by the U.S. Government Printing Office for joint distribution by the federal Forest Service and state forestry agencies, this poster predates the now-iconic Smokey Bear by mere months. During the war years, America's forests were considered strategic resources essential for shipbuilding and military construction, while the genuine threat of Japanese incendiary balloon attacks made civilian fire prevention a matter of national security.

A compelling document of the home front effort, this poster bridges wartime anxiety with environmental stewardship in a way that resonates across decades. A standout piece for collectors of WWII Americana, conservation history, or mid-century graphic design.

Size: 20.0" x 14.25"

Artist: Baldridge

Condition: Very Good, Condition: Very Good, Age-appropriate wear, fading and toning. Original fold lines present. Circle drawn on backside of upper right corner, lightly visible on front. Creasing in upper right corner. Light border wear. Please use the photo zoom feature to get a better understanding of overall condition. *Additional photos available upon request.

classifications.description:
C-37 PLUMBING

Installation, alteration, and repair of all plumbing when performed solely within property lines and not on public easements or right-of-ways, except as hereinafter provided.

Installation, alteration, and repair of all piping, fixtures, and appliances related to water supply, including pressure vessels and tanks (excluding municipal or related water supply systems); venting and sanitary drainage systems for all fluid, semi-fluid, and organic wastes; septic tanks and leaching lines; roof leaders; lawn sprinklers; water conditioning equipment; piping; and equipment for swimming pools.

Also included are piping, fixtures, appliances, and pressure vessels for manufactured and natural gases, compressed air and vacuum systems, petroleum, fuel oil, non-potable liquids, hot water heating, and hot water supply systems operating at pressures not exceeding 30 PSIG, or temperatures not exceeding 220?é?? F; steam heating and steam supply systems not exceeding 15 PSIG operating pressure; gas or oil fired space heaters and furnaces, excluding duct work. Piping for water cooling systems, excluding the refrigerant piping and equipment. Testing and balancing of hydronics systems.

Sewer, gas, water lines, and connections from structure to the nearest point of public supply or disposal may cross public or private easements or be installed within private easements or right-of-ways. Pipe installed across public property may not be increased in size, or make any other connection between the point of exit from private property to the point of connection at public supply or disposal. These lines shall not be installed parallel to main lines in public easements or right-of-ways.

post.description:
The current Canadian policy rate, the rate in effect on a given date (e.g. at the end of a quarter, for comparison with other central banks), or when and by how much the Bank last moved it.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

date.description: As-of date, YYYY-MM-DD. The rate in effect on it is the latest business-day observation on or before it. Default: the latest published. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

start_date.description: Start of the change history, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: three years before date (or the last three years). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

response.attribution: Source: Bank of Canada
response.label: Target for the overnight rate (business daily)
response.note: The policy interest rate is the Bank of Canada's target for the overnight rate (Valet series V39079, business daily). The rate in effect on a date is the latest business-day observation on or before it. A rate decision takes effect the business day after its announcement and the series publishes that day about one business day later; until it does, announced_change carries the decision from the Bank's press release and, once in effect, rate_percent and last_change follow it.

post.description:
Where a bank has branches, or which banks have offices in a city, ZIP or state. Filter by `cert` (from `institutions`) for one bank's network. Use `deposits` for deposits held at each branch and `history` for branch openings and closings.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cert.description: FDIC certificate number, the institution id shared by every BankFind dataset (3511 = Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.; 628 = JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.). Find it with `institutions`. A number no institution has ever held is not_found.

city.description: Exact city, matched against `CITY` as BankFind stores it, case included (`Sioux Falls`, not `sioux falls`). Pattern: ^[^"\\]+$.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same query (the record offset).

fields.description: Projection: column names to return instead of the default set, e.g. ["ADDRESS", "CITY", "LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "SERVTYPE_DESC"]. The identity columns are always added and every record carries `ID`. An unknown name is ignored. The FDIC's column definitions are at https://api.fdic.gov/banks/docs/.

filters.description: Raw BankFind filter, ANDed with the other inputs. Lucene-style: `FIELD:value`, `FIELD:"two words"`, `FIELD:("A","B")` for any of several, `FIELD:[low TO high]` for an inclusive range (`*` open), `!(FIELD:value)` to exclude, `AND`/`OR` between terms. Column names are upper case and values match exactly as stored, case included. An unknown column matches nothing (an empty result, not an error); a syntax error is invalid_input.

sort_by.description: Columns to sort by, in priority order, e.g. ["ESTYMD"]. Defaults to `CERT`, then office number ascending (main office first). Unique tiebreak columns are always appended so offset paging is stable. An unsortable or unknown column is invalid_input.

sort_order.description: Direction for every sort column. Defaults to the direction of the default sort.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, matched against `STALP`, the office's state. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2,3}$.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code of the office. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

response.filters: CERT:3511 AND STALP:SD AND CITY:"Sioux Falls"

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

charter_group.description: CB for commercial banks, SI for savings institutions. Omit for both (two records per state and year).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same query (the record offset).

post.description:
Resolve a player's name to the MLBAM `player_id` needed by `get_player`, `get_player_gamelogs`, `get_pitch_type_summary` and `search_statcast`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

query.description: Full or partial player name, e.g. `Aaron Judge` or `ohtani`.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

x-codeSamples.label: Reference example

post.description:
Statcast pitch-level data for a known `player_id` (or team abbreviation) in a date window; narrow the window or add `pitch_types` to keep results small.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`; send it with the same other inputs to get the next page.

end_date.description: Last game date, YYYY-MM-DD; same season as `start_date`, at most 31 days later. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

post.description:
Browse or rank players by 9-category stats in a public league. Pass stat_period explicitly (S_AS_2025 = 2025-26 per-game averages, S_S_2026 = 2026-27 season totals, S_AL14 = last 14 days averages, S_PS7 = next 7 days projected, S_PSR = rest of season projected). Sort by OR (pre-season rank), AR (current rank), R_PO (% rostered), MPG, NAME or a stat id (5 FG%, 8 FT%, 10 3PTM, 12 PTS, 15 REB, 16 AST, 17 ST, 18 BLK, 19 TO). For rank windows use player_rankings.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

fantasy_team_id.description: Fantasy team id in this league (fteam filter). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,3}$.

league_id.description: Public league id, the number after /nba/ in a league URL (e.g. 10000). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

league_url.description: A league page URL; the league id is taken from its /nba/{league_id} segment. Alternative to league_id. Pattern: ^https?://(www\.)?basketball\.fantasysports\.yahoo\.com/nba/[0-9]{1,9}(/.*)?$.

nba_team.description: NBA team filter code from the page's team dropdown (ET_2 = Boston, ET_13 = LA Lakers). Pattern: ^ET_[0-9]{1,2}$.

offset.description: Row offset; the page serves 25 rows. Use next_offset from the previous page.

position.description: Position filter: P (all players), PG, SG, G, SF, PF, F, C, Util.

sdir.description: Sort direction as the site encodes it (sdir).

sort.description: Sort column as the site encodes it: OR (pre-season rank), AR (current rank), R_PO (% rostered), MPG, NAME, 0 (games played) or a stat id (5 FG%, 8 FT%, 10 3PTM, 12 PTS, 15 REB, 16 AST, 17 ST, 18 BLK, 19 TO; 4/3 FGM/FGA, 7/6 FTM/FTA). Must be one of the page's column sort keys (see columns[].sort_key). Pattern: ^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,11}|[0-9]{1,7})$.

stat_period.description: Stat window code from the page's dropdown. Projected: S_PS7, S_PS14, S_PSR (remaining games). Totals: S_L (today), S_L7, S_L14, S_L30, S_S_{season}. Averages: S_AL7, S_AL14, S_AL30, S_AS_{season}. Standard deviation: S_SDL7, S_SDL14, S_SDL30, S_SD_{season}. {season} is the starting year (2025 = 2025-26). Omitted: the page's default (reported in stat_period). Pattern: ^S_(PS7|PS14|PSR|L|L7|L14|L30|S_[0-9]{4}|AL7|AL14|AL30|AS_[0-9]{4}|SDL7|SDL14|SDL30|SD_[0-9]{4})$.

status.description: Availability in this league: ALL, A (available), FA (free agents), W (waivers), T (taken), K (keepers), STATE_IL (available, IL eligible). Watch list (WL) needs a login and is not supported.

items.summary: The question in Philadelphia isn't talent, it's fit and chemistry. And health.
items.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on 76ers key: 'Our chemistry... Us liking each other'

items.summary: Four-time All-Star Shawn Marion explains why the 76ers may not be a shoo-in contender despite the additions of LeBron James and Jaylen Brown The post NBA Legend Explains Why LeBron James, Joel Embiid Could Falter With 76ers appeared first on HEAVY.
items.title: NBA Legend Explains Why LeBron James, Joel Embiid Could Falter With 76ers

items.summary: After leaving the Lakers to join the 76ers, NBA superstar LeBron James could be the subject of a new bombshell Pablo Torre investigation. The post LeBron James Gets Very Concerning News After Lakers Departure appeared first on HEAVY.
items.title: LeBron James Gets Very Concerning News After Lakers Departure

items.summary: Furious... and perhaps a little concerned.
items.title: LeBron James Fans Are Not Happy With Former ESPN Star Pablo Torre

items.summary: Pablo Torre’s reporting on the Los Angeles Clippers salary cap circumvention in the franchise’s acquisition of Kawhi Leonard resulted in multiple journalism awards, acclaim for the Pablo Torre Finds Out podcast, and led to one of the most significant penalties against a pro sports owner in American history. While Torre has continued his probe into the…
items.title: Pablo Torre ‘looking into’ LeBron James’ helicopter benefits from Michael Rubin

items.summary: PHILADELPHIA (AP) — The 76ers tried. Oh, how they tried, to find that missing All-Star, that missing piece they could team with Joel Embiid and a rotating cast of starters and that could finally lead the franchise to an NBA championship.
items.title: Jimmy Butler, Paul George, James Harden among All-Stars failed to win a title in Philly. Can LeBron?

items.summary: With James taking a helicopter to 76ers practices and games, he's caught the attention of arguably the most famous investigative sports journalist right now.
items.title: Pablo Torre gives update into latest investigation involving LeBron James and his Fanatics helicopter

items.summary: On paper, LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers have a tailor-made roster to run a championship this season. However, titles aren’t earned on paper. When a revamped team comes together for one common goal, only a handful of players understand the hurdles that lead to a title as well as James. He’s led three franchises to four titles throughout […] The post How LeBron James is setting the ground work for 2026-27 amid 76ers’ preseason appeared first on ClutchPoints.
items.title: How LeBron James is setting the ground work for 2026-27 amid 76ers’ preseason

post.description:
Compare players by Yahoo's pre-season and actual rank windows in a public league. Sort with OR (pre-season), AR_S, AR_L30, AR_L14, AR_L7 (total-stats ranks) or AR_AS, AR_AL30, AR_AL14, AR_AL7 (average-stats ranks); page with offset.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

fantasy_team_id.description: Fantasy team id in this league (fteam filter). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,3}$.

league_id.description: Public league id, the number after /nba/ in a league URL (e.g. 10000). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

league_url.description: A league page URL; the league id is taken from its /nba/{league_id} segment. Alternative to league_id. Pattern: ^https?://(www\.)?basketball\.fantasysports\.yahoo\.com/nba/[0-9]{1,9}(/.*)?$.

nba_team.description: NBA team filter code from the page's team dropdown (ET_2 = Boston, ET_13 = LA Lakers). Pattern: ^ET_[0-9]{1,2}$.

offset.description: Row offset; the page serves 25 rows. Use next_offset from the previous page.

position.description: Position filter: P (all players), PG, SG, G, SF, PF, F, C, Util.

sdir.description: Sort direction as the site encodes it (sdir).

sort.description: Rank column to sort by: OR pre-season; AR_S / AR_L30 / AR_L14 / AR_L7 actual rank on total stats (season / last 30 / 14 / 7 days); AR_AS / AR_AL30 / AR_AL14 / AR_AL7 the same windows on average stats.

status.description: Availability in this league: ALL, A (available), FA (free agents), W (waivers), T (taken), K (keepers), STATE_IL (available, IL eligible). Watch list (WL) needs a login and is not supported.

response.attribution: Rotowire
response.scoring_context: Ranks, availability and ownership are specific to this league's scoring and roster settings; the league's own category or points rules are not part of this result.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Inspect a specific public team (league_id + team_id, e.g. from a /nba/{league}/{team} URL). NBA rosters are daily: pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) or week, not both; omitted: the league's current date. Private leagues are refused with upstream_blocked (login required).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

date.description: Roster date YYYY-MM-DD (NBA rosters change daily). Omitted (and no week): the league's current date. Pattern: ^20[0-9]{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$.

include_stats.description: Also return each player's raw stat lines (stat_id/value pairs for the league's categories) for the window; the 9-category values are always included.

league_id.description: Public league id, the number after /nba/ in a league URL (e.g. 10000). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

team_id.description: Team id inside the league (1..num_teams). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,3}$.

team_url.description: A team page URL /nba/{league_id}/{team_id}; alternative to league_id + team_id. Pattern: ^https?://(www\.)?basketball\.fantasysports\.yahoo\.com/nba/[0-9]{1,9}/[0-9]{1,3}(/.*)?$.

week.description: Fantasy week; the API answers with the first date of that week. Alternative to date.

response.scoring_context: Ranks, availability and ownership are specific to this league's scoring and roster settings; the league's own category or points rules are not part of this result.

stat_categories.name: Field Goals Made / Field Goals Attempted
Free Throws Made / Free Throws Attempted

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Use for positioning: large directional bets before a catalyst. It reports orders, not outcomes, and a sweep filled at or above the ask (execution_estimate) is a stronger signal than one at the midpoint.

post.description:

post.description:
Page through all customer reviews of one Best Buy US product (SKU or product/review URL), 20 per source page, via the endpoint Best Buy's own review pages call. Each review: stable review_id, 1-5 rating, title, text, author display name, submitted_at (ISO 8601), verified_purchase, incentivized, recommended, helpful/unhelpful votes, pros/cons, attribute ratings, photo URLs and the purchased variant. Also total_reviews, average_rating and the 1-5 star rating_distribution. sort: newest (default), oldest, most_helpful, highest, lowest, relevant. Pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is null to read every review (pages=1-10 fetches that many source pages per call). Incremental sync: sort=newest and stop at the first review_id or submitted_at already stored; for a backfill under live writes prefer sort=oldest, whose offsets do not shift when new reviews arrive.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous call for the same product and sort. Omit for the first page.

pages.description: Source pages (20 reviews each) to fetch in this call; 1 when omitted.

sku.description: Best Buy SKU, the same id the other functions take. Supply this or url. Pattern: ^[0-9]{6,8}$.

sort.description: Review order; newest when omitted. Must match the sort of a supplied cursor.

url.description: https://www.bestbuy.com product or reviews URL carrying the SKU (skuId query or the numeric path segment). Supply this or sku.

post.description:
Browse or filter lots currently at auction; find the lot id or VIN for `get_lot` and `similar_sold_lots`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

body_style.description: Site body-style filter value (Sedan, SUV, Pickup, Hatchback, Coupe, Minivan, Crossover, Convertible, Cargo-Van, Van, Wagon).

continuation.description: Continuation from a previous call (`next_cursor`): the next page number. Overrides `page`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,4}$.

estimated_max.description: Upper bound of the site's estimated value (USD).

estimated_min.description: Lower bound of the site's estimated value (USD).

fuel_type.description: Site fuel-type filter value (Diesel, Electric, Hybrid).

limit.description: Return at most this many lots from the page (the site always serves 50 per page; the rest of the page is dropped). Pagination is unaffected.

loss_type.description: Site loss-type filter value (Biohazard, Fire, Hail, Mechanical, Repossession, Theft, Vandalized, Water).

model.description: Model as listed by `makes_models` (e.g. `3 Series`); default `All`. Requires `make`.

order_by.description: Site sort key (filter mode); omitted means the site's default order (sale date).

page.description: 1-based page of 50 lots (default 1).

query.description: Free-text search (`search-type=typing`): make/model words, a VIN or a lot number. Mutually exclusive with the structured filters.

status.description: Site status filter: All (default), Active (pre-bid open), Live (auction in progress), Ended (finished today), Fast-buy (Buy Now lots).

vehicle_type.description: Site vehicle type for filter mode, as the site spells it: Automobile (default), Motorcycle, Atv, Personal-watercraft, Snowmobile, Truck, Boat, ...

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

id.description: Reference number (e.g. 0000411581) or notice id (e.g. 444172273888). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,20}$.

kind.description: Optional; inferred from the id length when absent (more than 10 digits = notice).

url.description: A bidnetdirect.com solicitation or notice page URL; used when `id` is absent.

post.description:
Local businesses matching a category or a business name near a street address, city/state or postal code (US and other Bing Maps markets). One page of up to 30 results with Bing ypid, name, street address, phone, website, coordinates, category, aggregate rating with review count and source (Yelp/Tripadvisor/...), and current open status (Open/Closed in the business's local time, with Bing's rendered sentence such as "Open · Closes 10 PM"). Results are not filtered by opening hours: to find what is open now, read `open_status` on the rows. Use the ypid with `business` for structured weekly hours.

longitude.description: Optional map centre longitude; provide together with latitude.

page.description: Result page; page N returns the businesses among Bing's top N*count that are not among its top (N-1)*count, so consecutive pages do not repeat businesses. next_page is null once a page adds no business beyond the earlier pages (Bing caps one response at about 50).

max_chars.description: Truncate `content` to this many characters; the full text is returned when omitted.

section.description: Heading text or anchor (case-insensitive) whose subtree to return, e.g. `introducing-gemini` or `Sophisticated reasoning`.

url.description: Post URL on blog.google, e.g. https://blog.google/technology/ai/google-gemini-ai/ or https://blog.google/intl/de-de/produkte/suchen-entdecken/gemini-4/. A #anchor selects that section. Pattern: ^https?://.

response.content:
## Rolling out soon

We built Gemini 4 Argon with frontier-level capabilities on coding, knowledge work, cybersecurity defense, and creative writing to be a partner for developers, professionals, and enterprises while they tackle the most difficult problems. We’re grateful for the initial cohort of cyber defenders and trusted testers whose real-world evaluations and feedback will help us strengthen our systems before we release to developers, enterprises, and consumers, starting with paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers.

include_short_posts.description: Include short posts (brief announcements) alongside articles and collections. Default true.

locale.description: Edition locale, e.g. en-us (default), de-de, fr-fr, ja-jp, en-in, es-419. Editions other than en-us live under https://blog.google/intl/{locale}/. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,4})?$.

To find a Google announcement when you know words from its headline or topic and roughly when it came out (for example 'Gemini 4 Argon' in October 2026, 'virtual power plant' this week), or to list a product's posts in a date range.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

include_short_posts.description: Include short posts (brief announcements) alongside articles and collections. Default true.

limit.description: Stop scanning after the page where at least this many matches were found, default 20.

locale.description: Edition locale, e.g. en-us (default), de-de, fr-fr, ja-jp, en-in, es-419. Editions other than en-us live under https://blog.google/intl/{locale}/. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,4})?$.

page.description: 1-based listing page to start scanning from; use next_page from the previous call.

q.description: Words that must all appear in a post's title, summary, URL, topic or author names, e.g. `Gemini 4 Argon`.

section.description: A listing page on blog.google as a URL or path: a section (https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/gemini/, old paths such as /technology/ai/ or /threat-analysis-group/ follow their redirects), an author page (/authors/sundar-pichai/), an RSS feed (/rss/, /technology/ai/rss/) or an edition front page (/intl/en-in/). Its locale comes from the URL. Pattern: ^(https?://|/).

since.description: Only posts published on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

until.description: Only posts published on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive). Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

post.description:
To learn what a series id means (its labels) without an API key, or to read history older than the API's 10-year window. For many series at once use bls_series.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

all_years.description: Return the whole published history instead of the latest 10 years. Not combined with start_year/end_year.

end_year.description: Last year of the table; requires start_year.

series_id.description: BLS series id (LNS14000000, CUUR0000SA0, CES0000000001, LAUST060000000000003) or a pasted https://data.bls.gov/timeseries/<id> URL.

start_year.description: First year of the table; requires end_year.

footnotes.text: Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations.
January 2026 estimates were revised to incorporate updated population controls. For more information, see www.bls.gov/cps/documentation.htm#pop.

code.description: The key: area_fips (30031, US000, C1074), industry_code (10, 236, 31-33 or 31_33), or size_code 1-9.

response.abstract_en: A negative electrode of a lithium secondary battery having a mixture layer containing graphite particles and an organic binder on a current collector, wherein the diffraction intensity ratio (002)/(110) of the mixture layer measured by X-ray diffraction is not higher than 500, and a lithium secondary battery having that negative electrode and a positive electrode containing a lithium compound. Since the quick charge/discharge characteristics and the cycle characteristics do not deteriorate significantly when the negative electrode density of the lithium secondary battery is increased, a high- capacity lithium secondary battery having an enhanced energy density per volume of secondary battery can be provided.
response.abstract_fr: La présente invention a trait à une électrode négative pour un accumulateur au lithium comportant une couche de mélange contenant des particules de graphite et un liant organique sur un collecteur de courant, dans laquelle le rapport d'intensité de diffraction (002)/(110) de la couche de mélange mesurée par diffraction de rayons X est égale ou inférieure à 500, et un accumulateur au lithium comportant cette électrode négative et une électrode positive contenant un composé de lithium. Etant donné que les caractéristiques de charge/décharge rapide et les caractéristiques de cycle ne se détériorent pas de manière significative lors de l'accroissement de la densité d'électrode négative de l'accumulateur au lithium, il est possible d'obtenir un accumulateur au lithium haute capacité présentant une densité d'énergie améliorée par volume d'un accumulateur au lithium.

post.description:
Start here to find patent numbers by keyword, title, inventor, applicant or owner name, IPC class, PCT or international publication number, or a date range; then call get_patent with a returned patent_number.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (the zero-based offset of the next hit). Keep every other input identical. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,5}$.

date_type.description: Which date the `from_date`/`to_date` range applies to. Requires both dates.

field.description: Restrict `query` to one bibliographic field (the CPD advanced-search field list). `intl-number` is the WO international publication number, `pct-number` the PCT filing number.

from_date.description: Inclusive range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Requires `date_type` and `to_date`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

language.description: Interface language of the results (English or French titles and summary URLs). The query syntax is the same in both.

page_size.description: Hits per page (the site serves 10, 25, 50 and 100; any value up to 100 is accepted).

query.description: Search words, or a raw CPD query expression (`field:(words)`, AND/OR/NOT, `date-field:[YYYY-MM-DD TO YYYY-MM-DD]`). Combined with `field`, only plain words belong here.

search_type.description: CPD search mode. Default: `basic` for plain words, `advanced` as soon as `field` or a date range is given. Pass `advanced` or `boolean` yourself when `query` is already a fielded expression.

to_date.description: Inclusive range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Requires `date_type` and `from_date`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

active_only.description: business_name only: tick the site's 'Only Active Corporations' box.

match.description: Name search method (business_name only): Starting With (default), All Words, Any Word or Exact Match. The site advises including corporate designations (Inc., LLC) and punctuation only for exact matches.

page.description: 1-based results page (20 rows per page). Pages after the first are reached by replaying the search and paging the grid; each page costs its own requests.

query.description: Business name text (search_type business_name) or a charter number (search_type charter_number).

search_type.description: Which registry search to run: the Business Name search (default) or the Charter No. search.

Guidant’s patented technology enables cemeteries to sell cemetery property and other products completely online from their own website, offering a seamless, consumer-friendly e-commerce experience. 

For consumers, it gives them the capability to search, shop, and purchase cemetery property directly from the cemetery’s website. Save Staff Time - Reduce the manual process and payment tracking so your team can focus on family service and customer support.

Deliver a Modern Experience - Offer families an online buying experience from the comfort of their own home at their own pace.

The Mission Accelerate client onboarding and operational execution. You will bridge client success and core engineering by utilizing Al workflows to rapidly prototype, configure, and launch custom client experiences without compromising core platform stability. The Opportunity Founded by industry veterans with a surging book of business, we are assembling a tech-forward Founding Trio in Woodland Hills, CA to accelerate our growth: Growth Product Manager Technical Program Manager Founding Lead Engineer Collaborating directly alongside our founders, this team will leverage Al to compress client rollout cycles while rapidly scaling our core e-commerce platform. Opening: Technical Program Manager (TPM) Location: Woodland Hills, CA (Hybrid / On-site with Founders) Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 + Equity Core Responsibilities Rapid Client Deployment: Lead technical onboarding workflows for enterprise clients, managing integrations, content migration, and tailored front-end setups. Al Tooling & Prototyping: Leverage Al development assistants and automated pipelines to rapidly configure client-facing assets, matching client brand standards while maintaining backend standardization. Cross-Functional Execution: Own sprint planning, client rollout schedules, project portfolio planning, portfolio reporting and technical deliverables between product, engineering, and external executive partners. Feedback Loop Standardization: Synthesize recurring client deployment requirements into actionable platform feature requests for the core engineering team. Minimum Qualifications 3+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager, Technical Implementation Manager, or Solutions Engineer in SaaS/tech. Working technical knowledge of modern web technology (APls, webhooks, CMS structures, HTML/CSS/JS basics). Experience utilizing modern Al workflows, LLM tools, or rapid prototyping frameworks to accelerate technical execution. Exceptional communication skills with a track record of managing enterprise client relationships and senior engineering stakeholders. ﻿﻿On-site availability in Woodland Hills, CA to collaborate closely with leadership. Preferred Qualifications Background in PropTech, e-commerce onboarding, or SaaS enterprise software integrations. Experience in agile development methodologies and project management tooling (Jira, Asana, MS Project, Smartsheet, Linear, GitHub, Notion). Strong technical background (e.g., Computer Science degree or developer background turned technical program manager).

entity_number.description: Public entity number in the registry's full form `<digits>-<4 digits>` (e.g. 12470848-0160). A bare business_id returned no records during reconnaissance.

entity_type.description: Entity type key from list_lookup_values(kind: entity_types), e.g. B7 (Domestic Limited Liability Company), B10104 (Domestic Business Corporation), B10310 (Assumed Name (DBA)). Pattern: ^B[0-9]{1,6}$.

formation_date_from.description: Earliest formation / registration date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

formation_date_to.description: Latest formation / registration date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

match.description: How `name` is matched (the form's Starts With / Contains / Exact Match radios).

name.description: Entity, DBA or reservation name text (3 characters or more, as the registry requires).

page.description: 1-based results page (25 rows per page; the registry serves at most 20 pages = 500 rows).

principal_name.description: Principal (officer, member, manager) name text, 3 characters or more.

registered_agent_name.description: Registered agent name text, 3 characters or more.

status.description: Entity status filter (the form's status dropdown: Active, Inactive, Cancelled, Pending).

post.description:
Enumerate every park on the marketplace or find a park by a word in its slug. Marketplace slugs are not booking slugs: use suggest_locations or search_parks to get a park_id for get_park.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

offset.description: offset

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the aggregator slug (e.g. "yellowstone", "-tx").

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

x-codeSamples.label: Reference example

post.description:
Find parks near a place or coordinates, optionally for a date range and party. Follow with get_park for details and get_park_availability for site-level availability and prices.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

amenities.description: Campsite amenity names as the site spells them (e.g. "Wi-Fi", "Electricity").

campsite_category.description: Site type filter (the site's campsiteCategory code).

checkin.description: Check-in date (park-local calendar date). Requires checkout. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

latitude.description: Search centre. Give latitude and longitude together, or `location` instead.

location.description: Place or park name resolved through the site's autocomplete (first match); not combined with latitude/longitude.

page.description: 1-based page; the continuation cursor is the next page number.

park_features.description: Park feature names as the site spells them (e.g. "Pool", "Bathrooms").

rv_slideout.description: The site's rvSlideoutValue: 0 none, 1 one side, 2 both sides.

rv_types.description: RV type names as the site spells them (e.g. "Motorhome", "Travel Trailer").

size.description: Results per page (the site caps it at 50).

sort.description: distance: nearest first; rating: highest Campspot rating first. Price sorting is not offered by this endpoint.

parks.name: Austonia RV Resort, Del Valle, Texas

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

reviews.author: Jaime M
reviews.content:
I absolutely love my 2021 Toyota Camry. From the moment I got it, I honestly fell in love with it. The car looks sporty and modern, but at the same time it’s very comfortable and smooth to drive. It feels reliable and safe, which gives me a lot of confidence, especially as someone still getting used to driving more often.

The fuel efficiency is great, and the interior is clean and well-designed. Everything feels solid and easy to use. It’s definitely a great value for the price. If I had to mention something, I wish it had push-button start, but overall I’m extremely happy with my purchase.

I would definitely recommend this car to anyone looking for something reliable, stylish, and comfortable.
reviews.title: Review

reviews.author: Nasir M
reviews.content: Great value. Car runs great and really smooth. No problems
reviews.title: Review

reviews.author: Adam V
reviews.content: A lot of people looking at a certain car for the lowest price end up getting the oldest/first year of a cars generation. Thats because its typically the least expensive year of that particular body style they are looking for. As someone whos sold many cars in the last decade I can assure you, that is typically a big mistake. They often have problems that automakers cant know about until thousands of people have driven them for tens of thousands of miles, or more. I wanted the most reliable car possible. Easy, right? Just buy a Toyota... right? No. Ive seen it with Toyota as well. Many times. So I purposely sought the most recent model year of a generation of cars that are widely considered the most reliable ever made. A 2017 Camry (non-hybrid), if treated well, can be counted on being driven for over 1 million miles without an engine rebuild. They are an engineering marvel of our time. The 2.5l 2AR-FE has to be the most bulletproof example of a gasoline engine to ever sit under a hood. The car itself is well designed and is a flawless performer in normal daily driving. The SE/XSEs in particular have a suspension that can take a quickly-turned corner without skipping a beat. The seats are very comfortable over long drives, but supportive when youre in the curves. It has large windows to avoid blind spots and has airbags in every direction. The crash tests show that its extraordinarily safe if the unthinkable occurs. Its simply a brilliant choice of car. And getting back to my first sentences, the 2017 model had it all nailed down after 6 years of getting closer and closer to perfection. Toyota could have gotten away with not redesigning it for several more years. Easily. However, being the most popular car in the United States is a challenge that requires not letting the customers get bored. So I suppose Ill forgive Toyota for not making the car longer. That said, any one of the years of the seventh generation Camry is a great car to own. But this last year is perfection. Its why I have one. Im proud & grateful to be the owner of a 2017 Camry SE. Ill likely drive it until the car or myself dies. Dont ask me which one will kick the bucket first though, because Im 42 and this engineering marvel of the auto world is only 7. Dont pass up a well treated one.
reviews.title: Review

reviews.author: Mary A
reviews.content:
I absolutely love the features of my car. The push start, sunroof, heated seats, heated steering wheel, and Apple CarPlay are all fantastic. For the value, the car is a great choice. Being a Toyota, its built to last and is also very fuel-efficient. Both the exterior and interior are incredibly clean, which adds to its appeal.

That said, there are a couple of things I wish were different. I’d love if the car had memory seats, and the display screen could be a bit more modern, especially compared to the ones in the Toyota Highlanders. Another small inconvenience is that, unlike the Highlanders where Apple CarPlay connects wirelessly through Bluetooth, my car requires the phone to be plugged in for CarPlay to work. While this isnt a huge issue, it would be more convenient if it were wireless like in the Highlanders.

Overall, it’s a really cute car and an amazing choice for a first car. Im really happy with it!
reviews.title: Review

reviews.author: Amy W
reviews.content: This car runs good, doesn't burn oil and is excellent on fuel. This car is a 4 cylinder and I have kept it up throughout the last three years I've owned it. I replaced some things such as struts, starter, fixed exhaust that leaked and cylinders. Oil change every month and today as a matter of fact, I just had it done. The tires are one year old and the auto shop said that there is a slight leak within the radiator, but that's about it.

post.description:
Finding used vehicles for sale near a US ZIP code, comparing prices against CarGurus' market value, or enumerating trims and counts for a model in an area. Chain listing_id into get_listing, entity_id into model_owner_reviews, and use suggest_vehicles or list_makes/list_models to obtain entity ids first.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

body_type_group_ids.description: Body style group ids: 0 Coupe, 1 Convertible, 3 Hatchback, 4 Minivan, 5 Pickup Truck, 6 Sedan, 7 SUV / Crossover, 8 Van, 9 Wagon (the numeric part of a listing's body_type_group_id bg<n>).

distance_miles.description: Search radius in miles; the site offers 10, 25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 500 and 50000 (nationwide). Default 50.

entity_id.description: CarGurus ontology id to search: a make (m7 = Toyota), model (d292 = Toyota Camry), model year (c33246) or trim (t56819), from suggest_vehicles, list_makes or list_models. Omit to search all vehicles. Pattern: ^[mdct][0-9]{1,9}$.

make_model_trim_paths.description: Make/model/trim paths as the site encodes them, e.g. ["m7", "m7/d292"] or ["m7/d292/XLE AWD"] (a trims facet value). Usually unnecessary: the site derives them from entity_id.

max_results.description: Return only the first N listings of the page (the site's page is 24 tiles; next_page still advances by site page). Default: the whole page.

page.description: 1-based page number (24 tiles per page); use next_page from the previous result. A page past the last one is invalid_input.

sort_type.description: Sort key: BEST_MATCH (default), DEAL_SCORE (best deals first), PRICE, MILEAGE, PROXIMITY, NEWEST_CAR_YEAR, AGE_IN_DAYS (listing age).

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code the search radius is centred on. A ZIP the site cannot resolve is invalid_input. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

post.description:
Full detail for an auction id from `search_auctions`, a sitemap or a pasted https://carsandbids.com/auctions/{id}/{slug} URL.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

auction_id.description: 8-character Cars & Bids auction id, e.g. `K1N4Qwxx` (the segment after /auctions/ in a listing URL, and `id` in search results). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{8}$.

include_photos.description: Include the full photo gallery (exterior, interior, mechanical, docs, other) with rendered URLs.

url.description: Listing URL https://carsandbids.com/auctions/{id}/{slug}; alternative to `auction_id`.

sections.equipment:
A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes:
- Weissach Package
- Sport Chrono Package
- Front-axle lift system
- Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB)
- 20-inch center-locking forged magnesium wheels
- Bose sound system
sections.highlights:
THIS... is a 2023 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS Weissach Package, finished in paint-to-sample Maritime Blue with a black and blue interior.
- The odometer on this Cayman GT4 RS currently displays approximately 6,500 miles.
- This Porsche is offered with a clean `Carfax` vehicle history report.
- A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes the Weissach and Sport Chrono packages, a front-axle lift system, Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB), and a Bose sound system. The seller reports no notable modifications.
- Introduced in 2022, the Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS boasts a naturally aspirated 4.0-liter flat-6 engine derived from the 911 GT3, featuring a 9,000-rpm redline, six individual throttle bodies, and a carbon fiber airbox mounted directly behind the driver and passenger. The sole transmission choice is a 7-speed PDK with shortened gear ratios compared to the standard GT4.
- Power comes from a 4.0-liter flat-6, rated at 493 horsepower and 331 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transmission.
sections.ownership_history: The seller reportedly purchased this Porsche in April 2025 and has added about 3,000 miles since.
sections.recent_service_history:
The attached `Carfax` history report shows that the following services have been performed:
- April 2025 (3,599 miles): Four-wheel alignment performed
- June 2024 (2,932 miles): Engine oil and filter changed
- June 2023 (1,533 miles): Engine oil and filter changed

blocks.text: A 42-year-old man killed while riding a roller-coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia was thrown from his seat and struck other patrons before landing below the ride, police said Tuesday.
Visitors to the Atlanta-area park watched in horror as he fell out of the coaster Monday, prompting Six Flags to temporarily close nine similar roller-coasters countrywide.
Investigators and park officials have not said how he ended up coming out of his seat.
"It was horrific to watch," said Summer Bates, who was at the park with her husband and three children. "One thing I think that will stick with us is the sound of his body coming down."

Bates said she and her family rode the Goliath roller-coaster earlier in the day. The park's tallest coaster, which towers over its entrance at 61 metres, has lap bar restraints that pull down over the riders' legs and waist. There are no seat belts.

"My older two children rode on the cart ahead of us," she said. "I noticed they kept trying to push theirs down tighter. I assured them that they were OK. But once my husband, youngest child and I loaded our cart and headed up the incline, I quickly understood why my older two were messing with theirs. It just didn't feel secure and tight."

The man who died was 42-year-old Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, according to Cobb County police. Officials have not released any other information about those who were injured when they were struck by the man.
Kariem worked as the information technology manager at a public charter school in Atlanta and before that was the school's technology teacher, according to an online resume.
Witness describes seeing man come out of his seat
Logan Conner said he was on the Goliath with his fiancée when he saw the man come out of his seat.
"The man started levitating in the air sideways," he told NBC. "We made direct eye contact with him."
WATCH | 1 dead, several injured in U.S. roller-coaster incident:
Britny Landry had been on the ride earlier Monday and was waiting in line to go again. She could see part of the Goliath track.
"We just look, and I just see somebody fly out," she told KTVU-TV. She said she wasn't sure if that's what she saw at first. "Maybe somebody had a bag or something."
Investigators say they spoke with park visitors and employees who saw what happened in the incident Monday at Six Flags Over Georgia in Mableton, about 24 kilometres northwest of Atlanta.
Coasters closed in Canada and U.S.

Nine roller-coasters at six North American parks that are similar to the coaster in Georgia were closed "out of an abundance of caution," according to a Six Flags Entertainment Corporation spokesperson, who said staff members and local authorities responded immediately and the park is co-operating with the investigation.
"We are deeply saddened by the guest incident at our park today," the spokesperson said, adding that the company is providing support to guests and staff who were impacted.

CBC News has confirmed that the list of nine rides includes the Behemoth and Leviathan at Canada's Wonderland, north of Toronto. A park spokesperson said it did not have a timeline for when the rides might be available again.
Canada's Wonderland is open to the public for 12 more Halloween-themed evenings and weekends until it closes for the winter.

Montreal's La Ronde amusement park said it was temporarily shutting down its Goliath roller-coaster until an update is received from the manufacturer of the ride. La Ronde was a Six Flags property until this spring, when the park's purchase by EPR Properties was finalized.
Authorities and Six Flags did not identify the roller-coaster at the Georgia location. However, local TV stations showed video of passengers being evacuated from the Goliath coaster.

The roller-coaster, which was opened in 2006, reaches top speeds of about 113 km/h and heights of 61 metres, the park's website reports. During about 3½ minutes, riders "navigate through razor-sharp turns and soar over colossal hills," according to the website.

"I cannot imagine the horror the patrons and employees witnessed today, and my heart aches for the family who lost a loved one," Lisa Cupid, chair of the Cobb County Board of Commissioners, said in a statement. She added that next of kin have been notified.
The amusement park is a major part of the county's tourism and brings in visitors from across the southeast, Cupid said.
"We are all grappling with how something so devastating could happen at a place that has given generations of families such happy memories," she said.

Georgia's Office of Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner, which oversees ride inspections, is "conducting an in‑depth and comprehensive review," said Garrison Bennett, a spokesperson. The park was already scheduled to be closed Tuesday.

This death would be at least the seventh at the Georgia park, including one in 2006 in which a man had a likely heart attack on the Goliath coaster, according to the Doan Law Firm, which focuses on amusement park accidents.

It also comes less than two weeks after Six Flags Magic Mountain, in Southern California, announced that it is retiring its famous X2 roller-coaster amid lawsuits alleging serious brain injury caused by the ride. The park had settled one wrongful-death lawsuit from the family of a 22-year-old man who died after riding the coaster in 2022.

Last year, a 32-year-old man died after riding a high-speed roller-coaster at the Universal Epic Universe theme park in Florida. He died from blunt impact injuries, and his death was ruled accidental.

results.description: The Edmonton Chamber of Commerce says the next city budget should be fiscally responsible and focused on core services while also investing in initiatives that will grow the economy.
results.title: Basic repairs, downtown investment on Edmonton business group's budget wish list

results.description: Councillors narrowly approved a motion to break down how much it would cost to launch a fare gate pilot project at one downtown LRT station. The viability of the project will be determined during budget deliberations in November.
results.title: Edmonton city council to vote on fare gate pilot project in November

results.description: Edmonton-based Studio Reset was founded by developers with years of experience working at studios like Electronic Arts-owned Bioware. As companies with billion-dollar budgets become more risk averse chasing the next big hit, it could be the best way for developers to flex their creative muscles.
results.title: Edmonton-based indie game studio latest to take blockbuster-making skills and get 'pretty risky'

results.description: The Edmonton Regional Airports Authority is lobbying federal and provincial government officials to discuss defence and economic development, amid Ottawa’s renewed commitment to the armed forces. Experts say there’s an opportunity for the Edmonton airport to grow its business.

results.description: Edmonton’s under-construction Lewis Farms Recreation Centre has a new price tag — and the project could cost almost $32 million more than the city expected.
results.title: Edmonton's Lewis Farms rec centre could cost nearly $32M more than original estimate

results.description: Mayor Andrew Knack campaigned on getting more everyday people involved in shaping the city’s priorities for the next four-year budget. That process is now underway, with a survey open until May 1, and in-person engagement sessions scheduled next month.
results.title: ‘Please get involved’: Edmonton mayor wants to know your budget priorities

results.description: A report heading to city council on Wednesday says the Lewis Farms project is facing higher inflation than predicted. City staff recommend council use an undisclosed amount from the capital budget to pay for the difference.
results.title: Edmonton Lewis Farms Recreation Centre over budget, despite being significantly scaled back

results.description: Mayor Andrew Knack says while he’s grateful the provincial government has reinstated municipal grants and is investing in Edmonton’s downtown, its latest budget doesn’t meet the mark for the city’s infrastructure needs.
results.title: Edmonton mayor says province’s ‘status quo’ 2026 budget leaves infrastructure gaps

results.description: The province has signalled significant budget challenges lie ahead. Mayor Andrew Knack said he’s aware of that, but has eyes on Edmonton’s $1.5-billion renewal deficit.
results.title: Edmonton mayor wants more infrastructure funding in provincial budget

results.description: The Edmonton Region Defence Alliance launched on Wednesday at Edmonton City Hall, promoting its capacity to capitalize on geography, innovation and industry.
results.title: Edmonton Region Defence Alliance launches day after PM unveils defence strategy
