post.description:
This week's or next week's projected points and stat lines for a football position, rest-of-season projections, or NBA fantasy basketball season and scoring-period projections.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

limit.description: Return only the top N rows. Omit for the whole table.

position.description: Football: QB, RB, WR, TE, K or DST (team defense and special teams). Basketball: PG, SG, SF, PF, C, or G (guards) and F (forwards).

scoring.description: Football only: PPR (a point per reception, the default) or STD (non-PPR). The site publishes no half-PPR tables. Omit for basketball, whose tables use CBS points scoring.

sport.description: football (default, NFL) or basketball (NBA). Positions, scoring and periods differ by sport; an option of the other sport is invalid_input.

type.description: weekly or ros (rest of season). Defaults to weekly for football and ros for basketball.

week.description: Weekly type only. Football: NFL week 1-18; omit for the current week. The site publishes the current and the next week; any other week is not_found. Basketball: a scoring period; the site publishes the next two; omit for the rest of the current period.

post.description:
Start/sit rankings for a football position this week, football draft rankings, or NBA fantasy basketball roto rankings by position.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

limit.description: Return only the top N rows. Omit for the whole table.

position.description: Football: QB, RB, WR, TE, K, DST, FLX (top 150 RB/WR/TE, weekly only) or ALL (top 200, draft only). Basketball: G (guards), F (forwards), C (centers) or ALL (top 200).

scoring.description: Football only: PPR (a point per reception, the default) or STD (non-PPR). The site publishes no half-PPR tables. Omit for basketball, whose rankings are roto.

sport.description: football (default, NFL) or basketball (NBA). Positions, scoring and periods differ by sport; an option of the other sport is invalid_input.

type.description: Football only: weekly (default), the current week, or draft, the preseason draft rankings. Omit for basketball, which publishes one list.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Actual fantasy production: last week's football scores, this season to date, a past season's totals, or recent NBA fantasy basketball form.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

limit.description: Return only the top N rows. Omit for the whole table.

period.description: Basketball only, current season, without week: yesterday, the last 7/14/21/28 days, or the three-year averages (published before the season starts). Periods the site is not showing are not_found.

position.description: Football: QB, RB, WR, TE, K or DST (team defense and special teams). Basketball: PG, SG, SF, PF, C, or G (guards) and F (forwards).

scoring.description: Football only: PPR (a point per reception, the default) or STD (non-PPR). The site publishes no half-PPR tables. Omit for basketball, whose tables use CBS points scoring.

season.description: Season year; an NBA season is labelled by the year it starts (2025 is 2025-26). Omit for the current season. The site publishes the current and the two previous seasons (three before an NBA season starts); others are not_found.

sport.description: football (default, NFL) or basketball (NBA). Positions, scoring and periods differ by sport; an option of the other sport is invalid_input.

week.description: Current season only; omit for season totals. Football: a single NFL week 1-18; the site publishes only the last completed week. Basketball: a scoring period; the site publishes only the current one ("This Period"). Others are not_found.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Retrieve estimates. Input: dataset path (acs/acs5, acs/acs1, acs/acs5/subject, acs/acs5/profile, dec/pl, dec/dhc, pep/population, cbp ...), vintage, 1-200 variable names or group(TABLE) tokens, and a geography as Data API for/in predicates (for: 'county:*', in: ['state:06']). Returns one row per geography with values as published, sentinels turned into null plus annotation, FIPS parts, variable metadata with units, and the equivalent api.census.gov URL. Unknown variables are rejected with invalid_input naming them.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: cursor

predicates.description: Exact-match filters on any returned column, e.g. {"NAICS2017": "00", "EMPSZES": "001"} for CBP or {"DATE_CODE": "12"} for PEP.

variables.description: Variable names (B01003_001E, B19013_001M, P1_001N, ESTAB) or group(TABLE). NAME and GEO_ID may be added to any request. Variables may span up to 8 tables; more than 50 variables are split into per-table fetches and merged by GEO_ID (reported in warnings).

post.description:
Search the Census Data API catalog. Input: free-text query over dataset path, title and description plus an optional vintage (year). Returns one record per dataset/vintage with its API endpoint, metadata links, publication date and supported geography levels.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page.

query.description: Case-insensitive tokens all of which must appear in the dataset path, title or description. Required (>= 2 characters) when vintage is null.

vintage.description: Restrict to one vintage year (reads api.census.gov/data/{vintage}.json, ~0.5 s). Null searches the whole catalog (~5 MB, 5-10 s).

records.description: The American Community Survey (ACS) is an ongoing survey that provides data every year -- giving communities the current information they need to plan investments and services. The ACS covers a broad range of topics about social, economic, demographic, and housing characteristics of the U.S. population. Summary files include the following geographies: nation, all states (including DC and Puerto Rico), all metropolitan areas, all congressional districts, all counties, all places, and all tracts and block groups. Summary files contain the most detailed cross-tabulations, many of which are published down to block groups. The data are population and housing counts. There are over 64,000 variables in this dataset.

Full collection of county or sub-county population estimates (annual population, births, deaths, migration) for a vintage, optionally for one state.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. It pins the vintage, file, Last-Modified and size; when the source has moved on the call fails with invalid_input at /continuation (issue code publication_changed) instead of mixing versions.

file.description: counties: counties/totals/co-est<YYYY>-alldata.csv (states and counties). subcounty: cities/totals/sub-est<YYYY>.csv (national, ~7.5 MB) or, with state, sub-est<YYYY>_<state>.csv.

state.description: Optional 2-digit state FIPS. counties: keeps that state's rows (state row included). subcounty: reads the per-state file sub-est<YYYY>_<n>.csv instead of the national file. Pattern: ^[0-9]{2}$.

sumlev.description: Optional summary level filter (050 counties only, 162 incorporated places, 061 county subdivisions ...). Pattern: ^[0-9]{3}$.

vintage.description: Vintage year YYYY of the 2020-YYYY directory. Default: the newest directory listed under popest/datasets/.

post.description:
List variables of one dataset vintage. Input: dataset path and vintage, plus a group (table id such as B01003 or DP05) and/or a free-text query matched against group descriptions and variable labels. Returns variable name, verbatim label, concept, predicate type, group and the unit phrase the label carries.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: cursor

dataset.description: Data API dataset path, e.g. acs/acs5, acs/acs5/profile, dec/pl, cbp. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_/]+$.

group.description: Table id, e.g. B01003, S0101, DP05, P1. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,40}$.

query.description: Tokens matched against group name/description (when no group is given; the first 5 matching groups are listed) or variable name/label/concept (within a group). Datasets with at most 5 tables (cbp, pep/population) whose descriptions do not match are searched by variable label instead.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Questions like "CER 2026 projection of Alberta in situ bitumen output in 2035", "Brent price assumption in the Canada Net-zero scenario", "electricity generation by fuel in Ontario to 2050".

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category.description: Sector (`Residential`, `Transportation`) or type (`Primary Fuel`, `Supply`).

dataset.description: Dataset (2021 lacks the two technology views and greenhouse gas emissions).

offset.description: `next_offset` from the previous page; repeat the other inputs with it.

region.description: Province, territory or `Canada`.

按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

commodity_group_name.description: Exact commodity_group_name, case-insensitive: AGRICULTURE, NATURAL RESOURCES, FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS.

commodity_name.description: Exact commodity_name, case-insensitive (GOLD, WHEAT, NATURAL GAS, BITCOIN).

commodity_subgroup_name.description: Exact commodity_subgroup_name, case-insensitive (GRAINS, PRECIOUS METALS, PETROLEUM AND PRODUCTS, CURRENCIES, STOCK INDICES, ...).

contract_market_code.description: Exact cftc_contract_market_code, a string with leading zeros kept (088691 = GOLD - COMMODITY EXCHANGE INC., 001602 = WHEAT-SRW - CBOT). Discover codes with `markets`. Alone, a code with no rows in this dataset is not_found; combined with date or other filters an empty page is a legitimate empty result. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,12}$.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same query (the SODA $offset).

exchange_code.description: cftc_market_code without its padding: CBT, CME, CMX, NYME, ICUS, ICEU, CMXE, FREX... Matches the padded value the dataset stores ('CMX '). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,4}$.

fields.description: Projection: SODA column names to return (open_interest_all, noncomm_positions_long_all, m_money_positions_long_all, ...). The identity columns id, market_and_exchange_names, report_date_as_yyyy_mm_dd and cftc_contract_market_code are always included. An unknown column is invalid_input. Omit for every column.

from.description: Earliest report date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

page_size.description: Rows per page (a legacy row is ~4.7 KB, a disaggregated row ~7 KB).

query.description: SODA full-text search ($q) over the text columns, e.g. `gold` or `chicago board of trade`.

report_date.description: One weekly report date (a Tuesday), YYYY-MM-DD. Not combinable with from / to. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

sort.description: Order by report date then id. The upstream default order is undefined, so an order is always sent.

to.description: Latest report date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

post.description:
Collecting the PSIX vessel register segment by segment. Iterate flags and service types (Recreational skipped by default, see README); for UNITED STATES add build_year.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

build_year.description: Construction completed year; needed to split large US segments under the 32 MiB response cap.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; carries the segment, so flag and service may be omitted with it.

flag.description: Flag state as PSIX spells CountryLookupName (case-insensitive), e.g. UNITED STATES, PANAMA, MARSHALL ISLANDS.

service.description: Service type, exact PSIX spelling (case-insensitive), e.g. Freight Ship, Tank Ship, Towing Vessel, Passenger (Inspected), Commercial Fishing Vessel.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

You want every known exploited vulnerability for a vendor or product, those used by ransomware, those added or due in a date range, or the catalog page a user pasted.

added_from.description: Earliest date added, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Pattern: ^\s*[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\s*$.

added_to.description: Latest date added, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Pattern: ^\s*[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\s*$.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page of the same search.

due_from.description: Earliest federal due date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Pattern: ^\s*[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\s*$.

due_to.description: Latest federal due date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Pattern: ^\s*[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\s*$.

forensic_triage.description: Yes keeps only CVEs that need forensic triage under BOD 26-04.

known_ransomware_campaign_use.description: Known keeps only CVEs CISA confirms are used in ransomware campaigns.

product.description: Case-insensitive substring of the product: Connect Secure, Exchange Server, Log4j.

query.description: Words that must all appear (case-insensitive) in the CVE id, vendor, product, vulnerability name or description: 'Roundcube', 'remote code execution', 'CVE-2024'.

url.description: A pasted cisa.gov KEV catalog page, print page, /kev or feed URL; its search_api_fulltext and field_cve values join query. Pattern: ^https?://.

vendor.description: Case-insensitive substring of the vendor or project: Ivanti, Microsoft, Apache.

catalog.title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

post.description:
You know the congress, session and roll call number (for example from `votes` or from a clerk.house.gov/Votes/{year}{roll} URL) and want the full result with member positions. Use `member_vote` for a single member.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

congress.description: Congress number (101 = 1989-1990, 119 = 2025-2026). Required unless `url` is given.

party.description: Keep only members of this party as coded by the Clerk (D, R, I).

position.description: Keep only members who voted this way. Yea-and-nay votes use Yea/Nay; recorded votes use Aye/No; the value is matched exactly as the Clerk records it.

roll.description: Roll call number within the session. Required unless `url` is given.

session.description: Session of the congress: 1 (odd year) or 2 (even year). Required unless `url` is given.

state.description: Keep only members from this two-letter state or territory postal code (e.g. NY). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

url.description: Alternative to congress/session/roll: a clerk.house.gov vote URL such as https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2025145 or https://clerk.house.gov/evs/2025/roll145.xml ({year}{roll} or {year}/roll{roll}).

response.question: On Passage

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

advanced_filter.description: Essie filter expression applied after the query (filter.advanced), e.g. AREA[StartDateType]ESTIMATED.

agg_filters.description: Facet filters as the site encodes them (aggFilters), e.g. "phase:3,status:rec". Pattern: ^[a-zA-Z]+:[a-zA-Z0-9_ ]+(,[a-zA-Z]+:[a-zA-Z0-9_ ]+)*$.

condition.description: Condition or disease (query.cond), e.g. "Breast Cancer". Essie syntax allowed.

location.description: Location terms: city, state, country or facility (query.locn), e.g. "Boston".

near.description: Only studies with a site within the radius of the coordinate (filter.geo=distance(lat,lon,radius)).

page_size.description: Studies per page (the API accepts up to 1000; capped at 100 here).

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page. Send the same query parameters again. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.

sort.description: Sort by a field piece with optional direction, e.g. "LastUpdatePostDate:desc", or "@relevance" (default when a query is given). Pattern: ^(@relevance|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(:(asc|desc))?)$.

status.description: Overall status filter (filter.overallStatus); any of the listed values matches.

term.description: Other terms searched across the record (query.term). Accepts Essie expressions such as AREA[StartDate]RANGE[2025-01-01,MAX].

title.description: Words in the brief or official title, or acronym (query.titles).

按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

currency.description: Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{3}$.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page for the same service and currency (tag.offset.publisher-token).

page_size.description: Records per answer. The publisher page (hint 200) holds a few thousand SKUs; the cursor carries an offset into it so answers stay bounded.

service_id.description: Optional service id (e.g. `6F81-5844-456A` for Compute Engine); when given it is the filter instead of the name. Pattern: ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}$.

service_name.description: Service display name as the publisher shows it, e.g. `Compute Engine`; matched case-insensitively against each answer group's service name.

post.description:
Find solicitations by keyword (description; with `match: any` also item description, bid number and alternate id), organization (agency), buyer, NIGP class, type code, status, UNSPSC category or opening-date window; pass a row's `bid_number` to get_bid and a `blanket_number` to get_blanket. Use list_open_bids instead for the site's curated list of currently open solicitations. At least one criterion is required; a legitimate zero-row answer sets `total_count` to 0.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

bid_number.description: Bid solicitation number or prefix, e.g. `BD-27-1060-ITD00-ITD00-133949` or `BD-27-1060` (the form's Bid # field).

buyer.description: Buyer id as the site uses it (e.g. `AUDREY.BANKS`) or the buyer's name as listed (`Last, First`); a unique fragment is accepted.

category_code.description: UNSPSC segment of the form's Category dropdown: the two-digit code, e.g. `43` (Information Technology Broadcasting and Telecommunications) or `00` (Grants), or a unique fragment of its name.

cursor.description: Row offset of the page to return (a multiple of 25), as given by the previous answer's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page. The same criteria must be passed again; the site's session is re-established on every call. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

keyword.description: Free text matched against the solicitation description (the form's Description field). With `match: any` it is also applied to the item description, bid number and alternate id, as the site's quick search does.

match.description: `all` (default): every filled criterion must match (the form's default). `any`: the site's Any/OR switch; the keyword is copied into the description, item description, bid number and alternate id fields, and a row matches when ANY filled criterion matches - so combining `any` with `status` or `type_code` returns every bid with that status or type, not the intersection. Use `any` for keyword-only quick searches and `all` when combining filters.

nigp_class.description: NIGP class code of the form's NIGP Class dropdown, e.g. `43-23`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

opening_date_from.description: Bid opening date lower bound as the form takes it, MM/DD/YYYY. Pattern: ^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])/(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])/[0-9]{4}$.

opening_date_to.description: Bid opening date upper bound, MM/DD/YYYY. Pattern: ^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])/(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])/[0-9]{4}$.

organization.description: Organization (agency) code as the site uses it, e.g. `1060`, or its name as listed, e.g. `Executive Office of Technology Services and Security`; a unique case-insensitive fragment of the name is accepted, an ambiguous one is rejected with candidates.

status.description: Status code: 2BA Approved, 2BCL Closed, 2BE Evaluated, 2BIA Intent To Award, 2BO Opened, 2BPO Bid to PO, 2BS Sent (open for responses).

type_code.description: Solicitation type: NS Non-Statewide Solicitation, SH Historical Solicitation, SS Statewide Solicitation.

post.description:
Which national tariff lines under an HS6 code a reporter traded with a partner in a period, with value, quantity and weight, e.g. USA imports from China under 850440 in 2019. For HS6-and-above aggregates use trade_data.

classification.description: HS edition in the URL path (tariffline is goods only).

cmd_code.description: Commodity code(s), comma-separated: HS6 codes select every national line beneath them; national 8-10 digit codes are accepted as the reporter publishes them. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,12}(,[A-Za-z0-9]{1,12})*$.

customs_code.description: Customs procedure code(s), comma-separated (C00 total). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,4}(,[A-Za-z0-9]{1,4})*$.

include_desc.description: Ask the API for description and ISO columns.

mot_code.description: Mode of transport code(s), comma-separated (0 total). Pattern: ^\d{1,4}(,\d{1,4})*$.

partner_code.description: Partner area code(s), comma-separated. 0 is World (the reporter's total); omit for a breakdown by every partner. Look codes up with reference_codes table=partnerAreas. Pattern: ^\d{1,4}(,\d{1,4})*$.

period.description: Period(s) YYYY or YYYYMM, comma-separated. Pattern: ^\d{4}(\d{2})?(,\d{4}(\d{2})?)*$.

reporter_code.description: UN M49 numeric reporter code(s), comma-separated (156 China, 842 USA, 276 Germany). Look codes up with reference_codes table=Reporters. Pattern: ^\d{1,4}(,\d{1,4})*$.

classification.description: Product classification in the URL path: HS (as reported, any HS edition), H0-H6 (a specific HS edition), S1-S4 (SITC), BE/BE5 (BEC), EB/EB10/EB02/EBS (EBOPS, services).

period.description: Period(s): YYYY (annual) or YYYYMM (monthly); a comma-separated list and/or inclusive ranges (2012-2019, 201901-201906). At most 12 periods after expansion; each costs one upstream request. Pattern: ^\d{4}(\d{2})?(-\d{4}(\d{2})?)?(,\d{4}(\d{2})?(-\d{4}(\d{2})?)?)*$.

response.content:
More than 99.9% of peer-reviewed scientific papers agree that climate change is mainly caused by humans, according to a new survey of 88,125 climate-related studies.

The research updates a similar 2013 paper revealing that 97% of studies published between 1991 and 2012 supported the idea that human activities are altering Earth’s climate. The current survey examines the literature published from 2012 to November 2020 to explore whether the consensus has changed.

“We are virtually certain that the consensus is well over 99% now and that it’s pretty much case closed for any meaningful public conversation about the reality of human-caused climate change,” said Mark Lynas, a visiting fellow at the Alliance for Science and the paper’s first author.

“It's critical to acknowledge the principal role of greenhouse gas emissions so that we can rapidly mobilize new solutions, since we are already witnessing in real time the devastating impacts of climate related disasters on businesses, people and the economy,” said Benjamin Houlton, the Ronald P. Lynch Dean of the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences and a co-author of the study, “[Greater than 99% Consensus on Human Caused Climate Change in the Peer-Reviewed Scientific Literature](https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/1748-9326/ac2966),” which published Oct. 19 in the journal Environmental Research Letters.

In spite of such results, public opinion polls as well as opinions of politicians and public representatives point to false beliefs and claims that a significant debate still exists among scientists over the true cause of climate change. In 2016, the Pew Research Center found that only 27% of U.S. adults believe that “almost all” scientists agreed that climate change is due to human activity, according to the paper. A 2021 Gallup poll pointed to a deepening partisan divide in American politics on whether Earth’s rising observed temperatures since the Industrial Revolution were primarily caused by humans.

“To understand where a consensus exists, you have to be able to quantify it,” Lynas said. “That means surveying the literature in a coherent and non-arbitrary way in order to avoid trading cherry-picked papers, which is often how these arguments are carried out in the public sphere.”

In the study, the researchers began by examining a random sample of 3,000 studies from the dataset of 88,125 English-language climate papers published between 2012 and 2020. They found only found four out of the 3,000 papers were skeptical of human-caused climate change. “We knew that [climate skeptical papers] were vanishingly small in terms of their occurrence, but we thought there still must be more in the 88,000,” Lynas said.

Co-author Simon Perry, a United Kingdom-based software engineer and volunteer at the Alliance for Science, created an algorithm that searched out keywords from papers the team knew were skeptical, such as “solar,” “cosmic rays” and “natural cycles.” The algorithm was applied to all 88,000-plus papers, and the program ordered them so the skeptical ones came higher in the order. They found many of these dissenting papers near the top, as expected, with diminishing returns further down the list. Overall, the search yielded 28 papers that were implicitly or explicitly skeptical, all published in minor journals.

If the 97% result from the 2013 study still left some doubt on scientific consensus on the human influence on climate, the current findings go even further to allay any uncertainty, Lynas said. “This pretty much should be the last word,” he said.

Support for the Alliance for Science is provided by the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.

If the document is not received by the Court by that date, the Court will deny the motion, on the ground that the movant failed to authorize the disclosure of information needed to permit the Government to respond to the motion. (Signed by Judge Colleen McMahon on 1/7/2021) (mml) (Entered: 01/07/2021)

entries.description: PRO SE REPLY TO THE UNITED STATES' RESPONSE TO MOTION TO VACATE, SET ASIDE OR CORRECT SENTENCE UNDER 28:2255. Document filed by Grevy Gerard Pierre-Louis. (sc) (Entered: 07/14/2021)

DECISION AND ORDER DENYING PETITIONER'S MOTION TO VACATE, SET ASIDE OR CORRECT SENTENCE PURSUANT TO 28 U.S.C. § 2255: Pierre-Louis's motion for relief pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 2255 is denied; no hearing is necessary. See Chang v. United States, 250 F.3d 79, 86 (2d Cir. 2001) (in claims of ineffective assistance, affirming district court's decision to forego a full testimonial hearing where the court "reasonably decided that the testimony of [the defendant] and his trial counsel would add little or nothing to the written submissions"). Furthermore, Pierre-Louis has not made a substantial showing of a denial of a federal right, so no certificate of appealability shall issue. See, e.g., Hamilton v. Superintendent, 2017 WL 1944114, at *6 (S.D.N.Y. 2017) (declining to issue a Certificate of Appealability "because Petitioner has failed to identify a claim that jurists ofreason would find debatable as to whether Petitioner was denied such a right) (citing Slack v. McDaniel, 529 U.S. 473,478 (2000)); Prousalis v. United States, 2018 WL 3471811, at *5 (DLC) (S.D.N.Y. 2018) (citing Hojjl.er v. Bezio, 726 F.3d 144, 154 (2d Cir. 2013); Tankleffv. Senkowski, 135 F.3d 235,241 (2d Cir. 1998); Rodriquez v. Scully, 905 F.2d 24, 24 (2d Cir. 1990)). The Court finds that any appeal by Pierre-Louis from its Order would not be taken in good faith, pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1915(a)(3). Id. (citing Coppedge v. United States, 369 U.S. 438,445 (1962)). This constitutes the decision and order of the Court. (Signed by Judge Colleen McMahon on 4/21/2022) (kv) (Entered: 04/21/2022)

Search federal PACER dockets (RECAP archive) on CourtListener by party name, attorney, case name, docket number, judge, nature of suit, cause, court and filing dates, or look one docket up by docket_id. Returns docket metadata (parties, judge, dates, PACER case id) and the docket_id needed for docket_entries.

Search published case law (opinions) from federal and state courts on CourtListener by full text, citation, case name, judge, docket number, court and filing date. Returns opinion clusters with citations, court, dates, cite counts and per-opinion snippets, PDF links and cited-opinion ids.

post.description:
To find a court form when you know a topic (`discovery`, `custody`) or a form number prefix. Use forms_list to walk the whole catalog and form for one form's detail page.

blocks.text: (a) Separate statement required
Any motion involving the content of a discovery request or the responses to such a request must be accompanied by a separate statement. The motions that require a separate statement include a motion:
(1) To compel further responses to requests for admission;
(2) To compel further responses to interrogatories;
(3) To compel further responses to a demand for inspection of documents or tangible things;
(4) To compel answers at a deposition;
(5) To compel or to quash the production of documents or tangible things at a deposition;
(6) For medical examination over objection; and
(7) For issue or evidentiary sanctions.
(Subd (a) amended effective January 1, 2007; previously amended effective July 1, 1987, January 1, 1992, January 1, 1997, and July 1, 2001.)
(b) Separate statement not required
A separate statement is not required under the following circumstances:
(1) When no response has been provided to the request for discovery; or
(2) When a court has allowed the moving party to submit-in place of a separate statement-a concise outline of the discovery request and each response in dispute.
(Subd (b) amended effective January 1, 2020; adopted effective July 1, 2001.)
(c) Contents of separate statement

A separate statement is a separate document filed and served with the discovery motion that provides all the information necessary to understand each discovery request and all the responses to it that are at issue. The separate statement must be full and complete so that no person is required to review any other document in order to determine the full request and the full response. Material must not be incorporated into the separate statement by reference. The separate statement must include-for each discovery request (e.g., each interrogatory, request for admission, deposition question, or inspection demand) to which a further response, answer, or production is requested-the following:
(1) The text of the request, interrogatory, question, or inspection demand;
(2) The text of each response, answer, or objection, and any further responses or answers;
(3) A statement of the factual and legal reasons for compelling further responses, answers, or production as to each matter in dispute;
(4) If necessary, the text of all definitions, instructions, and other matters required to understand each discovery request and the responses to it;

(5) If the response to a particular discovery request is dependent on the response given to another discovery request, or if the reasons a further response to a particular discovery request is deemed necessary are based on the response to some other discovery request, the other request and the response to it must be set forth; and
(6) If the pleadings, other documents in the file, or other items of discovery are relevant to the motion, the party relying on them must summarize each relevant document.
(Subd (c) amended effective January 1, 2007; previously repealed and adopted effective July 1, 2001.)
(d) Identification of interrogatories, demands, or requests
A motion concerning interrogatories, inspection demands, or admission requests must identify the interrogatories, demands, or requests by set and number.
(Subd (d) amended effective January 1, 2007; adopted as subd (b); previously amended effective July 1, 1987; previously relettered effective July 1, 2001.)

post.description:
The default listing. Use `category` with an industry slug from list_filters (`agency`, `portfolio`, `finance`, ...). For style or tag filters (dark, minimal, saas, ...) use list_shelf_sites instead: style filters on this feed are Pro-only.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category.description: Industry category slug as used on the home page buttons and the /inspiration/ industry shelves (agency, artificial-intelligence, assets, design-tools, desktop-apps, development-tools, shops, education, finance, marketing, mobile-apps, portfolio, productivity, tech, web-apps, web3). Omit for all sites. An unknown slug is not_found. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the feed; pass the previous page's `next_offset`.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

bbl.description: Borough-Block-Lot: the 10-digit form `1008350041` (borough 1-5, 5-digit block, 4-digit lot) or `1-835-41` / `1/835/41`.

cursor.description: Row offset to resume from: the `next_cursor` of the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

doc_type.description: ACRIS document type code to keep, e.g. `DEED`, `MTGE`, `AGMT`, `SAT`, `UCC1`. Case-insensitive. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9 ,&/._-]+$.

response.description:
List of issued building permits from the City of Edmonton - Urban Planning & Economy Department for the public to do construction or maintenance on a structure located in the City. Note - All records start from January 1, 2009.
Please note : the decision was made to not release applicant information on this dataset as it was seen as a potential privacy issue. For instance, if a high profile member of the public were to apply for a permit, their name (and consequently address) would show up on this table and become easily searchable by the public.  We viewed this as a potential issue and decided to publish the dataset without applicant information.

Also Note: The General Building Permits dataset now includes an "Occupancy Date" to indicate when a building has met the requirements for use or habitation. 
- Residential: Permits finalized on or after January 1, 2022.
- Non-Residential: Permits completed on or after January 1, 2024, only if an occupancy record exists.
- Historical Data: Records before these dates are blank for accuracy, or if no permit was required.
- Usage: For trend analysis only; not a legal confirmation of occupancy for property transactions.

response.notes:
This dataset presents the preliminary estimates of the resident population by age and sex as at 30 June 2020. The data is aggregated to the 2020 edition of the Local Government Areas (LGA).
This data is ABS data available from the Australian Bureau of Statistics.
For more information please refer to the Methodology.
Estimated resident population (ERP) is the official estimate of the Australian population, which links people to a place of usual residence within Australia. Usual residence within Australia refers to that address at which the person has lived or intends to live for six months or more in a given reference year. For the 30 June reference date, this refers to the calendar year around it. Estimates of the resident population are based on Census counts by place of usual residence (excluding short-term overseas visitors in Australia), with an allowance for Census net undercount, to which are added the estimated number of Australian residents temporarily overseas at the time of the Census. A person is regarded as a usual resident if they have been (or expected to be) residing in Australia for a period of 12 months or more over a 16-month period.

documents.name: UO_schema.xsd
documents.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" elementFormDefault="qualified" attributeFormDefault="unqualified">

<xs:element name="SUBJECT">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Юридична особа</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:complexType>
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="RECORD" type="xs:string" minOccurs="1"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Унікальний ідентифікатор суб’єкта в Єдиному державному реєстрі</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="NAME" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Найменування</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="SHORT_NAME" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Скорочене найменування</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="OPF" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Організаційно-правова форма</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="EDRPOU" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>ідентифікаційний код в Єдиному державному реєстрі підприємств і організацій України</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="STAN" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Стан діяльності</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="FOUNDING_DOCUMENT_NUM" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Цифровий код модельного статуту</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>

      <xs:element name="EXECUTIVE_POWER" type="EXECUTIVE_POWER_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="PURPOSE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Мета діяльності громадського формування</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>

      <xs:element name="FOUNDERS" type="FOUNDERS_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="BENEFICIARIES" type="BENEFICIARIES_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="SUPERIOR_MANAGEMENT" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Назви органів управління</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="SIGNERS" type="SIGNERS_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="AUTHORIZED_CAPITAL" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Розмір статутного (складеного) капіталу (пайового фонду)</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="MEMBERS" type="MEMBERS_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="STATUTE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Відомості про діяльність на підставі установчих документів, затверджених засновниками (учасниками) чи на підставі модельного статуту</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="REGISTRATION" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дата державної реєстрації, дата та номер реєстраційної дії</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="MANAGING_PAPER" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дані про розпорядчий акт, на підставі якого створено юридичну особу (назва, номер та дата)</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>

      <xs:element name="BRANCHES" type="BRANCHES_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="TERMINATION_STARTED_INFO" type="TERMINATION_STARTED_INFO_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="BANKRUPTCY_READJUSTMENT_INFO" type="BANKRUPTCY_READJUSTMENT_INFO_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="PREDECESSORS" type="PREDECESSORS_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="ASSIGNEES" type="ASSIGNEES_Type" minOccurs="0"/>

      <xs:element name="TERMINATED_INFO" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дата та номер запису про державну реєстрацію припинення юридичної особи, підстава для його внесення</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="TERMINATION_CANCEL_INFO" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дата та номер запису про відміну державної реєстрації припинення юридичної особи, підстава для його внесення</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
      <xs:element name="EXCHANGE_DATA" type="EXCHANGE_DATA_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
    </xs:sequence>
  </xs:complexType>
</xs:element>

<xs:complexType name="EXECUTIVE_POWER_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Відомості про центральний чи місцевий орган виконавчої влади, до сфери управління якого належить державне підприємство, або частку держави у статутному капіталі юридичної особи, якщо ця частка становить не менше 25 відсотків</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="NAME" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Найменування</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="CODE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Ідентифікаційний код в Єдиному державному реєстрі підприємств і організацій України</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="FOUNDERS_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Перелік засновників (учасників) юридичної особи (відомості про фізичних та юридичних осіб, що містяться в Єдиному державному реєстрі юридичних осіб, фізичних осіб-підприємців та громадських формувань в структурованому вигляді)</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="FOUNDER" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Прізвище, ім'я, по батькові або найменування; ідентифікаційний код в Єдиному державному реєстрі підприємств і організацій України (якщо засновник - юридична особа); країна громадянства або резидентства; розмір частки</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="BENEFICIARIES_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Перелік кінцевих бенефіціарних власників або обґрунтована причина його відсутності</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="BENEFICIARY" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Прізвище, ім'я, по батькові; країна громадянства; тип впливу; відсоток частки</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="SIGNERS_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Відомості про керівника юридичної особи, інших осіб, які можуть вчиняти дії від імені юридичної особи, у тому числі підписувати договори, подавати документи для державної реєстрації тощо</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="SIGNER" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Прізвище, ім’‎я, по батькові; дата призначення; дані про наявність обмежень щодо представництва юридичної особи; роль</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="MEMBERS_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Відомості про членів керівних органів</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="MEMBER" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Прізвище, ім’‎я, по батькові; посада</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="BRANCHES_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Перелік відокремлених підрозділів юридичної особи</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="BRANCH" type="BRANCH_Type" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
<xs:complexType name="BRANCH_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Запис про відокремлений підрозділ юридичної особи</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="CODE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Ідентифікаційний код відокремленого підрозділу в Єдиному державному реєстрі підприємств і організацій України</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="NAME" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Найменування</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="SIGNER" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Відомості про керівника відокремленого підрозділу: прізвище, ім'я, по батькові; посада; дата призначення; наявність обмежень щодо представництва від імені юридичної особи</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="CREATE_DATE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дата створення відокремленого підрозділу</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="EXCHANGE_DATA" type="EXCHANGE_DATA_Type" minOccurs="0"/>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="TERMINATION_STARTED_INFO_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дані про перебування юридичної особи у процесі припинення</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="OP_DATE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дата реєстраційної дії</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="REASON" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Підстава</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="SBJ_STATE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Стан суб’єкта</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="SIGNER_NAME" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Відомості про голову комісії з припинення або ліквідатора: прізвище, ім'я, по батькові; роль</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
    <xs:element name="CREDITOR_REQ_END_DATE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Строк для заявлення кредиторами своїх вимог</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="BANKRUPTCY_READJUSTMENT_INFO_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дані про перебування юридичної особи у процесі провадження у справі про банкрутство, санації</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="OP_DATE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    <xs:element name="REASON" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    <xs:element name="SBJ_STATE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    <xs:element name="BANKRUPTCY_READJUSTMENT_HEAD_NAME" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="PREDECESSORS_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дані про юридичних осіб, правонаступником яких є зареєстрована юридична особа</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="PREDECESSOR" type="PREDECESSOR_Type" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
<xs:complexType name="PREDECESSOR_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="NAME" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    <xs:element name="CODE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="ASSIGNEES_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Дані про юридичних осіб – правонаступників</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="ASSIGNEE" type="ASSIGNEE_Type" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
<xs:complexType name="ASSIGNEE_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="NAME" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
    <xs:element name="CODE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
  </xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>

<xs:complexType name="EXCHANGE_DATA_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Відомості, отримані в порядку інформаційної взаємодії між Єдиним державним реєстром та інформаційними системами державних органів</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>

    <xs:element name="EXCHANGE_ANSWER" type="EXCHANGE_ANSWER_Type" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>

<xs:complexType name="EXCHANGE_ANSWER_Type" mixed="true">
  <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Окремий набір даних від одного органу</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
  <xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="TAX_PAYER_TYPE" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"><xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Відомості про відомчий реєстр Державної податкової служби України</xs:documentation></xs:annotation></xs:element>

post.description:
Retrieve observations from any IMF dataflow (BOP current account, ER exchange rates, IL reserves, IMTS bilateral trade, CPI, GFS, FM, WEO) by dimension key. Codes are validated against the dataflow's availability; unknown codes fail with invalid_input listing valid ones. Observations carry source codes, unit, scale, status and dataset vintage; a valid key with no observations returns complete=true and no records.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

items.abstract: The present invention relates to the use of an I h chanel modular in the manufacture of a medicament for use in psychiatry. To certain novel methanamine derivatives, to processes for their preparation, to pharmaceutical formulations containing them and to their use in medical therapy, particularly for use in psychiatry.
items.title: MODULATEURS DE CANAL I h?

items.abstract: At least some embodiments of the disclosure include a method and device for information identification. In the method, a base station acquires a notification message about a start of a traffic information service, wherein the notification message carries a traffic information identifier and a timestamp, the traffic information identifier is a service identifier for indicating traffic information, and the timestamp indicates a time point when the base station sends Multicast Channel Scheduling Information (MSI); and the base station sends the MSI according to the notification message, wherein the MSI is indicative of position information and expansion information of a sub-frame where a Multicast Traffic Chanel (MTCH) corresponding to the traffic information is. With the technical solution provided in the disclosure, the power consumption for an On Board Unit (OBU) to acquire traffic and scheduling information is further reduced, and it is realized that the OBU receives the required traffic information timely.
items.title: PROCÉDÉ ET DISPOSITIF POUR IDENTIFICATION D'INFORMATIONS

items.abstract: The facility is of the type that has a pair of side bars (1,1) acting as inclined supports for an upper sheet (2) with openings (8) for inserting the plants, a closed lower sheet (4) acting as a collector, and at least one intermdiate sheet (3) with openings determining a cascade trajectory for the water with the nutrients. The invention consist in providing a multi-layer uppersheet (2) comprising preferably four layers (2a,2b and 2d), which together define narrow Channels (7) for selective use, such that at the time of insertion, the root of each plant is placed in a chanel (7) different from that used by adjacent plants. Furthermore according to the invention, the openings (8) for the insertion of the plants form two marginal and longitudinal lines. In this way, the roots of the adjacent plants can be completely isolated during the first growth phase thereof, preventing interference therebetween and allowing plants with different growth rates and even different types of plants to be arranged on the facility, generating, in turn, continuous production and an improved yield from the facility.
items.title: INSTALLATION DE CULTURE HYDROPONIQUE

Is anything burning near this ranch or parcel right now, how big is it and how contained? Use fire_history_for_geometry for past fires and incident_detail for one incident's full record.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Foreign members (properties, id, bbox, crs) pass through unused. FeatureCollection, GeometryCollection, lines and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused as invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code (ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, antimeridian, feature_collection, outside_coverage).

include_rx.description: Include prescribed fires (IncidentTypeCategory RX). Default true.

radius_km.description: Search radius around the geometry in kilometres (default 25, max 200).

post.description:
Has this parcel burned in a recorded fire perimeter, when and how much of it? For what is burning now use active_fires_near_geometry.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

buffer_km.description: Also return perimeters within this many kilometres of the geometry (default 0: intersecting only).

end.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Foreign members (properties, id, bbox, crs) pass through unused. FeatureCollection, GeometryCollection, lines and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused as invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code (ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, antimeridian, feature_collection, outside_coverage).

start.description: First day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (default 20 years before end). The historic view is filtered by fire year. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

response.history_note: Perimeter history is only as complete as the agencies' submissions: the all-years view is sparse before ~2000 and many pre-2014 rows lack an IrwinID; WFIGS perimeters start in 2021. A parcel with no perimeter here may still have burned in an unmapped fire.

What started burning in the last day, nationally or near a place.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Foreign members (properties, id, bbox, crs) pass through unused. FeatureCollection, GeometryCollection, lines and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused as invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code (ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, antimeridian, feature_collection, outside_coverage).

radius_km.description: Search radius around the geometry in kilometres (default 50, max 200).

sources.name: WFIGS Interagency Fire Incident Locations, last 24 hours

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

release.description:
The Address Points from National Address Database dataset was compiled on September 30, 2026 by the US Department of Transportation. The National Address Database (NAD) is a spatial database containing address data, point location coordinates, jurisdictions, record-level metadata and other supporting data for addressable locations including structures, some sub-units within those structures, and landmarks as included in the aggregated datasets from providers included therein.

Technical Note: Record Ordering and Object IDs
Please Note: The records in this flat text file are structured in their optimized physical database order, rather than numerical sequence by OID_ (Object ID). Because the National Address Database leverages highly efficient spatial indexing and bit-packing compression algorithms before export, geographically clustered records (such as specific states or counties) are grouped together on disk.

All OID_ values remain perfectly unique across the entire dataset, but they will appear out of chronological order when reading the file sequentially. If your integration workflow requires a strict numerical sequence, you can safely sort the dataset by the OID_ column upon ingestion.

attributes.value: This indicator is related to the national accounts, which are critical for understanding and managing a country's economy. They provide a framework for the analysis of economic performance. National accounts are the basis for estimating the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and Gross National Income (GNI), which are the most widely used indicator of economic performance. They are essential for government policymakers, providing the data needed to design and assess fiscal and monetary policies; and are also used by businesses and investors to assess the economic climate and make investment decisions. NAS enable comparison between economies, which is crucial for international trade, investment decisions, and economic competitiveness. More specifically, this indicator is related to national accounts aggregates. Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross National Income (GNI), and other aggregates provide a snapshot of the size and health of an economy by measuring the total economic activity within a country. They can thus be used by policymakers to design and implement economic policies, as they reflect the overall economic performance and can indicate the need for intervention in certain areas. Aggregates also allow for comparisons between different economies, which can be useful for trade negotiations, investment decisions, and economic benchmarking. By examining aggregates over time, economists and analysts can identify trends, cycles, and potential areas of concern within an economy, and investors can use national accounts aggregates to assess the potential risks and returns of investing in a particular country. Overall, national accounts aggregates are fundamental tools for economic analysis, policy formulation, and decision-making at both the national and international levels.

Gross domestic product (GDP), though widely tracked, may not always be the most relevant summary of aggregated economic performance for all economies, especially when production occurs at the expense of consuming capital stock.









While GDP estimates based on the production approach are generally more reliable than estimates compiled from the income or expenditure side, different countries use different definitions, methods, and reporting standards. World Bank staff review the quality of national accounts data and sometimes make adjustments to improve consistency with international guidelines. Nevertheless, significant discrepancies remain between international standards and actual practice. Many statistical offices, especially those in developing countries, face severe limitations in the resources, time, training, and budgets required to produce reliable and comprehensive series of national accounts statistics.









Among the difficulties faced by compilers of national accounts is the extent of unreported economic activity in the informal or secondary economy. In developing countries a large share of agricultural output is either not exchanged (because it is consumed within the household) or not exchanged for money.

Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.

Methodology: National accounts are compiled in accordance with international standards: System of National Accounts, 2008 or 1993 versions. Specific information on how countries compile their national accounts can be found on the IMF website: https://dsbb.imf.org/
Statistical concept(s): The conceptual elements of the SNA (System of National Accounts) measure what takes place in the economy, between which agents, and for what purpose. At the heart of the SNA is the production of goods and services. These may be used for consumption in the period to which the accounts relate or may be accumulated for use in a later period. In simple terms, the amount of value added generated by production represents GDP. The income corresponding to GDP is distributed to the various agents or groups of agents as income and it is the process of distributing and redistributing income that allows one agent to consume the goods and services produced by another agent or to acquire goods and services for later consumption. The way in which the SNA captures this pattern of economic flows is to identify the activities concerned by recognizing the institutional units in the economy and by specifying the structure of accounts capturing the transactions relevant to one stage or another of the process by which goods and services are produced and ultimately consumed.

post.description:
Look up one indicator code and return its full metadata: name, theme, unit label, data availability, glossary definition and calculation method, and the disaggregation dimensions the code encodes. Unknown codes answer not_found.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

indicator_code.description: UIS indicator code, e.g. CR.1.F, ROFST.1.CP, XGDP.FSGOV, EXPGDP.TOT. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]+(\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$.

version.description: UIS data version id such as 20260507-91260335 (see versions). null or omitted = current default version. Pattern: ^[0-9]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{8}$.

license.attribution: Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public, extracted 2026-09-15T03:50:00.000Z
license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)

glossary.calculation_method: The number of persons in the relevant age group who have completed the last grade of the given level of education is expressed as a percentage of the total population (in the survey sample) of the same age group. As with attendance rates, individuals are assigned completion age group based on actual or assumed age at the beginning of the school year.
glossary.data_source:
Population censuses and household surveys which collect data on the highest level of education or grade completed by children and young people in a household, through self- or household-declaration. In the former case, each household member above a certain age reports his or her own level of educational attainment. In the latter case, one person, usually the head of the household or another reference person, indicates the highest grade and/or level of education completed by each member of the household. Administrative data from ministries of education on the structure of the education system (entrance ages and durations) are also needed.

Surveys can serve as a source of data if they collect information for the age groups of concern. In addition to national surveys, international sample surveys, such as Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS, http://dhsprogram.com) or Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS, http://mics.unicef.org), are another source. These surveys are designed to meet commonly agreed upon international data needs and aim to assure cross-national comparability, while also providing data for national policy purposes. These surveys are implemented on a regular basis in selected countries, on average every 3 to 5 years.

Population censuses can also be a source of attainment data but they are carried out less frequently than household surveys, often only once per decade.  Data on attainment collected with surveys or censuses are usually mapped to ISCED levels post-enumeration.
glossary.definition:
SDG Indicator 4.1.2: Percentage of a cohort of children or young people aged 3-5 years above the intended age for the last grade of each level of education who have completed that grade.

The intended age for the last grade of each level of education is the age at which pupils would enter the grade if they had started school at the official primary entrance age, had studied full-time and had progressed without repeating or skipping a grade.

For example, if the official age of entry into primary education is 6 years, and if primary education has 6 grades, the intended age for the last grade of primary education is 11 years. In this case, 14-16 years (11 + 3 = 14 and 11 + 5 = 16) would be the reference age group for calculation of the primary completion rate.
glossary.interpretation:
A completion rate at or near 100% indicates that most or all children and adolescents have completed a level of education by the time they are 3 to 5 years older than the official age of entry into the last grade of the given level of education.

A low completion rate indicates low or delayed entry into a given level of education, high drop-out, high repetition, late completion, or a combination of these factors.  To identify the causes of low completion rates, it is necessary to examine other indicators, for example the out-of-school rate, the gross intake ratio to the last grade, and the percentage of over-age children.  When disaggregated by sex, location and other characteristics, this indicator can identify excluded population groups.
glossary.limitations: Education levels and grades reported in household surveys may not align with the country ISCED mappings, with implications for comparability. Programme completion is typically determined using data on the highest grade completed and the official duration for the given level.  As a result, individuals that complete a programme corresponding to a given ISCED level that has a duration less than the official duration of that ISCED level are assumed to not have completed. In addition, changes in the official duration of education levels over time can prevent the accurate assessment of the completion status of older cohorts.
glossary.name: Completion rate (primary education, lower secondary education, upper secondary education)

privacy_policies.description: The Microsoft Data Privacy Notice describes the collection and use of personal employment data of employees, external staff, candidates and guests. The Notice is available to employees on Microsoft internal and publicly viewable websites, systems, tools and applications used by employees, external staff, candidates, and guests to enter, edit or view their personal data. For description of Data Privacy Framework, please see the section "Where we store and process personal data”: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?Linkid=518021
privacy_policies.name: Microsoft Data Privacy Notice

response.purpose:
Microsoft collects data from Microsoft product users and employees, external staff, candidates and guests through interactions with them and through their interactions with Microsoft products, in accordance with the Microsoft Privacy Statement (for Microsoft product users) and the Microsoft Global Data Privacy Notice for Employees, External Staff, Candidates and Guests. The personal data we process related to product users is provided by data subjects directly, and we get some of it by collecting data about interactions, use, and experiences with our products. The data we collect depends on the context of interactions with Microsoft and the choices users make, including privacy settings and the products and features used. We also obtain data about users from third parties. Microsoft uses the data we collect to provide rich, interactive experiences. In particular, we use data to provide our products, which includes updating, securing, and troubleshooting, as well as providing support.
 
Microsoft processes data to improve and develop our products, personalize our products and make recommendations, and advertise and market to users, which includes sending promotional communications, targeting advertising, and presenting relevant offers. We also use the data to operate our business, which includes analyzing our performance, meeting our legal obligations, developing our workforce and doing research. The personal data Microsoft processes related to employees, external staff, candidates and guests is processed to administer the employment contract, offer letter or other commitments we have made to the individual, and for other overriding and legitimate business purposes, legally required purposes, and other uses where permissible and in accordance with applicable laws and consultation requirements, as further detailed in the Microsoft Global Data Privacy Notice for Employees, External Staff, Candidates and Guests.
 
Microsoft data processing also includes sharing data, when it is required to provide the service or carry out the transactions requested. We share personal data with consent or to complete any transaction or provide any product data subjects have requested or authorized. We also share data with Microsoft-controlled affiliates and subsidiaries; with vendors working on our behalf; when required by law or to respond to legal process; to protect our customers; to protect lives; to maintain the security of our products; and to protect the rights and property of Microsoft and its customers. All U.S. subsidiaries using the Microsoft brand name are covered entities, as well as those subsidiaries listed above, which use different names. Certain Microsoft U.S. entities continue to maintain their own DPF certification, including LinkedIn Corporation and GitHub.

data_covered.description: Restrict to certifications covering human-resources data (`HR`) and/or non-HR data (`NonHR`). The site accepts other strings silently, so only these two are allowed.

frameworks.description: Framework ids: 1 = EU-U.S. DPF, 2 = Swiss-U.S. DPF, 3 = UK Extension to the EU-U.S. DPF.

industry_ids.description: Industry row ids from list_reference_data(kind=industries). Several ids share one industry name; pass every id you want to match.

page.description: 1-based page number; `next_page` of the previous result.

page_size.description: Rows per page; the three sizes the site's own list offers.

query.description: Text matched against the organization's public display name (substring, case-insensitive on the site). Omit for the full list.

recourse_mechanisms.description: Recourse mechanism provider names exactly as listed by list_reference_data(kind=recourse_mechanisms), e.g. `JAMS`.

start_letter.description: Only organizations whose display name starts with this letter or digit. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]$.

states.description: Two-letter U.S. state or territory codes (e.g. CA, NY, DC, PR).

status.description: Participation status bucket: `active` (includes 'Active - Re-certification under Review'), `inactive` (lapsed or withdrawn), or `all`.

statutory_bodies.description: The U.S. statutory body with jurisdiction over the participant.

verification_method.description: How the organization verified its compliance.

post.description:
After support_documents gave you a book_id and a guid, read a chapter; use the returned toc to find the guid of 'Keyboard', 'External ports and slots', 'Power adapter' or any other specification chapter. A guid the book does not contain is not_found.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

book_id.description: Manual book id, e.g. dellpro16plus_pb-16250_om. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,119}$.

locale.description: Manual language/locale (Dell publishes manuals in 30+ languages). Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]{2}$.

response.profile:
Electronic and alternative rock (modern rock) band from Oxfordshire, England (United Kingdom).

The name Radiohead comes from the [a=Talking Heads] song, "Radio Head", from the "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Talking-Heads-True-Stories/master/39386]True Stories[/url]" album.

Formed by school friends in 1985, Radiohead did not release their first single until 1992's "[r=767600]". The cathartic "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Creep/master/21481]Creep[/url]", from the debut album "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Pablo-Honey/master/13344]Pablo Honey[/url]" (1993), became a worldwide hit as grunge music dominated radio airwaves.

Radiohead were initially branded as a one-hit wonder abroad, but caught on at home in the UK with their second album, "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-The-Bends/master/17008]The Bends[/url]" (1995), earning fans with their dense guitar atmospheres and front man [a=Thom Yorke]'s expressive singing. The album featured the hits "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-High-Dry-Planet-Telex/release/199387]High & Dry[/url]", "[r=1463625]" and "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Fake-Plastic-Trees/master/21526]Fake Plastic Trees[/url]".

The band's third album, "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-OK-Computer/master/21491]OK Computer[/url]" (1997), propelled them to greater attention. Popular both for its expansive sound and themes of modern alienation, the album has been acclaimed by critics as a landmark record of the 1990s, some critics go as far to consider it one of the best of all time. "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Kid-A/master/21501]Kid A[/url]" (2000) marked further evolution, containing influences from experimental electronic music.

"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Hail-To-The-Thief/master/16962]Hail To The Thief[/url]" (2003) was seen as a conventional return to the guitar and piano-led rock sound. After fulfilling their contract with EMI, Radiohead released "[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-In-Rainbows/master/21520]In Rainbows[/url]" (2007) famously via a pay-what-you-want model. Their latest album,  "[url=https://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-A-Moon-Shaped-Pool/master/998252]A Moon Shaped Pool[/url]", was released in May 2016.
 
Radiohead's original influences were cited as alternative rock and post-punk bands like [url=http://www.discogs.com/artist/Smiths,+The]The Smiths[/url], [a=Pixies], [a=Magazine], [a=Joy Division] and [a=Siouxsie & The Banshees], who Thom Yorke claims inspired him to become a performer, and [a=R.E.M.] (with lead singer of the band, Thom Yorke, referring to himself as an 'R.E.M. groupie').

Band members:
Thom Yorke – vocals, guitar, piano, keyboards, laptop (1985–present)
Colin Greenwood – bass guitar (1985–present)
Ed O'Brien – guitar, effects, backing vocals (1985–1990, 1990–present)
Philip Selway – drums, percussion (1985–present)
Jonny Greenwood – guitar, keyboards, ondes Martenot, glockenspiel, laptop, orchestral arrangements (1988–present)

Current live members:
Clive Deamer – drums, percussion (2011–present)

Former members:
Rasmus "Raz" Peterson – tenor saxophone, alto saxophone (1985–1989)
Liz Cotton – alto saxophone (1988–1989)
Charlotte Cotton – alto saxophone (1988–1989)
Nigel Powell – drums (1990)

Previous names:
On a Friday (1985–1990, 1990–1991)
Shindig (1990)
