        "profile": "Electronic and alternative rock (modern rock) band from Oxfordshire, England (United Kingdom).\r\n\r\nThe name Radiohead comes from the [a=Talking Heads] song, \"Radio Head\", from the \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Talking-Heads-True-Stories/master/39386]True Stories[/url]\" album.\r\n\r\nFormed by school friends in 1985, Radiohead did not release their first single until 1992'"'"'s \"[r=767600]\". The cathartic \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Creep/master/21481]Creep[/url]\", from the debut album \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Pablo-Honey/master/13344]Pablo Honey[/url]\" (1993), became a worldwide hit as grunge music dominated radio airwaves.\r\n\r\nRadiohead were initially branded as a one-hit wonder abroad, but caught on at home in the UK with their second album, \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-The-Bends/master/17008]The Bends[/url]\" (1995), earning fans with their dense guitar atmospheres and front man [a=Thom Yorke]'"'"'s expressive singing. The album featured the hits \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-High-Dry-Planet-Telex/release/199387]High & Dry[/url]\", \"[r=1463625]\" and \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Fake-Plastic-Trees/master/21526]Fake Plastic Trees[/url]\".\r\n\r\nThe band'"'"'s third album, \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-OK-Computer/master/21491]OK Computer[/url]\" (1997), propelled them to greater attention. Popular both for its expansive sound and themes of modern alienation, the album has been acclaimed by critics as a landmark record of the 1990s, some critics go as far to consider it one of the best of all time. \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Kid-A/master/21501]Kid A[/url]\" (2000) marked further evolution, containing influences from experimental electronic music.\r\n\r\n\"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-Hail-To-The-Thief/master/16962]Hail To The Thief[/url]\" (2003) was seen as a conventional return to the guitar and piano-led rock sound. After fulfilling their contract with EMI, Radiohead released \"[url=http://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-In-Rainbows/master/21520]In Rainbows[/url]\" (2007) famously via a pay-what-you-want model. Their latest album,  \"[url=https://www.discogs.com/Radiohead-A-Moon-Shaped-Pool/master/998252]A Moon Shaped Pool[/url]\", was released in May 2016.\r\n \r\nRadiohead'"'"'s original influences were cited as alternative rock and post-punk bands like [url=http://www.discogs.com/artist/Smiths,+The]The Smiths[/url], [a=Pixies], [a=Magazine], [a=Joy Division] and [a=Siouxsie & The Banshees], who Thom Yorke claims inspired him to become a performer, and [a=R.E.M.] (with lead singer of the band, Thom Yorke, referring to himself as an '"'"'R.E.M. groupie'"'"').\r\n\r\nBand members:\r\nThom Yorke – vocals, guitar, piano, keyboards, laptop (1985–present)\r\nColin Greenwood – bass guitar (1985–present)\r\nEd O'"'"'Brien – guitar, effects, backing vocals (1985–1990, 1990–present)\r\nPhilip Selway – drums, percussion (1985–present)\r\nJonny Greenwood – guitar, keyboards, ondes Martenot, glockenspiel, laptop, orchestral arrangements (1988–present)\r\n\r\nCurrent live members:\r\nClive Deamer – drums, percussion (2011–present)\r\n\r\nFormer members:\r\nRasmus \"Raz\" Peterson – tenor saxophone, alto saxophone (1985–1989)\r\nLiz Cotton – alto saxophone (1988–1989)\r\nCharlotte Cotton – alto saxophone (1988–1989)\r\nNigel Powell – drums (1990)\r\n\r\nPrevious names:\r\nOn a Friday (1985–1990, 1990–1991)\r\nShindig (1990)",

Search the Discogs database for releases, masters, artists or labels by free text, artist, release title, track, label, catalog number or barcode, optionally narrowed by year, format, country, genre and style. Returns one page of matches with type, title, year, country, formats, labels, catalog number, barcodes and IDs to pass to the detail functions.

按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

catno.description: Catalog number as printed, e.g. `PB 41447` or `WARPLP92`.

country.description: Country as Discogs spells it, e.g. `US`, `UK`, `Germany`, `Japan`.

page.description: Result page, 1-based.

query.description: Free-text query matched against artist, title, label and catalog number.

type.description: Restrict results to one record type. Omit for all types.

year.description: Release year.

post.description:
To build or check a Higgsfield API request for a specific model: which endpoints a family offers, and the exact parameters, allowed values and defaults a workflow accepts. Credit costs are not published in the docs (the estimate endpoint needs an API key).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

model.description: Model family slug from list_models (e.g. kling-3), a model/workflow path (kling-3/pro-text-to-video) or a model docs URL.

workflow.description: Workflow slug from the family's workflows, e.g. pro-text-to-video.

response.description: Generate videos with Standard, Pro, 4K and Turbo workflow variants.
response.name: Kling 3.0

workflow.description: Pro · Text to video with Kling 3.0: request parameters, examples and response handling.
workflow.title: Kling 3.0 — Pro · Text to video
usage_notes: Always include a non-empty top-level prompt, including when using multi_prompt. Keep it within 2,500 characters; longer prompts are truncated.
For custom shots, set multi_shots to true and provide 1–6 multi_prompt objects. Each object needs prompt (at most 512 characters) and duration (a positive integer from 1 to 15 seconds).
Custom-shot durations are summed for generation and billing; the top-level duration does not override that sum. With multi_shots enabled and no custom shots, the top-level duration is retained.
Native audio uses sound: on or off and defaults to on.
elements contains Kling element IDs as decimal strings. Each ID must belong to the account making the request; arbitrary provider IDs are rejected.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
To read primary Higgsfield API documentation: quickstart, authentication, request lifecycle, polling, webhooks, file uploads, errors, rate limits, billing and retention, SDKs, or a model workflow page. Call without section (with a small max_chars) to see the outline, then fetch the section you need.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

max_chars.description: Cut content to this many characters. The whole page or section is returned when omitted.

path.description: Page path such as quickstart, how-to/webhooks or concepts/polling.md#retry-decisions. A leading docs/ and .md are accepted; index is the overview page.

section.description: Heading text or anchor of the section to return, e.g. Delivery and retries or delivery-and-retries.

url.description: Alternatively a page URL, e.g. https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/how-to/webhooks#delivery-and-retries. Pattern: ^https?://.

response.content:
## Delivery and retries

* Return any `2xx` response after durably recording the event.
* Network failures and `5xx` responses are retried for up to two hours.
* `4xx` responses are treated as permanent and are not retried.
* Duplicate deliveries are possible. Deduplicate by `request_id` and terminal `status`.
* If delivery fails permanently, retrieve the result through the authenticated status endpoint.

Reject request bodies that do not match the documented envelope, but acknowledge valid duplicate deliveries with `2xx`.

To see what the Higgsfield API docs cover (getting started, request lifecycle, SDKs, organizations, API reference, help) and pick a page for get_page, instead of fetching llms.txt raw.

guidance: Start at https://console.higgsfield.ai to discover models and open their model-specific API documentation.
Use the selected model’s documentation for its endpoint, request schema, supported parameters, and examples. Follow its model-specific `llms.txt` link when available.
Use https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/llms.txt for shared authentication, SDK, polling, webhook, and error-handling guidance.
Treat `/docs/openapi.json` as supplementary reference, not the authoritative model catalog. A model’s absence from that file does not establish that it is unavailable.
Check whether model documentation targets production or preview. Do not silently substitute environments, endpoints, or models.
If sources conflict or access prevents verification, describe the specific uncertainty. Distinguish documented availability from access verified with the user’s account.

limit.description: Maximum hits, 1-10 (the server returns at most 10). Defaults to 10.

max_snippet_chars.description: Cut each snippet to this many characters. Defaults to 1500.

query.description: Search text, e.g. webhook delivery retries.

results.snippet:
## Delivery and retries

* Return any `2xx` response after durably recording the event.
* Network failures and `5xx` responses are retried for up to two hours.
* `4xx` responses are treated as permanent and are not retried.
* Duplicate deliveries are possible. Deduplicate by `request_id` and termina
results.title: Delivery and retries

results.snippet:
## Retry after an ambiguous failure

1. Create the key before sending the generation request.
2. Store the key with your local operation or job record.
3. After a network error, timeout, or `5xx`, retry the same endpoint and parameters with the same key.
4. Store the returned `request_id` and use it
results.title: Retry after an ambiguous failure

results.snippet:
## Safe retry policy

* Retry `GET` status requests after network failures and `5xx` responses.
* Do not retry authentication or validation failures without changing the request.
* Use exponential backoff with jitter.
* Set maximum attempts and a total retry deadline.
* Send an [`Idempotency-Key`](/
results.title: Safe retry policy

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

agencies.description: Airiti DOI is a Taiwan-based registration agency operated by Airiti, which is a service provider deeply involved in the scholarly community of the Chinese-speaking area. They manage applications to Chinese and English materials, incorporating the DOI into the digital publishing process, saving time and money for their members and partners. In addition to DOI registration services, Airiti DOI also develops and provides value-added services that support academic publishing, such as DOI Resolution, DOI Data Finder (search DOI names and metadata), DOI resolution data download, and Cited by Link.
agencies.name: Airiti DOI

agencies.description: BSI Identify is a service operated by BSI to provide unambiguous identification for products and the long-term persistent storage of associated product information that can be accessed using a digital ID called a UPIN (Unique Persistent Identification Number). The service provides a consistent approach to identification of construction products that supports the industry as it continues to digitize and addresses critical safety issues.
agencies.name: BSI Identify

agencies.description: Chinese DOI is a DOI registration service jointly run by ISTIC & Wanfang Data, and it was the first DOI RA in China and Asia. It mainly provides DOI registration, resolution and other value-added services to Chinese publishers, research institutions, service providers and researchers for research content such as academic journals, scientific data, dissertations, books, conference proceedings, preprints, etc. ISTIC (Institute of Science and Technology Information of China) is a national public beneficial research institute under the Ministry of Science and Technology of China, and Wanfang Data (Wanfang Data Co., Ltd. & Wanfang Data CORP. (INTL) LTD) is the leading science and technology information service provider in China.
agencies.name: Chinese DOI

agencies.description: China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) manages China-based information resources, including Chinese politics, economics, humanities, social science, science, and technology. CNKI publishes databases containing e-journals, newspapers, dissertations, proceedings, yearbooks, references works, and more.
agencies.name: CNKI

agencies.description: Crossref is an open scholarly infrastructure supporting the discovery, assessment, and reuse of all kinds of research objects. With over 24,000 members across 166 countries and ~180 million DOI records representing more than 90% of all DOI usage, Crossref is the DOI registration agency most relied upon by the global research community. Members contribute to the Research Nexus — an open network of relationships connecting research organisations, people, outputs, and actions that can be built on forever, for the benefit of society.
agencies.name: Crossref

agencies.description: DataCite is a global non-profit organization that provides DOIs for research data and all other research outputs. By assigning DataCite DOIs, research outputs become discoverable and associated metadata is made available to the community. DataCite develops additional services to make it easy to connect and share research outputs with the broader research ecosystem and to assess the use of outputs within that ecosystem. All organizations within the research community can join DataCite to start registering DOIs.
agencies.name: DataCite

agencies.description: The Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) provides identification services for Content Identifers and Video Service Identifers. Content IDs are a registry of movies, television shows, radio programs, podcasts, and other audio/video assets of commercial, cultural, historic, or scientific interest. Video Service IDs are a registry of content delivery services including terrestrial broadcast channels, satellite delivery channels, cable television networks, Internet streaming services, etc. EIDR IDs are commonly used for process automation, linked data, engineering standards, academic citation, universal search, and so forth.
agencies.name: EIDR

agencies.description: HAND is the Universal Talent Identifier built for the business requirements of Hollywood & sports. By identifying Legal Entity Humans, Licensed Virtual Humans, and Fictional Characters, HAND provides the interoperable Talent ID the industry needs for historical, present, and future uses.
agencies.name: HAND

agencies.description: The Japan Link Center (JaLC) provides public information services to promote science and technology in Japan. Scientific and academic metadata and content from holders nationwide, including national institutes, universities, government organizations, and commercial publishers. Operated by Japan Science and Technology Agency, National Institute of Material Science, National Institute of Informatics, and National Diet Library. Collaboration with Crossref and DataCite for global distribution.
agencies.name: JaLC

agencies.description: The Korean DOI Center is operated by the Korea Institute of Science and Technology Information (KISTI). They collect bibliographic information of Korean science and technology information and data, including journal articles, proceedings, official Government documents, Korean patent information, R&D Reports and traditional Korean knowledge. In addition, the Korean DOI Center promotes the use of the collected information and data in Korea and improve access to Korean research achievements.
agencies.name: Korean DOI Center

agencies.description: The multilingual European DOI Registration Agency (mEDRA) is a persistent citation system for Internet documents. Relation tracking between intellectual property entities. Certification of voluntary deposit including time stamping and digital signatures.
agencies.name: mEDRA

agencies.description: The Publications Office of the European Union (OP) is the official publisher of the institutions, bodies, offices and agencies of the European Union. As such, it is responsible for assigning DOI names to content produced by these clients. Types of content currently covered by this service include official EU publications, online journal articles, datasets and grants.
agencies.name: OP

post.description:
Find US stores near a postal code or city and state, nearest first with the distance in miles. Returns the fixed nearest set Domino's publishes for the query (at most 10 stores) in one complete response; the store lookup has no page, limit, cursor or radius parameter upstream, so this is not paginated and nothing beyond that set is reachable for one query.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

service_method.description: CARRYOUT (default) returns the nearest stores for the postal code or city and state; each store reports availability.delivery. post.description:
Weekly start/sit rankings and point projections for a position, for example week 4 half-PPR quarterbacks. Omit week for the current week.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

limit.description: Return only the top N players. Omit for the whole list.

position.description: Position. FLX is RB/WR/TE, IDP is DL/LB/DB, DST is team defense, ALL is the site's overall board.

scoring.description: Scoring: standard (non-PPR), half PPR, full PPR or TE premium. Default PPR.

superflex.description: Superflex league values. Changes the overall order and tiers; positional projections stay the same.

week.description: NFL week, 1-18 regular season and 19-23 playoffs. Omit for the current week.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

To show a field on a given date. Get the scene id from search_scenes. Sizes grow with the geometry: keep max_px small for large fields.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

collection.description: Collection of the scene id; inferred from the id form when omitted.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 with [lon, lat] positions: Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored; FeatureCollection and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused (invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code: ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, too_many_vertices, feature_collection, antimeridian, unsupported_type). Open because GeoJSON allows foreign members (properties, id, bbox).

layer.description: `true_colour` (default) reads the visual asset; `ndvi` reads red and nir.

max_px.description: Longest side of the PNG; the native clip is enlarged by the largest whole factor that fits.

scene_id.description: Earth Search item id, e.g. S2B_T16SDE_20260903T163711_L2A (sentinel-2-c1-l2a) or S2A_16SDE_20220909_0_L2A (sentinel-2-l2a). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.

response.legend: Sentinel-2 true colour (TCI, bands 4/3/2 as 8-bit); pixels outside the geometry are dimmed

post.description:
To see whether a period has usable imagery, or how dense the archive is for a place, before calling search_scenes or vegetation_indices.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

collection.description: `sentinel-2-c1-l2a` (Collection 1, default), `sentinel-2-l2a` (legacy archive, denser before 2023) or `auto` (c1, falling back to the legacy collection when c1 matches nothing).

end.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), inclusive. Defaults to today. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 with [lon, lat] positions: Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored; FeatureCollection and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused (invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code: ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, too_many_vertices, feature_collection, antimeridian, unsupported_type). Open because GeoJSON allows foreign members (properties, id, bbox).

start.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Earth Search holds Sentinel-2 L2A from 2015-06-27. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

notes: counts are per MGRS tile intersecting the bbox: a field near a tile edge is counted once per tile and per pass

post.description:
Start here to find scene ids and dates for a field, then pass them to vegetation_indices or render_clip. Percentages are per MGRS tile, not per field; use vegetation_indices for the field's own cloud share.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

collection.description: `sentinel-2-c1-l2a` (Collection 1, default), `sentinel-2-l2a` (legacy archive, denser before 2023) or `auto` (c1, falling back to the legacy collection when c1 matches nothing).

continuation.description: Opaque token from a previous page.

end.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), inclusive. Defaults to today. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 with [lon, lat] positions: Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored; FeatureCollection and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused (invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code: ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, too_many_vertices, feature_collection, antimeridian, unsupported_type). Open because GeoJSON allows foreign members (properties, id, bbox).

max_cloud_cover_pct.description: Keep scenes whose tile-level eo:cloud_cover is below this percentage (Earth Search `query` filter).

start.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Earth Search holds Sentinel-2 L2A from 2015-06-27. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
For a paddock, field or parcel: how green or moist is it per scene, how much of it was cloudy, and which zones lag. Pass scene_ids from search_scenes, or a window and the newest clear scenes are chosen.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

collection.description: `sentinel-2-c1-l2a` (Collection 1, default), `sentinel-2-l2a` (legacy archive, denser before 2023) or `auto` (c1, falling back to the legacy collection when c1 matches nothing).

end.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), inclusive. Defaults to today. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 with [lon, lat] positions: Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored; FeatureCollection and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused (invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code: ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, too_many_vertices, feature_collection, antimeridian, unsupported_type). Open because GeoJSON allows foreign members (properties, id, bbox).

max_cloud_cover_pct.description: Keep scenes whose tile-level eo:cloud_cover is below this percentage (Earth Search `query` filter).

max_field_cloud_share.description: Skip reflectance reads when the SCL cloud share over the geometry exceeds this.

max_scenes.description: Newest distinct acquisitions to read when searching a window.

scene_ids.description: Specific scenes to read; otherwise the window is searched.

start.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Earth Search holds Sentinel-2 L2A from 2015-06-27. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

zone_grid.description: Zones per side of the grid over the geometry's bbox (1 disables).

response.pixel_rule: a pixel counts when its centre falls inside the geometry; SCL classes 3, 8, 9, 10 are cloud; reflectance = scale * DN + offset from the item's raster:bands

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

post.description:
Find earthquakes (or other seismic events) in a time window, region or magnitude range: recent significant quakes, a historical sequence, quakes near a site. Use event for one event's ShakeMap, PAGER and DYFI summaries.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

alert_level.description: Only events with this PAGER alert level.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same search. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,5}$.

end_time.description: Latest origin time (inclusive), UTC, same formats. A bare date means 00:00:00 of that day. Defaults to now. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,3})?)?)?Z?$.

event_type.description: ComCat event type, e.g. earthquake, explosion, quarry blast. Defaults to every type. Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z ]{0,39}$.

latitude.description: Circle center latitude; requires longitude and max_radius_km.

min_latitude.description: Rectangle south edge. Rectangle edges may be given in any subset; do not combine with the circle.

min_longitude.description: Rectangle west edge; values beyond +/-180 let a rectangle cross the antimeridian.

order_by.description: Newest first (time), oldest first, largest first (magnitude) or smallest first.

start_time.description: Earliest origin time, UTC: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS[.fff]][Z]. Defaults to 30 days ago. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,3})?)?)?Z?$.

post.description:
Potency and SAR data: how strongly a compound hits a target, or which compounds are most potent against a target. Get IDs from search_molecules / search_targets first.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

assay_type.description: B binding, F functional, A ADME, T toxicity, P physicochemical, U unclassified.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,8}$.

min_pchembl.description: Only rows with pchembl_value at least this (6 = 1 uM, 9 = 1 nM).

molecule_chembl_id.description: Measurements recorded on exactly this molecule form. Pattern: ^CHEMBL[0-9]{1,12}$.

parent_molecule_chembl_id.description: Measurements on a parent compound and all its salts and forms (parent_chembl_id from get_molecule). Pattern: ^CHEMBL[0-9]{1,12}$.

sort.description: activity_id (stable record order) or potency (highest pChEMBL first; rows without one are excluded).

standard_type.description: Endpoint, e.g. IC50, Ki, Kd, EC50, Potency, Inhibition (common ones are case-insensitive). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ()%/._+'-]{0,39}$.

target_chembl_id.description: Target ChEMBL ID, e.g. CHEMBL203. Pattern: ^CHEMBL[0-9]{1,12}$.

target_organism.description: Exact target organism, case-sensitive, e.g. Homo sapiens.

activities.assay_description: Inhibitory concentration against v-Abl tyrosine kinase
Inhibition of human Abl kinase expressed in Sf9 cells
Inhibition of wild-type c-Abl by liquid scintillation counting

post.description:
Turn a gene, protein or UniProt accession into ChEMBL target IDs for get_target and list_activities. One protein usually maps to a SINGLE PROTEIN target plus complexes, families and protein-protein interaction targets that contain it.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,8}$.

organism.description: Exact organism name as ChEMBL stores it, case-sensitive, e.g. Homo sapiens.

query.description: Gene symbol, protein or target name.

target_type.description: ChEMBL target type, e.g. SINGLE PROTEIN, PROTEIN COMPLEX, PROTEIN FAMILY. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z -]{1,40}$.

uniprot_accession.description: UniProt accession, e.g. P00533 (EGFR); returns every target with that component. Pattern: ^([OPQ][0-9][A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]|[A-NR-Z][0-9]([A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2}[0-9]){1,2})$.

base.description: With quote: also derive the cross rate quote-per-base (e.g. base USD, quote JPY gives JPY per 1 USD) from the two EUR legs on each common date. Non-EUR. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{3}$.

currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes of the currencies to quote against the euro, e.g. ["USD", "JPY", "GBP"]. Case-insensitive. EUR itself is not a series (every rate is per 1 EUR). Optional when base/quote is given.

date.description: One day, YYYY-MM-DD. Weekends and TARGET holidays have no rates (not_found). Mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

end_date.description: Last day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

quote.description: With base: the currency the cross rate is expressed in. Non-EUR, different from base. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{3}$.

start_date.description: First day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

response.attribution: Source: European Central Bank (ECB Data Portal)
response.publication_note: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates are units of currency per 1 EUR, set at the 14:15 CET concertation and published around 16:00 CET on TARGET business days only. There are no rates for weekends or TARGET holidays, so the latest rate is often the previous business day's; every row carries its actual observation date.

One page of observations from an EIA route (`<route>/data`) at a frequency, filtered by facet codes and a period range, sorted, with offset pagination up to 5000 rows per page. Each record carries the period, every facet as {code, name}, requested values as source strings, units copied from the source, extra source flags, and the series id when the route has one. Period formats follow the frequency (YYYY, YYYY-Qn, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

end.description: Inclusive last period in the frequency's format.

post.description:
You have a numeric EventId (from `list_events`) and want the division-level official count. Use `division_results` for the poll-by-poll detail of one division.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

event_id.description: Elections Alberta numeric EventId as used on officialresults.elections.ab.ca (101 = Provincial General Election May 29, 2023; 130 = By-Election September 14, 2026). `list_events` returns them. Referendum (68RQ1) and senate (67S) ids use other page templates and are rejected. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

name.description: Candidate name fragment, at least 3 letters.

year.description: Four-digit financial year, or ALL (default). Pattern: ^([0-9]{4}|ALL)$.

post.description:
To build or check a call to the ElevenLabs API, e.g. the parameters and output formats of Create speech.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

path.description: API reference docs path, e.g. `api-reference/text-to-speech/convert` (from search_docs or list_pages).

url.description: Alternatively the reference URL, e.g. https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert. Pattern: ^https?://.

response.description: Converts text into speech using a voice of your choice and returns audio.

parameters.description: ID of the voice to be used. Use the [Get voices](/docs/api-reference/voices/search) endpoint list all the available voices.
parameters.name: voice_id

parameters.description: When enable_logging is set to false zero retention mode will be used for the request. This will mean history features are unavailable for this request, including request stitching. Zero retention mode may only be used by enterprise customers.
parameters.name: enable_logging

parameters.description: You can turn on latency optimizations at some cost of quality. The best possible final latency varies by model. Possible values: 0 - default mode (no latency optimizations) 1 - normal latency optimizations (about 50% of possible latency improvement of option 3) 2 - strong latency optimizations (about 75% of possible latency improvement of option 3) 3 - max latency optimizations 4 - max latency optimizations, but also with text normalizer turned off for even more latency savings (best latency, but can mispronounce eg numbers and dates). Defaults to None.
parameters.name: optimize_streaming_latency

parameters.description: Output format of the generated audio. Formatted as codec_sample_rate_bitrate. So an mp3 with 22.05kHz sample rate at 32kbs is represented as mp3_22050_32. MP3 with 192kbps bitrate requires you to be subscribed to Creator tier or above. PCM and WAV formats with 44.1kHz sample rate requires you to be subscribed to Pro tier or above. Note that the μ-law format (sometimes written mu-law, often approximated as u-law) is commonly used for Twilio audio inputs.
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.description: The text that will get converted into speech.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Identifier of the model that will be used, you can query them using GET /v1/models. The model needs to have support for text to speech, you can check this using the can_do_text_to_speech property.
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.description: Language code (ISO 639-1) used to enforce a language for the model and text normalization. If the model does not support the provided language code, it will be ignored. This parameter is not supported for multilingual_v2 models.
parameters.name: language_code

parameters.description: Voice settings overriding stored settings for the given voice. They are applied only on the given request.
parameters.name: voice_settings

parameters.description: A list of pronunciation dictionary locators (id, version_id) to be applied to the text. They will be applied in order. You may have up to 3 locators per request
parameters.name: pronunciation_dictionary_locators

parameters.description: If specified, our system will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result. Determinism is not guaranteed. Must be integer between 0 and 4294967295.
parameters.name: seed

parameters.description: The text that came before the text of the current request. Can be used to improve the speech's continuity when concatenating together multiple generations or to influence the speech's continuity in the current generation.
parameters.name: previous_text

parameters.description: The text that comes after the text of the current request. Can be used to improve the speech's continuity when concatenating together multiple generations or to influence the speech's continuity in the current generation.
parameters.name: next_text

parameters.description: A list of request_id of the samples that were generated before this generation. Can be used to improve the speech's continuity when splitting up a large task into multiple requests. The results will be best when the same model is used across the generations. In case both previous_text and previous_request_ids is send, previous_text will be ignored. A maximum of 3 request_ids can be send.
parameters.name: previous_request_ids

parameters.description: A list of request_id of the samples that come after this generation. next_request_ids is especially useful for maintaining the speech's continuity when regenerating a sample that has had some audio quality issues. For example, if you have generated 3 speech clips, and you want to improve clip 2, passing the request id of clip 3 as a next_request_id (and that of clip 1 as a previous_request_id) will help maintain natural flow in the combined speech. The results will be best when the same model is used across the generations. In case both next_text and next_request_ids is send, next_text will be ignored. A maximum of 3 request_ids can be send.
parameters.name: next_request_ids

parameters.description: Whether to use the IVC version of a professional voice. This may improve expressiveness and reduce latency.
parameters.name: use_pvc_as_ivc

parameters.description: This parameter controls text normalization with three modes: 'auto', 'on', and 'off'. When set to 'auto', the system will automatically decide whether to apply text normalization (e.g., spelling out numbers). With 'on', text normalization will always be applied, while with 'off', it will be skipped.
parameters.name: apply_text_normalization

parameters.description: This parameter controls language text normalization. This helps with proper pronunciation of text in some supported languages. WARNING: This parameter can heavily increase the latency of the request. Currently only supported for Japanese.
parameters.name: apply_language_text_normalization

parameters.description: Audio effects applied to the generated audio. Unknown IDs return 404 with `param` naming the field. Reverb (`environment_id` with `send_level` above 0) and a non-zero `pan` produce stereo audio and are rejected with 400 for `ulaw_*`, `alaw_*`, and `pcm_*` output formats. Effects don't change the cost of the request.
parameters.name: audio_effects

response.title: Create speech

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

response.content:
## Multilingual v2

Eleven Multilingual v2 is a previous generation emotionally-aware speech synthesis model. It produces natural, lifelike speech with high emotional range and contextual understanding across multiple languages.

The model delivers consistent voice quality and personality across all supported languages while maintaining the speaker's unique characteristics and accent.

This model excels in scenarios requiring high-quality, emotionally nuanced speech:

* **Character Voiceovers**: Ideal for gaming and animation due to its emotional range.
* **Professional Content**: Well-suited for corporate videos and e-learning materials.
* **Multilingual Projects**: Maintains consistent voice quality across language switches.
* **Stable Quality**: Produces consistent, high-quality audio output.

While it has a higher latency & cost per character than Flash models, it delivers superior quality for projects where lifelike speech is important.

Our multilingual v2 models support 29 languages:

*English (USA, UK, Australia, Canada), Japanese, Chinese, German, Hindi, French (France, Canada), Korean, Portuguese (Brazil, Portugal), Italian, Spanish (Spain, Mexico), Indonesian, Dutch, Turkish, Filipino, Polish, Swedish, Bulgarian, Romanian, Arabic (Saudi Arabia, UAE), Czech, Greek, Finnish, Croatian, Malay, Slovak, Danish, Tamil, Ukrainian & Russian.*

Credits are shared across every product — see the per-product credit costs below.
faqs.question: How much does each plan cost and what is included?

faqs.answer: Each text character you generate consumes credits, with the exact cost depending on the model used. For V2 Multilingual models, 1 text character equals 1 credit. For V2 Flash/Turbo English and V2.5 Flash/Turbo Multilingual models, discounted pricing applies for API usage, costing between 0.5 and 1 credit per character.
faqs.question: How do text characters and credits work?

faqs.answer: All products draw from one shared monthly credit pool, so the same credits can be spent on any of them and using one leaves fewer for the others. Approximate credit costs are: Text to Speech 1 credit per character; Speech to Text 330 credits per minute; Eleven Music 900 credits per minute; Sound Effects 200 credits per generation; Voice Changer and Voice Isolator 1,000 credits per minute; and Dubbing 2,000 credits per minute (automatic with watermark), 3,000 (automatic without watermark), 5,000 (Dubbing Studio with watermark) or 10,000 (Dubbing Studio without watermark).
faqs.question: How many credits does each product use?

faqs.answer: Your credit allowance resets at the start of each billing cycle, which begins on the day you subscribed. Unused credits roll over for up to two months — up to 2× your monthly quota — so your balance can reach at most 3× your monthly quota (this month's allotment plus up to two months of rollover), as long as you maintain an active paid subscription and do not downgrade or cancel. Downgrading or cancelling forfeits unused credits at the end of the cycle. Rollover does not apply to the Free plan. Pay-as-you-go top-up credits are separate and are not subject to this rollover cap. When your subscription renews, you receive a new monthly allotment of credits.
faqs.question: When do my credits reset, and do unused credits roll over?

faqs.answer: Yes. Annual billing works out to two months free — you pay for 10 months (annual price = monthly price × 10). The equivalent monthly price on an annual plan is $5 for Starter, $18.33 for Creator, $82.50 for Pro, $249.17 for Scale, and $825 for Business.

faqs.answer: Credits are charged per generation request, not per download. If you are not satisfied with the output, a limited number of free regenerations may be available as long as the content and certain settings do not change. Whether a regeneration is free is indicated before generating.

entries.content:
### Eleven Realtime

Eleven Realtime is a new family of models for ElevenAgents voice agents, rolling out gradually across workspaces. Each one is a complete voice agent configuration. You pick one model, and ElevenLabs handles the LLM, Speech to Text and Text to Speech settings behind it. Your agent's system prompt, voice, tools and knowledge base work the same as before.

There are two to choose from. Eleven Realtime v1 Mini (`eleven_realtime_v1_mini`) is the default, and it's the fastest and cheapest. Eleven Realtime v1 Max (`eleven_realtime_v1_max`) reasons before it answers, so use it when your agent has complex instructions or multi-step tool calls.

If you've already built on OpenAI's Realtime API, you don't need to rewrite your client. The events and the WebSocket transport are the same, so you change the endpoint and the session configuration. Your backend calls [Create realtime client secret](/docs/api-reference/conversations/create-client-secret) to get a short-lived secret,

entries.content:
### ElevenAgents

- **Merge and search triage tickets**: [Merge tickets](/docs/api-reference/triage-tickets/merge) folds up to 50 open tickets from the same agent into one target ticket. Merged tickets keep the status `merged` and reference the target through `merged_into_ticket_id`. [List tickets](/docs/api-reference/triage-tickets/list) and [List workspace tickets](/docs/api-reference/triage-tickets/list-for-workspace) add a case-insensitive `search` parameter that matches ticket titles, descriptions, comments and turn comments, and each result includes a `search_match` excerpt showing where the query matched.
- **Workflow End node outcomes**: Workflow End nodes accept an `outcome` of `success` (default) or `failure`, so a workflow can record whether a conversation ended successfully. The conversation error type adds `workflow_end_failure`.
- **Call queueing enabled for new agents**: New agents are created with [call queueing](/docs/eleven-agents/guides/call-queueing) enabled unless

post.description:
Search medicines evaluated through EMA's centralised procedure (EU EPAR medicine pages): name, EMA product number, status (Authorised, Withdrawn, Refused, ...), INN, active substance, ATC code, therapeutic area, marketing authorisation holder, procedure dates and flags such as orphan, generic, biosimilar and conditional approval. Filter by words, category or status, or resolve one ema_product_number. Therapeutic indications are withheld. Every result carries EMA attribution.

post.description:
Search medicine supply shortages assessed by EMA: medicine, INN, status (Shortage ongoing, Shortage resolved, Medicine discontinued), pharmaceutical forms and strengths affected, availability of alternatives, expected resolution and the EMA shortage page. Filter by words, category or status, or resolve one record_id. Covers shortages EMA assessed, not every national shortage. Every result carries EMA attribution.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category.description: category

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page with the same filters. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

query.description: Words that must all appear, case-insensitive, in the medicine affected, INN, therapeutic area or pharmaceutical form, e.g. immunoglobulins.

record_id.description: record_id returned by this function, e.g. cerezyme. No match is not_found. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9-]{1,200}$.

status.description: Exact supply_shortage_status, case-insensitive: Shortage ongoing, Shortage resolved or Medicine discontinued.

response.attribution: Source: European Medicines Agency (EMA), https://www.ema.europa.eu. Reproduced under EMA's legal notice, which requires EMA to be acknowledged as the source: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/about-us/about-website/legal-notice

post.description:
Get player-level box score stats for a game (shots on goal, passing/rushing/receiving yards, points, rebounds, strikeouts, saves) to audit props or bets, plus per-period scoring; find the event_id with scoreboard or team_schedule.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

event_id.description: ESPN event id (from scoreboard / team_schedule / search). Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

league.description: ESPN league slug within the sport, e.g. nfl, nhl, nba, mlb, wnba, college-football, eng.1, usa.nwsl (from `leagues`). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$.

sport.description: ESPN sport slug, e.g. football, hockey, basketball, baseball, soccer (from `leagues` without `sport`). Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.

event_id.description: ESPN event id (from scoreboard / team_schedule / search). Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

post.description:
Check NHL, NFL, NBA, MLB or WNBA injuries (Out, IR, day-to-day, questionable) before a game, for tonight's clubs, fantasy lineups or betting/props research; feed athlete_id to `player`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

league.description: ESPN league slug within the sport: nba, wnba, nfl, mlb, nhl, college-football (from `leagues`). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$.

sport.description: ESPN sport slug, e.g. football, soccer, basketball, baseball, hockey (from `leagues` without `sport`). Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.

status.description: Only players with this status, matched case- and punctuation-insensitively against the status, its abbreviation and its code: e.g. Out, day-to-day, DD, Questionable, IR.

team.description: Only these teams: one or more ESPN team ids (e.g. 29) or abbreviations (e.g. CBJ, LAL), comma-separated, from `teams`. Every named team is returned, with an empty list when ESPN lists no injuries for it. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}(\s*,\s*[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}){0,39}$.

injuries.long_comment: Gilbert continues to deal with patella tendinitis. His last chance to appear this preseason is Friday against the Mavericks.
injuries.short_comment: Gilbert (knee) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.long_comment: Wiggins and most of Atlanta's regulars won't play in the penultimate preseason game. He finished with 13 points (4-9 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), two rebounds, an assist and two steals across 20 minutes off the bench in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
injuries.short_comment: Wiggins (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Okongwu is getting the night off Monday with Atlanta resting a number of starters. His next chance to play arrives Friday against Dallas.
injuries.short_comment: Okongwu (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.long_comment: McCollum and most of Atlanta's regulars won't play in the penultimate preseason game. He recorded 12 points (2-4 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 7-7 FT) and five rebounds across 19 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
injuries.short_comment: McCollum (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Dort is sitting out Monday for maintenance purposes. The veteran swingman's next chance to play is Friday against Dallas.
injuries.short_comment: Dort (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.long_comment: Johnson and most of Atlanta's regulars won't suit up for the penultimate preseason contest. He tallied 20 points (8-12 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and three assists over 25 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
injuries.short_comment: Johnson (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Daniels and most of Atlanta's regulars will rest during the Hawks' penultimate preseason contest. He tallied 13 points (6-16 FG, 1-3 3Pt), 11 rebounds, an assist and a steal across 21 minutes in Thursday's 123-116 preseason win over the Spurs but struggled with his shot against the Pacers on Saturday.
injuries.short_comment: Daniels (rest) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.
injuries.short_comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.long_comment: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).
injuries.short_comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Garza took an inadvertent elbow to the nose from teammate Chris Cenac, and the former was taken to the locker room shortly thereafter. Assuming Garza doesn't return, he'll end his night with eight points (4-9 FG), seven rebounds and one assist over 11 minutes.
injuries.short_comment: Garza (nose) went to the locker room late in the fourth quarter of Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Bobby Manning of CLNS Media Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Carter played 25 minutes during Boston's preseason opener against Cleveland on Thursday, but the third-year pro is under the weather and not be available for Saturday's contest. His next chance to play is Wednesday against Charlotte.
injuries.short_comment: Carter (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's exhibition game against the 76ers, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

injuries.long_comment: Harper is working through right shoulder illness, which has prevented him from playing in each of the Celtics' first two preseason games. His next opportunity to play is Wednesday against the Hornets.
injuries.short_comment: Harper (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

injuries.long_comment: Jefferson will be sidelined for his third straight exhibition. The rookie forward will have one more chance to return in the preseason Oct. 14 against the Heat.
injuries.short_comment: Jefferson (back) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

injuries.long_comment: Brown has yet to suit up during the preseason as he continues to work his way back from a left ankle issue. His final chance to get in an exhibition is Wednesday against the Heat.
injuries.short_comment: Brown (ankle) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

injuries.long_comment: Anderson will miss a second straight game due to a left ankle sprain. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's exhibition against the Celtics.
injuries.short_comment: Anderson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against Milwaukee.

injuries.long_comment: Allen performed well in the Hornets' opening preseason game, posting 13 points in 14 minutes, but he will miss Sunday's contest with a knee injury. Sion James and Royce O'Neale could see extra action with Allen out of the lineup.
injuries.short_comment: Allen will not play in Sunday's preseason game against the Bucks due to right knee soreness.

injuries.long_comment: It doesn't sound like the two-way guard will be available for the preseason, but he's hopeful to not miss any time during the G League season. Boswell is not expected to be a significant part of the Hornets' rotation this season.
injuries.short_comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.

injuries.long_comment: White missed time with a left calf strain last season and is now in jeopardy of starting the regular season on the inactive list. If the 26-year-old guard is forced to miss time beyond the preseason, Christian Anderson and Dennis Schroder would likely see increased playing time.
injuries.short_comment: The Hornets announced Monday that White suffered a left calf strain during training camp and will not play during the preseason.

injuries.long_comment: Knueppel's status for Opening Night remains uncertain as he continues to work his way back from his left hamstring injury. Peterson's comments suggest the Hornets aren't ready to rule out the second-year wing, though his availability will likely become clearer as training camp progresses. He has already been ruled out for the entire preseason, to be clear.
injuries.short_comment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

injuries.long_comment: Williams will be re-evaluated the first week of the regular season, putting his status for Opening Night in the air. Williams will have a difficult path to minutes this season as he competes with the likes of Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun.
injuries.short_comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

injuries.long_comment: Collins has yet to suit up in the preseason due to a toe injury but is making progress ahead of the regular season. The big man's final chance to suit up in the preseason will come Friday against Minnesota.
injuries.short_comment: Collins (toe) is progressing in his recovery but has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason meeting with the Bucks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Awaka banged his knee in Friday's preseason game against Memphis. The undrafted rookie can be deemed questionable for Wednesday's exhibition versus the Bucks.
injuries.short_comment: Awaka (knee) didn't practice Tuesday, per K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network.

injuries.long_comment: It's unclear why Okoro didn't practice, though he can be considered questionable for Wednesday's exhibition against Milwaukee. If the 25-year-old wing is unable to suit up, Leonard Miller, Jordan Hawkins and Buddy Hield could see a bump in playing time.
injuries.short_comment: Okoro (undisclosed) didn't participate in Tuesday's practice, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

injuries.long_comment: Sellers continues to deal with lower-back soreness that has limited his preseason availability. The two-way guard will look to return to action as Chicago completes its exhibition schedule, though his immediate fantasy outlook remains limited.
injuries.short_comment: Sellers (back) did not play in Sunday's 133-128 preseason loss to Denver.

injuries.long_comment: This is a huge blow for Claxton and it rules him out for the entire preseason. For now, fantasy managers can consider him questionable for Opening Night on Oct. 21 against the Raptors. Jalen Smith is the next man up on the depth chart for Chicago, followed by Zach Collins (toe).
injuries.short_comment: Claxton tweaked his hamstring and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network of the Bulls Radio Network reports.

post.description:
Get athlete_id values and roster details for a team; feed athlete_id to `player`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

league.description: ESPN league slug within the sport, e.g. nfl, college-football, eng.1, uefa.champions, fifa.world, nba, mlb, nhl (from `leagues`). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the full upstream list.

sport.description: ESPN sport slug, e.g. football, soccer, basketball, baseball, hockey (from `leagues` without `sport`). Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Read a league table or conference/division standings for a season.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。

league.description: ESPN league slug within the sport, e.g. nfl, college-football, eng.1, uefa.champions, fifa.world, nba, mlb, nhl (from `leagues`). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$.

level.description: Group depth (NFL: 3 returns divisions instead of conferences).

sport.description: ESPN sport slug, e.g. football, soccer, basketball, baseball, hockey (from `leagues` without `sport`). Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.

stats.description: Keep only these standings columns, matched case- and punctuation-insensitively against ESPN's stat name, type, abbreviation, display names and description (e.g. wins, losses, points, pointDifferential, winPercent, streak, playoffSeed, home, road, vsDiv, clincher; NFL home/away records are the stats named `Home` and `Road`). Requested columns no row carries are listed in `missing_stats`. Default: every column ESPN sends; a full NFL table is ~90 KB, so filter when you only need a few.

Read a team's record, standing and next fixture by team_id.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

league.description: ESPN league slug within the sport, e.g. nfl, college-football, eng.1, uefa.champions, fifa.world, nba, mlb, nhl (from `leagues`). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$.

sport.description: ESPN sport slug, e.g. football, soccer, basketball, baseball, hockey (from `leagues` without `sport`). Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.

team_id.description: ESPN team id (from teams / scoreboard competitors / search). Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

30.4.2004

EN

Official Journal of the European Communities

L 158/77

DIRECTIVE 2004/38/EC OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL

of 29 April 2004

on the right of citizens of the Union and their family members to move and reside freely within the territory of the Member States amending Regulation (EEC) No 1612/68 and repealing Directives 64/221/EEC, 68/360/EEC, 72/194/EEC, 73/148/EEC, 75/34/EEC, 75/35/EEC, 90/364/EEC, 90/365/EEC and 93/96/EEC

(Text with EEA relevance)

THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

Having regard to the Treaty establishing the European Community, and in particular Articles 12, 18, 40, 44 and 52 thereof,

Having regard to the proposal from the Commission (1),

Having regard to the Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee (2),

Having regard to the Opinion of the Committee of the Regions (3),

Acting in accordance with the procedure laid down in Article 251 of the Treaty (4),

Whereas:

(1)

Citizenship of the Union confers on every citizen of the Union a primary and individual right to move and reside freely within the territory of the Member States, subject to the limitations and conditions laid down in the Treaty and to the measures adopted to give it effect.

(2)

The free movement of persons constitutes one of the fundamental freedoms of the internal market, which comprises an area without internal frontiers, in which freedom is ensured in accordance with the provisions of the Treaty.

(3)

Union citizenship should be the fundamental status of nationals of the Member States when they exercise their right of free movement and residence. It is therefore necessary to codify and review the existing Community instruments dealing separately with workers, self-employed persons, as well as students and other inactive persons in order to simplify and strengthen the right of free movement and residence of all Union citizens.

(4)

With a view to remedying this sector-by-sector, piecemeal approach to the right of free movement and residence and facilitating the exercise of this right, there needs to be a single legislative act to amend Council Regulation (EEC) No 1612/68 of 15 October 1968 on freedom of movement for workers within the Community (5) and to repeal the following acts: Council Directive 68/360/EEC of 15 October 1968 on the abolition of restrictions on movement and residence within the Community for workers of Member States and their families (6), Council Directive 73/148/EEC of 21 May 1973 on the abolition of restrictions on movement and residence within the Community for nationals of Member States with regard to establishment and the provision of services (7), Council Directive 90/364/EEC of 28 June 1990 on the right of residence (8), Council Directive 90/365/EEC of 28 June 1990 on the right of residence for employees and self-employed persons who have ceased their occupational activity (9) and Council Directive 93/96/EEC of 29 October 1993 on the right of residence for students (10).

(5)

The right of all Union citizens to move and reside freely within the territory of the Member States should, if it is to be exercised under objective conditions of freedom and dignity, be also granted to their family members, irrespective of nationality. For the purposes of this Directive, the definition of "family member" should also include the registered partner if the legislation of the host Member State treats registered partnership as equivalent to marriage.

(6)

In order to maintain the unity of the family in a broader sense and without prejudice to the prohibition of discrimination on grounds of nationality, the situation of those persons who are not included in the definition of family members under this Directive, and who therefore do not enjoy an automatic right of entry and residence in the host Member State, should be examined by the host Member State on the basis of its own national legislation, in order to decide whether entry and residence could be granted to such persons, taking into consideration their relationship with the Union citizen or any other circumstances, such as their financial or physical dependence on the Union citizen.

(7)

The formalities connected with the free movement of Union citizens within the territory of Member States should be clearly defined, without prejudice to the provisions applicable to national border controls.

(8)

With a view to facilitating the free movement of family members who are not nationals of a Member State, those who have already obtained a residence card should be exempted from the requirement to obtain an entry visa within the meaning of Council Regulation (EC) No 539/2001 of 15 March 2001 listing the third countries whose nationals must be in possession of visas when crossing the external borders and those whose nationals are exempt from that requirement (11) or, where appropriate, of the applicable national legislation.

(9)

Union citizens should have the right of residence in the host Member State for a period not exceeding three months without being subject to any conditions or any formalities other than the requirement to hold a valid identity card or passport, without prejudice to a more favourable treatment applicable to job-seekers as recognised by the case-law of the Court of Justice.

(10)

Persons exercising their right of residence should not, however, become an unreasonable burden on the social assistance system of the host Member State during an initial period of residence. Therefore, the right of residence for Union citizens and their family members for periods in excess of three months should be subject to conditions.

(11)

The fundamental and personal right of residence in another Member State is conferred directly on Union citizens by the Treaty and is not dependent upon their having fulfilled administrative procedures.

(12)

For periods of residence of longer than three months, Member States should have the possibility to require Union citizens to register with the competent authorities in the place of residence, attested by a registration certificate issued to that effect.

(13)

The residence card requirement should be restricted to family members of Union citizens who are not nationals of a Member State for periods of residence of longer than three months.

(14)

The supporting documents required by the competent authorities for the issuing of a registration certificate or of a residence card should be comprehensively specified in order to avoid divergent administrative practices or interpretations constituting an undue obstacle to the exercise of the right of residence by Union citizens and their family members.

(15)

Family members should be legally safeguarded in the event of the death of the Union citizen, divorce, annulment of marriage or termination of a registered partnership. With due regard for family life and human dignity, and in certain conditions to guard against abuse, measures should therefore be taken to ensure that in such circumstances family members already residing within the territory of the host Member State retain their right of residence exclusively on a personal basis.

(16)

As long as the beneficiaries of the right of residence do not become an unreasonable burden on the social assistance system of the host Member State they should not be expelled. Therefore, an expulsion measure should not be the automatic consequence of recourse to the social assistance system. The host Member State should examine whether it is a case of temporary difficulties and take into account the duration of residence, the personal circumstances and the amount of aid granted in order to consider whether the beneficiary has become an unreasonable burden on its social assistance system and to proceed to his expulsion. In no case should an expulsion measure be adopted against workers, self-employed persons or job-seekers as defined by the Court of Justice save on grounds of public policy or public security.

(17)

Enjoyment of permanent residence by Union citizens who have chosen to settle long term in the host Member State would strengthen the feeling of Union citizenship and is a key element in promoting social cohesion, which is one of the fundamental objectives of the Union. A right of permanent residence should therefore be laid down for all Union citizens and their family members who have resided in the host Member State in compliance with the conditions laid down in this Directive during a continuous period of five years without becoming subject to an expulsion measure.

(18)

In order to be a genuine vehicle for integration into the society of the host Member State in which the Union citizen resides, the right of permanent residence, once obtained, should not be subject to any conditions.

(19)

Certain advantages specific to Union citizens who are workers or self-employed persons and to their family members, which may allow these persons to acquire a right of permanent residence before they have resided five years in the host Member State, should be maintained, as these constitute acquired rights, conferred by Commission Regulation (EEC) No 1251/70 of 29 June 1970 on the right of workers to remain in the territory of a Member State after having been employed in that State (12) and Council Directive 75/34/EEC of 17 December 1974 concerning the right of nationals of a Member State to remain in the territory of another Member State after having pursued therein an activity in a self-employed capacity (13).

(20)

In accordance with the prohibition of discrimination on grounds of nationality, all Union citizens and their family members residing in a Member State on the basis of this Directive should enjoy, in that Member State, equal treatment with nationals in areas covered by the Treaty, subject to such specific provisions as are expressly provided for in the Treaty and secondary law.

(21)

However, it should be left to the host Member State to decid

post.description:
Find EU documents whose English title contains every word of `query` (Cellar full-text index over titles, not body text), optionally restricted to regulations/directives/decisions, a CELEX sector (legislation by default) and a document-date year range. Returns CELEX, title, type, dates, in-force flag, ELI and EUR-Lex URL per hit, newest first, with offset pagination.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

offset.description: offset

query.description: Words that must all appear in the title.

url.description: Pasted EUR-Lex search URL (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/search.html?...&text=<words>) instead of `query`; its `text` words become the title query. Saved (`qid`-only) and advanced searches are not replayable.

notice.description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je dodávka, instalace a implementace integrační sběrnice (dále jen ESB) v rozsahu: • dodávka ESB, • dodávka nezbytného systémového SW pro dodávané systémy, • projektový managment, • implementační projekt, • vývoj, implementace, nastavení, • integrace na specifikované systémy zadavatele, • připojení do infrastruktury eHealth, • realizace pilotního provozu, • akceptační testy, zkušební provoz, školení uživatelů a administrátorů, dokumentace, • provedení compliance check na úrovni L1, • zkušební provoz s plnou podporou uživatelů, • technická podpora, rozvoj. VZ je realizována v rámci projektu: „Elektronizace zdravotnické dokumentace ve FNO“, reg. č. projektu: CZ.31.1.0/0.0/0.0/23_088/0011187, který je financován Evropskou unií z Nástroje pro oživení a odolnost prostřednictvím Národního plánu obnovy ČR. Bližší informace jsou uvedeny v Zadávací dokumentaci (dále jen "ZD").

post.description:
Search EU public procurement notices on TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) by full-text words, buyer country, CPV code, publication date range and notice kind (contract notice / award / prior information), or a raw TED expert query. Each hit carries the publication number, title, buyer, dates, deadline, procedure, CPV codes, estimated value and TED links. Newest notices first (unless the raw query has its own SORT BY); page-number pagination.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

country.description: Buyer country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3.

page.description: page

query.description: Raw TED expert query, e.g. `buyer-name~("Deutsche Bahn")`; combined with the other filters using AND.

text.description: Words searched in the notice full text (all must match).

records.description: SBH | Schulbau Hamburg hat als Landesbetrieb der Freien und Hansestadt Hamburg (nachstehend SBH genannt) die Aufgabe, die Schulimmobilien unter Berücksichtigung der schulischen Belange nach wirtschaftlichen Grundsätzen zu planen, zu bauen, zu unterhalten und zu bewirtschaften und die mehr als 400 Schulen an die Behörde für Schule und Berufsbildung (BSB) zu vermieten. --------------- Am Standort Hebebrandstr. 1 ist die Neugründung einer 6-zügigen Campusschule geplant. Die Neugründung des Schulstandortes erfordert die Errichtung einer Dreifeldsporthalle. Diese soll auf dem zukünftig entstehenden Baufeld des abzureißenden Gebäudes 05 entstehen. Die Sporthalle wird als Versammlungsstätte geplant und muss den Anforderungen des Denkmalschutzes entsprechen. --------------- Hier: Maler --------------- Bei der Sporthalle handelt es sich um eine Dreifeld-Halle mit Schul- und Vereinsnutzung, inkl. Nebenräume. Der Sporthallenbau ist zweigeschossig ausgebildet und erhält eine Tribüne die über zwei Treppen zu erreichen ist. Neben der Haupterschließung der Halle über Eingänge von außen ist der Neubau mittels eines geschlossenen Brückenbauwerks vom Bestandsbau aus zugänglich. Die Sporthalle ist als Versammlungsstätte deklariert. Die Sporthalle ist als Stahlbeton-Massivbau konzipiert und wird flach gegründet. Es sind Malerarbeiten gem. LV zu errichten.

response.abstract:
Introduction

The role of population-wide smoking cessation campaigns is uncertain as smoking prevalence reaches historically low levels. We examined whether the Power to Quit campaign in England, which aimed to increase uptake of evidence-based cessation support, particularly digital aids, was associated with changes in quitting behaviour.

Methods

We analysed nationally-representative cross-sectional surveys of adults in England who smoked in the past year, conducted immediately before (n=803) and after (n=1,713) the campaign (February-April 2026). Logistic regression estimated associations with quit attempts, digital cessation support, local Stop Smoking Services (SSS), and quit success, overall and by social grade. Exploratory analyses examined participants recognising campaign materials (n=799). Smoking Toolkit Study (STS) data (January 2023-June 2026; n=11,442) were used to contextualise findings against longer-term trends.

Results

In the primary pre/post analysis, there were increases in quit attempts (48.4% to 52.3%, aOR=1.16 [95%CI=0.97-1.38]), attempts involving digital support (16.0% to 18.4%, aOR=1.18 [0.92-1.50], and attempts involving SSS (2.4% to 3.6%, aOR=1.53 [0.89-2.65]), although estimates were uncertain. Associations were larger among participants recognising campaign materials (quit attempts: 64.9%, aOR=1.82 [1.47-2.26]; digital support: 28.7%, aOR=1.88 [1.44-2.45]; SSS: 5.4%, aOR=2.14 [1.19-3.88]). Increases in support uptake were particularly evident among less advantaged adults. There was no clear evidence of a change in quit success. STS data showed increases in support uptake continued from before the campaign.

Conclusions

Power to Quit coincided with increased engagement with cessation support, particularly among less advantaged adults and those recognising campaign materials. Increases in support continued pre-campaign trends, indicating that the contribution of the campaign occurred within a broader period of changing cessation behaviour.

Implications

National mass media campaigns appear to still contribute to increasing engagement with evidence-based cessation support when smoking prevalence is low, particularly among more disadvantaged groups, where smoking remains more common and quit success rates are lower. Although Power to Quit was a population-wide campaign, media planning prioritised areas with higher smoking prevalence and settings where smoking was more common and habitual, alongside sociodemographic targeting where feasible. These findings suggest that population-wide campaigns and targeted delivery strategies can be complementary rather than competing approaches.

response.abstract: Like many organisms the fungal pathogen Candida albicans senses changes in the environmental CO(2) concentration. This response involves two major proteins: adenylyl cyclase and carbonic anhydrase (CA). Here, we demonstrate that CA expression is tightly controlled by the availability of CO(2) and identify the bZIP transcription factor Rca1p as the first CO(2) regulator of CA expression in yeast. We show that Rca1p upregulates CA expression during contact with mammalian phagocytes and demonstrate that serine 124 is critical for Rca1p signaling, which occurs independently of adenylyl cyclase. ChIP-chip analysis and the identification of Rca1p orthologs in the model yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae (Cst6p) point to the broad significance of this novel pathway in fungi. By using advanced microscopy we visualize for the first time the impact of CO(2) build-up on gene expression in entire fungal populations with an exceptional level of detail. Our results present the bZIP protein Rca1p as the first fungal regulator of carbonic anhydrase, and reveal the existence of an adenylyl cyclase independent CO(2) sensing pathway in yeast. Rca1p appears to regulate cellular metabolism in response to CO(2) availability in environments as diverse as the phagosome, yeast communities or liquid culture.
