records.author: Liz
records.body: I have two Hemnes bookcases but needed something smaller for art supplies and books and when I saw the blue I fell in love! Bought a few extra glass shelves and baskets to organize my once unruly paints and pencils, power cords and electronics—my work laptop, personal laptop, Kindle and iPad are all easy to find—and it’s perfect. I smile whenever I look at my space. Thinking of buying a third just for manga and merch.
records.title: Color won me over

records.author: Marie
records.body: Both back panels on this bookshelves are damaged.  I need a call
records.title: Damage

records.author: Kevin
records.body:
Bought the larger bookshelf about a year ago and recently decided to expand my fiancées library. Got home only to notice my current bookshelf was 2-3 shades darker. Thought I purchased the wrong finish, so I disassembled everything, returned it, bought the darker finish. I got home only to realize this also didn’t match. When I talked to customer service I was told occasionally their suppliers change and there was nothing I could do about it. 

So long story short: Don’t purchase these if you plan on expanding your library later on, or if you are buying them to expand the bookshelf you already own.
records.title: Great bookshelf, but don’t plan on expanding it later

records.author: Cynthia
records.body: We had two awkward little alcoves that were wasted space. These bookcases fit beautifully.
records.title: Good choice

records.author: Betty
records.body: Was looking for additional storage for my closet.  The versatile of this storage unit was just the right solution.  It fit nicely into the corner of my closet turning dead space into additional storage.  I would highly recommend it.
records.title: Just the right size

records.author: W Thomas
records.body: Today's Billy Bookcases are not the same as the ones I bought 15+ years ago.  Color, wood pattern, and size have changed.  Nothing matches.  Why call them by the same name if they have changed?  I hope the new ones are as sturdy as the older ones.
records.title: If you change the game, change the name.

records.author: Sara
records.body: I purchased one bookcase and then quickly bought 3 more.  The verticality really helps with storage in small spaces and they hold quite a bit.  Recommend.
records.title: So good, I purchased 4

records.author: Bobby
records.body: Assembly was not difficult. Love the black oak effect.
records.title: Good Looking Bookcase

records.author: Pamela
records.body: My husband and I recently moved into a new home and bought 2 Billy Bookcases to augment the closet system in our primary bedroom. We have never had to assemble furniture before and found the bookcases easy to put together, attractive, sturdy and functional! We are now considering the Billy Bookcase cabinet system for our back entry drop zone. Great product, Ikea!
records.title: Operation Billy Bookcase

records.author: Monica
records.body: We use these everywhere, Large spaces, small spaces, they just work. They look great and I LOVE that you can add a bit of wallpaper or paint to the backing and give it all kinds of character.
records.title: What a versatile shelf!

records.author: Diane
records.body: I purchased this recently to organize my husband‘s video games. I only had a limited amount of space to put an organizer and this was perfect. My husband also loved it because now all his games were nice, organized and easier to find what he is looking for.
records.title: Perfect for small spaces

records.author: Sara
records.body: Please restock, I need another! Its so perfect.
records.title: THE BEST COLOR

records.author: Daniel
records.body: I really like the look of this bookcase, but IKEA offers no way to purchase additional blue shelves for this piece. If you want more blue shelves than what is provided, you will have to buy entire additional bookcase.
records.title: No additional shelving

records.author: Eduardo
records.body: Easy to assembly.Perfect fit for my place.
records.title: Billy Bookcase

records.author: Richard
records.body: Good construction, great price. Instruction pictorial needs some study before diving. Be sure you don't need the larger model.
records.title: Great small bookcase.

records.author: John
records.body: I needed storage space in my bathroom and the bookcase fit the spot and now my bathroom is organized and everything is easy to locate. My home has a lot of storage issues and this is one of my solutions.
records.title: billy to the rescue

records.author: Margarita
records.body:
I got 5 units to build a custom media center for my office/playroom for my son and I to have better organization. Each unit took me less that 15 minutes to build! We added the doors as well for a cleaner look (I get overstimulated easily with messes). I used the Billy tool to help create what I was looking for! 
I will say, delivery took forever so in the future I would much rather use the click and collect option and pick it up myself or just go in and shop what I need. Thank you ikea for creating such creative and amazing storage hacks!
records.title: Billy is the way to go!!

records.author: Tina
records.body: Bought the corner hardware separately. They went together easily (make sure you have a ratcheting screwdriver to avoid hand pain and cracking the particleboard veneer).
records.title: Great Shelves

records.author: Dana
records.body: I bought 3 with the corner connector kit. Top half is super easy, bottom half not so and once they're in place good luck if you need to shift them BUT! I adore the bookcases. Perfect depth for little book display setups, fits quite a lot if you're just shelving books. Addons are good too, I plan to build a whole library wall with these complete with ladder rail eventually.
records.title: Perfect for books/media display!

records.author: Jennifer
records.body: Affordable, easy assembly, and the height extensions are amazing!!!
records.title: Love this Bookcase

post.description:
Browse or filter equipment for sale by category or make; discover filter values via `include_facets`; paginate with `continuation`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category_slug.description: Path segment of a category or make listing page, as in the site's URLs: `Excavators`, `Bobcat`, `Truck+Tractors`, `Skid+Steer+Loaders`, `Cat-Excavators`. Spaces are accepted and encoded as `+`. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 +._&',()-]*$.

continuation.description: Continuation cursor: the `next_offset` of the previous page as a decimal string. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,7}$.

include_facets.description: Also return the page's facet links (type, buying format, make, location, year, price, marketplace) with counts.

ironclad_assurance.description: Only items with (true) or without (false) IronClad Assurance (`ica`).

location.description: Location code (`l2`): a country (`USA`, `CAN`, `MEX`) or country-region (`USA-TX`). Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2,3}(-[A-Z0-9]{2,3})?$.

marketplace.description: Marketplace (`ms`): I IronPlanet, M Marketplace-E, T TruckPlanet, G GovPlanet, R Ritchie Bros. Auctioneers, S SalvageSale.

price_bucket.description: USD price bucket lower bound (`p_us`): -1 any USD price, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, 1000000.

sale_format.description: Buying format (`fp`): D any auction, A online auction, L on-site auction, S sealed auction, B Buy Now, M Make Offer.

sort.description: Sort key as the site encodes it: `bm asc` Best Match, `p asc`/`p desc` price, `d asc` closest to the exit IP (not reproducible), `ad asc`/`ad desc` ending sooner/later, `yr desc` year (newest first).

type_id.description: Sub-type id within the category (`t`), e.g. 12912 Tracked Excavator; discover via `include_facets`.

url.description: Alternatively a pasted listing URL such as https://www.ironplanet.com/Excavators?c=3&sm=0&m=Bobcat; its slug and recognised query parameters are used.

post.description:
Find the sale group ids of upcoming online auctions before listing their lots.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

realm_id.description: Site realm: 1 IronPlanet (default), 21 TruckPlanet, 22 GovPlanet, 3 Europe, 2 Australia, 23 GovPlanet EU, 71 SalvageSale.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

x-codeSamples.label: Reference example
x-codeSamples.source:
# Fixed reference example. Playground inputs do not update this sample.
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.aisa.one/apis/v1/firecrawl-alexandria/ironplanet-com/equipment-auctions/list_upcoming_auctions \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "alexandria": {
    "provider": "ironplanet-com",
    "capability": "equipment-auctions/list_upcoming_auctions",
    "options": {
      "request": {

post.description:
Find ISRCTN studies on a topic, from a sponsor or funder, in a country or with a recruitment status, before calling study for the full record. For a known ISRCTN, URL or NCT/EudraCT/IRAS number, call study directly.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

condition.description: Condition or disease, matched as a phrase, e.g. "breast cancer".

country.description: Recruitment country as the registry names it ("United Kingdom", "United States of America", "Korea, South"); UK, US, USA and common aliases work. "United Kingdom" also matches studies that list only England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.

funder.description: Funder name, matched as a phrase, e.g. "Wellcome Trust".

intervention.description: Intervention, drug or device, matched as a phrase, e.g. "tranexamic acid".

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page; send the same filters again.

phase.description: Any of these phases; combined phases match both (PHASE2 matches Phase I/II, Phase II and Phase II/III).

registered_from.description: Registered (ISRCTN assigned) on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

registered_to.description: Registered on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

sponsor.description: Sponsor organisation, matched as a phrase, e.g. "University of Oxford".

status.description: Keep studies whose overall or recruitment status is any of these, computed as ISRCTN computes them (see overall_status and recruitment_status). The registry does not index computed statuses, so each page is filtered after fetching: total_count is null and a page can come back short with a next_page_token.

term.description: Free text searched across the whole record, with AND, OR, NOT, quoted phrases and parentheses, e.g. "tranexamic acid" AND trauma. Field constraints from the ISRCTN API also work (condition:asthma). Unbalanced quotes or parentheses are refused: the registry would silently match nothing.

title.description: Words in the public or scientific title, or the acronym, matched as a phrase, e.g. "RECOVERY".

updated_since.description: Record edited on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

license.attribution: Study records from the ISRCTN registry (https://www.isrctn.com), contributed by each study's registering researchers under CC BY 4.0; cite a study by its DOI.
license.name: CC BY 4.0

post.description:
You have an ISRCTN (from search, a pasted isrctn.com or doi.org/10.1186/ISRCTN link) or a study's NCT, EudraCT or IRAS number and need its protocol details, eligibility, outcomes, sites, funders or result publications.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

isrctn.description: ISRCTN number, e.g. ISRCTN86750102 or 86750102. Pass exactly one of isrctn, url or secondary_id.

secondary_id.description: Another identifier the study lists: an NCT number, EudraCT or CTIS number, IRAS, CPMS or NIHR number, or a sponsor protocol number. Matched exactly against the record's listed identifiers; fails with ambiguous_secondary_id when several studies list it.

url.description: A record URL: isrctn.com/ISRCTN..., doi.org/10.1186/ISRCTN..., the API trial URL, or the registry's old controlled-trials.com address.

response.brief_title: CRASH2 Trial, a large randomised placebo-controlled trial among trauma patients with significant haemorrhage of the effects of an antifibrinolytic treatment on death and transfusion requirement
response.citation: Roberts, I (2004): CRASH2 Trial, a large randomised placebo-controlled trial among trauma patients with significant haemorrhage of the effects of an antifibrinolytic treatment on death and transfusion requirement. ISRCTN. https://doi.org/10.1186/ISRCTN86750102

eligibility.exclusion_criteria: The fundamental eligibility criterion is the responsible doctor's 'uncertainty' as to whether or not to use an antifibrinolytic agent in a particular adult with traumatic haemorrhage. Patients for whom the responsible doctor considers there is a clear indication for antifibrinolytic therapy should not be randomised. Likewise, patients for whom there is considered to be a clear contraindication to antifibrinolytic therapy (such as, perhaps, those who have clinical evidence of a thrombotic disseminated intravascular coagulation) should not be randomised. Where the responsible doctor is substantially uncertain as to whether or not to use an antifibrinolytic, all these patients are eligible for randomisation and should be considered for the trial. There are no other pre-specified exclusion criteria.
eligibility.inclusion_criteria: All adult trauma patients who are considered to be at risk of significant haemorrhage and are within 8 hours of the injury, are eligible for trial entry if they appear to be at least 16 years old. There are no other pre-specified exclusion criteria, as the fundamental eligibility criterion is the responsible doctor's 'uncertainty' whether or not to use tranexamic acid (TXA) in a particular adult with traumatic haemorrhage. Patients for whom there is considered by the responsible doctor to be a clear indication for TXA should not be randomised. Likewise, any for whom there is considered to be a clear contraindication to TXA (such as, perhaps, those who have clinical evidence of a thrombotic disseminated intravascular coagulation) should not be randomised. All those for whom the responsible doctor is substantially uncertain as to whether or not to use an anti-fibrinolytic agent are eligible for randomisation, and as many such patients as possible should be considered for the trial.

funders.name: NIHR Health Technology Assessment Programme - HTA (UK)
London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (UK)

interventions.description:
Tranexamic acid 2 g intravenously over 8 hours versus placebo.

Please note that as of 24/03/10 this trial has completed recruitment, analysis is ongoing.
interventions.name: Tranexamic acid

lead_sponsor.name: London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (UK)

license.attribution: Roberts, I (2004): CRASH2 Trial, a large randomised placebo-controlled trial among trauma patients with significant haemorrhage of the effects of an antifibrinolytic treatment on death and transfusion requirement. ISRCTN. https://doi.org/10.1186/ISRCTN86750102. CC BY 4.0, via the ISRCTN registry.
license.name: CC BY 4.0

locations.facility: London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine

response.objectives:
Because the coagulation abnormalities that occur after injury are similar to those after surgery, it is possible that antifibrinolytic agents might also reduce blood loss, the need for transfusion and mortality following trauma. However, to date there has been only one small randomised controlled trial (70 randomised patients, drug versus placebo: 0 versus 3 deaths) of the effect of antifibrinolytic agents in major trauma. As a result, there is insufficient evidence to either support or refute a clinically important treatment effect. Systemic antifibrinolytic agents have been used in the management of eye injuries where there is some evidence that they reduce the rate of secondary haemorrhage. 

CRASH2 aims to determine the effect of the early administration of the antifibrinolytic agent tranexamic acid (TXA) on death and transfusion requirement in adult trauma patients with ongoing significant haemorrhage, or who are considered to be at risk of significant haemorrhage. In addition, the effect on the risk of non-fatal vascular events (either haemorrhagic or occlusive) will be assessed. 

The initial stages of the trial was funded by the London School of Hygiene, the Bupa Foundation and the Moulton Charitable Trust. In 2007, this trial obtained main funding from the NIHR Health Technology Assessment Programme, which will fund this trial from April 2007 to September 2010. 

More information on the CRASH2 trial can be found at: http://www.nets.nihr.ac.uk/projects/hta/0630320 

As of 16/06/2008, the CRASH2 trial will conduct sub-group analyses "CRASH-2 Intracranial Bleeding Study (IBS)" (start date: October 2009) to study the effect of TXA in participants who also have traumatic brain injury (TBI). About 40% of participants out of 9,000 enrolled so far have TBI. Details of this sub-study can be found at: http://www.nets.nihr.ac.uk/projects/hta/0910201 

Hypothesis: Early administration of TXA can prevent the occurrence or increase of intracranial bleeding in patients with TBI and significant bleeding. 

On 21/08/2009 the anticipated start and end dates of this trial were changed from 01/05/2005 and 30/04/2010 to 01/04/2007 and 30/09/2010, respectively. 

This trial completed follow-up on the 02/03/2010, and the record was updated to reflect this on 09/07/2010.

primary_outcomes.measure:
The primary outcome measure is death in hospital within 4 weeks of injury (causes of death will be classified).

An additional outcome measure for the sub-group analyses (added as of 18/06/2008): 
1. Increase in volume of intracranial bleeding. A repeat CT scan will be carried out 24-48 hours after injury and compared to a clinical baseline CT scan.

secondary_outcomes.measure:
Secondary outcome measures will be receipt of a blood transfusion, volume of blood transfused, surgical intervention and the occurrence of vascular events (haemorrhagic stroke, occlusive stroke, myocardial infarction, pulmonary embolism, clinically diagnosed deep vein thrombosis). Data will be recorded on a single sided outcome form which can be completed entirely from the hospital notes. There will be no additional tests.

Additional outcome measures for the sub-group analyses (added as of 18/06/2008): 
A repeat CT scan will be carried out 24 - 48 hours after injury and compared to a clinical baseline CT scan to assess the following:
1. Frequency of progressive haematomas
2. Frequency of delayed haematomas
3. New focal ischaemic lesions

Find candidate parts for a keyword, part number or category; page through a category; then call get_part with a returned component_code for the full detail.

availability.description: JLCPCB's result tabs: `stock` = parts in JLCPCB's own assembly stock, `buy` = global sourcing (purchasable on request), `post` = consignment / pre-order, `all` = every tab.

category.description: Top-level category name exactly as list_categories returns it, e.g. `Embedded Processors & Controllers`.

library_type.description: Restrict to Basic (no hand-loading fee) or Extended assembly parts.

manufacturers.description: Restrict to these manufacturer names as JLCPCB spells them (e.g. `Lattice`, `Intel/Altera`).

packages.description: Restrict to these package strings as JLCPCB spells them (e.g. `TQFP-100(14x14)`, `0402`).

page.description: page

query.description: Keyword, LCSC C-number or manufacturer part number. At least one of query, category or subcategory is required.

sort.description: sort

subcategory.description: Second-level category name exactly as list_categories returns it, e.g. `Programmable Logic Device (CPLDs/FPGAs)`. Requires category.

response.description:
Wir begleiten unsere Kunden Ende-zu-Ende – von der strategischen, KI-nativen Neuausrichtung & Zieldefinition der Organisation über die Konzeption & Entwicklung von cutting-edge KI-Lösungen bis hin zum technischen Design & der Implementierung von KI- & Daten-Plattformen. Dabei verbinden wir fachliche Expertise, moderne KI-Technologien (insb. generative und agentische KI) und tiefes Technologieverständnis, um messbaren, transformativen Geschäftswert zu schaffen.

## Aufgaben

**Das erwartet dich:**

*   **KI- und Datenanwendungen mit Vision**  
Nutze dein technisches Fachwissen und deine Leidenschaft für moderne Technologien, um die nächste Generation von KI- und Datenarchitekturen für unsere Kunden zu gestalten und den Einsatz generativer und agentischer KI voranzutreiben.  
 
*   **Technologieberatung auf höchstem Niveau**  
Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams identifizierst du als Technology Consultant die passenden Technologien und Architekturen, um Daten- und KI-Anwendungen effizient und skalierbar nutzbar zu machen. Du bewertest technologische Optionen, entwirfst Zielarchitekturen und leitest daraus belastbare technische Konzepte und Roadmaps ab.  
 
*   **Realer Impact für Industrien und Gesellschaft**  
Bei Accenture arbeitest du mit weltweit führenden Unternehmen und Institutionen an wegweisenden Lösungen. Das Ziel: datengetriebene Anwendungsfälle identifizieren, gestalten, testen und erfolgreich in die Praxis bringen – von der ersten Idee bis zur Skalierung. So schaffst du echten Mehrwert und treibst Innovation voran.  
 
*   **Implementierung von Lösungen mit nachhaltigem Erfolg**  
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Entscheidungsträger:innen und Umsetzungsteams verantwortest du die technische Realisierung von Lösungen im KI und Datenbereich. Du stellst eine saubere Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften sicher und begleitest den Übergang in den produktiven Betrieb – mit besonderem Augenmerk auf Stabilität, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und langfristige Wartbarkeit.

## Qualifikation

**Darauf freuen wir uns:**

*   Erfolgreicher Abschluss eines relevanten Studiums auf Master- oder PhD-Niveau im IT-Bereich, bevorzugt mit Schwerpunkt KI, Data Engineering, Software-Engineering oder Datenbanken.  
 
*   Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem einschlägigen Bereich.  
 
*   Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in diesen Bereichen setzen wir voraus: Software-Engineering (z.B.: Python, Scala, Java, C#, Go), Version Control System (z.B.: Git, Azure DevOps), Datenmanipulation (z.B.: SQL, R, Spark), SQL-Datenbanken (z.B.: MS SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres), Web APIs (z.B.: REST, SOAP).  
 
*   Zusätzlich erwarten wir uns Expertise in einem der folgenden Kernbereiche:  
\- Advanced AI: AI & ML Development (LangChain/Graph, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, MLflow) sowie Erfahrung mit LLM Foundation-/Fine Tuned Models (Open AI, Mistral, Anthropic, Hugging Face) und Vektordatenbanken (Azure AI Search, Chroma DB, PgVector)  
\- Data Architecture & Engineering: Data Warehouse/Data Integration (z.B.: Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric, BigQuery, Azure Synapse) sowie NoSQL Datenbanken (z.B.: Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, InfluxDB)  
 
*   Folgende Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren dieser Bereiche sind ein Plus: Continuous Integration & Delivery (z.B.: Unit Testing, Jenkins, Release Management), Cloud Architekturen (z.B.: AWS, Azure, GCP – Zertifizierungen erwünscht), Big Data /In-Memory-Datenbanken (z.B.:Cloudera, Redis), Graphdatenbanken (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, ArangoDB), Streaming Plattformen z.B. (Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs), Containerisierung & Orchestrierung (z. B. Docker, Kubernetes).  
 
*   Projektbezogene Mobilität, Kommunikationsstärke auf Deutsch und Englisch sowie eine hohe Kundenorientierung

## Benefits

*   Attraktive Benefits eines globalen Unternehmens
*   Zugriff auf internationales Wissen und Expertennetzwerke
*   Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle & Homeoffice
*   Überstundenausgleich
*   Umfangreiche Trainings- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
*   Zusammenarbeit mit führenden Expert:innen
*   Stetige fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung

​**Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied**  
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst. 

Neben spannenden Projekten bieten wir dir ein sehr attraktives Vergütungspaket, flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein modernes Umfeld und viele weitere zusätzliche Benefits. Du hast bei uns die Möglichkeit, basierend auf deiner individuellen Leistung aktiv dein Jahreseinkommen positiv zu beeinflussen.

Das Jahresbruttogehalt für diese Position startet, je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung, bei 61.000 €.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

\- Advanced AI: AI & ML Development (LangChain/Graph, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, MLflow) sowie Erfahrung mit LLM Foundation-/Fine Tuned Models (Open AI, Mistral, Anthropic, Hugging Face) und Vektordatenbanken (Azure AI Search, Chroma DB, PgVector)  
\- Data Architecture & Engineering: Data Warehouse/Data Integration (z.B.: Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric, BigQuery, Azure Synapse) sowie NoSQL Datenbanken (z.B.: Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, InfluxDB)  
 
*   Folgende Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren dieser Bereiche sind ein Plus: Continuous Integration & Delivery (z.B.: Unit Testing, Jenkins, Release Management), Cloud Architekturen (z.B.: AWS, Azure, GCP – Zertifizierungen erwünscht), Big Data /In-Memory-Datenbanken (z.B.:Cloudera, Redis), Graphdatenbanken (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, ArangoDB), Streaming Plattformen z.B. (Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs), Containerisierung & Orchestrierung (z. B. Docker, Kubernetes).  
 
*   Projektbezogene Mobilität, Kommunikationsstärke auf Deutsch und Englisch sowie eine hohe Kundenorientierung
response.tasks:
**Das erwartet dich:**

*   **KI- und Datenanwendungen mit Vision**  
Nutze dein technisches Fachwissen und deine Leidenschaft für moderne Technologien, um die nächste Generation von KI- und Datenarchitekturen für unsere Kunden zu gestalten und den Einsatz generativer und agentischer KI voranzutreiben.  
 
*   **Technologieberatung auf höchstem Niveau**  
Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams identifizierst du als Technology Consultant die passenden Technologien und Architekturen, um Daten- und KI-Anwendungen effizient und skalierbar nutzbar zu machen. Du bewertest technologische Optionen, entwirfst Zielarchitekturen und leitest daraus belastbare technische Konzepte und Roadmaps ab.  
 
*   **Realer Impact für Industrien und Gesellschaft**  
Bei Accenture arbeitest du mit weltweit führenden Unternehmen und Institutionen an wegweisenden Lösungen. Das Ziel: datengetriebene Anwendungsfälle identifizieren, gestalten, testen und erfolgreich in die Praxis bringen – von der ersten Idee bis zur Skalierung. So schaffst du echten Mehrwert und treibst Innovation voran.  
 
*   **Implementierung von Lösungen mit nachhaltigem Erfolg**  
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Entscheidungsträger:innen und Umsetzungsteams verantwortest du die technische Realisierung von Lösungen im KI und Datenbereich. Du stellst eine saubere Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften sicher und begleitest den Übergang in den produktiven Betrieb – mit besonderem Augenmerk auf Stabilität, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und langfristige Wartbarkeit.

post.description:
Start here with an employer slug (or company_id from company) to enumerate its openings; pass next_page back as page. Use category_ids from categories or this function's aggregations, city_id from company offices or aggregations. There is no keyword search on JOIN.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category_ids.description: JOIN category ids (filters.categoryIds); ids from categories or aggregations.categories.

city_id.description: JOIN city UUID (filters.placeIds); from company offices[].city_id or aggregations.cities[].city_id. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$.

company_id.description: JOIN's numeric company id (company.company_id). Exactly one of company_slug, company_id or url. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

company_slug.description: The employer's slug on join.com: the segment after https://join.com/companies/ (equals company.domain in JOIN payloads), e.g. accenture, join. Case-insensitive. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,99}$.

page.description: 1-based page; pass next_page back here. A page past the last one is rejected as invalid_input.

page_size.description: Ads per page (the API accepted up to 50).

url.description: A pasted employer page URL https://join.com/companies/<slug>. Exactly one of company_slug, company_id or url. Pattern: ^https?://.

post.description:
Catalog questions such as 'top Netflix movies in Germany' or 'what is streaming free in the UK'. Provider short names come from `providers`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose catalog and offers are returned (US, DE, GB, BR, ...). A GraphQL argument on JustWatch, not a proxy property. Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{1,64}$.

genres.description: Genre short names as returned in `genres` (act, cmy, drm, hrr, scf, ...).

language.description: ISO 639-1 language for titles, descriptions and genre names (en, de, fr, ...). Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

providers.description: Provider short names (nfx, amp, atp, ...) from `providers`.

post.description:
'What came to Netflix in the US today', 'what arrives on Apple TV next week'. Dates are the catalog dates JustWatch publishes; page through with `cursor`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose catalog and offers are returned (US, DE, GB, BR, ...). A GraphQL argument on JustWatch, not a proxy property. Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{1,64}$.

date.description: Catalog date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language for titles, descriptions and genre names (en, de, fr, ...). Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

page_type.description: NEW: offers created on `date`; UPCOMING: announced releases from `date` on.

price_drops.description: true lists price drops instead of new offers.

show.title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

episodes.title: Fiasco

post.description:
The issue's core question: where can this movie or show be watched, per country. Pass `countries` for a multi-market comparison; one request serves every market.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

all_variants.description: true returns every offer variant (each quality per provider); false the best one per provider and monetization type.

countries.description: Countries to return offers for; default the URL's country or US.

imdb_id.description: With `query`: the search result whose IMDb id matches is used. JustWatch has no direct lookup by IMDb id. Pattern: ^tt[0-9]{5,10}$.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language for titles, descriptions and genre names (en, de, fr, ...). Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

monetization_types.description: Keep only these offer types; default all.

query.description: Title text used to locate the title when `imdb_id` or `tmdb_id` is given.

title_id.description: JustWatch node id: tm<n> movie, ts<n> show, tss<n> season, tse<n> episode. Returned as `id` by every function. Pattern: ^(tm|ts|tss|tse)[0-9]{1,12}$.

tmdb_id.description: With `query`: the search result whose TMDB id matches is used. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,10}$.

url.description: A justwatch.com title page URL (https://www.justwatch.com/us/movie/inception, /de/Film/Inception, /us/tv-show/slow-horses/season-1) or its site-relative path. The country prefix selects the default country.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Search kbb.com dealer and private-seller inventory for a make (optionally model and trim) within a radius of a US ZIP code, optionally filtered by year, price, maximum mileage, exterior colour and drivetrain. Returns one page of 25 listings with price, KBB Fair Purchase Price and deal rating, mileage, VIN, seller and distance, plus the total match count for pagination.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

drive_type.description: Drivetrain group. kbb.com groups AWD and 4WD together, so awd and 4wd return the same listings (drive_type AWD4WD).

exterior_color.description: kbb.com exterior colour group; matches the manufacturer colour names in `exterior_color` (e.g. white matches Snowflake White Pearl Mica).

listing_type.description: Inventory to search: used, new, certified pre-owned, or all three. Defaults to used.

make.description: kbb.com make slug, e.g. toyota, honda, ford, mercedes-benz.

mileage_max.description: Only listings with at most this many miles on the odometer (kbb.com maxMileage filter; any ceiling, not just the site's 10,000-mile steps).

model.description: kbb.com model slug, e.g. camry, civic, f150, model-3. Powertrain variants are not separate models (Kona Electric is kona, Bolt EV is bolt); an unknown slug fails with not_found naming the make's valid slugs. Omit for all models of the make.

page.description: Result page; 25 listings per page.

price_max.description: Highest advertised price to include, in whole US dollars; must not be below price_min.

price_min.description: Lowest advertised price to include, in whole US dollars.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles; 0 means nationwide. KBB pads a market's results with remote 'virtual dealer' delivery listings whose distance is not the seller's; with a non-zero radius these are excluded (count may be below page_size while total_count still includes them).

sort.description: Result order: relevance (KBB default), price_asc / price_desc by KBB derived price (advertised price plus fees, so advertised prices are only approximately ordered), mileage_asc, year_desc (newest model year first), distance_asc (nearest seller first), newest (most recently listed first).

trim.description: Trim name as shown in listings (e.g. SE, XLE, Sport Touring). Requires model.

year_max.description: Newest model year to include, inclusive; must not be below year_min.

year_min.description: Oldest model year to include, inclusive.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code at the centre of the search. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

creator.description: Creator slug or numeric creator id, the first path segment after /projects/. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}$.

slug.description: Project slug, the second path segment after /projects/. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,200}$.

url.description: Pasted project URL: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/{creator}/{slug}[/...]. Alternative to `creator` + `slug`.

post.description:
Refresh backers and pledged totals for a known project without re-reading the full page.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

creator.description: Creator slug or numeric creator id, the first path segment after /projects/. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}$.

slug.description: Project slug, the second path segment after /projects/. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,200}$.

url.description: Pasted project URL: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/{creator}/{slug}[/...]. Alternative to `creator` + `slug`.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Discover projects before fetching one with get_project. Use list_categories for category ids and search_locations for woe_ids.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category_id.description: Numeric category id from list_categories or a card's `category.id` (e.g. 34 = Tabletop Games, 12 = Games).

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from a previous page (`seed:page`). Mutually exclusive with `page` and `seed`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}:[0-9]{1,3}$.

goal.description: Goal bucket 0..5 as on the discover page (0 = under $1,000 ... 5 = over $100,000).

page.description: 1-based page; 12 cards per page. Kickstarter answers 404 past roughly page 200.

recommended.description: Only projects Kickstarter marks as recommended.

seed.description: Shuffle seed returned by a previous page; keeps `magic` order stable while paginating.

sort.description: Kickstarter sort. `magic` is a seeded shuffle: pass the returned `seed` (or `cursor`) to keep the order across pages.

state.description: Limit to live campaigns or to successfully funded ones. Omit for Kickstarter's default mix.

tag.description: Browse a tag collection (/discover/tags/{tag}, e.g. `witchstarter`, `make-100`; slugs from list_categories.tags). Combines with `sort` and `page` only. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,80}$.

woe_id.description: Location WOE id from search_locations (e.g. 2357536 = Austin, TX).

post.description:
Resolve a project name to its id, creator and slug quickly; prefer search_projects for filtered, paginated discovery.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

(a) New Year’s Day,
(b) Alberta Family Day,
(c) Good Friday,

(f) Labour Day,
(g) Thanksgiving Day,

response.description: Unsere Durchgangskugelhähne aus Messing vernickelt sind als Muffen-Kugelhähne (Innengewinde), Einschraub-Kugelhähne (Innen-/Außengewinde) oder Kugelhähne mit beiderseits Außengewinde lieferbar. Die Kugelhähne sind mit Zulassungen wie zum Beispiel EN 331, DVGW, KTW (Trinkwasser) und natürlich auch in genormter Baulänge nach DIN 3202-M3 verfügbar. Sie können mit Standardgriff (auch abschließbar), Knebelgriff oder mit Federrückstellung betätigt werden. Durch das von uns eingeführte Kombigriff-System können Sie bei den meisten Kugelhähnen eine Vielzahl optionaler Griffe montieren. Tipp: Verwenden Sie, wo immer es möglich ist, Kugelhähne mit genormter Baulänge nach DIN 3202-M3. Bei einem späteren Austausch sparen Sie Anpassungen an dem Leitungsnetz.

response.text:
Access to Information Act
R.S.C., 1985, c. A-1
An Act to extend the present laws of Canada that provide access to information under the control of the Government of Canada and to provide for the proactive publication of certain information
Short Title
Short title
1 This Act may be cited as the Access to Information Act.
Purpose of Act
Purpose of Act
2 (1) The purpose of this Act is to enhance the accountability and transparency of federal institutions in order to promote an open and democratic society and to enable public debate on the conduct of those institutions.
Specific purposes of Parts 1 and 2
(2) In furtherance of that purpose,
(a) Part 1 extends the present laws of Canada to provide a right of access to information in records under the control of a government institution in accordance with the principles that government information should be available to the public, that necessary exceptions to the right of access should be limited and specific and that decisions on the disclosure of government information should be reviewed independently of government; and
(b) Part 2 sets out requirements for the proactive publication of information.
Complementary procedures
(3) This Act is also intended to complement and not replace existing procedures for access to government information and is not intended to limit in any way access to the type of government information that is normally available to the general public.
Interpretation
Definitions
3 In this Act,
alternative format
alternative format, with respect to a record, means a format that allows a person with a sensory disability to read or listen to that record; (support de substitution)
business day
business day means a day other than
(a) a Saturday;
(b) a Sunday or other holiday; and
(c) a day that falls during the Christmas recess, as defined in section 2 of the Federal Courts Rules; (jour ouvrable)
Court
Court means the Federal Court; (Cour)
designated Minister
designated Minister means a person who is designated as the Minister under subsection 3.2(1); (ministre désigné)
foreign state
foreign state means any state other than Canada; (État étranger)
government institution
government institution means
(a) any department or ministry of state of the Government of Canada, or any body or office, listed in Schedule I, and
(b) any parent Crown corporation, and any wholly-owned subsidiary of such a corporation, within the meaning of section 83 of the Financial Administration Act; (institution fédérale)
head
head, in respect of a government institution, means
(a) in the case of a department or ministry of state, the member of the Queen’s Privy Council for Canada who presides over the department or ministry, or
(b) in any other case, either the person designated under subsection 3.2(2) to be the head of the institution for the purposes of this Act or, if no such person is designated, the chief executive officer of the institution, whatever their title; (responsable d’institution fédérale)
Information Commissioner
Information Commissioner means the Commissioner appointed under section 54; (Commissaire à l’information)
personal information
personal information has the same meaning as in section 3 of the Privacy Act; (renseignements personnels)
record
record means any documentary material, regardless of medium or form; (document)
sensory disability
sensory disability means a disability that relates to sight or hearing; (déficience sensorielle)
third party
third party, in respect of a request for access to a record under Part 1, means any person, group of persons or organization other than the person that made the request or a government institution. (tiers)
For greater certainty
3.01 (1) For greater certainty, any provision of this Act that applies to a government institution that is a parent Crown corporation applies to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries within the meaning of section 83 of the Financial Administration Act.
For greater certainty
(2) For greater certainty, the Canadian Race Relations Foundation and the Public Sector Pension Investment Board are parent Crown corporations for the purposes of this Act.
For greater certainty
3.1 For greater certainty, for the purposes of this Act, information that relates to the general administration of a government institution includes information that relates to expenses paid by the institution for travel, including lodging, and hospitality.
Designation
Power to designate Minister
3.2 (1) The Governor in Council may designate a member of the Queen’s Privy Council for Canada to be the Minister for the purposes of any provision of this Act.
Power to designate head
(2) The Governor in Council may, by order, designate a person to be the head of a government institution, other than a department or ministry of state, for the purposes of this Act.
PART 1 Access to Government Records
Access
Right of Access
Right to access to records
4 (1) Subject to this Part, but notwithstanding any other Act of Parliament, every person who is
(a) a Canadian citizen, or
(b) a permanent resident within the meaning of subsection 2(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act,
has a right to and shall, on request, be given access to any record under the control of a government institution.
Extension of right by order
(2) The Governor in Council may, by order, extend the right to be given access to records under subsection (1) to include persons not referred to in that subsection and may set such conditions as the Governor in Council deems appropriate.
Responsibility of government institutions
(2.1) The head of a government institution shall, without regard to the identity of a person making a request for access to a record under the control of the institution, make every reasonable effort to assist the person in connection with the request, respond to the request accurately and completely and, subject to the regulations, provide timely access to the record in the format requested.
Records produced from machine readable records
(3) For the purposes of this Part, any record requested under this Part that does not exist but can, subject to such limitations as may be prescribed by regulation, be produced from a machine readable record under the control of a government institution using computer hardware and software and technical expertise normally used by the government institution shall be deemed to be a record under the control of the government institution.
Information about Government Institutions
Publication on government institutions
5 (1) The designated Minister shall cause to be published, on a periodic basis not less frequently than once each year, a publication containing
(a) a description of the organization and responsibilities of each government institution, including details on the programs and functions of each division or branch of each government institution;
(b) a description of all classes of records under the control of each government institution in sufficient detail to facilitate the exercise of the right of access under this Part;
(c) a description of all manuals used by employees of each government institution in administering or carrying out any of the programs or activities of the government institution; and
(d) the title and address of the appropriate officer for each government institution to whom requests for access to records under this Part should be sent.
Bulletin
(2) The designated Minister shall cause to be published, at least twice each year, a bulletin to bring the material contained in the publication published under subsection (1) up to date and to provide to the public other useful information relating to the operation of this Act.
Descriptions in publication and bulletins
(3) Any description that is required to be included in the publication or bulletins published under subsection (1) or (2) may be formulated in such a manner that the description does not itself constitute information on the basis of which the head of a government institution would be authorized to refuse to disclose a part of a record requested under this Part.
Publication and bulletin to be made available
(4) The designated Minister shall cause the publication referred to in subsection (1) and the bulletin referred to in subsection (2) to be made available throughout Canada in conformity with the principle that every person is entitled to reasonable access thereto.
Requests for Access
Request for access to record
6 A request for access to a record under this Part shall be made in writing to the government institution that has control of the record and shall provide sufficient detail to enable an experienced employee of the institution to identify the record with a reasonable effort.
Reasons for declining to act on request
6.1 (1) With the Information Commissioner’s written approval, the head of a government institution may, before giving a person access to a record or refusing to do so, decline to act on the person’s request if, in the opinion of the head of the institution, the request is vexatious, is made in bad faith or is otherwise an abuse of the right to make a request for access to records.
Limitation
(1.1) The head of a government institution is not authorized under subsection (1) to decline to act on a person’s request for a record for the sole reason that the information contained in it has been published under Part 2.
Time limit suspended
(1.2) If the head of a government institution communicates with the Information Commissioner to obtain his or her approval to decline to act, the 30-day period set out in section 7 — and any extension to it under section 9 — is suspended during the period beginning on the day on which the head of the institution communicates with the Information Commissioner and ending on the day on which he or she receives the Information Commissioner’s decision in writing.
Notice — suspension
(1.3) The head of the institution shall give written notice to the person who made the request for access to a record under this Part of the suspension of the period, and of the reasons for the suspension, at the same time as they communicate with the Information Commissioner to obtain his or her approval to decline to act.
Notice — end of suspension
(1.4) If the Information Commissioner refuses to give his or her approval, the head of the institution shall, on receiving the Information Commissioner’s decision in writing, give written notice to the person who made the request for access to a record under this Part of the refusal and of the date on which the running of the period resumes in accordance with subsection (1.2).
Notice
(2) If the head of a government institution declines to act on the person’s request, they shall give the person written notice of their decision to decline to act on the request and their reasons for doing so.
Notice where access requested
7 Where access to a record is requested under this Part, the head of the government institution to which the request is made shall, subject to sections 8 and 9, within 30 days after the request is received,
(a) give written notice to the person who made the request as to whether or not access to the record or a part thereof will be given; and
(b) if access is to be given, give the person who made the request access to the record or part thereof.
Transfer of request
8 (1) Where a government institution receives a request for access to a record under this Part and the head of the institution considers that another government institution has a greater interest in the record, the head of the institution may, subject to such conditions as may be prescribed by regulation, within fifteen days after the request is received, transfer the request and, if necessary, the record to the other government institution, in which case the head of the institution transferring the request shall give written notice of the transfer to the person who made the request.
Deeming provision
(2) For the purposes of section 7, where a request is transferred under subsection (1), the request shall be deemed to have been made to the government institution to which it was transferred on the day the government institution to which the request was originally made received it.
Meaning of greater interest
(3) For the purpose of subsection (1), a government institution has a greater interest in a record if
(a) the record was originally produced in or for the institution; or
(b) in the case of a record not originally produced in or for a government institution, the institution was the first government institution to receive the record or a copy thereof.

An Act to extend the present laws of Canada that provide access to information under the control of the Government of Canada and to provide for the proactive publication of certain information
Short Title
Short title
1 This Act may be cited as the Access to Information Act.
Purpose of Act
Purpose of Act
2 (1) The purpose of this Act is to enhance the accountability and transparency of federal institutions in order to promote an open and democratic society and to enable public debate on the conduct of those institutions.
Specific purposes of Parts 1 and 2
(2) In furtherance of that purpose,
(a) Part 1 extends the present laws of Canada to provide a right of access to information in records under the control of a government institution in accordance with the principles that government information should be available to the public, that necessary exceptions to the right of access should be limited and specific and that decisions on the disclosure of government information should be reviewed independently of government; and
(b) Part 2 sets out requirements for the proactive publication of information.
Complementary procedures
(3) This Act is also intended to complement and not replace existing procedures for access to government information and is not intended to limit in any way access to the type of government information that is normally available to the general public.

Definitions

alternative format

business day

(b) a Sunday or other holiday; and
(c) a day that falls during the Christmas recess, as defined in section 2 of the Federal Courts Rules; (jour ouvrable)

designated Minister

foreign state
foreign state means any state other than Canada; (État étranger)
government institution
government institution means

(b) any parent Crown corporation, and any wholly-owned subsidiary of such a corporation, within the meaning of section 83 of the Financial Administration Act; (institution fédérale)

(b) in any other case, either the person designated under subsection 3.2(2) to be the head of the institution for the purposes of this Act or, if no such person is designated, the chief executive officer of the institution, whatever their title; (responsable d’institution fédérale)
Information Commissioner
Information Commissioner means the Commissioner appointed under section 54; (Commissaire à l’information)
personal information
personal information has the same meaning as in section 3 of the Privacy Act; (renseignements personnels)
record
record means any documentary material, regardless of medium or form; (document)
sensory disability
sensory disability means a disability that relates to sight or hearing; (déficience sensorielle)
third party
third party, in respect of a request for access to a record under Part 1, means any person, group of persons or organization other than the person that made the request or a government institution. (tiers)

For greater certainty
(2) For greater certainty, the Canadian Race Relations Foundation and the Public Sector Pension Investment Board are parent Crown corporations for the purposes of this Act.
For greater certainty
3.1 For greater certainty, for the purposes of this Act, information that relates to the general administration of a government institution includes information that relates to expenses paid by the institution for travel, including lodging, and hospitality.
Designation
Power to designate Minister
3.2 (1) The Governor in Council may designate a member of the Queen’s Privy Council for Canada to be the Minister for the purposes of any provision of this Act.
Power to designate head
(2) The Governor in Council may, by order, designate a person to be the head of a government institution, other than a department or ministry of state, for the purposes of this Act.
PART 1 Access to Government Records
Access
Right of Access
Right to access to records
4 (1) Subject to this Part, but notwithstanding any other Act of Parliament, every person who is
(a) a Canadian citizen, or
(b) a permanent resident within the meaning of subsection 2(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act,
has a right to and shall, on request, be given access to any record under the control of a government institution.
Extension of right by order
(2) The Governor in Council may, by order, extend the right to be given access to records under subsection (1) to include persons not referred to in that subsection and may set such conditions as the Governor in Council deems appropriate.
Responsibility of government institutions
(2.1) The head of a government institution shall, without regard to the identity of a person making a request for access to a record under the control of the institution, make every reasonable effort to assist the person in connection with the request, respond to the request accurately and completely and, subject to the regulations, provide timely access to the record in the format requested.
Records produced from machine readable records
(3) For the purposes of this Part, any record requested under this Part that does not exist but can, subject to such limitations as may be prescribed by regulation, be produced from a machine readable record under the control of a government institution using computer hardware and software and technical expertise normally used by the government institution shall be deemed to be a record under the control of the government institution.
Information about Government Institutions
Publication on government institutions
5 (1) The designated Minister shall cause to be published, on a periodic basis not less frequently than once each year, a publication containing
(a) a description of the organization and responsibilities of each government institution, including details on the programs and functions of each division or branch of each government institution;
(b) a description of all classes of records under the control of each government institution in sufficient detail to facilitate the exercise of the right of access under this Part;
(c) a description of all manuals used by employees of each government institution in administering or carrying out any of the programs or activities of the government institution; and
(d) the title and address of the appropriate officer for each government institution to whom requests for access to records under this Part should be sent.
Bulletin
(2) The designated Minister shall cause to be published, at least twice each year, a bulletin to bring the material contained in the publication published under subsection (1) up to date and to provide to the public other useful information relating to the operation of this Act.

(3) Any description that is required to be included in the publication or bulletins published under subsection (1) or (2) may be formulated in such a manner that the description does not itself constitute information on the basis of which the head of a government institution would be authorized to refuse to disclose a part of a record requested under this Part.
Publication and bulletin to be made available
(4) The designated Minister shall cause the publication referred to in subsection (1) and the bulletin referred to in subsection (2) to be made available throughout Canada in conformity with the principle that every person is entitled to reasonable access thereto.

Request for access to record
6 A request for access to a record under this Part shall be made in writing to the government institution that has control of the record and shall provide sufficient detail to enable an experienced employee of the institution to identify the record with a reasonable effort.
Reasons for declining to act on request

Notice

(a) the record was originally produced in or for the institution; or
(b) in the case of a record not originally produced in or for a government institution, the institution was the first government institution to receive the record or a copy thereof.",

post.description:
Which members of Congress a lobbyist or firm gave to, contributions to a campaign committee by registered lobbyists, a firm's PAC giving.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

amount_max.description: An item of at most this amount, US dollars.

amount_min.description: An item of at least this amount, US dollars.

contribution_date_after.description: An item dated on or after this date. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

contribution_date_before.description: An item dated on or before this date. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

contribution_type.description: Item type: feca (FECA contribution), he (honorary expenses), me (meeting expenses), ple (presidential library), pic (presidential inaugural committee).

contributor.description: Contributor name on an item, substring.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same search; keep every other input unchanged. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

exclude_lobbyist_reports.description: true keeps only reports filed by organizations (registrants), dropping individual lobbyists' reports.

filing_type.description: MM mid-year, MA mid-year amendment, YY year-end, YA year-end amendment.

honoree.description: Honoree name on an item (e.g. a member of Congress), substring.

page_size.description: Results per page (lda.gov caps pages at 25).

payee.description: Payee name on an item (e.g. a campaign committee), substring.

posted_after.description: Report posted on or after this date. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

posted_before.description: Report posted on or before this date. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

registrant_name.description: Registrant name, case-insensitive substring; matches the registrant's own report and its lobbyists' reports.

sort.description: Order by posting time. Omit for lda.gov's default order.

post.description:
Who lobbies for a company or on an issue, how much a client paid a firm in a year, which firms or lobbyists worked a bill topic.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

affiliated_organization_name.description: Affiliated organization named on the filing, substring.

amount_max.description: Maximum reported income or expenses, US dollars.

amount_min.description: Minimum reported income or expenses, US dollars.

client_id.description: Client id from search_clients (one registrant-client relationship).

client_name.description: Client name, case-insensitive substring (google matches GOOGLE CLIENT SERVICES LLC).

client_state.description: Client state, two-letter USPS code. Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same search; keep every other input unchanged. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

filing_period.description: Reporting period; quarterly since 2008, mid_year/year_end before.

filing_type.description: LDA filing type code: RR registration (LD-1), RA its amendment, Q1-Q4 quarterly reports (LD-2), 1A-4A amendments, 1T-4T terminations; Y suffix = no activity; M*/Y* are the pre-2008 semiannual forms.

foreign_entity_name.description: Foreign entity named on the filing, substring.

issue.description: Full-text search of the specific lobbying issues text. Words are OR-ed; "quoted text" is a phrase; OR and a leading - (NOT) are supported, e.g. "artificial intelligence" -defense. lda.gov has no filter on the general issue code; it is returned per activity.

lobbyist_id.description: Lobbyist id from a filing's lobbying_activities.

page_size.description: Results per page (lda.gov caps pages at 25).

posted_after.description: Posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

posted_before.description: Posted on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

registrant_name.description: Registrant (lobbying firm or in-house organization) name, case-insensitive substring.

sort.description: Order by posting time. Omit for lda.gov's default order.

response.digest:
Existing law, the Gambling Control Act, provides for the licensure and regulation of various legalized gambling activities and establishments by the California Gambling Control Commission and the investigation and enforcement of those activities by the Department of Justice. Under existing law, the commission consists of 5 members who are appointed by the Governor, subject to confirmation by the Senate. Existing law requires one member of the commission, among other criteria, to be an attorney with regulatory law experience.
This bill would instead require one member of the commission, among other criteria, to be an attorney with regulatory or gaming law experience. The bill would make other technical, nonsubstantive changes.
response.text:
The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
SECTION 1. Section 19800 of the Business and Professions Code is amended to read:
19800. This chapter is known, and may be cited, as the “Gambling Control Act.”
SEC. 2. Section 19812 of the Business and Professions Code is amended to read:
19812. (a) Each member of the commission shall be a citizen of the United States and a resident of this state.
(b) A Member of the Legislature, a person holding any elective office in state, county, or local government, and an officer or official of any political party are not eligible for appointment to the commission.
(c) No more than three of the five members of the commission shall be members of the same political party.
(d) A person is ineligible for appointment to the commission if, within two years prior to appointment, the person, or any partnership or corporation in which the person is a principal, was employed by, retained by, or derived substantial income from, any gambling establishment. For the purposes of this subdivision, “gambling establishment” means one or more rooms in which any gaming within the meaning of Chapter 10 (commencing with Section 330) of Title 9 of Part 1 of the Penal Code, or any controlled game within the meaning of Section 337j of the Penal Code, is conducted, whether or not the activity occurred in California.
(e) One member of the commission shall be a certified public accountant or a person with experience in banking or finance, one member shall be an attorney and a member of the State Bar of California with regulatory or gaming law experience, one member shall have a background in law enforcement and criminal investigation, one member shall have a background in business with at least five years of business experience or alternatively five years of governmental experience, and one member shall be from the public at large.
response.title: An act to amend Sections 19800 and 19812 of the Business and Professions Code, relating to gambling.

heading_path.heading: CHAPTER 2. Province of Court and Jury [310 - 312]

sections.text:
(a) All questions of law (including but not limited to questions concerning the construction of statutes and other writings, the admissibility of evidence, and other rules of evidence) are to be decided by the court. Determination of issues of fact preliminary to the admission of evidence are to be decided by the court as provided in Article 2 (commencing with Section 400) of Chapter 4.
(b) Determination of the law of an organization of nations or of the law of a foreign nation or a public entity in a foreign nation is a question of law to be determined in the manner provided in Division 4 (commencing with Section 450).

If the law of an organization of nations, a foreign nation or a state other than this state, or a public entity in a foreign nation or a state other than this state, is applicable and such law cannot be determined, the court may, as the ends of justice require, either:
(a) Apply the law of this state if the court can do so consistently with the Constitution of the United States and the Constitution of this state; or
(b) Dismiss the action without prejudice or, in the case of a reviewing court, remand the case to the trial court with directions to dismiss the action without prejudice.

Except as otherwise provided by law, where the trial is by jury:
(a) All questions of fact are to be decided by the jury.
(b) Subject to the control of the court, the jury is to determine the effect and value of the evidence addressed to it, including the credibility of witnesses and hearsay declarants.

response.history_note: (Amended by Stats. 2018, Ch. 317, Sec. 4. (AB 2230) Effective January 1, 2019. Section operative January 1, 2020, pursuant to Sec. 6, Stats. 2018, Ch. 317.)
response.text:
(a) On receipt of a response to a demand for inspection, copying, testing, or sampling, the demanding party may move for an order compelling further response to the demand if the demanding party deems that any of the following apply:
(1) A statement of compliance with the demand is incomplete.
(2) A representation of inability to comply is inadequate, incomplete, or evasive.
(3) An objection in the response is without merit or too general.
(b) A motion under subdivision (a) shall comply with each of the following:
(1) The motion shall set forth specific facts showing good cause justifying the discovery sought by the demand.
(2) The motion shall be accompanied by a meet and confer declaration under Section 2016.040.
(3) In lieu of a separate statement required under the California Rules of Court, the court may allow the moving party to submit a concise outline of the discovery request and each response in dispute.
(c) Unless notice of this motion is given within 45 days of the service of the verified response, or any supplemental verified response, or on or before any specific later date to which the demanding party and the responding party have agreed in writing, the demanding party waives any right to compel a further response to the demand.
(d) In a motion under subdivision (a) relating to the production of electronically stored information, the party or affected person objecting to or opposing the production, inspection, copying, testing, or sampling of electronically stored information on the basis that the information is from a source that is not reasonably accessible because of the undue burden or expense shall bear the burden of demonstrating that the information is from a source that is not reasonably accessible because of undue burden or expense.
(e) If the party or affected person from whom discovery of electronically stored information is sought establishes that the information is from a source that is not reasonably accessible because of the undue burden or expense, the court may nonetheless order discovery if the demanding party shows good cause, subject to any limitations imposed under subdivision (g).
(f) If the court finds good cause for the production of electronically stored information from a source that is not reasonably accessible, the court may set conditions for the discovery of the electronically stored information, including allocation of the expense of discovery.
(g) The court shall limit the frequency or extent of discovery of electronically stored information, even from a source that is reasonably accessible, if the court determines that any of the following conditions exists:
(1) It is possible to obtain the information from some other source that is more convenient, less burdensome, or less expensive.
(2) The discovery sought is unreasonably cumulative or duplicative.
(3) The party seeking discovery has had ample opportunity by discovery in the action to obtain the information sought.
(4) The likely burden or expense of the proposed discovery outweighs the likely benefit, taking into account the amount in controversy, the resources of the parties, the importance of the issues in the litigation, and the importance of the requested discovery in resolving the issues.
(h) Except as provided in subdivision (j), the court shall impose a monetary sanction under Chapter 7 (commencing with Section 2023.010) against any party, person, or attorney who unsuccessfully makes or opposes a motion to compel further response to a demand, unless it finds that the one subject to the sanction acted with substantial justification or that other circumstances make the imposition of the sanction unjust.
(i) Except as provided in subdivision (j), if a party fails to obey an order compelling further response, the court may make those orders that are just, including the imposition of an issue sanction, an evidence sanction, or a terminating sanction under Chapter 7 (commencing with Section 2023.010). In lieu of, or in addition to, that sanction, the court may impose a monetary sanction under Chapter 7 (commencing with Section 2023.010).
(j) (1) Notwithstanding subdivisions (h) and (i), absent exceptional circumstances, the court shall not impose sanctions on a party or any attorney of a party for failure to provide electronically stored information that has been lost, damaged, altered, or overwritten as the result of the routine, good faith operation of an electronic information system.
(2) This subdivision shall not be construed to alter any obligation to preserve discoverable information.

subprovisions.text: (2) Subsection (1) is subject to sections 15 to 30A .
(3A) An order under subsection (3)(a) may also amend section 6(7)(a) of the Public Order Act 2023 (obstruction etc of major transport works).
(4) An order under subsection (3)(b) may amend this Act.

(5) The power conferred by subsection (3) may be exercised to add a new type of project to subsection (1) only if—
(a) a project of the new type is a project for the carrying out of works in one or more of the fields specified in subsection (6), and
(b) the works are to be carried out wholly in one or more of the areas specified in subsection (7).

post.description:
To see amendments, repeals and commencements touching an Act (e.g. what the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 changed in the Planning Act 2008) and whether they are applied in the current text yet.

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

post.description:
Pass a Letterboxd film URL or boxd.it link (`url`), a slug (`slug`), a boxd.it id (`lid`), a TMDB id (`tmdb_id`) or an IMDb id (`imdb_id`); exactly one. For many films at once use ratings_bulk; for the histogram and watched/list/like counts use film_ratings; for member reviews use reviews (sort `popular` is the film page's Popular reviews strip); for lists use lists.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

imdb_id.description: IMDb title id; resolved through letterboxd.com/imdb/<id>/. Pattern: ^tt[0-9]+$.

lid.description: Letterboxd short id, the path of a boxd.it link (case-sensitive). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]+$.

slug.description: Film slug from the URL path, e.g. parasite-2019 (the year suffix is part of the slug when Letterboxd uses one). A bare title slug such as parasite or sentimental-value belongs to whichever film took that slug first, often an older film with the same title; when the slug is not known from a Letterboxd URL, pass tmdb_id or imdb_id, or take the slug from search_films, and confirm name and year in the output. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$.

tmdb_id.description: TMDB movie id; resolved through letterboxd.com/tmdb/<id>/. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

url.description: Letterboxd film page URL (https://letterboxd.com/film/<slug>/...) or boxd.it short link (https://boxd.it/<lid>). Pattern: ^https?://(www\.)?(letterboxd\.com/film/[a-z0-9-]+|boxd\.it/[A-Za-z0-9]+).

response.description:
IMDB's top 250 list: loved by some, hated by others. Of course you can argue about the order of movies and the presence or absence of certain titles. Fact remains that it holds a great deal of the most appreciated films of all time and the overall quality is pretty high.

I tried to complete the list once, but choked near the end... ;-) I will keep updating weekly though and one day I will finish the last few missing films.

Feel free to comment your % or must sees from this list!
And for the people who find 250 entries a bit lacking, here's a list with every movie that was once in IMDB's Top 250.

A few statistics...

The oldest movie on the list is Charlie Chaplin's The Kid, released in 1921. The most popular decade in the list is the 2000's with 49 entries. A complete overview:
1920's - 6 entries
1930's - 6 entries
1940's - 9 entries
1950's - 21 entries
1960's - 16 entries
1970's - 19 entries
1980's - 25 entries
1990's - 39 entries
2000's - 49 entries
2010's - 41 entries
2020's - 19 entries

Christopher Nolan is the king of IMDB, with 9 films on the top 250. There are three directors with 7 films on the list. Scorsese, Kubrick and Spielberg complete the crème de la crème according to IMDB users.

All popular directors:
9 entries - Christopher Nolan
7 entries - Stanley Kubrick, Steven Spielberg, Martin Scorsese
6 entries - Akira Kurosawa, Quentin Tarantino
5 entries - Billy Wilder, Charlie Chaplin, Alfred Hitchcock
4 entries - Hayao Miyazaki, Sergio Leone
3 entries - Brad Bird, Clint Eastwood, David Fincher, Francis Ford Coppola, James Cameron, Joel Coen, Pete Docter, Peter Jackson, Ridley Scott, Denis Villeneuve


Latest update: 28/9/2026. I am currently at 98%

Back in the list:
Miracle in Cell No. 7 at #250

Gone, not forgotten:
Andhadhun

post.description:
Which curated lists a film appears in: pass `film` (slug, Letterboxd URL or boxd.it link), `tmdb_id` or `imdb_id`, pick a `sort` and page through with `page`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

film.description: Film slug, Letterboxd film URL or boxd.it link.

imdb_id.description: IMDb title id; resolved through letterboxd.com/imdb/<id>/. Pattern: ^tt[0-9]+$.

sort.description: popular = list popularity; updated = when updated (the page's default); name; newest/oldest = when published.

tmdb_id.description: TMDB movie id; resolved through letterboxd.com/tmdb/<id>/. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

What members think of a film, beyond the average: pass `film` (slug, Letterboxd URL or boxd.it link), `tmdb_id` or `imdb_id`, pick a `sort` and page through with `page`. For the thread under one review use review_comments.
