sections.content: In most cases, convolution is more a expensive algorithm for downscaling because it takes into account all the pixels of source image. Therefore BILINEAR and BICUBIC filters’ performance can be lower than before. On the other hand the quality of BILINEAR and BICUBIC was close to NEAREST. So if such quality is suitable for your tasks you can switch to NEAREST filter for downscaling, which will give a huge improvement in performance. At the same time performance of convolution resampling for downs...
sections.title: Resize performance

sections.content: Image resizing methods resize() and thumbnail() take a resample argument, which tells which filter should be used for resampling. Possible values are: NEAREST, BILINEAR, BICUBIC and ANTIALIAS. Almost all of them were changed in this version.
highlights: Image resizing methods resize() and thumbnail() take a resample argument, which tells which filter should
sections.title: Image resizing filters

sections.content: A new LANCZOS constant was added instead of ANTIALIAS. When ANTIALIAS was initially added, it was the only high-quality filter based on convolutions. It’s name was supposed to reflect this. Starting from Pillow 2.7.0 all resize method are based on convolutions. All of them are antialias from now on. And the real name of the ANTIALIAS filter is Lanczos filter. The ANTIALIAS constant is left for backward compatibility and is an alias for LANCZOS.
highlights: Starting from Pillow 2.7.0 all resize method are based on convolutions.
sections.title: Antialias renamed to Lanczos

sections.content: reduce() is a highly efficient operation to reduce an image by integer times. Normally, it shouldn’t be used directly. Used internally by resize() and thumbnail() methods to speed up resize when a new argument reducing_gap is set.
highlights: Used internally by resize() and thumbnail() methods to speed up resize when a new argument reducing_gap
sections.title: New Image.reduce() method

sections.content: The default resampling filter has been changed to the high-quality convolution Image.BICUBIC instead of Image.NEAREST, for the resize() method and the pad(), scale() and fit() functions. Image.NEAREST is still always used for images in “P” and “1” modes. See Filters to learn the difference. In short, Image.NEAREST is a very fast filter, but simple and low-quality.
highlights: has been changed to the high-quality convolution Image.BICUBIC instead of Image.NEAREST, for the resize
sections.title: Default resampling filter

sections.content: If the draft() method has no effect, it returns None. If it does have an effect, then it previously returned the image itself. However, unlike other chain methods, draft() does not return a modified version of the image, but modifies it in-place. So instead, if draft() has an effect, Pillow will now return a tuple of the image mode and a co-ordinate box. The box is the original coordinates in the bounds of resulting image. This may be useful in a subsequent resize() call.
highlights: This may be useful in a subsequent resize() call.
sections.title: Image.draft() return value

sections.content: For geometry operations that may map multiple input pixels to a single output pixel, the Python Imaging Library provides different resampling filters. Resampling.NEAREST Pick one nearest pixel from the input image. Ignore all other input pixels. Resampling.BOX Each pixel of the source image contributes to one pixel of the destination image with identical weights. For upscaling, this is equivalent to Resampling.NEAREST. This filter can only be used with the resize() and thumbnail() methods. Added...
highlights: This filter can only be used with the resize() and thumbnail() methods. Added in version 3.4.0.
sections.title: Filters

sections.content: Two new filters are available for resize() and thumbnail(): Image.Resampling.MKS2013 and Image.Resampling.MKS2021. These are versions of the Magic Kernel Sharp filter.
highlights: Two new filters are available for resize() and thumbnail(): Image.Resampling.MKS2013 and Image.Resampling.MKS2021
sections.title: New resizing filters

sections.content: The reducing_gap argument to resize() is now applied to RGBA and LA images. Previously, these modes ignored the argument, including when called by thumbnail(), which uses reducing_gap=2.0 by default.
highlights: The reducing_gap argument to resize() is now applied to RGBA and LA images.
sections.title: Resizing images with alpha

sections.content: The stretch function on the core image object has been removed. This used to be for enlarging the image, but has been aliased to resize recently.
highlights: This used to be for enlarging the image, but has been aliased to resize recently.
sections.title: Image.core.stretch removed

sections.content: The PIL.Image.Image class contains methods to resize() and rotate() an image. The former takes a tuple giving the new size, the latter the angle in degrees counterclockwise.
highlights: The PIL.Image.Image class contains methods to resize() and rotate() an image.
sections.title: Geometrical transforms

sections.content: Pillow reads JPEG, JFIF, and Adobe JPEG files containing L, RGB, or CMYK data. It writes standard and progressive JFIF files. Using the draft() method, you can speed things up by converting RGB images to L, and resize images to 1/2, 1/4 or 1/8 of their original size while loading them. By default Pillow doesn’t allow loading of truncated JPEG files, set ImageFile.LOAD_TRUNCATED_IMAGES to override this.

This is not about removing existing functionality, but instead about raising an explicit error to prevent later consequences. The resize method is the correct way to change an image’s size. post.description:
Screening and prospect lists of French companies: e.g. software publishers (58.29C) or IT consultancies (62.02A) in Île-de-France with 50-249 employees and over EUR 10M revenue, manufacturers whose executive is 60+ (succession targets), ESS structures in a department, or finding a company's SIREN from its name. Chain `results[].siren` into get_company.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

commune_codes.description: INSEE commune codes (5 characters, e.g. 75056 Paris, 2A004 Ajaccio); matches units with an establishment there.

company_categories.description: INSEE company category: PME (SME), ETI (mid-cap), GE (large enterprise).

departments.description: Department codes (01-95, 2A, 2B, 971-976); matches units with an establishment there.

labels.description: Only units carrying all these public labels: ess (social and solidarity economy), sole_proprietorship (entreprise individuelle), association, local_authority (collectivité territoriale), mission_company (société à mission), public_administration, rge (RGE environmental certification), qualiopi (training quality), organic (Agence Bio), training_organization, siae (work-integration structure), finess (health/social facility), living_heritage (Entreprise du Patrimoine Vivant), entertainment_contractor (licence d'entrepreneur de spectacles), responsible_purchasing (RFAR label), alim_confiance (food-safety inspection published), uai (education establishment), egapro (gender pay-equality index published), collective_agreement (collective agreement IDCC on file).

legal_forms.description: INSEE legal categories (catégorie juridique, 4 digits): e.g. 5710 SAS, 5720 SASU, 5499 SARL, 5498 EURL, 5599/5699 SA, 5800 SE, 1000 sole proprietor, 9220 association.

naf_codes.description: Main activity of the legal unit, NAF rév. 2 / APE codes such as 62.01Z (6201Z accepted). Any of them matches.

naf_sections.description: NAF sections of the main activity: A agriculture, B mining, C manufacturing, D energy, E water/waste, F construction, G wholesale/retail trade, H transport, I accommodation/food, J information/communication, K finance/insurance, L real estate, M professional/scientific/technical (incl. head offices 70.10Z), N administrative support, O public administration, P education, Q health/social, R arts/recreation, S other services, T households, U extraterritorial.

net_income_max.description: Maximum net income of the latest published accounts, euros.

net_income_min.description: Minimum net income (résultat net) of the latest published accounts, euros (negative allowed).

page.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` from the previous answer. page * per_page may not exceed 10,000.

person_birth_date_max.description: Latest birth date of an executive or elected official (YYYY-MM). For 'executive aged 60+' in October 2026, pass 1966-10. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(-[0-9]{2})?$.

person_birth_date_min.description: Earliest birth date of an executive or elected official (YYYY-MM; a day is accepted and ignored). For 'executive under 40' in 2026, pass 1986-11. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(-[0-9]{2})?$.

person_first_names.description: First name(s) of an executive or elected official.

person_last_name.description: Last name of an executive (dirigeant) or local elected official.

person_type.description: Restrict the person filters to executives (dirigeants) or local elected officials (élus).

postal_codes.description: Postal codes; matches legal units with at least one establishment there.

q.description: Free text over company names, addresses and executive or elected-official names, or a direct SIREN (9 digits) / SIRET (14 digits) lookup. At least 3 characters unless a filter is also given.

regions.description: INSEE region codes; matches units with an establishment there: 01 Guadeloupe, 02 Martinique, 03 Guyane, 04 La Réunion, 06 Mayotte, 11 Île-de-France, 24 Centre-Val de Loire, 27 Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, 28 Normandie, 32 Hauts-de-France, 44 Grand Est, 52 Pays de la Loire, 53 Bretagne, 75 Nouvelle-Aquitaine, 76 Occitanie, 84 Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, 93 Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, 94 Corse.

revenue_max.description: Maximum revenue of the latest published accounts, euros.

revenue_min.description: Minimum revenue (chiffre d'affaires) of the latest published accounts, euros. Units without published accounts never match.

sort_by_size.description: true: order by company size (number of establishments) instead of relevance.

post.description:
Local market mapping: which companies operate establishments around an address or coordinates, e.g. restaurant companies (56.10A) within 1 km of a site, or groups whose head-office activity (70.10Z) has offices in a business district.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

naf_codes.description: Main activity of the legal unit, NAF rév. 2 / APE codes such as 70.10Z (7010Z accepted); any of them matches. The API applies it to the unit, not to the establishment in the radius (each matching establishment reports its own naf_code).

naf_sections.description: NAF sections of the main activity: A agriculture, B mining, C manufacturing, D energy, E water/waste, F construction, G wholesale/retail trade, H transport, I accommodation/food, J information/communication, K finance/insurance, L real estate, M professional/scientific/technical (incl. head offices 70.10Z), N administrative support, O public administration, P education, Q health/social, R arts/recreation, S other services, T households, U extraterritorial.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` from the previous answer. page * per_page may not exceed 10,000.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km, up to 50.

sort_by_size.description: true: order by company size (number of establishments) instead of relevance.

complaints.description:
Assunto: Atraso no reembolso - Pedido enviado incorretamente e devolvido

Realizei uma compra no dia 28/08 e o produto foi entregue em 08/09. Porém, recebi o item errado e solicitei a devolução imediata.

Acompanhando a devolução, recebi uma mensagem da Magalu confirmando que o produto já havia chegado à loja, informando um prazo de 3 dias úteis para a conferência e liberação do reembolso.

Esse prazo já expirou e até o momento não recebi nenhuma atualização ou confirmação do estorno. O valor retido está me impossibilitando de adquirir outro aparelho. Solicito a regularização imediata e o comprovante do reembolso.
complaints.title: Não recebi meu reembolso após devolução de item errado

complaints.description:
Título: Reembolso não realizado 24 dias após devolução de cafeteira com defeito

No dia 23/08/2026, comprei no Magazine Luiza uma cafeteira Cadence para preparo de dois cafés.

Assim que recebi o produto, fui realizar o primeiro teste e constatei que um dos lados funcionava normalmente, enquanto o outro não funcionava corretamente. Inclusive, o lado que estava funcionando fez com que a xícara enchesse e o café transbordasse.

Diante do problema, solicitei a devolução do produto, o cancelamento da compra e o respectivo reembolso.

A cafeteira foi devolvida no dia 26/08/2026 e, no dia 27/08/2026, consta no sistema que o objeto foi postado nos Correios.

Hoje, 21/09/2026, já se passaram 24 dias desde a devolução, e até o momento não recebi o reembolso.

No próprio site do Magazine Luiza, o andamento da solicitação continua parado da seguinte forma:

Andamento da solicitação
Solicitação de cancelamento recebida 26/08/2026 às 13:36
Objeto postado nos Correios 27/08/2026 às 13:19

Quando já haviam se passado 18 dias sem que o reembolso fosse realizado, entrei em contato com o Magazine Luiza pelo WhatsApp para registrar uma reclamação. Na ocasião, o atendente informou que, no máximo em alguns dias, eu seria reembolsada.

Esse prazo também já terminou e, até agora, não houve reembolso nem uma solução para o problema.

Já devolvi o produto há 24 dias e continuo sem o produto e sem receber de volta o valor pago. Além disso, o próprio sistema da empresa não apresenta nenhuma atualização sobre a conclusão do cancelamento.

Diante disso, solicito o reembolso imediato e integral do valor pago. Não desejo receber uma nova previsão ou promessa de prazo, pois os prazos anteriormente informados já foram ultrapassados. Quero apenas que o reembolso seja efetivamente realizado.
complaints.title: Não recebi o reembolso de 24 dias após devolver cafeteira com defeito

response.cancellation_policy: Cancellations more than 48 hours in advance of arrival date only incur a $10 transaction fee.  Within 48 hours, $10 and the first night's fee are charged (Exception: 1 night reservations do not incur an additional $10 fee, but do not receive a refund).  No-shows will be assessed a $20 service fee along with the loss of the first night's fee.

descriptions.html: For facility specific information, please call (209) 372-8502.
descriptions.title: Contact Info

descriptions.html:
Upper Pines Campground is the largest of the three reservation campgrounds in Yosemite Valley. It offers paved roads and parking spurs, flush toilets, and drinking water. Each campsite contains a picnic table, fire ring, and a food storage locker.
Yosemite's free shuttle bus stops at the campground entrance. Nearby, historic Curry Village offers showers (for a fee), a general store, restaurants and bar, amphitheater and a tour and activities desk.
descriptions.title: Facilities

descriptions.html: Yosemite Valley is forested with a diverse mix of California black oak, Ponderosa pine, incense-cedar, White fir, and Whiteleaf Manzanita, which offers a pleasant combination of sun and shade. Through the trees, Yosemite's telltale granite cliffs peek through, and the gentle, refreshing Merced River flows nearby.
descriptions.title: Natural Features

descriptions.html:
Glacier Point offers sweeping views of Yosemite Valley, Little Yosemite Valley, Half Dome, Vernal and Nevada Falls, and Clouds Rest, among other notable landmarks.

The Tioga Road offers a 39-mile scenic drive past forests, meadows, lakes and granite domes. Beautiful Hetch Hetchy Reservoir is home to spectacular scenery and numerous wilderness trailheads.
descriptions.title: Nearby Attractions

descriptions.html:
Upper Pines campsites are available to reserve up to five months in advance on the 15th of each month at 7:00 a.m. PST. For example, on January 15, arrival dates for the period May 15 to June 14 become available to reserve, and therefore, the full arrival date window would be from January 15 to June 14. 

Reservation Tips! Campsites in Yosemite are extremely popular and typically sell out in minutes. Login to your account or create a new account before the 7:00 a.m. (PST) release time. You may only add reservations to your cart and proceed with your reservation if you are logged into your account. The recreation.gov call center does NOT have access to additional sites or additional information beyond what is published on recreation.gov. 

Upper Pines Campground is located in breathtaking Yosemite National Park in Central California's rugged Sierra Nevada Mountain Range at an elevation of 4,000 feet. The site is situated in the heart of Yosemite Valley, an awe-inspiring landscape containing many of the famous features for which Yosemite National Park is known. Within Yosemite, visitors can gaze upon waterfalls, sheer granite cliffs, deep valleys, grand meadows, ancient giant sequoias, vast wilderness areas and much more. 


Yosemite National Park Campground Reservation Dates 

For additional park information, call (209)372-0200 or visit www.nps.gov/yose
descriptions.title: Overview

descriptions.html:
Yosemite's trails, cliffs, roads and rivers provide endless recreational activities for any kind of visitor. Hiking, biking, rock climbing, fishing, horseback riding, rafting, auto touring, cross-country skiing and photography are all very popular activities within the park.

Hiking trails range from the easy paved, two-mile roundtrip walk to Mirror Lake/Meadow, to the grueling but rewarding 14- to 16-mile trek to Half Dome (permit required). Both of these trails begin near the Pines Campgrounds, and there are many additional trailheads within Yosemite Valley.

Rafting the Merced River is a fun way to cool down on a summer day when water levels are sufficient. Yosemite Valley also offers numerous guided bus tours, educational programs, museums, ranger-led activities and an art center with workshops.
descriptions.title: Recreation

response.directions: Take Highway 41 north from Fresno, Highway 140 east from Merced, or Highway 120 east from Manteca into Yosemite National Park. Follow signs to Yosemite Valley and the campgrounds.
response.fees_note: Base use fees published by Recreation.gov, USD. The per-reservation fee and any taxes are unknown and not included.
response.name: Upper Pines Campground

notices.text: You are responsible for reading the site alerts and booking a site that will accommodate your equipment.
If arriving one or more days late, call (209) 372-8502; your reservation will be cancelled if we do not hear from you within 24 hours of your arrival date.
You must check-in at the campground kiosk upon arrival. After-hours arrivals must sign-in and return to the kiosk to complete check-in the following morning or your reservation may be cancelled.

Bears and other wildlife live here! Food and toiletries must be properly stored 24 hours/day.  

  • Food storage lockers are provided in all campsites (35 inches deep x 43 inches wide x 28 inches high). 

  • Absolutely no food stored in vehicles. 

  • Dispose of garbage immediately in bear-proof dumpsters.
There are no electric, water or sewer hook-ups available at individual campsites. A free dump station is located on-site along with potable water.
Your camping reservation does NOT get you into Yosemite for free. You must pay an additional fee per vehicle at the park entrance or buy a pass ahead of time on recreation.gov.

Road conditions can change at any time; before arrival, please call (209) 372-0200 for road and weather conditions inside Yosemite, and 1-800-427-ROAD for conditions outside the park. For additional park information, call (209) 372-0200 or visit www.nps.gov/yose

Don't Move Firewood: Help protect our forests! Prevent the spread of tree-killing pests by obtaining firewood at or near your destination and burning it on-site. Moving firewood is illegal in some states. Visit dontmovefirewood.org to learn more.

Help Yosemite be a Zero Landfill park! Leave excess packaging at home. Use refillable propane bottles, water bottles, food containers and travel mugs. Place all of your recyclable waste in designated recycling containers. For more information go to: https://www.nps.gov/yose/getinvolved/zlf.htm
Resale or auction of advance reservations is prohibited.

post.description:
Start here to find a campground_id / permit_id / rec area id by name or place; then call `campground`, `campsites`, `campground_availability` or `permit_availability`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

parent_id.description: Restrict to children of this rec area id (e.g. 2991 Yosemite National Park). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

query.description: Free text: a park, forest, campground, or place name.

radius_miles.description: Search radius around the centre, miles (default 50 when coordinates are given).

sort.description: `available` puts entities with availability for the dates first (the site's default with dates); `score` is relevance.

start.description: Offset of the first result; use `next_start` from the previous page.

start_date.description: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD (facility local calendar date). With `end_date` the index reports availability for that stay. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

state.description: US state name as Recreation.gov spells it, e.g. `Utah`, `California`.

results.description:
Tucked away among the pines is the hidden gem of Yosemite Creek campground. Accessing this campground is an adventure down a rutted, 5-mile, single-lane dirt road.  Motorhomes and trailers are NOT allowed.Yosemite Creek campground is a primitive campground with vault toilets and  no drinking water . A seasonal creek runs through the campground but    water must be boiled and/or treated    before drinking. Do not rely on creek water being available;  bring water!  
Granite boulders abound and the peaceful Yosemite Creek meanders through the campground on its way to Yosemite Valley. Bring your comfy chairs and hammocks and let the sounds of nature whisk you away from the busyness of day-to-day life. 
Head to Tuolumne Meadows for breathtaking views and a multitude of day hiking opportunities. Tenaya Lake is a great place to relax and swim or canoe. Yosemite Valley offers restaurants, museums, bike paths, day hikes and world-famous climbing. Don't forget about the Pioneer History center in Wawona, and of course, the Mariposa Grove of giant sequoias. Be prepared to make your own fun here-take delight in the quiet and give your screens a rest.  
Your adventure awaits! Hiking, swimming, bouldering, napping (some of us are tired!), bird watching; the possibilities are as great as your imagination. Be sure to bring bug spray and sunscreen, plenty of water, and dress in layers as the weather can rapidly change at this elevation.
results.name: Yosemite Creek Campground

results.description:
Staying at Porcupine Flat Campground requires reservations. No first come, first serve sites are available.   The campground typically opens in late-June and closes mid-October. The opening date varies depending on the opening of the Tioga Road and related seasonal facility and road work.  Porcupine Flat Campground is located off the Tioga Road about 30 minutes west of Tuolumne Meadows and over an hour from Yosemite Valley. RVs and Trailers are not recommended for the narrow roads in this more primitive campground. At an elevation of 8,100 feet (2,500 m) elevation, the campground is near Porcupine Creek, which is the only water source (must be filtered, treated, or boiled). The Porcupine Creek Trailhead is nearby. There are no visitor services close to the campground.  For additional park information, call (209)372-0200 or visit www.nps.gov/yose Yosemite National Park covers nearly 1,200 square miles (3,100 square km) in the Sierra Nevada, with elevations ranging from about 2,000 feet (600 m) to 13,000 ft (4,000 m). Yosemite receives 95% of its precipitation between October and May (and over 75% between November and March). Most of Yosemite is blanketed in snow from about November through May. (The Valley can be rainy or snowy in any given winter storm.)  

 Porcupine Flat is situated along a seasonal creek which is it's only source of water. Creek water must be treated and/or boiled before consuming.  
Just 25 miles away is Yosemite Valley, an awe-inspiring landscape containing many of the famous features for which Yosemite National Park is known. Hiking trails and bike paths are abundant in the valley. Rafting the Merced River is a fun way to cool down on a summer day when water levels are sufficient. Yosemite Valley also offers numerous guided bus tours, educational programs, museums, ranger-led activities, and an art center with workshops. 
 The Tioga Road offers a 39-mile scenic drive past forests, meadows, lakes and granite domes. Tuolumne Meadows embodies the high-country of the Sierra Nevada, with its broad sub-alpine meadows and granite peaks. Several trailheads line the road offering hikes to beautiful, secluded areas that can only be accessed and enjoyed by foot. 
 Beautiful Hetch Hetchy Reservoir, just 23 miles from Crane Flat, is home to spectacular scenery and numerous wilderness trailheads. 
Yosemite's trails, cliffs, roads and rivers provide endless recreational activities for any kind of visitor. Hiking, biking, rock climbing, fishing, horseback riding, rafting, auto touring, and photography are all very popular activities within the park. The White Wolf area has hiking and backpacking opportunities that begin near the campground, such as Lukens Lake, Harden Lake and the Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne. Tuolumne Meadows and all it's High Sierra wonder lie 25 miles to the east, where many beautiful day and overnight excursions await.

project_num.description: Full project number, e.g. 5P01CA244114-05. Returns the parent record (not a subproject); when several fiscal-year records share the number, the latest one with a warning. Pattern: ^\s*[A-Za-z0-9-]+\s*$.

url.description: A RePORTER project page, e.g. https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/11171443.

response.abstract:
Abstract (Overall):
Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a deadly disease whose mechanisms of development remain
incompletely understood. Evidence suggests that pancreatic cancers may arise from acinar cells undergoing a
process called acinar to ductal metaplasia (ADM) or from ductal cells to give rise to Pancreatic Intraepithelial
Neoplasias (PanINs). How mutations or combinations of mutations promote PDAC development and the role of
inflammation in the process still remains unclear. Moreover, interactions between immune cells, cancer-
associated fibroblasts (CAFs) and cancer cells can promote PDAC development and progression, but much
remains to be learned about how signaling between cells in the tumor microenvironment (TME) affects the stem
cell compartment (`stemness') thought to underlie PDAC development and promotes immune evasion. Thus,
multiple questions about fundamental mechanisms governing PDAC development persist.
To address these challenges, our superb and highly interactive team will identify genetic and stromal (immune
cells and CAFs) interactions and pathways that regulate the inception and progression of PDAC using innovative
mouse models and human tissue-based approaches. We propose three Projects to address the following overall
aims:
1. Identify the originating cell(s) and deconstruct genetic pathways underlying PDAC initiation
2. Discover immune signals that cross-talk with epithelial cells and CAFs to promote pancreas cancer
development and stemness
3. Investigate the impact of tumor genetics on PDAC immunobiology and response to macrophage-targeted
immunotherapy
Effort on these projects will be organized through an Administrative and Biostatistics Core (A) and empowered
by two Research Cores, focused on human tissue procurement (Core B), and use of high-dimensional imaging
to measure cell and signaling interactions in tissues (CODEX; Core C).
The participating investigators on this P01 lead teams that have collaborated productively for years and have
generated compelling preliminary data that support the potential for unraveling the genetic and immune signaling
mechanisms underlying PDAC development, and developing new immunotherapeutic strategies for PDAC,
which has proven frustratingly resistant to immuno-based therapies.
Our studies should broadly impact pancreas cancer biology and importantly, elucidate the reciprocal interactions
between immune and non-immune compartments (epithelial, CAFs) in shaping the tumor microenvironment
during disease evolution. accelerate discovery of novel diagnostic or preventive strategies for early-stage
disease, or therapeutics for advanced PDAC.
response.public_health_relevance:
Project Narrative (Overall):
This P01 application from investigators at Stanford University seeks to discover, apply, and translate science
about pancreatic cancer (PDAC), with the ultimate goal of improving care for patients with this disease. To
address fundamental, persistent questions about the biology of PDAC, we have assembled a superb,
interactive team of productive collaborators to lead our Projects and Research Cores that will identify genetic,
immune cell, and cancer-associated fibroblasts based interactions and pathways that regulate the inception
and progression of PDAC. Advances from studies proposed here could broadly impact pancreas cancer
biology and drive translational efforts in PDAC.
response.title: Pancreatic Cancer Development: Genetic and Immune Regulation

org_name.description: Funded organization name; RePORTER matches it as a prefix/wildcard ("Stanford" also matches "Stanford Research Institute") unless org_name_exact is true.

org_name_exact.description: Match org_name exactly as RePORTER spells it, e.g. "STANFORD UNIVERSITY". Requires org_name.

org_states.description: Organization state or territory codes, e.g. ["CA", "MA"].

pi_name.description: Principal investigator name, partial match on any name part, e.g. "Seung K Kim" or "Attardi".

pi_profile_id.description: RePORTER PI profile id from a previous result: every project of exactly that investigator.

sort.description: sort

sort_order.description: Applies to every sort except relevance.

text.description: Words searched in project titles, abstracts and RCDC terms. All words must match by default; wrap a phrase in double quotes for an exact match.

text_fields.description: Limit the text search to these fields (default all three). Requires text.

text_operator.description: How text words combine: and (all words), or (any word), advanced (RePORTER boolean syntax). Requires text.

post.description:
Pull a complete publication county by county: every county's tax base and tax distribution, every county's class-by-class summary for two tax years, or every county's quarterly oil and gas collections, distributions and fund split.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page. Carries the publication; the edition inputs may be repeated but are not needed.

limit.description: Records per page. Default 10. County summary records are large (about 90 rows each); use a small limit.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

post.description:
Check whether a publication changed (compare `sha256` or `etag`), see which tax years, bienniums or quarters are available, or get the statewide totals cheaply before paging through counties.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。

edition.description: `county_summaries` only: the biennium as `YYYY-YYYY` (`2022-2024` is the report for July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2024). Retired editions are looked up in the document archive catalog. Default: the edition on the biennial reports page.

fiscal_year.description: `oil_gas_distribution` only, with `quarter`: the state fiscal year of the `{fy}-Q{q}-County-Distribution.pdf` file. Default: the newest quarter listed.

quarter.description: `oil_gas_distribution` only, with `fiscal_year`: the fiscal quarter (Q1 ends September 30, Q2 December 31, Q3 March 31, Q4 June 30; the report prints the quarter ending date it covers).

report.description: `tax_base`: County and Statewide Tax Base and Tax Distribution (annual, by tax year). `county_summaries`: Biennial Report Appendix, County Summaries (by biennium edition such as `2022-2024`). `oil_gas_distribution`: Oil and Gas County Distribution (by fiscal year and quarter).

tax_year.description: `tax_base` only: the tax year in the index page URL (`/property/{year}-County-and-Statewide-Tax-Base-and-Tax-Distribution-Information`). Default: the newest year in the site map.

post.description:
Turn a partial or ambiguous place name into a location string before `search_sitters`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country to bias predictions; US is the market this program serves. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

query.description: Partial place text, e.g. `Seatt` or `Brooklyn`.

suggestions.description: Seattle Ferry Terminal, Seattle, WA, USA

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

x-codeSamples.label: Reference example

post.description:
Owners whose validity started or ended since a date, or partners deregistered since a date. Rows edited in place without a date change are not detectable; diff records_list snapshots for those.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (the upstream `$skiptoken` Id). Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

include_birth_date.description: Also return the full `birth_date` (personal data). Off by default: only `birth_month_year` is returned.

since.description: Inclusive start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

post.description:
Detail for one partner found by records_list, records_changes or search, or for a known Slovak ICO.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

ico.description: Slovak company registration number (ICO); spaces are ignored. Pattern: ^[0-9 ]{6,12}$.

include_birth_date.description: Also return the full `birth_date` (personal data). Off by default: only `birth_month_year` is returned.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

x-aisa-response-pending.reason: public success response has no authoritative payload declaration

post.description:
Start here to find products by name or brand, to list a category, or to enumerate the catalogue page by page; then call get_product with a returned upc for the record with its related items.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category_id.description: Category public id (uuid) as returned by list_categories (`id`) or seen in the site's `/products?category=` links. Includes the category's descendants. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$.

page.description: 1-based page of 42 products; pass the returned next_cursor to continue.

query.description: Free-text search (product description or brand, e.g. `advil`). Empty or omitted lists the catalogue.

sort.description: Sort order; the site's own values.

special_offers_only.description: Only products in the site's 'On Sale' view (`/products?special=true`); their `price_override` carries the sale price.

wholesale_prices.description: Return wholesale unit prices instead of retail ones, as the public 'Wholesale Prices' toggle on the site does (no login involved).

response.consumer_contact: Peony Design by email at peonydesigncoshoppe@gmail.com for more information.
response.description: This recall involves Peony Design personalized handmade baby bibs and stroller bags. The bibs have scalloped edges, a snap closure, and personalized embroidery on the front. The bibs were sold in fabric designs of geese, strawberries, heart tulip, plaid checks, and floral print. The stroller bags were made in coordinating fabrics including heart tulip, plaid check, floral print, and Winnie the Pooh. Each stroller bag has two straps with snaps at the ends for attachment and is personalized with embroidery and a ruffle around the top edge.
hazards: The snap can detach from the recalled bibs and stroller bags, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a choking hazard to young children.

images.caption: Recalled bib with plaid check print
Recalled bib with heart tulip print
Recalled Winnie the Pooh stroller bag

injuries: The firm received three reported incidents of a broken snap on a bib and a broken snap on two stroller bags. No injuries have been reported.
manufacturers: Peony Design Co., of Howell, MI

products.name: Personalized Baby Bibs and Stroller Bags

remedies: Consumers should take the recalled baby bibs and stroller bags away from children immediately, stop using them, and contact Peony Design to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to discard the recalled baby bibs and stroller bags.
retailers: Online at Etsy.com from October 2025 through July 2026 for between $15 and $45.

post.description:
Fetch one SAM.gov contract opportunity by its 32-character notice id (the id in https://sam.gov/opp/{id}/view): full description, deadlines, NAICS, set-aside, place of performance, points of contact, award data, attachments (titles and download URLs only) and optionally the amendment history.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

fresh.description: Always true in practice: every call goes to SAM.gov live with a cache-busting parameter; the workflow keeps no cache.

include_attachments.description: List attachments (title, download URL, size, type). Contents are never fetched.

include_history.description: Include the version history (original notice and every amendment) as record.history.

opportunity_id.description: SAM.gov notice id. Each published version (original or amendment) has its own id; is_latest/latest_opportunity_id in the record point at the current version. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$.

Combined Synopsis/Solicitation

AFLCMC/PZI Installation Contracting Support

Wright Patterson AFB, OH 45433

Date: 2 SEP 2026

Title: AFIT HVAC CLEANING

Request for Quote (RFQ) / Solicitation Number: FA8601-26-Q-0141

Quotes Due: 15 SEP 2026 at 12:00 PM EST

Contact Point(s): TSgt Adam Holden, Contract Specialist; contact@example.gov

Contact Point(s): Jessica Stamper, Contracting Officer; contact@example.gov

Description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with RFO Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued.

Solicitation number FA8601-26-Q-0141 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for AFIT HVAC CLEANING at Wright Patterson Air Force Base as described under the requirements section of this combined synopsis/solicitation and accompanying requirements attachment.

This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns under NAICS code 561790 – Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings with a small business size of $9.0M. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov.

The Government reserves the right to conduct interchanges with some, none, or all offerors, or make no award at all depending upon: An award, if any, will be made LPTA. Ie, to the lowest priced Offeror who submits a proposal that:

Conforms to the requirements of the combined synopsis/solicitation.

Receives a rating of “Acceptable” on the Technical Capability evaluation factor.

Contains the lowest evaluated price (TEP), provided that the TEP is not unbalanced and is fair and reasonable.

***NOTE: The Government is recommending that all bidding vendors attend a site visit for Wednesday September 9, 2026 10:00EST at the following address:

4185 Logistics Ave,

Bldg 286 Area A,

Wright Patterson Air Force Base

To obtain access to the installation vendors will need to acquire a visitor’s pass. Attendees must register in advance by emailing Joel Wilson at contact@example.gov and Mark Rauch at contact@example.gov, no later than 10:00AM. EST on Tuesday Sep 8, 2026, with the following information:

​​​​

Visitor’s full name and cell phone number

Preferred email address

Driver’s license number and state of issuance

The vendor will be required to pick-up their visitor’s pass at Pass and Registration located in Area A, Bldg 286, 4185 Logistics Ave, Dayton, OH 45433. Once base access has been granted, please wait in the lobby for Joel Wilson to escort you to the site visit location.

The Government also reserves the right to cancel this solicitation, either before or after the closing date.

1. Requirement:

This requirement is for AFIT HVAC CLEANING at Wright Patterson Air Force Base in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS).

2. Period of Performance:

No later than 90 Days after contract award. This is inclusive of in person post award site visit, material finish selection, furniture lead time and installation.

3. Provisions and Clauses:

See solicitation attachment for applicable provisions and clauses that apply to this acquisition. post.description:
Search SAM.gov contract opportunities by keyword, agency, notice status, publication date, NAICS, set-aside, notice type and response deadline. Returns one page (default 20, max 100) with an opaque cursor for the next page. By default each hit is enriched with its full notice detail (NAICS, set-aside, place of performance, full description).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

agency_ids.description: SAM.gov federal organization ids at any hierarchy level (100000000 = Dept of Defense, 300000188 = Dept of the Navy, 100006688 = Dept of Veterans Affairs). Matched as OR.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Bound to the same filters and page_size; valid for 24 hours; then cursor_expired.

include_attachments.description: Also list each notice's attachments (one more upstream request per record). Requires include_details and page_size <= 50.

include_details.description: Fetch each hit's notice detail (one extra upstream request per record) so naics_codes, set_aside, place_of_performance and the full description are populated. false returns summary records with detail_level=summary.

naics_codes.description: NAICS codes or prefixes (2 to 6 digits). Matched as OR.

notice_types.description: Notice types (SAM.gov codes p,o,k,a,r,s,i,g,u,f,l). Empty = all.

page_size.description: Records per page. At most 50 when include_attachments is true.

published_from.description: Inclusive lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern calendar day) on the notice's latest publication/modification date. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

published_to.description: Inclusive upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD). Must not be before published_from. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

query.description: Keyword query matched against title, solicitation number and description. Multi-word queries combine per query_mode (default: every word must match). Empty matches everything.

query_mode.description: How the words of query must match, as SAM.gov's own keyword search offers them (upstream qMode): all = every word (SAM.gov's default), any = at least one word, exact = the phrase as written.

response_deadline_from.description: Inclusive lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD) on the response deadline.

response_deadline_to.description: Inclusive upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD) on the response deadline.

set_asides.description: SAM.gov set-aside codes (SBA = total small business, 8A, HZC = HUBZone, SDVOSBC, WOSB, EDWOSB, ...). Matched as OR.

sort.description: sort

statuses.description: Notice status as SAM.gov indexes it. active = accepting responses / not yet archived; inactive = archived. Both = no status filter.

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

Get OECD numbers for a country and period: G20 or national quarterly exports/imports (DF_IMTS, DF_BOP), tax revenue as % of GDP (DF_RSOECD), social spending (DF_SOCX_AGG), household saving or sector accounts (DF_QSA). Call structure_get first when unsure of codes.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; pins the dataflow version and segment hash.

filters.description: Codes per dimension id, e.g. {"REF_AREA": "USA", "FREQ": "Q", "TRADE_FLOW": ["X", "M"]}. Countries go in REF_AREA as ISO3 codes; dimensions left out are wildcards. structure_get lists the dimension ids and the codes with data. Use instead of `key`.

key.description: Raw SDMX series key in dimension order (see structure_get); empty position = wildcard, `+` joins codes. Prefer `filters`, which cannot get the positions wrong. Pattern: ^(all|[A-Za-z0-9_@+.-]*)$.

post.description:
Before or between records_list pulls: compare `version` and `obs_count` (or `content_hash`) with the last pull to know whether the segment changed.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

filters.description: Codes per dimension id, e.g. {"REF_AREA": "USA", "FREQ": "Q", "TRADE_FLOW": ["X", "M"]}. Countries go in REF_AREA as ISO3 codes; dimensions left out are wildcards. structure_get lists the dimension ids and the codes with data. Use instead of `key`.

include_hash.description: Download the CSV segment and return its canonical SHA-256 and size. Costs one data download; the segment must be under 50,000 observations.

key.description: Raw SDMX series key in dimension order (see structure_get); empty position = wildcard, `+` joins codes. Prefer `filters`, which cannot get the positions wrong. Pattern: ^(all|[A-Za-z0-9_@+.-]*)$.

end_date.description: Latest local event date, YYYY-MM-DD inclusive (datetime_local.lte). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

event_ids.description: Explicit event ids to look up in bulk (1-50).

latitude.description: Centre of a radius search; requires longitude.

page.description: 1-based page; use next_page from the previous call.

per_page.description: Results per page; the API caps at 100.

range_miles.description: Radius in miles around latitude/longitude (default 30 when a centre is given).

taxonomy.description: Taxonomy name as the API uses it, e.g. concert, mlb, theater, comedy (taxonomies.name). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9_]+$.

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's meta.page.next_cursor. It pins the publication; when the source has moved on the call fails with invalid_input at /continuation (issue code publication_changed) instead of mixing versions.

join.description: Which rows are joined with the filer's submissions JSON for items and the primary document: 8-K (default: 8-K and 8-K/A), all, or none.

page_size.description: Filings per page (default 50). Each joined filer costs one submissions request.

since.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

until.description: Last day, inclusive. Default: since. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

response.removals_note: Additions only: the daily index never lists deletions or corrections; those appear in the weekly full-index rebuild, which the downstream must diff.

post.description:
Form 13F-HR holdings of an institutional investment manager: every position from the XML information table (issuer, class, CUSIP, value, shares or principal, put/call, discretion, voting authority). Defaults to the latest 13F-HR; pick a quarter with report_date or a filing with accession_number. Values are whole USD for filings since 2023-01-03 and thousands before.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros.

name.description: Filer name; the best EDGAR typeahead match is used.

offset.description: offset

ticker.description: Exchange ticker as EDGAR lists it (BRK-B or BRK.B both work). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9.\-]{1,12}$.

NEW YORK TIMES CO MTN BE

To read one filing's complete structured content, footnotes included, after insider_transactions_list.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

accession_number.description: EDGAR accession number with dashes (0001213900-26-105429). Pattern: ^[0-9]{10}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{6}$.

quarter.description: Quarter of the filing date (2026q3). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}[qQ][1-4]$.

FOOTNOTES.FOOTNOTE_TXT: Represents shares of common stock sold pursuant to a 10b5-1 plan adopted by the reporting person on August 27, 2026.

This transaction was executed in multiple trades at prices ranging from $1.00 to $1.54. The price reported above reflects the weighted average sale price. The reporting person hereby undertakes to provide upon request to the SEC staff, the issuer or a security holder of the issuer full information regarding the number of shares and prices at which the transaction was effected.

The reporting owner in whose name the securities reported herein are held, is managed by its general manager, Nadir Ali. Mr. Ali owns 1% of the outstanding equity interests of Grafiti Group LLC and Mr. Ali is trustee for the Ali Family Charitable Trust, which owns 99% of the equity interests of Grafiti Group LLC. As such, Mr. Ali holds voting and investment discretion with respect to the shares of common stock beneficially owned by the reporting person. Mr. Ali may be deemed a beneficial owner of the shares of common stock held by Grafiti Group LLC.

OWNER_SIGNATURE.OWNERSIGNATURENAME: /s/ Grafiti Group LLC By: Nadir Ali, as General Manager

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's meta.page.next_cursor. It pins the publication; when the source has moved on the call fails with invalid_input at /continuation (issue code publication_changed) instead of mixing versions.

forms.description: Subset of the eight Schedule 13D/13G form types as the index spells them. Default: all eight. SCHEDULE 13D|13G[/A] (since 2024-12-18) are structured XML; SC 13D|13G[/A] are legacy free text, returned as index metadata only.

since.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

until.description: Last day, inclusive. Default: since. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

post.description:
Primary-source deal terms across companies: licensing, collaboration, merger and acquisition agreements as filed, with upfront, milestone, royalty and per-share values. Search forms ["8-K"] for a quoted phrase such as "license agreement" or "merger agreement" over a from/to date range, keep hits whose items include 1.01 (material definitive agreement) or 2.01 (completed acquisition), and pass snippets to get the sentences that state the terms; an EX-99.1 hit is usually the company's press release. sic_codes 2834 and 2836 mark pharmaceutical and biotech filers. Also any other cross-company full-text question, such as 8-K Item 2.02 filings this quarter.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros.

from.description: Earliest filing date. Alone, the range runs to today. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

page.description: page

query.description: Full-text query; wrap phrases in double quotes.

snippets.description: Fetch the matched document of the first hits and return the sentences containing the query. Needs `query`. Off when omitted; the search output is then unchanged.

to.description: Latest filing date. Alone, the range starts on 2001-01-01, the first day full-text search covers. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

sections.canonical_title: Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk
sections.text:
The Company is exposed to economic risk from interest rates and foreign exchange rates. The Company uses various strategies to manage these risks; however, they may still impact the Company’s consolidated financial statements.
Interest Rate Risk
The Company is primarily exposed to fluctuations in U.S. interest rates and their impact on the Company’s investment portfolio and term debt. Increases in interest rates will negatively affect the fair value of the Company’s investment portfolio and increase the interest expense on the Company’s term debt. To protect against interest rate risk, the Company may use derivative instruments, offset interest rate–sensitive assets and liabilities, or control duration of the investment and term debt portfolios.

items.descricao_produto:
Apresenta os valores correntes e os índices de volume (1995=100) trimestralmente para o Produto Interno Bruto a preços de mercado, impostos sobre produtos, valor adicionado a preços básicos, consumo pessoal, consumo do governo, formação bruta de capital fixo, variação de estoques, exportações e importações de bens e serviços. São calculadas duas séries de números-índices: a com base no ano anterior e a encadeada com referência em 2010 (1995 = 100). A série encadeada é ajustada sazonalmente pelo X13-ARIMA possibilitando o cálculo das taxas de variação em relação ao trimestre imediatamente anterior.

No IBGE, a pesquisa foi iniciada em 1988 e reestruturada a partir de 1998, quando os seus resultados foram integrados ao Sistema de Contas Nacionais, de periodicidade anual.

Em 2015, continuando a compatibilidade com o Sistema Anual, as Contas Nacionais Trimestrais também foram reformuladas, adotando o Manual Internacional SNA 2008, passando para a referência 2010.

As ponderações anuais são obtidas a partir deste novo sistema de contas.

Periodicidade: Trimestral

Abrangência geográfica: Brasil

Destina-se a produzir informações contínuas sobre a inserção da população no mercado de trabalho associada a características demográficas e de educação, e, também, para o estudo do desenvolvimento socioeconômico do País, agregando a produção de resultados anuais sobre temas permanentes da pesquisa (como trabalho infantil e outras formas de trabalho, migração, fecundidade etc.) e outros aspectos relevantes selecionados de acordo com as necessidades de informação.

A pesquisa é realizada por meio de uma amostra de domicílios, extraída de uma amostra mestra, de forma a garantir a representatividade dos resultados para os diversos níveis geográficos definidos para sua divulgação. A cada trimestre, são investigados 211.344 domicílios particulares permanentes, em aproximadamente 16.000 setores censitários, distribuídos em cerca de 3.500 municípios.

Periodicidade: Mensal, para um conjunto restrito de indicadores relacionados à força de trabalho e somente para o nível geográfico de Brasil; trimestral, para indicadores relacionados à força de trabalho; anual, para os demais temas permanentes da pesquisa e indicadores complementares relacionados à força de trabalho; e variável, para outros temas ou tópicos dos temas permanentes a serem pesquisados com maior periodicidade ou ocasionalmente.

Abrangência geográfica: Brasil, Grandes Regiões, Unidades da Federação, 20 Regiões Metropolitanas que contêm Municípios das Capitais (Manaus, Belém, Macapá, São Luís, Fortaleza, Natal, João Pessoa, Recife, Maceió, Aracaju, Salvador, Belo Horizonte, Vitória, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Curitiba, Florianópolis, Porto Alegre, Vale do Rio Cuiabá, e Goiânia), Municípios das Capitais e Região Integrada de Desenvolvimento da Grande Teresina.

items.descricao_produto:
A Pesquisa Mensal de Comércio produz indicadores que permitem acompanhar o comportamento conjuntural do comércio varejista no País, investigando a receita bruta de revenda nas empresas formalmente constituídas, com 20 ou mais pessoas ocupadas, e cuja atividade principal é o comércio varejista. A pesquisa foi iniciada em janeiro de 1995, apenas na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro, produzindo indicadores de faturamento real e nominal, pessoal ocupado e salários e outras remunerações.

A partir de 1997, a pesquisa foi expandida para as Regiões Metropolitanas de Recife e Salvador. A versão da pesquisa com abrangência nacional teve início no ano 2000, produzindo indicadores de volume e de receita nominal, desagregados em cinco grupos de atividades, para o Brasil e os Estados do Ceará, Pernambuco, Bahia, Minas Gerais, Espírito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Goiás e Distrito Federal. Para as demais Unidades da Federação, são divulgados indicadores para o comércio varejista, sem desagregação.

A partir de janeiro de 2004, iniciou-se a série da pesquisa, com base 2003=100. O segmento "Demais artigos de uso pessoal e doméstico" foi desagregado, iniciando a série de indicadores para os segmentos de "Artigos farmacêuticos, médicos, ortopédicos, de perfumaria e cosméticos", "Equipamentos e materiais para escritório, informática e comunicação", "Livros, jornais, revistas e papelaria" e "Outros artigos de uso pessoal e doméstico". A série 2003=100 expande a abrangência dos indicadores incluindo o comércio de material de construção e dá inicio à série de índices do Comércio Varejista Ampliado, que agrega, aos índices do varejo, as atividades "Veículos, motocicletas, partes e peças" e "Material de construção", que incluem o ramo atacadista.

A partir de 2005, iniciou-se o cálculo dos indicadores de receita nominal e de volume de vendas ajustados sazonalmente.

Em 2012, de janeiro em diante, iniciou-se nova série da pesquisa, com base 2011=100.

A partir de janeiro de 2017, iniciou-se uma nova série com ano-base em 2014.

items.historico: Maior país da América do Sul, com vasta área de litoral banhada pelo oceano Atlântico. Tem fronteiras com Venezuela, Guiana, Suriname, Guiana Francesa, Colômbia, Peru, Bolívia, Paraguai, Argentina e Uruguai. O topônimo “Brasil” tem sua origem muito discutida, embora boa parte das explicações se refiram ao pau-brasil daqui extraído. Para alguns filólogos, vem do tupi ibira-ciri, “pau eriçado”. Os europeus, ao ouvirem este nome dado pelos indígenas à madeira de coloração avermelhada, chamaram-na de “brasil”. As extensas porções de terras que hoje constituem o país foram habitadas por tribos que pertenciam ao tronco tupi-guarani, caribe e arawak. Para todos os efeitos, a frota chefiada pelo fidalgo português Pedro Álvares de Gouveia (ele só adquiriria o sobrenome Cabral com o falecimento de seu irmão primogênito, João Fernandes, em 1515) foi oficialmente a primeira a chegar às terras que hoje fazem parte do Brasil. Sabe-se, no entanto, que outros europeus aqui aportaram antes de Pedro Álvares, mas não puderam tomar posse, nem sequer anunciar que haviam encontrado o local, por conta do Tratado de Tordesilhas. A colonização do país se inicia com Martim Afonso de Souza em 1532. Antes disso, as novas terras só serviam à Coroa portuguesa como entreposto na linha comercial Lisboa-Índia e para extração de pau-brasil. Em 1540, Portugal resolve terceirizar a colonização do Brasil, repartindo as terras em capitanias hereditárias a serem entregues a fidalgos que deveriam explorá-las e fazê-las se desenvolver. O modelo não alcança os resultados necessários, mesmo com a presença de representantes da Coroa, os governadores-gerais. Das capitanias, somente São Vicente e Pernambuco conseguem bons resultados econômicos, especialmente a segunda, que desenvolve latifúndios de cana-de-açúcar produtivos.A França e, posteriormente, a Holanda resolvem tirar um quinhão das novas terras descobertas ao sul do Equador. Franceses tentam estabelecer colonização no Rio de Janeiro e no Maranhão. Holandeses tentam incursões na Bahia e em Pernambuco, onde conseguem se assentar por algum tempo. Os portugueses conseguem expulsar os estrangeiros invasores, retomando as possessões que estavam sob o seu domínio. Ao longo dos séculos XVII e XVIII, expedições chamadas Entradas e Bandeiras vão expandindo as terras da Colônia para oeste, conquistando espaços que estavam na parte espanhola do Tratado de Tordesilhas.Foi estabelecido um fluxo de mão de obra escrava inicialmente indígena e, posteriormente, negra africana para as plantações brasileiras e para a procura e extração de metais preciosos. No século XVIII, já havia um razoável núcleo urbano em várias regiões do Brasil, a ponto de fazer germinar ideias separatistas, como ocorreu em Vila Rica, com a Conjuração Mineira, prontamente rechaçada pelo governo português. No início do século XIX, um fato seria determinante para o futuro da colônia. Napoleão invade Portugal, no seu esforço de estrangular comercialmente a Inglaterra e isso acarreta na fuga da família real portuguesa, incluindo a rainha Maria I, e seu filho, o príncipe regente D. João, que governava Portugal desde 1792, por conta dos problemas psíquicos de sua mãe. Eles chegam a Salvador, em 1807, e de lá seguem para a capital da colônia, o Rio de Janeiro, onde se estabelecem a partir de 1808. Aqui, D. João abre os portos brasileiros às nações amigas, eleva o Brasil à condição de Reino Unido e cria uma infraestrutura básica na colônia. Com isso, o porto do Rio de Janeiro, que era o mais importante do país, se expande, dinamizando a economia, atraindo mais pessoas para a Corte. No Brasil, D. Maria I, dita a Louca, morre em 1816, e D. João é aclamado como novo rei de Portugal e do Brasil, embora tendo que retornar a Lisboa em 1821. As cortes portuguesas querem fazer o Brasil voltar à condição de colônia, com monopólio comercial, o que não interessava mais aos brasileiros. Em 1822, Portugal pressiona o príncipe regente D. Pedro e ele, insuflado por José Bonifácio, pela princesa Leopoldina e por outras pessoas de influência na Corte, resolve declarar o Brasil independente de Portugal. Isso se deu em 7 de setembro de 1822, na província de São Paulo, às margens do riacho Ipiranga. O Brasil independente se transforma em um império, com D. Pedro I assumindo a chefia do governo. A primeira constituição foi outorgada em 1824, e a fase do Primeiro Reinado transcorre em meio a muitas crises políticas. Em 1831, o imperador Pedro I abdica em prol de seu filho e segue para Portugal. A década de 1830 foi das mais agitadas na vida política brasileira. O país passa a ser governado por regentes provisórios, até que o infante D. Pedro adquira idade para assumir o trono. Em 1840, antecipam a maioridade do príncipe e ele assume como imperador. Por quase cinquenta anos ele governaria o país, consolidaria a unidade nacional brasileira e, mesmo enfrentando crises políticas e revoltas civis nas províncias, manteria o país coeso e com um produto agrícola de forte penetração internacional: o café. A lavoura cafeeira, ao tempo do Império, era totalmente assentada na mão de obra escrava negra. Enormes latifúndios cafeeiros davam sustentação econômica ao país. Em 1865, o Brasil, unido à Argentina e ao Uruguai, declara guerra ao Paraguai e é vencedor do conflito em 1870. A partir dessa década, começam a surgir as primeiras leis que levariam à abolição da escravatura: em 1871, com a Lei do Ventre Livre, que libertava todos os filhos de escravos; em 1885, com a Lei Saraiva-Cotegipe, ou dos Sexagenários, que libertava escravos com mais de 60 anos; e finalmente, com a definitiva Lei Áurea, de 13 de maio de 1888, que extinguia a escravidão no país. No ano seguinte, a monarquia chegava ao fim, com o golpe militar que proclamou a República. Começou o ciclo de presidentes, a partir do proclamador Deodoro da Fonseca. Esse período, que passaria à História como a Velha República, se caracterizou por várias crises políticas. Somente um presidente, Campos Sales, não decretou estado de sítio em seu governo. Em 1930, uma revolta chefiada por Getúlio Vargas toma o poder e mantém o seu líder por 15 anos na chefia do governo. Após a Segunda Guerra, ventos liberalizantes chegam ao Brasil e destituem Vargas. Dutra é eleito, mas Getúlio retorna pelas urnas à presidência e de lá só sai morto, após suicidar-se em meio a uma grave crise política, em agosto de 1954. Dez anos depois, ocorre uma nova crise, culminando com o golpe militar em 1º de abril de 1964, que mergulhou o Brasil em um período de ditadura até 1985. Com a redemocratização, uma nova Constituição foi votada pelo Congresso em 1988.Em 2016, a então presidenta eleita do Brasil, Dilma Vana Rousseff, sofreu um processo de impedimento e o país passou a ser governado  pelo então vice-presidente, Michel Temer. Nas eleições presidenciais de outubro de 2018, Jair Bolsonaro foi eleito presidente da República.

Observe bookable SevenRooms slots for one local service date and party size. Excludes request-only placeholders. Optional exact local time filter. Not a reservation or hold; no restaurant-wide sold-out claim.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

date.description: Venue-local service date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

time.description: Optional exact displayed local HH:MM filter, applied to returned day slots. Pattern: ^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$.

venue.description: Known SevenRooms venue URL key, e.g. bennelong. No global name search. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,100}$.

warnings: Availability is a snapshot, not a hold. No slots means no bookable SevenRooms slots for this query, not that the restaurant is sold out.

sections.heading: Company Description
sections.html: Feldco is a leading home renewal company specializing in delighting our customers through our products: windows, siding, and doors.
sections.text: Feldco is a leading home renewal company specializing in delighting our customers through our products: windows, siding, and doors.

sections.heading: Job Description
sections.html:
We are looking for Outside Sales Representatives to join our successful, highly-motivated team at Feldco, the #1 Window, Siding and Door Company in the USA (recognized by Window and Door Magazine). We have 40 years of experience in delighting customers by making home improvement projects simple.


What We Can Offer You?


Leadership -- We are the #1 Replacement Window, Door and Siding Company in America! We take great pride in our leadership and transformation of the home improvement market. 


Growth -- We have more than quadrupled our business over the past few years and are presently expanding into more new markets.


Advancement -- We have recently promoted many internal staff members to senior management positions and offer external training.


Security -- We operate profitably and are enhancing the benefits and care of our employees.


Professionalism -- We are investing heavily in quality improvements and establishing industry-best operations.


Teamwork -- We are focused on assisting each other and working together to take care of our customers.


Location: Evergreen Park, IL


Responsibilities:

• Respond to all sales appointments and conduct in-home product demonstrations of Windows, Siding, & Doors.

• Maximize the conversion of leads to sales

• Ownership of the Customer through coordination with Feldco’s Call Center, Finance & Fulfillment departments

• Utilize sales and problem-solving skills to better serve external and internal customers

• Achieve or exceed individual sales goals and company sales metrics standards

• Ensure an exceptional and delightful experience for all Feldco customers


Additional Information


• Base salary and lucrative commission structure


• Average total compensation over $80,000 per year


• 25% of Outside Sales Representatives earning $100,000-$200,000 per year


• Unlimited earning potential


• Paid Sales training


• Industry-best customer sales leads


• Benefits - (Medical, Dental, Vision, Vol Life, STD, LTD, 401 K, and Paid Time Off)


• Career Advancement

company.description: SmartRecruiters company identifier: the first path segment of jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<company> (e.g. ServiceNow, BoschGroup). find_companies resolves a name to it. Matched case-insensitively upstream. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,99}$.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call; omit to start. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,5}(\.[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5})?$.

location.description: Case-insensitive text matched against each posting's location (city, region, country, or the career-site group heading), e.g. Bangalore.

name.description: Business name, trade name or trademark text. The site matches every record whose name has a word starting with this text (a multi-word text as a phrase), case-insensitive, and caps the result set at a few hundred records: `Animal Clinic` (about 330 rows) passes, common words such as `Denver`, `Veterinary` or `Animal Hospital` exceed the cap and fail with invalid_input (issue code too_many_matches). There is no status, city, county or address filter to narrow with; add a distinguishing word of the name instead.

response.overview:
Magnum Opus: A Private Collection of Exceptional Art and Objects Through the Ages has been conceived as four distinct but interconnected chapters, each organized around a unifying theme rather than a traditional category framework, reflecting the deeply cross-disciplinary nature of the collection Itself.


ACT I: The Magnum Opus Evening Auction launches the series with a selection of the collection's exceptional masterworks, bringing together fine art, ancient sculpture, Islamic works of art and courtly carpets, furniture, and decorative arts in a single auction that mirrors the collector's instinct for dialogue across Disciplines. 


Illustrating the scope of the collection, you have one of the Evening Auction’s most arresting pairings: a cuirassed marble torso of a Roman emperor, the only such example in private hands with an extensive documented provenance extending back more than two centuries, and a small, early print of Richard Avedon's celebrated portrait of Marilyn Monroe from 1957, one of the defining images of 20th century photography. Two icons of presence and power, separated by two millennia, united in a single Room.


RSVP to the live auction here.

The Workshop (L’atelier), by Pablo Picasso, 1927.

  • Pablo Picasso (Spanish, 1881-1973).
  • Etching and aquatint on Wove paper.
  • Hand-signed and numbered.
  • This work is presented unframed.


This etching is hand signed in red ink by the artist "Picasso" at the lower left margin. It is also hand numbered in red ink from the edition of 150, above the signature. It was published by Ambroise Vollard, Paris in an edition of 150 signed and numbered impressions in the 1927.


Other impressions of this subject can be found in the collections of The McNay, San Antonio, Texas; The Portland Art Museum, Oregon; The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), New York and the Brooklyn Museum, New York.

The Vollard Suite is Picasso’s most important series of etchings. Created in bouts of fervent activity between 1930 and 1937, the series was retrospectively named for Ambroise Vollard, the great Parisian print publisher and art dealer behind its creation. The wide-ranging source imagery is partially autobiographical—perhaps most apparent across the fifteen prints detailing the narrative arc of the Minotaur, the half-man, half-beast figure with whom Picasso related deeply. The art critic Robert Hughes wrote that Picasso “was the Minotaur in a canvas-and-paper labyrinth of his own construction,” and indeed to the artist, the Minotaur represented the turmoil of his own uncontrollable desires (Robert Hughes, “The Artist Pablo Picasso”, Time, 1998). That turmoil is most directly observed in the depictions of Picasso, often as the Minotaur, with Marie-Thérèse Walter, the artist's young lover, nearly thirty years his junior. 


Marie-Thérèse’s presence in the suite ranges from serving as a sculptor's model to dreaming of Ovid’s Metamorphoses. In the present image, one of the strongest and most compositionally complex in the series, she is guiding the blind and helpless Minotaur through the night. The Minotaur, who has already undergone a transformation from young and inquisitive faun to fully-fledged and wildly savage beast, has been blinded and enfeebled. The young Marie-Thérèse holds a white dove while their journey is watched by three fishermen, witnesses from the ordinary world to a bizarre mythological drama. Picasso employs every resource at his disposal: the distorted surrealist setting, the Grecian profile of Marie-Thérèse that hints at cubist depictions, and his mastery and combination of the intaglio mediums in a single image.


Minotaure aveugle guidé par Marie-Thérèse au pigeon dans une nuit étoilée is representative of Picasso's dominance of the 20th century. His fame extended past the worlds of art, politics and culture—Hughes writes that “more people have heard of him than ever heard the names, let alone saw the work, of Michelangelo, Rembrandt or Cézanne while they were alive” (Robert Hughes, “Anatomy of a Minotaur”, Time, 1998). That level of recognition befits an artist consumed as equally by genius as he was by his lust for creation. To make art was, for Picasso, to live. Much like the Minotaur, that creative lust was inherent and uncontrollable: the anguish across the face of the Minotaur in the subject work carries within it the feverish emotion and mastery of the medium that willed Pablo Picasso to his status as an icon of modern art.
