response.description:
WooCommerce Subscriptions is compatible with Cart and Checkout blocks — a customizable, conversion-optimized checkout experience available in WooCommerce core.

Multiple billing schedules available to suit your store’s needs.
Integration with over 25 payment gateways for automatic recurring payments.
Supports manual renewal payments through any WooCommerce payment gateway, along with automatic email invoices and receipts.
Supports automatic rebilling on failed subscription payments, so you never lose revenue.
Give subscribers the ability to manage their own plan, including upgrading or downgrading, without needing to wait on you for help.
Built-in renewal notifications and automatic emails let you — and your customers — know when subscription payments have been processed, so there are never any surprises.
Detailed reports allow you to keep track of recurring revenue, number of active subscribers, and more.
Allow shoppers to gift subscriptions to each other, helping you reach new shoppers and grow recurring revenue with less effort.
Include simple and variable downloadable products with your subscriptions. Link new downloadable products and manage existing ones directly from within WooCommerce Subscriptions.
New! Create multiple plans for a single product and turn one-time purchases into recurring revenue.

Capture residual revenue with recurring payments

Can you guarantee how much money your store is going to make this month? If you offered subscription-based products, you could do just that.

With WooCommerce Subscriptions, you can create and manage products with recurring payments — payments that will give you residual revenue you can track and count on.

WooCommerce Subscriptions allows you to introduce a variety of subscriptions for physical or virtual products and services. Create product-of-the-month clubs, weekly service subscriptions or even yearly software billing packages. Add sign-up fees, offer free trials, or set expiration periods.

A subscription-based model will allow you to capture more residual revenue — and all you have to do is ship the orders.

WooCommerce Subscriptions features

Reusable subscription plans

Create storewide plans — with your own frequency and pricing — and apply them across the subscription products in your store.

Flexible purchase options

Choose how each product is sold: as a one-time purchase, a subscription, or both. Offer every storewide plan, just a select few, or create custom plans unique to that product.

Free trials and sign-up fees

Let customers try before they buy, or recoup your setup costs upfront — add free trials and sign-up fees to any subscription plan.

Aligned renewals

Sync all subscribers on a plan to the same renewal date with billing date alignment — ideal for shipping on set days. You can also choose how the first payment is charged: in full, on the next billing date, or prorated.

Subscription coupons

Offer customers a discount on their recurring payments, or on the sign-up fee alone — with dedicated recurring discount coupons and sign-up fee coupons.

Gifting

Allow shoppers to buy any subscription as a gift for someone else. Recipients get their own account to manage their subscription — helping you reach new customers and grow recurring revenue.

Multiple subscriptions

Your customers can purchase different subscription products in the same transaction, and WooCommerce Subscriptions will group them by billing schedule — so future renewals process as a single order and a single payment, with fewer gateway fees.

Switching

Allow customers to upgrade, downgrade, or switch between subscription plans, variations, and products. With flexible proration for the recurring amount, sign-up fee and length, you can customize the cost of switching to suit your store.

Subscription management

Manage every subscription from your WP Admin dashboard. Suspend or cancel a subscription, change the trial end date, add products, shipping, fees, or taxes, or adjust the recurring total for future payments.

Subscriber account management

Your customers can manage their own subscriptions from their account — suspend, cancel, or reactivate, switch plans, update their shipping address, and manage their payments — so routine changes don’t turn into support requests.

Subscription emails

Both you and your customers stay in the loop with built-in subscription emails for key events: renewal receipts, invoices awaiting payment, failed payment retries, cancellations, expirations, and switches.

Subscriptions Health Check

Stay in control of renewal health. The Subscriptions Health Check routinely scans every subscription in your store and flags the ones that need attention — renewals that didn’t process on schedule, or manual subscriptions that could be renewing automatically — right from your dashboard.

Capture more residual revenue

Whether your goal is to ship a surprise bundle of products to faithful customers every month or bill them for an in-person service provided by your small business, WooCommerce Subscriptions can take the stress out of capturing that all-important residual revenue.

You’ll be able to track how many subscribers you have, when they’re being billed, and how much revenue you’re generating — meaning you’ll always know how much revenue your store can count on as you continue to grow.

How to get started

Download, install, and activate this extension in your WooCommerce store.
Set up your first subscription-based product or service and take it live.
Check out our detailed documentation to help you customize your subscription products, renewal options and more.
Sit back and enjoy earning more revenue!

response.short_description: WooCommerce Subscriptions is a WooCommerce extension that lets customers subscribe to your products or services and pay on a weekly, monthly, or annual basis. It integrates with over 25 payment gateways for automatic recurring payments and supports automatic rebilling on failed subscription payments. Subscribers can manage their own plan — upgrading, downgrading, suspending, or canceling — and update their shipping address or payment method. It’s a paid annual extension with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

post.description:
Product catalogue, prices or stock from a store running WooCommerce (WordPress shops on their own domain). Start here; get ids or slugs for get_product, category slugs from list_categories, attribute taxonomies and term slugs from list_attributes.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category.description: One category id or slug (from list_categories); includes subcategories as the store does. Pattern: ^[^,\s]+$.

max_price.description: Maximum price in major units of the store currency.

min_price.description: Minimum price in major units of the store currency (e.g. 19.99).

orderby.description: Sort key; the store's default (relevance for a query, else date) otherwise.

page.description: 1-based page; use next_page from the previous result.

query.description: Keywords matched against product title and content.

store.description: The store: a bare domain (example.com) or any URL on the store. Any WooCommerce site with the public Store API (/wp-json/wc/store/v1) enabled.

tag.description: One product tag id or slug. Pattern: ^[^,\s]+$.

items.name: WooCommerce Subscriptions
items.short_description: WooCommerce Subscriptions is a WooCommerce extension that lets customers subscribe to your products or services and pay on a weekly, monthly, or annual basis. It integrates with over 25 payment gateways for automatic recurring payments and supports automatic rebilling on failed subscription payments. Subscribers can manage their own plan — upgrading, downgrading, suspending, or canceling — and update their shipping address or payment method. It’s a paid annual extension with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

items.name: Enhancer for WooCommerce Subscriptions
items.short_description: Additional features for WooCommerce Subscriptions such as Updating Price for Existing Users, Cancel Delay, Auto-Renewal Reminder, etc.

items.name: Buy Once or Subscribe for WooCommerce Subscriptions
items.short_description: Offer one-time purchases and recurring subscription plans side by side on the same product page — no duplicate listings, no complex setup. Increase recurring revenue, reduce churn, and give every type of customer exactly the flexibility they’re looking for.

items.name: Minimum Periods for WooCommerce Subscriptions
items.short_description: Set a minimum subscription term before customers can cancel.

items.name: Custom Start Date for WooCommerce Subscriptions
items.short_description: The only extension that gives you and your customers full control over subscription start dates.

response.description_html:
At Ocean Infinity, we're on a bold mission to subsea data using innovative technology.

Using cutting-edge robotics, autonomous technology and world-class software, we're transforming how complex operations are carried out at sea. Our uncrewed systems are making ocean exploration and operations safer, smarter and more sustainable, helping unlock the vast potential of our oceans while reducing environmental impact. 🌍

This isn't a vision for the future. It's happening right now.

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and redefine what's possible in the maritime industry, we're looking for exceptional talent to join our fast-growing team.

Ocean Infinity is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help build, operate & evolve the systems, tooling & infrastructure that support our software delivery & platform operations.

In this role you'll be taking ownership of key platform components & contribute to the foundations that enable engineering teams to build, deploy & operate services reliably at scale. You'll work on improving internal tooling, strengthening observability and operational practices & ensuring teams have the self-service capabilities required to confidently manage their services.

You'll report to the Core Engineering Lead & collaborate closely with the teams across the organization providing hands-on technical support, architectural input & practical solutions that strengthen the company's core engineering platform.
response.requirements_html:
What you will do! 🚀

  • Design and evolve core platform systems, Contribute to architecture & implementation strategy of cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD & internal tooling foundations that support the operations across the organization
  • Drive High-impact Platform Improvements, Own & deliver enhancements across infrastructure, deployments & automation to improve reliability, scalability & performance
  • Build for resilience and efficiency, Develop platform capabilities that are secure, fault-tolerant & easy for product teams to adopt
  • Enhance developer productivity Create internal tools, services & workflows that aim to reduce friction & help engineers build, test and deploy faster & smoother
  • Strengthen observability and operations, Improve monitoring, logging & alerting to ensure visibility across environments and support fast, effective incident response
  • Solve complex technical challenges, Investigate & resolve issues across distributed systems, cloud services, networking & Kubernetes - & translate findings into measurable improvements
  • Collaborate across teams, Work closely with engineering and product teams to support new features, troubleshoot integration issues & ensure services run reliably on the platform
  • Evaluate and introduce new technologies, Stay current with cloud-native & DevOps ecosystems – bringing in tools & approaches that aim to improve delivery speed, reliability and developer experience
  • Promote platform standards and best practices, Help establish and reinforce patterns that lead to secure, scalable and well-operated services

What we look for!🔍

  • You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
  • You bring in 5+ years of experience working in Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps or infrastructure-focused software development
  • You have a strong experience with Cloud environments (Azure preferred) and understand the fundamentals of cloud networking, identity, compute & storage
  • You have deep, hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production – including deployments, troubleshooting, networking & day-to-day operations
  • You are comfortable running & operating containerized services at scale
  • You work confidently with infrastructure-as-code to automate deployments environments and operational workflows
  • You have experience owning, building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, internal tooling or automation that supports development operations
  • You’re comfortable troubleshooting issues across distributed systems, networking, containers and cloud services
  • You have a strong understanding of monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting and appreciate the value that a strong observability setup brings to an organization

Nice to have! ✨

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform as familiarity with modern Kubernetes configuration approaches – operators, GitOps controllers, or similar
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals, cluster lifecycle & multi-cluster patterns
  • Experience operating & supporting platforms across Azure and on-prem environments, including practical experience with Windows Servers & Linux systems
  • Solid understanding of distributed system concepts, including service networking, messaging patterns & event-driven designs
  • Good grasp of software architecture fundamentals such as CQRS, domain-driven principles & how backend services interact with modern cloud-native environments
  • Understanding of structured observability concepts – metrics, traces, logs – even if not specialized in any single stack

response.description_html:
🌍 Redefining how people live.

At Blueground, we believe that when your base is reliable, the world opens up. That’s why we’re building the world’s leading platform for living.

Every year, 350 million people move between cities—yet today’s housing options haven’t caught up with the needs of this modern, mobile generation. Blueground was built to change that.

With 40,000+ homes across the globe, available for stays from a few days to a year or more, we’re just getting started. We’re on an exponential growth path to redefine living and create an entirely new category. Our edge? Powerful proprietary tech, operational excellence, and a team that executes with speed and discipline.

 Our culture is grounded in five principles:

  • Guests First – Every decision starts with their experience.
  • Move Fast – We value speed, momentum, and action.
  • Dive In – The magic is always in the details, and we go deep.
  • Embrace Change – Change isn’t a disruption; it’s how we grow.
  • Keep It Honest – Transparency accelerates progress—and strengthens relationships.

If you’re ready to do the best work of your life and help reshape how the world lives, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Pit Stop Lead/Maintenance Technician to join our fast-growing team in Athens. This field-based role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving problems, leading by example, and ensuring every property meets the highest standards of quality and guest satisfaction.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Property Turnovers: Oversee the full apartment preparation process—from coordinating housekeeping and maintenance teams to conducting detailed inspections before guest check-ins.
  • Own Onsite Readiness: Assemble furniture, troubleshoot WiFi and tech setups, and carry out small repairs to ensure every apartment meets our standards before move-in.
  • Field Coordination & Team Supervision: Act as the go-to person in the field, managing relationships with external vendors, housekeeping staff, and building personnel to ensure seamless operations.
  • Perform Quality Control: Conduct thorough property inspections using mobile checklists, flag issues, and ensure that every space meets our cleanliness, functionality, and design expectations.
  • Hands-On Support: Step in to help with urgent needs—whether that’s swapping out furniture, fixing appliances, delivering essentials, or solving guest lockouts.
  • Drive Efficiency: Manage and maintain our corporate vans and inventory stock, ensuring supplies and tools are always available and organized.
response.requirements_html:
• 2–3 years of experience in a supervisory or team lead role—ideally in field ops, facilities, hospitality, or housekeeping
  • Comfortable performing basic handyman tasks and minor repairs
  • Physically capable of lifting 10+ kilos and being active for most of the workday
  • Tech-savvy—familiar with tools like Slack, G Suite, and mobile apps
  • Strong communicator with a customer-first mindset and a positive, can-do attitude
  • A flexible team player who thrives in a dynamic, constantly evolving environment

Additional Requirements:

  • Valid driver’s license and ability to drive company vans (van-sized vehicles)
  • Access to a personal, reliable vehicle (mileage reimbursed when used for work)
  • Willingness to work weekends and holidays, while staying within a 40-hour workweek

post.description:
You have a barcode (or a world.openfoodfacts.org product URL) and want its nutrition facts, ingredients, allergens or scores. Use `search` first when you only know a name or brand.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

barcode.description: Product barcode: GTIN-8/12/13/14 (EAN, UPC) as digits, leading zeros kept. Open Food Facts normalises codes, so the returned `barcode` may carry extra leading zeros. Exactly one of `barcode` or `url`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{8,14}$.

country.description: Two-letter country code (`cc`) the site uses for country-dependent computations such as the Nutri-Score comparison country; default `us`. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

lang.description: Two-letter language code (`lc`) for localised names; default `en`. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

url.description: A product page URL on any Open Food Facts country site, e.g. https://world.openfoodfacts.org/product/5449000000996/coca-cola or https://fr.openfoodfacts.org/produit/5449000000996. The barcode is taken from the path.

attribution.text: Data from Open Food Facts (https://world.openfoodfacts.org), licensed under the Open Database License (ODbL) with contents under the Database Contents License (DbCL); product images are CC BY-SA 3.0.

response.ingredients_text: Agua carbonatada, azúcar, colorante (E-150d), acidulante (ácido fosfórico), aromas naturales (contiene cafeína).
response.name: Coca-Cola Original

post.description:
Find products by name, brand or category, e.g. 'oat milk' sold in France, then call `product` with a hit's barcode for the full record. Use `suggest` to turn a typed category or brand into the taxonomy id the filters expect.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

brand.description: Brand tag (`coca-cola`, `oatly`); lower-case slug, `en:` prefix accepted and stripped.

category.description: Category taxonomy id (`en:oat-milks`) or bare slug (`oat-milks`); `suggest` returns these ids.

country.description: Selling country as a taxonomy id (`en:france`) or bare slug (`france`, `united-states`). Matched against `countries_tags`.

facets.description: When true, return facet counts for `brands_tags`, `nutrition_grades` and `countries_tags` (default false).

lang.description: Language the text is matched in and names are returned in; default `en`. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

page.description: 1-based page; the service refuses to page past 10000 hits, so page * page_size must stay within 10000.

query.description: Free text, e.g. `oat milk`. At least one of `query`, `country`, `category`, `brand`, `nutriscore_grade`, `nova_group` is required.

sort.description: `relevance` (default; score order), `popularity` (unique scans, descending) or `recent` (last edit, descending).

attribution.text: Data from Open Food Facts (https://world.openfoodfacts.org), licensed under the Open Database License (ODbL) with contents under the Database Contents License (DbCL); product images are CC BY-SA 3.0.

replies.author: Allakhazam

Like 1% of the server population seems to understand how attack power works.

Basically it's like this, the slower the weapon, no matter what it is, 1h, 2h, bow, etc, the higher the boost from attack power.  So a 50dps 2hander with a speed of 5, would outdamage a 80dps 2hander with a speed of 3 when it comes to instant attack specials like mortal strike.  Now the regular hits from the 80dps 2hander would make up a little ground, but not nearly enough to combat the huge bonus for slow weapons.

Point is, Ashbringer sucks for mortal strike warriors.  It's a dream weapon for a fury 2h warrior tho

replies.author: Allakhazam

            "body_markup": "Why is this useless for a Rogue?",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281712,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-07T03:26:29-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281712"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "Having 115 max damage, 1.9 speed, and it being main hand only kind of pooches it for combat rogues.  Remember, us combat rogues look for high max damage and slow speed weapons to hit off those nice sinister strikes.  However, if this was one-handed, i'"'"'d cry, and then get it for my off-hand.",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281716,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-07T03:39:17-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281716"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "for the same reason Ashbringer sucks for a warrior; speed.",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281715,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-07T04:03:07-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281715"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "Don'"'"'t forget that it not only does normal damage, but also Nature damage.\n44 - 115 Damage\tSpeed 1.90\n[b]+ 16 - 30 Nature Damage[/b]\n\n\nPlus its Proc\n[i]Chance On Hit: Blasts your enemy with lightning, dealing 300 Nature\ndamage and then jumping to additional nearby\nenemies. Each jump reduces that victim'"'"'s Nature\nresistance by -25. Affects 5 targets. Your target\nis also consumed by a cyclone, slowing its attack\nspeed by -25% for 12 seconds.[/i]\n\nI wouldn'"'"'t mind having this sword though.",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281720,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-07T08:45:37-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281720"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "3.0 speed on a 2 hander is decent .... and ashbringer rocks for any MS warrior",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281718,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-07T09:48:51-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281718"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "No it doesn'"'"'t. Even with 88 DPS, it gets inferior to slower weapons with lower DPS.",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281717,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-07T13:55:32-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281717"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "Like 1% of the server population seems to understand how attack power works.\n\nBasically it'"'"'s like this, the slower the weapon, no matter what it is, 1h, 2h, bow, etc, the higher the boost from attack power.  So a 50dps 2hander with a speed of 5, would outdamage a 80dps 2hander with a speed of 3 when it comes to instant attack specials like mortal strike.  Now the regular hits from the 80dps 2hander would make up a little ground, but not nearly enough to combat the huge bonus for slow weapons.\n\nPoint is, Ashbringer sucks for mortal strike warriors.  It'"'"'s a dream weapon for a fury 2h warrior tho",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281719,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-07T17:59:12-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281719"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "run the calculations.  +elemental damage is actually counted in with the DPS.",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281713,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-07T21:07:16-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281713"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "1) It'"'"'s a sword -- dagger types won'"'"'t like the loss of abilities from it.\n\n2)  It'"'"'s damage is 44-115 so sword types, that use SS a lot, won'"'"'t like the low SS yield from it.\n\n3)  It'"'"'s procs -- It'"'"'s an AoE effect \"up to 5 enemies\" -- great... soloing you now can tank whatever'"'"'s in the area when it goes off, grouping, let'"'"'s see your tank keep aggro on a multi-pull with you using it, raiding -- etc...\n\nIn other words it'"'"'d be a nice main tank 1h weapon to help get the attention of everything in the area but for rogues, who rely on in-fighting, speedy attacks and NOT getting a lot of attention while",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,
            "id": 1281721,
            "posted_at": "2005-07-08T08:27:44-05:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281721"
          },
          {
            "author": "Allakhazam",
            "body_markup": "um this PWNS for a rouge... srry u a noob but ur prbly lev 40 or something",
            "comment_id": 3071632,
            "data_tree": 1,

            "posted_at": "2006-03-03T04:32:46-06:00",
            "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019#comments:id=3071632:reply=1281714"
          }
        ],
        "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=19019"
      },

posts.author: ElhonnaDS
posts.body_markup:
Just a public service announcement- be careful how much information you give when friending people you don't know.  The Battletag system is anonymous, but a lot of times people will start phishing for e-mails, real names, facebook pages, etc.  They could just be super friendly, or they could be phishing for account info, or they could be mentally unstable people who you don't want to have that kind of info. 

That being said, I do have a number of battletag friends I met on wowhead, and it can be a great place to meet people.  But these were people who I knew from the forums for months or even years beforehand.  

On the other hand, I have given my battletag on an occasion or two to people who were really new and had a lot of questions, in an attempt to be a resource, and the results have been...interesting- lol. Certainly, if you don't give out any other info battletags are pretty harmless, though.

[toc]

World of Warcraft: Forever brings massive changes to all classes, and for Retribution Paladin this is especially the case. Retribution is getting some desperately-needed love and attention, from new abilities and spells, to improvements & changes for existing ones. 

[pad]

[h2 type=bar toc="Changes in Forever"]Changes to Retribution Paladin in WoW Forever[/h2]
[pad]
[pad]

Previously, Retribution Paladin was a rather weak class with little class identity and modest support offerings to raid and party members. Forever seeks to address these issues with the introduction of a revitalized talent tree, new spells & abilities, and has reworked existing ones to make them much more powerful and substantial. 

[h3 toc="New Abilities"]New Abilities and Talents in WoW Forever[/h3]

Of the new abilities and talents, the most interesting and impactful are surely [b]Holy Strike[/b] - our new instant attack which deals Holy damage - and [b]Twist of Light[/b], our current Retribution talent tree capstone that allows you to benefit from two seals on a single auto-attack by weaving back and forth between them. 

[center]
[table class=grid width=75%]

[tr][td width=20%]Spell[/td][td]Description[/td][/tr]

[tr][td][spell=10333][/td][td]A new instant attack that deals Holy damage based on weapon damage and spell power; similar to Crusader Strike. A new mainstay primary ability for damage-dealing. [/td][/tr]

response.body_markup:
[db=classicplus]Many World of Warcraft: Classic players looked forward to horizontal progression in World of Warcraft: Forever, and the Legacy Points system delivers just that. Players earn Legacy Points by completing tasks such as leveling characters, leveling professions, completing dungeons, and more. From there, players spend those points in any of the three Legacy Trees to unlock account-wide perks and benefits. Then, as you earn and spend points, you'll also unlock various cosmetics at different milestones. 

[center][cta-button guide=34790 border=strong icon=inv_jewelry_amulet_03]Legacy System Guide[/cta-button][/center]

[h2 type=bar toc="Legacy Challenges"]Legacy System Challenges[/h2]

Here's a quick rundown of all of the Legacy System Challenges that you can complete to earn points: 

[ul]
[li]Leveling all classes to 25, 45, and 60. [/li]
[li]Leveling all professions to 150, 225, and 300. [/li]
[li]PvP Honor Ranking[/li]
[li]Exalted Reputation with Battleground factions[/li]
[li]Complete dungeons[/li]
[li]Complete raids[/li]
[li]Explore Azeroth[/li]
[li]And More! [/li][/ul]

Each of these will award 1 Legacy Point. 

[h2 type=bar toc="Legacy Tree"]Legacy System Tree[/h2]

After you earn these points, you can spend them in the three Legacy Trees: Professions, Adventure, and Resourcefulness. Below is a complete menu of all of the offerings, as well as our Legacy System Calculator. You can unlearn your Legacy Tree talent points at a class trainer for [money=100000].

[center][cta-button=legacy-calculator border=strong url https://www.wowhead.com/forever/legacy-calculator]Legacy System Calculator[/cta-button][/center]
[pad]
[tabs name=legacytree uniform=true]

[tab name=Professions]

[center][table class=grid]
[tr background=black]
[td width=25%][b]Perk[/b][/td]
[td width=10%][b]Ranks[/b][/td]
[td][b]Description[/b][/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Working Overtime[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]Increases the chance to gain a skill point from primary, secondary, and class tradeskills by 4%.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Bountiful Harvest[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]Increases the amount of Scarce materials gathered from Mining, Herbalism, and Skinning by 20%.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Performance Bonus[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]Grants a 5% chance to receive 100% additional Merchant's Favor when turning in a supply crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Luremaster[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]While using a fishing lure, you have a 25% chance to catch an additional fish.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Master Chef[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]Cooking recipes have a 10% chance to create an additional item.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Dedicated Study[/td]
[td]TBD[/td]
[td]Raises your lowest primary or secondary tradeskill by 1. Once both primary tradeskills and all three secondary tradeskills reach 300, grants 2–4 random Elemental Essences instead. 25 sec cast, 23 hr cooldown.[/td]
[/tr]

[/table][/center]

[/tab]

[tab name=Adventure]

[center][table class=grid]
[tr background=black]
[td width=25%][b]Perk[/b][/td]
[td width=10%][b]Ranks[/b][/td]
[td][b]Description[/b][/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Well Rested[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]Your rested experience accumulates 4% faster, and your rested experience cap is increased by 4%.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Talented[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]You gain talent points every level starting at level 9 instead of level 10, but you may still have no more than 51 total talent points.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]High Alert[/td]
[td]2[/td]
[td]Increases your ability to detect nearby targets with Stealth as if your level were increased by 1. Ineffective in battlegrounds.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Thrill of Adventure[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]You gain 1% of your maximum Health and Mana over 10 sec each time you deliver the killing blow to a non-trivial enemy. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Field Guide[/td]
[td]3[/td]
[td]Reduces the cooldown on adding Camp features by 8%.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Frequent Flier[/td]
[td]1[/td]
[td]Flight paths cost 50% less, and your flight path mount flies 20% faster.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Field Medicine[/td]
[td]2[/td]
[td]Reduces the duration of Recently Bandaged by 5 sec when you use a Bandage. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.[/td]
[/tr]

[/table][/center]

[/tab]

[tab name=Resourcefulness]

[td]Increases your movement speed while dead by 5%. After being resurrected, your helpful spells and abilities cost no resources for 1 min or until you enter combat.[/td]

[tr]

[/tr]

[tr]
[td]Gourmand[/td]
[td]3[/td]

[/tr]

[/tabs]

When you reach 15, 25, 40, and 55 Legacy Points, you'll unlock various cosmetics, including the Reins of the Spectral Bear at 55 points.

items.content_html:
In World of Warcraft: Forever, players must purchase new and upgraded ranks of their abilities from their class trainers. When you purchase a new spell rank as a mana user, though, or as a melee class that uses mana-based abilities, it may not automatically update to the highest rank you have on your action bars.

Reminder: update your spell ranks
Melee players like Rogues and Warriors won't need to worry about accidental downranking of their abilities, since their action bars will update automatically when a higher-ranked ability is learned. Other classes, however, have had the option of downranking their spells for lower costs at the expense of damage.

Double-check and make sure your spell ranks are correct. Just because you purchased it does not mean it's on your action bars already.

The default UI for your Spellbook will not show lower ranks. To see lower ranks, hover over the down arrow at the top right and then select the option to show all ranks of spells.

In WoW Forever, unlike modern World of Warcraft, spells don't automatically update their ranks when you buy them for mana users.

Many World of Warcraft: Classic players looked forward to horizontal progression in World of Warcraft: Forever, and the Legacy Points system delivers just that. Players earn Legacy Points by completing tasks such as leveling characters, leveling professions, completing dungeons, and more. From there, players spend those points in any of the three Legacy Trees to unlock account-wide perks and benefits. Then, as you earn and spend points, you'll also unlock various cosmetics at different milestones.

Complete raids

And More!

items.content_html:
Blizzard has released an article detailing the various classes, race/class combinations, and racial abilities each race possesses in World of Warcraft: Forever.

Race and class shape the hero you become in World of Warcraft: Forever, from the fantasy you embody to the role you take on in the world. You can return to a familiar favorite, explore a newly available combination, or begin your journey as a Skyborne character, with each choice offering a different way to step into Azeroth’s next chapter.

The Skyborne are a new playable race in World of Warcraft: Forever, bringing their own identity to the unfolding story. When choosing to play this new race, players can choose between Horde-aligned Windshapers which can become Shaman, or an Alliance-aligned High-Order Skyborne which can become Mages.

Meet the Classes

When creating your character, it’s worth considering both the class you want to play and the race that can become that class. The nine available classes each bring their own abilities and roles to the adventure, whether you prefer healing allies, dealing damage, protecting your group, or shifting between multiple roles with a few tradeoffs along the way. Choose wisely—the path you set your feet upon will shape the hero you become.
Druid: Druids live in a state of unparalleled union with nature. Tightly bound to the plant and animal kingdoms, they are natural shapeshifters, and so they know firsthand the abuse visited on their wild brethren. In consequence, despite their numbers, druids tend to be wary, reclusive, and difficult to spot. Few outsiders have plumbed the depths of their secrets.

Hunter: Hunters know the uncharted places of the world. Gifted with a deep empathy for all life, they have an uncanny knack for befriending wild animals and taming them as pets. In addition, hunters can use their finely honed senses to become master trackers. Wherever hunters go, they fight back the ravages of sickness, exploitation, and industrialization.

Mage: Magi are wizards of immense knowledge and skill. Their obvious physical frailty is deceptive, for they can call upon the cosmic energies of the Twisting Nether. Rarely do the magi engage in melee combat. Instead, they prefer to attack from a distance, hurling powerful bolts of frost and flame at their unsuspecting enemies.

Paladin: Paladins do battle to protect the world from the forces of shadow. Powerful warriors in their own right, they can also call upon the Light to heal wounds, create shields of force, and incinerate evil creatures.

Priest: Priests guide the spiritual destiny of their people. Through their unique insight into the mind, they are able to shape an individual’s beliefs, whether to inspire or terrify, soothe or dominate, heal or harm. Just as the heart can hold both darkness and light, priests wield powers of creation and devastation by channeling the potent forces underlying faith.

Rogue: Rogues are most successful when their deeds never come to light. Fond of poisons and silent projectile weapons, rogues rely on a blend of stealth and minor mysticism. Usually in the employ of rich nobles or local governments, the rogue redistributes wealth or eliminates designated targets. A rogue’s allegiance lasts only as long as the latest contract.

Shaman: Shaman commune directly with the elements. Their combination of wisdom and resilience makes them ideal as community advisors and leaders. In battle the shaman use totems and spells to manipulate the elements and provoke other fighters to untold heights of rage and might. Shaman exemplify the prima bond between the mortal races and their environment.

Warlock: Warlocks are the bane of all life. Empowered by demonic blood, they can inflict great torment upon their foes. To replenish the dreadful energy their spells expend, warlocks drain vitality from their victims. The warlock can also summon and control terrifying demonic entities. Still, warlocks are feared above all else for their singular wickedness and cruelty.

Warrior: Warriors train constantly and strive for perfection in armed combat. Though they come from all walks of life, they are united by their singular commitment to engage in glorious battle. Many warriors serve as mercenary soldiers, while others become adventurers and danger-seeking fortune hunters. A typical warrior is strong, tough, and exceptionally violent.

New and Notable Combinations

World of Warcraft: Forever opens new ways to build your character, including Orc Mages, Troll Warlocks, Undead Paladins, Human Hunters, Gnome Priests, Dwarf Shamans, and the debut of the Skyborne.

Racial Traits

Each playable race has its own racial traits, offering additional flavor and utility alongside your chosen class as you adventure through Azeroth.

Some racial traits have also been updated for World of Warcraft: Forever, with adjustments that better support the expanded class options and give each race a stronger sense of identity. These updates preserve the spirit of each race while helping their traits feel at home in this new era of adventure.

Horde

The proud nations of the Horde are loosely joined in an alliance of convenience against a hostile world that would see them destroyed.

Focused, ferocious, and sometimes monstrous, the Horde values strength and honor, but struggles to keep aggression in check. Join the Horde and fight to build a world where their people can live free. Orc

The Orc race originated on the planet Draenor. A peaceful people with shamanic beliefs, they were enslaved by the Burning Legion and forced into war with the humans of Azeroth. Although it took many years, the orcs finally escaped the demons’ corruption and won their freedom. To this day they fight for honor in an alien world that hates and reviles them.
Blood Fury: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 seconds.

Shatter Curse: Immunity to Curses and Banes and reduce Magical damage taken for 8 seconds.

Axe Specialization (Passive): Axes increase spell and ability critical chance by 1%.

Hardiness (Passive): Stun durations decreased by 20%.
Undead

Free of the Lich King’s grasp, the Forsaken seek to overthrow his rule. Led by the banshee Sylvanas, they hunger for vengeance against the Scourge. Humans, too, have become the enemy, relentless in their drive to purge all undead from the land. The Forsaken care little even for their allies; to them the Horde is merely a tool that may further their dark schemes.
Will of the Forsaken: Removes Charm, Fear, and Sleep.

Cannibalize: Consume corpses to regenerate 35% Health and Mana over time.

Underwater Breathing (Passive): Breathe 300% longer underwater.

Touch of the Grave (Passive): Sometimes drain health with your attacks.
Tauren

Always the tauren strive to preserve the balance of nature and heed the will of their goddess, the Earth Mother. Recently attacked by murderous centaur, the tauren would have been wiped out, save for a chance encounter with the orcs, who helped defeat the interlopers. To honor this blood-debt, the tauren joined the Horde, solidifying the two races’ friendship.
War Stomp: Stuns nearby enemies for 2 seconds.

Cultivation: Grow bonus herbs that don’t require herbalism to gather.

Plainsrunning (Passive): Gain increased movement speed the longer you stay moving.

Endurance (Passive): Total Health increased by 5% and Hit Chance increased by 1%.
Troll

Once at home in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale, the fierce trolls of the Darkspear tribe were pushed out by warring factions. Eventually the trolls befriended the orcish Horde and Thrall, the orcs’ young warchief convinced the trolls to travel with him to Kalimdor. Though they cling to their shadowy heritage, the Darkspear trolls hold a place of honor in the Horde.
Berserking: Increases casting and attack speed by 10% for 10 seconds.

Rapid Regeneration: Regenerate 50% of maximum Health over time.

Beast Slaying (Passive): Damage to Beasts increased by 5%.

Regeneration (Passive): 10% of Health regeneration continues during combat.
Windshaper Skyborne

The Windshapers are the descendants of the first shen’dorei high elves to receive the wind spirits’ gift of elemental skysight. A new generation of Windshapers is called to Azeroth from their home within Skywall to solve the mystery of what became of their missing elemental mentors and will stop at nothing to see the wind spirits restored and their way of life preserved.
Walk on Air: Glide downward through the air for 10 seconds.

Skysight: Receive an Elemental Blessing increasing run speed by 10%.

Wind Blessed (Passive): 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.

Elemental Insight (Passive): Damage to Elementals increased by 5%.

Alliance

The noble races of the Alliance are bound together by proud traditions of nobility, honor, faith, justice, and sacrifice.

The many different Alliance peoples all contribute their technical, arcane, and spiritual wisdom toward the goal of a peaceful and just world.

Take up their banner to represent the high ideals of the Alliance throughout Azeroth and beyond. Human

Humans are a young race, and thus highly versatile, mastering the arts of combat, craftsmanship, and magic with stunning efficiency. The humans’ valor and optimism have led them to build some of the world’s greatest kingdoms. In this troubled era, after generations of conflict, humanity seeks to rekindle its former glory and forge a shining new future.
Will to Survive: Remove Stuns.

Perception: Detect Stealthed enemies for 20 seconds.

Sword Specialization (Passive): Swords increase spell and ability critical chance by 2%.

The Human Spirit (Passive): 5% increased Spirit.
Dwarf

In ages past the dwarves cared only for riches taken from the earth’s depths. Then records surfaced of a god-like race said to have given the dwarves life… and an enchanted birthright. Driven to learn more, the dwarves devoted themselves to the pursuit of lost artifacts and ancient knowledge. Today dwarven archaeologists are scattered throughout the globe.
Stoneform: Immunity to Bleeds, Poisons, and Diseases and reduce Physical damage taken for 8 seconds.

Find Treasure: Track nearby treasure chests.

Mace Specialization (Passive): Maces increase spell and ability critical chance by 1%.

Big Game Hunter (Passive) Damage to Beasts increased by 5%.
Night Elf

Ten thousand years ago, the night elves founded a vast empire, but their reckless use of primal magic brought them to ruin. In grief, they withdrew to the forests and remained isolated there until the return of their ancient enemy, the Burning Legion. With no other choice, the night elves emerged at last from their seclusion to fight for their place in the new world.
Elune’s Light: Increases critical chance by 10% for 15 seconds.

Shadowmeld: Gain Stealth while immobile.

Quickness (Passive): 1% increased Dodge chance and 2% increased run speed.

Wisp Spirit (Passive): 75% increased run speed while dead.
Gnome

Though small in stature, the gnomes of Khaz Modan have used their great intellect to secure a place in history. Indeed, their subterranean kingdom, Gnomeregan, was once a marvel of steam-driven technology. Even so, due to a massive trogg invasion, the city was lost. Now its builders are vagabonds in the dwarven lands, aiding their allies as best they can.
Escape Artist: Brief Immunity to Roots and Snares.

Eureka!: Reduced cost and 10% increased damage or healing on next 3 spells or abilities.

Expansive Mind (Passive) Maximum Mana, Rage, or Energy increased by 5%.

Engineering Specialization (Passive): More reliable engineering devices.
High Order Skyborne

The High Order is made up of the descendants of the ancient Highborne scholars of Eldre’Thalas. When the wind spirits disappeared from Zephras Isle, the High Order realized that the Skyborne’s utter dependence upon their elemental patrons had left them dangerously vulnerable. A new generation of High Order have now been called upon to return to Azeroth to reclaim the arcane knowledge that they have lost, and use that power to ensure that the shen’dorei have the self-reliance to survive on their own.
Walk on Air: Glide downward through the air for 10 seconds.

Read Ley Line: Activate a ley line to gain 100% increased Health and Mana regeneration.

Wind Blessed (Passive); 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.

Elemental Insight (Passive): Damage to Elementals increased by 5%.

With new choices to explore and classic favorites to revisit, World of Warcraft: Forever gives every hero a meaningful place to begin their next adventure.

When you purchase a new spell rank as a mana user, though, or as a melee class that uses mana-based abilities, it may not automatically update to the highest rank you have on your action bars.

Reminder: update your spell ranks
Melee players like Rogues and Warriors won'"'"'t need to worry about accidental downranking of their abilities, since their action bars will update automatically when a higher-ranked ability is learned. Other classes, however, have had the option of downranking their spells for lower costs at the expense of damage.

Double-check and make sure your spell ranks are correct. Just because you purchased it does not mean it'"'"'s on your action bars already.

The default UI for your Spellbook will not show lower ranks. To see lower ranks, hover over the down arrow at the top right and then select the option to show all ranks of spells.

Players earn Legacy Points by completing tasks such as leveling characters, leveling professions, completing dungeons, and more. From there, players spend those points in any of the three Legacy Trees to unlock account-wide perks and benefits. Then, as you earn and spend points, you'"'"'ll also unlock various cosmetics at different milestones.

Legacy System Guide

Legacy System Challenges

Here'"'"'s a quick rundown of all of the Legacy System Challenges that you can complete to earn points:

Leveling all classes to 25, 45, and 60.

Leveling all professions to 150, 225, and 300.

PvP Honor Ranking

Exalted Reputation with Battleground factions

Complete dungeons

Complete raids

Explore Azeroth

And More!

Each of these will award 1 Legacy Point.

Legacy System Tree

Continue reading »", "title": "How do Legacy Points Work in WoW: Forever?", "url": "https://www.wowhead.com/news=383029/how-do-legacy-points-work-in-wow-forever" }, { "category": "Forever", "content_html": "Blizzard has released an article detailing the various classes, race/class combinations, and racial abilities each race possesses in World of Warcraft: Forever.

Race and class shape the hero you become in World of Warcraft: Forever, from the fantasy you embody to the role you take on in the world. You can return to a familiar favorite, explore a newly available combination, or begin your journey as a Skyborne character, with each choice offering a different way to step into Azeroth’s next chapter.

The Skyborne are a new playable race in World of Warcraft: Forever, bringing their own identity to the unfolding story. When choosing to play this new race, players can choose between Horde-aligned Windshapers which can become Shaman, or an Alliance-aligned High-Order Skyborne which can become Mages.

Meet the Classes

When creating your character, it’s worth considering both the class you want to play and the race that can become that class. The nine available classes each bring their own abilities and roles to the adventure, whether you prefer healing allies, dealing damage, protecting your group, or shifting between multiple roles with a few tradeoffs along the way. Choose wisely—the path you set your feet upon will shape the hero you become.
Druid: Druids live in a state of unparalleled union with nature. Tightly bound to the plant and animal kingdoms, they are natural shapeshifters, and so they know firsthand the abuse visited on their wild brethren. In consequence, despite their numbers, druids tend to be wary, reclusive, and difficult to spot. Few outsiders have plumbed the depths of their secrets.

Hunter: Hunters know the uncharted places of the world. Gifted with a deep empathy for all life, they have an uncanny knack for befriending wild animals and taming them as pets. In addition, hunters can use their finely honed senses to become master trackers. Wherever hunters go, they fight back the ravages of sickness, exploitation, and industrialization.

Mage: Magi are wizards of immense knowledge and skill. Their obvious physical frailty is deceptive, for they can call upon the cosmic energies of the Twisting Nether. Rarely do the magi engage in melee combat. Instead, they prefer to attack from a distance, hurling powerful bolts of frost and flame at their unsuspecting enemies.

Paladin: Paladins do battle to protect the world from the forces of shadow. Powerful warriors in their own right, they can also call upon the Light to heal wounds, create shields of force, and incinerate evil creatures.

Priest: Priests guide the spiritual destiny of their people. Through their unique insight into the mind, they are able to shape an individual’s beliefs, whether to inspire or terrify, soothe or dominate, heal or harm. Just as the heart can hold both darkness and light, priests wield powers of creation and devastation by channeling the potent forces underlying faith.

Rogue: Rogues are most successful when their deeds never come to light. Fond of poisons and silent projectile weapons, rogues rely on a blend of stealth and minor mysticism. Usually in the employ of rich nobles or local governments, the rogue redistributes wealth or eliminates designated targets. A rogue’s allegiance lasts only as long as the latest contract.

Shaman: Shaman commune directly with the elements. Their combination of wisdom and resilience makes them ideal as community advisors and leaders. In battle the shaman use totems and spells to manipulate the elements and provoke other fighters to untold heights of rage and might. Shaman exemplify the prima bond between the mortal races and their environment.

Warlock: Warlocks are the bane of all life. Empowered by demonic blood, they can inflict great torment upon their foes. To replenish the dreadful energy their spells expend, warlocks drain vitality from their victims. The warlock can also summon and control terrifying demonic entities. Still, warlocks are feared above all else for their singular wickedness and cruelty.

Warrior: Warriors train constantly and strive for perfection in armed combat. Though they come from all walks of life, they are united by their singular commitment to engage in glorious battle. Many warriors serve as mercenary soldiers, while others become adventurers and danger-seeking fortune hunters. A typical warrior is strong, tough, and exceptionally violent.

New and Notable Combinations

World of Warcraft: Forever opens new ways to build your character, including Orc Mages, Troll Warlocks, Undead Paladins, Human Hunters, Gnome Priests, Dwarf Shamans, and the debut of the Skyborne.

Racial Traits

Each playable race has its own racial traits, offering additional flavor and utility alongside your chosen class as you adventure through Azeroth.

Some racial traits have also been updated for World of Warcraft: Forever, with adjustments that better support the expanded class options and give each race a stronger sense of identity. These updates preserve the spirit of each race while helping their traits feel at home in this new era of adventure.

Horde

The proud nations of the Horde are loosely joined in an alliance of convenience against a hostile world that would see them destroyed.

Focused, ferocious, and sometimes monstrous, the Horde values strength and honor, but struggles to keep aggression in check. Join the Horde and fight to build a world where their people can live free. Orc

The Orc race originated on the planet Draenor. A peaceful people with shamanic beliefs, they were enslaved by the Burning Legion and forced into war with the humans of Azeroth. Although it took many years, the orcs finally escaped the demons’ corruption and won their freedom. To this day they fight for honor in an alien world that hates and reviles them.
Blood Fury: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 seconds.

Shatter Curse: Immunity to Curses and Banes and reduce Magical damage taken for 8 seconds.

Axe Specialization (Passive): Axes increase spell and ability critical chance by 1%.

Hardiness (Passive): Stun durations decreased by 20%.
Undead

Free of the Lich King’s grasp, the Forsaken seek to overthrow his rule. Led by the banshee Sylvanas, they hunger for vengeance against the Scourge. Humans, too, have become the enemy, relentless in their drive to purge all undead from the land. The Forsaken care little even for their allies; to them the Horde is merely a tool that may further their dark schemes.
Will of the Forsaken: Removes Charm, Fear, and Sleep.

Cannibalize: Consume corpses to regenerate 35% Health and Mana over time.

Underwater Breathing (Passive): Breathe 300% longer underwater.

Touch of the Grave (Passive): Sometimes drain health with your attacks.
Tauren

Always the tauren strive to preserve the balance of nature and heed the will of their goddess, the Earth Mother. Recently attacked by murderous centaur, the tauren would have been wiped out, save for a chance encounter with the orcs, who helped defeat the interlopers. To honor this blood-debt, the tauren joined the Horde, solidifying the two races’ friendship.
War Stomp: Stuns nearby enemies for 2 seconds.

Cultivation: Grow bonus herbs that don’t require herbalism to gather.

Plainsrunning (Passive): Gain increased movement speed the longer you stay moving.

Endurance (Passive): Total Health increased by 5% and Hit Chance increased by 1%.
Troll

Once at home in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale, the fierce trolls of the Darkspear tribe were pushed out by warring factions. Eventually the trolls befriended the orcish Horde and Thrall, the orcs’ young warchief convinced the trolls to travel with him to Kalimdor. Though they cling to their shadowy heritage, the Darkspear trolls hold a place of honor in the Horde.
Berserking: Increases casting and attack speed by 10% for 10 seconds.

Rapid Regeneration: Regenerate 50% of maximum Health over time.

Beast Slaying (Passive): Damage to Beasts increased by 5%.

Regeneration (Passive): 10% of Health regeneration continues during combat.
Windshaper Skyborne

The Windshapers are the descendants of the first shen’dorei high elves to receive the wind spirits’ gift of elemental skysight. A new generation of Windshapers is called to Azeroth from their home within Skywall to solve the mystery of what became of their missing elemental mentors and will stop at nothing to see the wind spirits restored and their way of life preserved.
Walk on Air: Glide downward through the air for 10 seconds.

Skysight: Receive an Elemental Blessing increasing run speed by 10%.

Wind Blessed (Passive): 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.

Elemental Insight (Passive): Damage to Elementals increased by 5%.

Alliance

The noble races of the Alliance are bound together by proud traditions of nobility, honor, faith, justice, and sacrifice.

The many different Alliance peoples all contribute their technical, arcane, and spiritual wisdom toward the goal of a peaceful and just world.

Take up their banner to represent the high ideals of the Alliance throughout Azeroth and beyond. Human

Humans are a young race, and thus highly versatile, mastering the arts of combat, craftsmanship, and magic with stunning efficiency. The humans’ valor and optimism have led them to build some of the world’s greatest kingdoms. In this troubled era, after generations of conflict, humanity seeks to rekindle its former glory and forge a shining new future.
Will to Survive: Remove Stuns.

Perception: Detect Stealthed enemies for 20 seconds.

Sword Specialization (Passive): Swords increase spell and ability critical chance by 2%.

The Human Spirit (Passive): 5% increased Spirit.
Dwarf

In ages past the dwarves cared only for riches taken from the earth’s depths. Then records surfaced of a god-like race said to have given the dwarves life… and an enchanted birthright. Driven to learn more, the dwarves devoted themselves to the pursuit of lost artifacts and ancient knowledge. Today dwarven archaeologists are scattered throughout the globe.
Stoneform: Immunity to Bleeds, Poisons, and Diseases and reduce Physical damage taken for 8 seconds.

Find Treasure: Track nearby treasure chests.

Mace Specialization (Passive): Maces increase spell and ability critical chance by 1%.

Big Game Hunter (Passive) Damage to Beasts increased by 5%.
Night Elf

Ten thousand years ago, the night elves founded a vast empire, but their reckless use of primal magic brought them to ruin. In grief, they withdrew to the forests and remained isolated there until the return of their ancient enemy, the Burning Legion. With no other choice, the night elves emerged at last from their seclusion to fight for their place in the new world.
Elune’s Light: Increases critical chance by 10% for 15 seconds.

Shadowmeld: Gain Stealth while immobile.

Quickness (Passive): 1% increased Dodge chance and 2% increased run speed.

Wisp Spirit (Passive): 75% increased run speed while dead.
Gnome

Though small in stature, the gnomes of Khaz Modan have used their great intellect to secure a place in history. Indeed, their subterranean kingdom, Gnomeregan, was once a marvel of steam-driven technology. Even so, due to a massive trogg invasion, the city was lost. Now its builders are vagabonds in the dwarven lands, aiding their allies as best they can.
Escape Artist: Brief Immunity to Roots and Snares.

Eureka!: Reduced cost and 10% increased damage or healing on next 3 spells or abilities.

Expansive Mind (Passive) Maximum Mana, Rage, or Energy increased by 5%.

Engineering Specialization (Passive): More reliable engineering devices.
High Order Skyborne

The High Order is made up of the descendants of the ancient Highborne scholars of Eldre’Thalas. When the wind spirits disappeared from Zephras Isle, the High Order realized that the Skyborne’s utter dependence upon their elemental patrons had left them dangerously vulnerable. A new generation of High Order have now been called upon to return to Azeroth to reclaim the arcane knowledge that they have lost, and use that power to ensure that the shen’dorei have the self-reliance to survive on their own.

talents.change_note: Same numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 Rage.
talents.name: Improved Heroic Strike

talents.description: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.change_note: Rank 1: 12 instead of 15. Rank 2: 23 instead of 25.
talents.description: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 12%.
talents.name: Improved Rend

talents.change_note: Same numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 3.
talents.name: Improved Charge

talents.description: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 3 Rage when you change stances.
talents.name: Improved Tactical Mastery

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 3 to tier 2.
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.
talents.name: Improved Overpower

talents.change_note: Rank 1: different numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.
talents.name: Anger Management

talents.change_note: Same numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 20% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.
talents.name: Deep Wounds

talents.description: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage, plus an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets.
talents.name: Spearing Strike

talents.change_note: 3 ranks (Classic: 5).
talents.description: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.
talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization

talents.change_note: Same numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.
talents.name: Impale

talents.description: Your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 4% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec.
talents.name: Bloodthrill

talents.description: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.
talents.name: Sweeping Strikes

talents.description: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Polearm: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%. Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor. Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 1% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target.
talents.name: Weaponmaster

talents.change_note: Now in the Arms tree (Classic: Fury). 2 ranks (Classic: 5). Rank 1: different numbers, reworded. Rank 2: different numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by -0.25 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by -3.0 sec.
talents.name: Improved Slam

talents.description: Gives your Hamstring ability a 5% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
talents.name: Improved Hamstring

talents.description: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.
talents.name: Mortal Strike

talents.change_note: Rank 1: different numbers, reworded. Rank 2: different numbers, reworded. Rank 3: different numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 10% and reduces their Rage cost by 5%.
talents.name: Booming Voice

talents.change_note: Same numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 1%.
talents.name: Cruelty

talents.description: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 2 sec.
talents.name: Lingering Rage

talents.change_note: Rank 1: different numbers, reworded. Rank 2: different numbers, reworded. Rank 3: different numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Gives you a 12% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.
talents.name: Unbridled Wrath

talents.description: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 4%.
talents.name: Furious Precision

talents.change_note: Rank 1: different numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Causes all enemies within 0 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
talents.name: Piercing Howl

talents.change_note: Rank 1: different numbers, reworded. Rank 2: different numbers, reworded. Rank 3: different numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Regenerates 1% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.
talents.name: Blood Craze

talents.change_note: Rank 1: different numbers, reworded. Rank 2: different numbers, reworded. Rank 3: different numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 10%.
talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization

talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by -3.
talents.name: Raging Blows

talents.change_note: Rank 1: 30 instead of 5, 2 instead of 12, reworded. Rank 2: 30 instead of 10, 4 instead of 12, reworded. Rank 3: 30 instead of 15, 6 instead of 12, reworded.
talents.description: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 2% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.
talents.name: Enrage

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 4 to tier 4. Rank 1: 3 instead of 2.
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 3.
talents.name: Improved Execute

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 6 to tier 5. Rank 1: different numbers, reworded. Rank 2: different numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 5 Rage and has a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.
talents.name: Improved Berserker Rage

talents.change_note: Rank 1: 5 instead of 20, reworded.
talents.description: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.
talents.name: Death Wish

talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 5 sec.
talents.name: Improved Intercept

talents.description: Increases your melee attack speed by 5% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
talents.name: Flurry

talents.description: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 0.5% of your maximum Health.
talents.name: Gore Drinker

talents.change_note: Rank 1: 30 instead of 5, 10 instead of 8, reworded.
talents.description: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.
talents.name: Bloodthirst

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 2 to tier 1. Rank 1: 25 instead of 2, reworded. Rank 2: 50 instead of 5, reworded.
talents.description: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 25%.
talents.name: Improved Bloodrage

talents.change_note: Rank 1: 5 instead of 1, reworded. Rank 2: 5 instead of 1, reworded. Rank 3: 5 instead of 1, reworded.
talents.description: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 1% and grants you a 20% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.
talents.name: Shield Specialization

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 2 to tier 1. Same numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 3%.
talents.name: Iron Will

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 1 to tier 2. Rank 1: 4 instead of 2. Rank 2: 8 instead of 4. Rank 3: 12 instead of 6.
talents.description: Increases your Defense Skill by 4.
talents.name: Anticipation

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 3 to tier 2. Rank 1: different numbers, reworded. Rank 2: different numbers, reworded. Rank 3: different numbers, reworded.

talents.name: Improved Revenge

talents.description: Grants you a 50% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.
talents.name: Master of Defense

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 4 to tier 3. Rank 1: 7 instead of 1, reworded. Rank 2: 13 instead of 2, reworded. Rank 3: 20 instead of 3, reworded.
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 7 secs.
talents.name: Improved Disarm

talents.change_note: 3 ranks (Classic: 5). Rank 1: 5 instead of 3, reworded. Rank 2: 10 instead of 6, reworded.
talents.description: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 5% while a shield is equipped.

talents.change_note: Same numbers, reworded.
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 1.

talents.change_note: Moved from tier 5 to tier 4.

talents.change_note: Rank 1: 5.5 instead of 3, reworded. Rank 2: 11 instead of 5, reworded.

talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 1.

talents.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% while a shield is equipped.

response.description_html:
The central bank in Europe is called the European Central Bank (ECB). Currently, 17 EU member states have adopted the Euro. It is the second-most traded currency on the forex market, after the US Dollar, and also a major global reserve currency. Other common names for the Euro include Yoyo (Irish English), Leru (Spanish), and Ege (Finnish).

Introduction of the Euro
On January 1, 1999, the Euro (EUR) was introduced as an account currency, replacing the European Currency Unit at par. The European Currency Unit was a theoretical basket of currencies rather than a physical currency in and of itself. Initially, eleven of the countries in the European Economic and Monetary Union replaced their own currencies with the Euro: Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal, and Spain. Greece followed suit in 2001, Slovenia in 2007, Malta and Cyprus in 2008, Slovakia in 2009 and Latvia in 2014.

Use of the Euro outside the EU
A number of sovereign states that are not part of the European Union have since adopted the Euro, including the Principality of Andorra, the Principality of Monaco, the Republic of San Marino, and the Vatican City. The Euro is also used in many territories, departments, and sovereign states of Euro-zone countries, such as the Azores, Balearic Islands, the Canary Islands, Europa Island, French Guiana, Guadeloupe, Juan de Nova, the Madeira Islands, Martinique, Mayotte, Reunion, Saint-Martin, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, to name just a few. The Euro is used as a trading currency in Cuba, North Korea, and Syria and several currencies are pegged to it.

Some old currencies are still physically convertible at special locations. For details, refer to the official ECB site listed in the Relevant Links section below.

Spelling and Capitalization
The official spelling of the EUR currency unit is "euro", with a lower case "e"; however, the common industry practice is to spell it "Euro", with a capital "E". Many languages have different official spellings for the Euro, which also may or may not coincide with general use. Additionally, there are various nicknames for the currency including, Ege (Finnish), Pavo (Spanish), and Euráče (Slovak).

\r\nThe central bank in Europe is called the European Central Bank (ECB). Currently, 17 EU member states have adopted the Euro. It is the second-most traded currency on the forex market, after the US Dollar, and also a major global reserve currency. Other common names for the Euro include Yoyo (Irish English), Leru (Spanish), and Ege (Finnish).\r\n

\r\n

Introduction of the Euro\r\n
\r\nOn January 1, 1999, the Euro (EUR) was introduced as an account currency, replacing the European Currency Unit at par. The European Currency Unit was a theoretical basket of currencies rather than a physical currency in and of itself. Initially, eleven of the countries in the European Economic and Monetary Union replaced their own currencies with the Euro: Austria, Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal, and Spain. Greece followed suit in 2001, Slovenia in 2007, Malta and Cyprus in 2008, Slovakia in 2009 and Latvia in 2014.\r\n

\r\n

Use of the Euro outside the EU\r\n
\r\nA number of sovereign states that are not part of the European Union have since adopted the Euro, including the Principality of Andorra, the Principality of Monaco, the Republic of San Marino, and the Vatican City. The Euro is also used in many territories, departments, and sovereign states of Euro-zone countries, such as the Azores, Balearic Islands, the Canary Islands, Europa Island, French Guiana, Guadeloupe, Juan de Nova, the Madeira Islands, Martinique, Mayotte, Reunion, Saint-Martin, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, to name just a few. The Euro is used as a trading currency in Cuba, North Korea, and Syria and several currencies are pegged to it.\r\n

\r\n

Spelling and Capitalization\r\n
\r\nThe official spelling of the EUR currency unit is \"euro\", with a lower case \"e\"; however, the common industry practice is to spell it \"Euro\", with a capital \"E\". Many languages have different official spellings for the Euro, which also may or may not coincide with general use. Additionally, there are various nicknames for the currency including, Ege (Finnish), Pavo (Spanish), and Euráče (Slovak).\r\n

\r\n

post.description:
Search public jobs across all YC companies. Title words (e.g. intern summer 2027, founding engineer) are matched against the job title in every job URL of YC's public jobs sitemap (never the company slug), newest first; role, type, remote_allowed / remote_only, country and location filters are applied while job pages are read, so a call keeps scanning until page_size records (default 10, max 50) are found or the per-call cap of 120 job pages / 30 s is reached (scan_limited true, partial page plus next_offset). Returns excluded counts per filter and candidates_scanned. A pasted /jobs/role/<role>[/<location>] or /jobs/location/<location> URL supplies role and location.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code from the derived countries. Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

location.description: Case-insensitive text in the source location (e.g. new york), or a country name matched against derived countries.

offset.description: Candidate offset; pass next_offset from the previous call. The scan resumes right after the last candidate the previous call read, so nothing is skipped or repeated.

page_size.description: Records per call. Default 10 for title / sitemap scans and 50 (the whole page) for listing pages.

query.description: Title words; each must appear in the job title slug of the job URL (plural and -ship forms count, so intern matches internship). Company names and slugs are not matched; use the jobs function for one company. Omit to scan all jobs newest first.

remote.description: Legacy exact match on the derived remote mode: remote is the same as remote_only true (fully remote roles, including country-restricted ones such as Remote (US)); hybrid and onsite match only that mode. Prefer remote_allowed or remote_only.

remote_allowed.description: true keeps roles that accept remote work (derived remote or hybrid, i.e. remote is an option); false keeps on-site-only roles. Roles whose location does not parse are excluded either way.

remote_only.description: true keeps fully remote roles only (derived remote, including country- or region-restricted remote such as Remote (US) or Remote - Canada); false keeps hybrid and on-site roles.

type.description: Source job type. Some internships are typed Full-time at the source; query intern catches those by title.

url.description: A pasted https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs, /jobs/role/<role>[/<location>] or /jobs/location/<location> URL.

post.description:
List public jobs advertised on a YC company profile, including source salary text, location, role and requirements. Each record adds best-effort structured locations, a remote/hybrid/onsite flag and ISO country codes parsed from the location text, plus the source role slug, skills, posting age, apply link and batch. No application or contact actions.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 firecrawl_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

slug.description: Company slug from search, e.g. firecrawl. Give exactly one of slug or url. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9-]{1,120}$.

url.description: A pasted https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/<slug>/jobs (or profile) URL.
